Find the first crypt key.

The crypt is composed of three separate levels locked behind separate doors. Throughout the crypt are several graves, which when opened up can reveal a Tomb Zombie, or in special cases a unique crypt inhabitant such as Big Tom. Several Crypt Gargoyles also appear in dormant states, although they will turn hostile when looked at. Sometimes, a grave with a beneficial effect can be found within. - 344, 35, -2112: +30 Main Attack Damage for 120 seconds

lines.title: finding Leucsaa's journal
lines.text:
The solution is:
- Walk into the room with a button on an emerald block.
- Click the button two times, so that the light gray carpet in the room directly above the button is facing north (the same direction in which the button that you have to press is positioned).
- From the room with the colored carpets, go north once, down once, east once, south once, up twice, and west once to reach a room on the third floor with another button on an emerald block. 
- Press the button on the third floor once. 
- From the room with the button, go east once, south once, and then west twice to the end of the hallway, until you reach a hole in the floor. 
- Jump down two stories, kill and collect the book, and exit the mansion.

You can also use your movement spell (teleport on mage, escape on archer, charge on warrior, vanish on assassin, haul on shaman), to go through a ceiling hole.

- Aledar: Well, what are we waiting for? Let's go ahead and explore this province.
Continue through the Wynn Province to the castle
- Tasim: So this is Wynn we've all been hearing about... It's beautiful.
- Aledar: I guess the war hasn't made it this far. This is what we'll be fighting to protect.
- Soldier: Hey, recruits! Come over here, I have something to tell you.
Talk to the Soldier at [-1457, 54, -1531].
Right-click on the Soldier to talk to him.
- Tasim: A soldier? What are you doing all the way out here?
- Soldier: There's a bit of trouble up ahead. They sent me out here to intercept new recruits.
- Soldier: If you want to survive out here, you're going to need this.
- Soldier: And for you two.
- Aledar: Woah, awesome!
- Tasim: Hopefully we won't have to use these just yet.
- Soldier: Good luck out there, recruits! Just  and there will be a bridge up ahead.
Cross the bridge at [-1376, 53, -1529].
- Tasim: Ah, this must be the bridge the soldier was talking about. But it certainly looks very...
- Aledar: Well, let's not keep the King of Ragni waiting!
Aledar will run over the bridge as it collapses.
- Tasim: No, wait!
- Tasim: Aledar!
Aledar will pull himself back up.
- Aledar: That sure was close!
- Tasim: That's what I was trying to warn you about! Let's just get off this bridge before the rest of it collapses...
- Aledar: Well, how are we meant to get to the other side of this ravine now? Ugh. Another thing gone wrong, just like-...
- Tasim: ... Aledar? What's wrong?
- Aledar: That's... weird. I was just thinking about something from before Wynn, but... it's gone. I can't remember.
- Tasim: Hm. I can't remember anything from Fruma either... Player, how about you?
- Aledar: Nothing. It can't be a coincidence we all lost our memories at the same time, right?
- Tasim: No, but... We can worry about that later. For now, we need to find a way past this ravine. Aledar, Player, you should . I'll keep looking here.
- Aledar: Alright! Let's go, Player.
Search for another way across the ravine at [-1394, 54, -1553].
Turn to the left and a tree can be found. Use your main attack on it. The fallen tree will bridge the chasm.
- Aledar: Woah! That sure did the trick, Player. Good thinking!
- Aledar: Hey, Tasim! Come over here, Player found a way over!
Continue onwards to [-1298, 53, -1584].
- Tasim: Phew! We made it over safely this time at least.
- Aledar: If we just continue forward, we should make it to Ragni in no time!
- Tasim: Hmm? What's that guard doing here? We should probably talk to them if we want to pass through.
Talk to the Guard at [-1298, 53, -1584].
- Guard: Halt, recruits!
- Tasim: What? What's going on?
- Guard: A group of corrupted have sieged this underpass. I can't let you enter without any armour.
- Aledar: Then what do we do? We have to get to Ragni!
- Guard: Do you see that cave over there? Caves such as those often contain useful loot that can help keep you alive.
- Guard: If you  to protect you. After that return to me.
- Aledar: What do you say Player? Let's go see what's in that cave.
Enter the cave and find some armour at [-1301, 52, -1560].
Go into the Grook's Nest  Cave. Three Angry Grooks have to be killed (highlighted in ) in order to unlock the Tier 2  Loot Chest.
Open the blue and yellow rewards chest that spawns at the end of the cave once the loot chest has been opened. An Unidentified Helmet will be given.
- Aledar: We should return to the guard to see if he'll let us through now!
Talk to the Guard at [-1298, 53, -1584].
- Guard: So you found some armor, huh?
- Aledar: Yes, a helmet! Will you let us pass now?
- Guard: Hold on there, recruit. Before you can equip a piece of armor you first have to identify it.
- Tasim: And how do we do that?
- Guard: You can identify items at Item Identifiers. They exist in every city across the whole world, and we keep one here for convenience.
- Guard:  After you've done that I'll let you pass.
- Tasim: Alright! Let's go, Player.

Go to the Item Identifier north of the Guard and right-click them. A menu will open up. Click the Unidentified Helmet and then click the check mark. The Unidentified Helmet is revealed to be a Tosach. Go back to the Guard and talk to him.
- Guard: I see you have your helmet on. Fantastic, you may now pass. Let me open this door for you.
The Guard will then open the door.
- Guard: Good luck in there recruits! Even with your armour it won't be so easy!
Enter the underpass at [-1288, 52, -1584].
After the underpass is entered, Aledar and Tasim will carry their weapons.
Continue through the underpass to [-1042, 67, -21517].
- Tasim: Wow, that guard wasn't joking. This place is crawling with the corrupt.
- Aledar: Well, we've got no choice but to make it through! Finally time for us to use these weapons we got. Let's go, Player.
Aledar and Tasim will fight the Undead Miners in the tunnel alongside the player.
Once some buildings are reached, a cutscene will play showing a skeleton awakening. Two Undead Miners will flank it.
- Aledar: Player, you take the skeleton in the front. We'll handle the two zombies in the back!
Defeat the Skeleton!
The Raised Sorcerer will fire a sequence of three homing projectiles as its main attack. Aledar and Tasim will fight the two Undead Miners, which are just cutscene mobs.
After the skeleton has been defeated, Aledar and Tasim will kill the two zombies, opening the way forward.
- Aledar: We did it!
- Tasim: This path opened up, let's continue through the underpass.
Continue through the underpass to [-1001, 67, -21554].
- Lieutenant: Over here! You're just what I needed!
Talk to the Lieutenant at [-1001, 67, -21554].
- Lieutenant: Finally, some backup! Wait a second... you're straight from Fruma aren't you?
A large zombie will appear behind the Lieutenant.
- Lieutenant: Oh well, this area should be clear by now. Ragni is just up ahead, after all.
The large zombie will run up to the Lieutenant.
- Tasim: Lieutenant, watch out behind you!
The large zombie will grab the Lieutenant and knock the player, Aledar, and Tasim back. It will then start to run towards the player with the Lieutenant in its hand.
- Lieutenant: Quick, you have to use an ability!
The compass will be circled in red. Right-click it to open the menu. Left-click the Ability Tree icon circled in red to open up its UI. Left-click on the ability circled in red to get it.
- Lieutenant:
- [Click Combo]
Cast the spell using the dialogue above. The large zombie will flee as a result of that.
- Tasim: Great job, Player!
- Aledar: Wait, it's running away! We have to save the Lieutenant!
Chase the Goliath to [-914, 69, -21552]!

As the player and co run down the cave, several walls of Corruption spikes will appear, as well as some groups of mobs. Aledar and Tasim will aid the player in combatting the mobs. At the end of the cave is the Corrupted Goliath.
Defeat the Goliath and free the Lieutenant.
Once the Corrupted Goliath has been defeated, the Lieutenant will stand up, although visibly injured. The Corrupted Goliath will also drop an item on the ground.
- Lieutenant: ... That was close. Thanks for the save, recruits!
- Lieutenant: I think you three are going to make good soldiers - not many can handle themselves like you just did.
- Lieutenant: It seems that beast dropped something, you should check it out before heading to Ragni.
Pick up the loot dropped by the Goliath.
- Tasim: That item looks rare! Maybe there's an identifier around here.
- Aledar: Onward to Ragni! We're almost there.
Enter the castle at [-764, 70, -21560].
- Aledar: We... we made it! We really made it! Sure was a close call at the end.
- Tasim: ... Still think those corrupted don't stand a chance against you?
- Aledar: Ha ha. Very funny. Ah, Player, there seems to be an identifier here for you to identify that rare helmet.
- Tasim: And a blacksmith too, you can sell your old helmet there for some emeralds.
Identifying the helmet the Corrupted Goliath dropped will reveal it to be an Awesome Bandana. While the Tosach can be sold, it is not required to sell it to progress the quest.
- Tasim: Here it is, the end of our journey.
- Aledar: The end of one adventure, but the beginning of another! Let's go inside and talk to the King!
The King will be down the right hallway if you are facing the fireplace. As you approach him Aledar and Tasim will walk away.
- Ragni's King: Ah, you must be the last recruit. Please come over here and speak to me.
Talk to Ragni's King at [-939, 70, -1567].
Upon arriving in Ragni's castle, Aledar and Tasim will be waiting by the King.
- King of Ragni: Welcome to the Province of Wynn! By your ragged appearance, I gather your journey here must have been quite the adventure.
- King of Ragni: This, recruits, is the noble fort of Ragni, one of the great cities of our province!
The King of Ragni looks at everyone.
- King of Ragni: As soldiers of Wynn, it is your duty to stem the tide of corrupted monsters ravaging this land.
- King of Ragni: Although, you may want to gain some experience beforehand. Many lives are tragically lost every day...
- King of Ragni: Take this Teleport Scrolls to aid you in your journey. Upon use, it will instantly bring you back to this city, wherever you may be.
- King of Ragni: With that, I must bid you farewell, more recruits may arrive at any time. Good luck out there, soldiers of Wynn!
Talk to Junes at [1341, 81, -1826]
Attempt to enter the bandit hideout at [1314, 91, -1660].
Meet with Geo & Tarek at [1311, 90, -1654].
Sneak into the highest room of the Rymek Mansion at [1179, 32, -1295].

lines.title: the path through the mansion
lines.text:
If you get too close to a guard, they will stun you and return you to the start.

Guards can be distracted with marked activites; they will move away and allow you to pass their original location.

* Go up the small parkour to the right, enter through the door.
* Turn right and go downstairs, fight the guard dog.
* Use the small pathway to the left to smash the cake, then quickly return and continue upstairs.
* Enter the small tunnel next to the closed mansion door, rip the carpet to distract the guard.
* Go all the way upstairs, then push the crates. Jump down, and use the parkour to the left.
* Smash the window and turn left, go up the stairway.
* Take the pathway to the right, throw potatoes and return.
* Pass through the door and go upstairs once more.
* Take the journal and leave the mansion by breaking & climbing through the furnace.
When the Guard Coyote spawns, a notice will appear.
After taking the journal, you will have to quickly avoid the guards in the room and break the furnace to escape.
Talk to Geo and Tarek outside the mansion.
Bring the journal from the Rymek Mansion to the Vault Guard to enter the hideout.
Enter the cart.
Look for the sceptre within the bandit hideout at [1314, 92, -1690].
The bandits will then walk out of the meeting room.
Search the broken cart at [1183, 78, -1857].
Search the abandoned house at [1220, 78, -1873].
The Scrawled Note reads: ""
Grab the sceptre on the second floor of the house.
Return to the tomb and give Junes the sceptre at [1408, 97, -1824].
- [1] I found the Emperor's Sceptre.
Talk to Colonel Gailard at [670, 80, -1755]
Dialogue:
- Colonel Gailard: Oh, good, good! I bet'cha you're a Ragni soldier, aren't ya? Listen up, soldier! I've got a task here that 'ye can help out with.
- Colonel Gailard: Ya see that lava spring right there? It just went and popped up out of nowhere! The brass is real concerned about it, mhm?
- Colonel Gailard: They've been yappin' about it bein' related to the Corruption, and 'ye can bet that that means trouble. BAD trouble.
- Colonel Gailard: Now, this here Savannah has always had some Corruption lurkin' about, but not to the point where it can do this! It won't be safe around here if we don't do somethin' about it!
- Colonel Gailard: Anyways, high command ain't gonna provide support for this until they know there's actual Corruption, so we've gotta find some evidence around the springs, understand?
- Colonel Gailard: Take a look around the springs, soldier! Find me some damn evidence around here! [3 Pieces of Evidence] should be enough! Now, get movin'!
Look for three pieces of corrupted evidence around the Lava Spring at [631, 83, -1736]
- This should be enough evidence. You should report back to Colonel Gailard.
Go back to Colonel Gailard at [670, 80, -1755]
Dialogue:
- Colonel Gailard: Alright, good! Ya found some evidence, let me take a look at that!
- Colonel Gailard: Oh... This is bad... very, VERY bad...
- Colonel Gailard: This here is some physical corruption. If it's gettin' onto the surface, then 'ye can bet one of those weeds is spreadin' underground, right beneath the springs...
- Colonel Gailard: If ya could get underneath the spring, 'ye could probably sever whatever damn root is causing this, but... the heat would be sure to fry your skin off...
- Colonel Gailard: Wait... I've got an idea... Alright, listen up soldier! There's a lil' town North of here called Bremminglar, yeah? There's a healer person there that can help us out.
- Colonel Gailard: They're holed up inside of some important well in the center of town. There's a password ya need to hop into that place, though...
- Colonel Gailard: Don't have much to go on, but I'm pretty damn sure the password is Bob, or something. After the hero himself.
- Colonel Gailard: Right, ye're headin' there to find a potion that can keep ya weak little hide safe from the heat, understand? Here, let me write down the location in that book of yours.
Talk to Gregor outside the Bremminglar well at [720, 70, -2098]
Dialogue:
- Gregor: Hey, hey hey hey! Darling, what do you think you're doing? You can't just waltz in here without telling me the password!
- Gregor: Hmm... Your face... confidence... it gleans with confidence... yet... you still haven't spoken to me since you arrived...
- Gregor: Could it be... you know that the password is penguin eggs, but you're just too shy to talk? Yeah... yeah, that's gotta be it!
- Gregor: You've convinced me, little mute darling... You can enter the well. Go on, now!
Enter the Bremminglar well and talk to the healer at [720, 70, -2098]
Dialogue:
- Nami The Healer: G'day to you, friend. How can I help you?
- Nami The Healer: Hm? The Colonel sent you? what for?
- Nami The Healer: ...Corrupted... lava springs...? You realize how ridiculous that sounds, yeah? Well, I completely believe you.
- Nami The Healer: Right, you said lava, sooo... You need a heat resistance potion, yes?
- Nami The Healer: Welp, you're in luck, kinda... I have a potion that can resist the heat of lava, but the brew will not let you swim in lava.
- Nami The Healer: Oh that works, you just need to enter a borehole that goes through the lava? Perfect
- Nami The Healer: Anyways, if you ever need any more special brews, my assistant will be happy to sell some at a very affordable price.
- Nami The Healer: Now, you have somewhere to be, right? Right. Go and report to the Colonel, soldier. Tell him I said hi, by the way.
Report back to Colonel Gailard at [670, 80, -1755]
Dialogue:
- Colonel Gailard: Report! Ya got the potion yet, soldier? Good, drink it if ya haven't already!
- Colonel Gailard: Right, that's what I like to hear! Now, LOOK TO THE LEFT SOLDIER! There is a borehole out there we dug to try and hit the source of this weed.
- Colonel Gailard: We found a pretty damn hot cave lying underneath the surface! If ya jumped into the borehole, 'ye could probably find the source of the Corruption and stop it.
- Colonel Gailard: Now, the roots and spikes of Corruption are very sturdy, but we ain't never seen something like lava burstin' out of the ground.
- Colonel Gailard: Had a small chat with the brass, earlier. They got a hunch that there's a heart to the Corruption that's pumpin' out all the lava!
- Colonel Gailard: That's gotta be our ticket, yeah? If 'ye destroy that, ya should be able to stop the spread of the lava! Now, get movin'! Head into the borehole, soldier!
Drink the Potion of Obsidian Skin, then enter the lava spring through the borehole at [670, 79, -1747] and look for a corrupted heart
- You can feel your body heat adjusting as the potion courses through your body... it should be safe for you to enter the lava spring.
Tell Colonel Gailard at [670, 80, -1755] that you destroyed the heart
Dialogue:
- Colonel Gailard: Hah! I knew ya'd give me results! Ye're pretty damn reliable, soldier! Here, take this for your trouble!
Talk to Laen in Nemract at [24, 41, -2199].
Find the lost tower in Ancient Nemract at [177, 51, -1883].
Find the book in the tower, and bring it back to Laen.

lines.title: finding the Book of Bones
lines.text: When you first enter the underground passages, turn right. After a short path down, you will reach another intersection; turn left and continue through the passage. Turn left again, and you will reach a large intersection, with a black spot on the right. There is an opening in the black spot; go through it and follow the passage to reach the Rotten Necromancer, in a room at (185, 27, -1860), which drops the Book of Bones when killed.
Bring back the book to Laen.
Talk to Rynend located in Maltic at [-568, 48, -1922]
Investigate the old Maltic well at [-564, 48, -1927] and bring Witch's Empty Bottle to Rynend
Jump into the well.
To find the witch, first follow the yellowish fragments on the floor down the appropriate tunnel. All the other tunnels have dead ends that lead to a Makeshift Totem.
Parkour up the broken stairs.
Avoid the mobs, and go through any of the three doors.
Go through any of the next three doors. A miniboss will appear in any door but isn't necessary to defeat. Simply move onwards to the next room.
At the end of the dialogue, you must kill the witch.
The child will turn into a rabbit.
Talk to Haily in Almuj at [929, 75, -1899]
Dialogue:
- Haily: Hello, dear. My name is Haily. Nice to meet you.
- Haily: This is the Almuj Charity center. We're looking for volunteers to help the homeless this year.
- Haily: If you want to help someone else this year, our boss Nick is already in the thick of it.
- Haily: He's a really special man. I'll write his location down for you in your book. Oh, remember this is charity work, so hopefully gratitude is a good enough reward for you.
Go talk to Haily's friend Nick at the poor area.
Dialogue:
- Nick: Oh. Oh... Oh dear. There's more people here than ever.
- Nick: Hm, are you just passing through? Oh! A volunteer!
- Nick: You're the only one this year. Things have really changed. We used to have hundreds of volunteers this time of year.
- Nick: The people here are starving. There's no two ways about it.
- Nick: I don't know how we're going to feed everyone this year.
- Nick: The man who runs the budget store used to be homeless... He knows the struggles they face.
- Nick: I'll look after things here. Can you go to the budget store? It's really close. Any food is gratefully received.
Go to the budget store and ask for food.
Dialogue:
- Flodur: 'ello young lad.
- Flodur: What can I do fer ye?
- Flodur: A food donation fer the 'omless?
- Flodur: I'm sorry but everyfin is sold out, everyone is preparing for Craftmas lad.
- Flodur: I might have something in the attic, if you find anyfin, you can 'ave it. I know how difficult it gets.
Look for food on the second floor.

lines.title: what to do with the apple
lines.text: Go upstairs, kill the Moldy apple, and return to Flodur.
Dialogue:
- Flodur: Hm... This apple has seen betta days.
- Flodur: Looks like i'm fresh outta food. Barely got enough to feed myself.
- Flodur: I wish I had something to give this year. I guess people are having a feast in the city.
Return to Nick and tell him the bad news.
Dialogue:
- Nick: Any news?
- Nick: I see. I was counting on him.
- Nick: I can't be too upset. He donates so much the rest of the year.
- Nick: We may have to ask the farmers directly...
- Nick: I know someone in Ternaves with a kind heart.
- Nick: We've fallen out before, seems he didn't understand what a donation was.
- Nick: There is a shortcut south from here, in a cave. Go through there.
- Nick: Oh, also, could you give this blanket to Margaret while you're down in the tunnel? Just follow the road behind me.
Bring the blanket to the woman in the tunnel south of Nick.
Dialogue:
- Margaret: Oh, please don't move me along. I have nowhere else to go!
- Margaret: Oh, a blanket for me? How sweet... From Nick, you say? He's always so kind... Thank you, as well.
- Margaret: If you want to get to Ternaves quickly, just keep going through this tunnel. Some unfriendly homeless folks live around here too, so be careful. It's so sad, their state.
Continue the tunnel and find Nick's friend.
Dialogue:
- Reshad: Welcome to my farm! Looking to buy some of my fresh crops?
- Reshad: Well, it seems you're out of luck. I've just sold the last of them from this harvest.
- Reshad: It was all for that big Craftmas feast happening in Detlas. Wish I could help you out, but I'm fresh out of food to sell you.
- Reshad: Wait, I bet Nick sent you, didn't he? Well, he's coming up on your left. Remind him that this isn't a charity.
- Nick: Hey, ! Any luck?
- Nick: We can't get any food? We're running out of options here...
- Nick: Well, there's only one person left that we can appeal to at this time of year.
- Nick: Follow me.
Explore the area and look for Santa.
- This must be Santa's village, you should probably look for him.
Dialogue:
- Elvura: Heya! I just finished decorating this christmas tree!
- Elvura: Oh, you're looking for Santa?
- Elvura: He is right down the stairs to the right.
Enter Santa's home and speak to him.
Dialogue
- Santa: Nick... You know the deal.
- Santa: The council all have their areas to care for. Yours is Almuj. How you care for it is your responsibility.
- Nick: There's five times more homeless and hungry than last year!
- Santa: Nick, I know times are tough there, but-
- Nick: Tough?! It's impossible! What happened to people's good will? I had one volunteer this year! ONE!
- Santa: I'm sorry Nick. You could go to Detlas and ask there, they have a feast big enough to feed an army!
- Nick: Hmmm... Oh, sorry. I miscalculated your journey here. Good to see you.
- Nick: I suppose you heard Santa and I. Our next location is Detlas.
- Santa: Alright, that's settled then. Leave through the fireplace behind me, it will bring you directly to Detlas. Good luck, Nick.
Leave through the portal behind Santa.
Enter the ball room.
Note: You do not need a ticket to enter.
- The portal brought you to Detlas, the ball must be nearby.

lines.title: the location of the ball room
lines.text: The ball room entrance is by the airship dock building, at [423, 67, -1560].
Dialogue:
- Nick: Wow. The people here live in such grandure. I wonder if they know people are starving to the east.
- Nick: Let's ask around for some donations.
- Nick: More importantly, let's hope they'll share a trifle of food.
Ask the guests for food.
Dialogue:
- Server: What are you doing here?
- Server: This event is invite-only.
- Server: You aren't even in a formal dress.
- Server: What do you want?!
- Server: Food? You want food? Does this look like a charity to you?
- Server: Of course not! We have an obligation to feed our partygoers, not some poor scraps of men in the desert!
- Server: Now get out of here before I call the security golems. And don't even think of stealing from the kitchen!
Steal the food from the kitchen and talk to Nick.
Dialogue:
- Nick: Were you able to get any food?
- Nick: You do?! I didn't expect them to be so generous, a whole crate?
- Nick: ...
- Nick: Oh...
- Nick: Stealing is not in the christmas spirit... But I think I can make this work.
- Nick: Go on ahead. I have a plan. Don't worry, I'll return all this food.
Escape the ball with Nick.
Dialogue:
- Nick: Listen up everyone!
- Nick: I know you are hungry. Because I am too.
- Nick: But your dinner will not be served tonight.
- Nick: There will be no Craftmas feast this year!
- Guest: You can't do that!
- Guest: The food on the table isn't enough to feed everyone here!
- Nick: This one night, this one missed meal.
- Nick: This is how thousands of people live every day.
- Nick: Hungry, wondering when the food will be available.
- Nick: And while you sit there with empty stomachs be thankful for what you have. Spare a thought for those who have not.
- Nick: Hundreds of men, women and children, just like you, will not eat tonight, at all.
- Nick: All because this enormous feast was not enough. Detlas bought all the food, cheap or expensive.
- Nick: I'm here to remind you the real meaning of this day. To think of others..
- Nick: I will return your meal tonight, but while you eat it... I want you to remember every empty mouth it could have fed.
- Nick: Share what you have, be thankful for what you are given.
- Guest: ...
You will then be teleported to Almuj.
Dialogue:
- ???: Well, looks like you came through yet again Nick.
- Santa: I came to see if I could help out. But it looks like you've done it.
- Santa: Well, I guess there is only one thing left to do to complete this scene.
- Santa: Hope you all have a merry craftmas. Ho-ho!
Santa will cast a spell, making it snow temporarily.
Talk to Nick.
Dialogue
- Nick: It looks like my little speech brought the rich back down to earth.
- Nick: They gave us half of their feast. Can you believe they still had leftovers?
- Nick: All of that food, going straight to waste.
- Nick: They have no idea what they have, compared to these poor folks.
- Nick: You might be wondering why I know Santa. Well, he's my brother.
- Nick: Me and my siblings take care of people at Craftmas. My area is the Almuj desert. I guess you could call me Sanda Claus, heh.
- Nick: It's people like you that keep the real meaning of this holiday alive. It gets harder every year as the meaning is distorted. Here is a personal gift from me. Thank you.
Visit the Nemract bar at [114, 40, -2176]
Dialogue:
- Barman: Hello there soldier! What can I get you?
- Honip: I'll take 2 Nemract Whiskeys. One for me, one for this chap.
- Barman: You got it.
- Honip: So... I've seen ya around town. I saw how happy that guy was when you brought him some journal.
- Barman: 2 Nemract Whiskeys, coming up!
The barman will place both whiskeys on the counter. You can drink yours by right-clicking it.
- Honip: So... Soldier. Are ya up for sailin' the ocean with me? I got a fancier boat than that seaskipper!
- Honip: I figured you'd be interested in explorin' the waters!
- Honip: I'll wait for ya on the docks. Don't worry, ya can't miss the boat!
Meet Honip at [103, 37, -2254]
Dialogue:
- Honip: There you are! Ready? Follow me, the boat's over here!
- Honip: Look at this.. Magnificent! Much better than whatever the Seaskipper is using!
- Honip: Well, what are you waiting for? Hop aboard!
Go on board Honip's ship.
- Honip: Then it's settled, we're goin' on an adventure!
- Honip: Buckle up, we got waves to catch.
A cutscene of a small version of Honip's ship on the ocean will play.
- Honip: So... I should warn ya', this is actually my first time sailing...
- Honip: It doesn't seem too difficult though, a little to the left...
- Honip: Hmm, looks like we're not the only ones out on the water  today.
- Honip: They are a bit too head on, don't you think?
- Honip: I'm trying to steer the ship but it's not budging...
- Honip: That's unfortunate...
- Honip: Unfortunate... For YOU!
- You've been knocked out...
- Sounds like you are being dragged around...
Right-click the small sign on the bed at [-3278, 47, 16379].
Dialogue:
- You pick up a small sign...
- It reads: Behind you, idiot.
- Honip: Hey, you're finally awake.
- Honip: I honestly, truly can't believe you fell for that. Let me sum it up for you...
- Honip: Some extremely suspicious pirate comes up, offers you a drink, and leads you to his suspicious boat.
- Honip: Any normal person would've turned back by then. But what do you do? You hop on! Well, now you're stuck with us.
- Honip: Let me make this quick. This boat needs renovation, and we want you to do it.
- Honip: Why? You're a soldier! All you do is take orders! Anyway, we'll need you to clean our stuff. Here, get out.
If you try to escape during Honip's dialogue:
- Honip: Stay back!
- Honip: I told you to stay back!
- Honip: Alright, that's enough!
Honip throws a potion to stop you from moving.
Walk out of the cell.
- [0/7] Bodies Cleaned
- Honip: So, there's quite a few skeletons in there, and we never bothered throwin' them out!
- Honip: Go ahead, here's a sponge for the dried blood as well. Just wack the skeletons with it!
- [+1 Sponge]
- Honip: If you need me, I'll be on the deck. And, uh, don't go in the hold. We've got a BIG rat problem.
If you tried to escape earlier:
- Honip: Also, for the sake of my crew, could you be more cooperative? I don't have an unlimited amount of these potions.
Clean the bodies in the boat. Look for clues on how to escape at the same time. -Bodies cleaned: #/7
Tip: Left-click the bodies with the sponge to clean them, but right-click the clues you find.

lines.title: other things you can do during this stage
lines.text:
- If you pick up the seeds at [-3280, 47, 16364], and find the chicken Snoo (Honip's pet chicken, as mentioned by one of the pirates) wandering the ship, you can tame it by right-clicking it with the seeds. It will then follow you around.
*You can also tame Pep the dog by picking up the bone at [-3290, 51, 16376] and giving it to Pep at [-3287, 51, 16389]. Pep will then lead you down to the hold entrance, and change the dialogue of the pirate standing next to it.
Dialogue:
- Pirate: Hey, so you're our personal guard, huh?
- Pirate: Nice to meet ya!
- Pirate: That ladder leads to the hold, but right now it's locked... We've got a severe case of rats.
If you tamed Pep:
- Pirate: Pep is just a treasure, ain't I right? I'm glad you're taking care of him too!
Dialogue:
- Pirate: Honip has a pet chicken, weird right?
- Pirate: I bet he got inspiration from that weird guy on his island...
If you did Cluck Cluck before this:
- Pirate: What? You murdered that guy's most prized chicken? You're an odd one, soldier.
Dialogue:
- You take a look inside the furnaces...
- There's nothing, except for...
- An absurd amount of wood shavings, for some reason.
- Pirate: Oh, uh... Don't worry about that, 'ay?
- Pirate: That's our... fuel source.
Dialogue:
- You find some notes on the table.
- There's mentions of... A human cannon? How does that make sense?
- Apparently, only gunpowder is needed, as well as a fuse.
Dialogue:
If you found the cannon notes earlier:
- This cannon is aiming slightly upwards, and it seems less powerful than the others.
- According to the notes you saw, it's probably the "human" cannon. This must be your escape route!
- Seth: Oh, that's my cannon! Pretty cool, right? I made it using a bunch of arm- Nevermind...
Dialogue:
- You pick up some notes.
- There are mentions of a hidden key in the hold...
Dialogue:
If you tamed Snoo:
- Honip: Oh, Snoo likes you!
- Honip: He's a strong chicken alright, trust me on that one.
- Honip: Anyway, get back to work!
Note: Most of the NPCs will have the same dialogues if you talk to them later in the quest, however, Honip's changes between stages, and Seth will hide and have the following dialogue after Stage 4:
Dialogue:
- Seth: I'm just goin' to... Wait here... With my cannons...
Alternatively, you can avoid talking to anyone and taming any pets and simply clean up all 7 bodies, updating your quest book and triggering the following dialogue:
- You cleaned the bodies! You should talk to Honip on the deck.
Talk to Honip on the deck to get your next task
Dialogue:
- Honip: Hey! The boat's lookin' real nice now!
- Honip: I'll probably let you rest so- hold on.
- Pirate: Ho-Honip! One of the guys said he saw something really weird coming right for us!
- Honip: Wait... What? Soldier, come!
- Honip: What's happening?!
- Pirate: We-we don't know! We can't exactly see it, but it seems huge!
- Honip: I- Let me see.
- Honip: Uh... Where am I supposed to be looking at, exactly?
- Pirate: I swear, it felt like the whole ocean was getting crazy a second ago!
- Honip: If this is another one of your jokes...
- Seth: LOOK OUT!
A small mob named "Osearer" will jump up onto the ship.
- Seth: What the hell is that??
- Honip: I don't know, this wasn't planned!

Here there are three possibilities. You can cast 5 of any of your spells at the Osearer, just wait, or tame Snoo before getting to this stage. The quest will continue regardless of which one you choose, but Honip will have different dialogues for each one.
If you scare it off with your spells =
Dialogue:
- Honip: Soldier, now's your time to shine! Scare it off with one of your spells or something!
- Honip: It's working! Do that again!
- Honip: One more...
- Honip: It's starting to panic!
- Honip: That's right, get back!
- Honip: I knew you had it in ya, haha!
- Honip: What a show! Come, I've got some things to tell ya!
Talk to Honip again.
- Honip: I don't know where that creature came from, but thanks to you it's gone.
- Honip: I've got something else for you to tackle. It's about... the rats.
- Honip: Come to the hold, I'll explain on the way.
- Honip: I think we have quite a hellish problem on our hands.
- Honip: I'm not sure what y'all find there, but these are NOT normal rats.
- Honip: So please, get in there... and kill everything, alright?
- Honip: I've got faith in ya. Here goes nothin'!
If you do nothing =
Dialogue:
- Honip: Soldier, now's your time to shine! Scare it off with one of your spells or something!
- Honip: Just cast one of your fancy spells!
- Honip: That was... Phew... That was something.
- Honip: Now, for an even bigger surprise...
- Honip: What the hell soldier?? What don't you get in the "soldier" part of your job?
- Honip: Come, let's figure some things out.
Talk to Honip again.
- Honip: You've been a massive disappointment, y'know?
- Honip: But you can still redeem yourself.
- Honip: Follow me, I'll explain on the way.
- Honip: I mentioned a rat problem earlier... It's, uh, not a small one.
- Honip: We've got gunpowder to retrieve, so you're the one who's gonna clear the hold.
- Honip: So get in there... and try to kill everything, alright?
- Honip: Don't be as bad as earlier. You're a soldier.
If you tamed Snoo earlier =
Snoo will walk up to the Osearer, fight it, and knock it off the ship.
Dialogue:
- Honip: What.
- Honip: Well... That's a twist.
- Honip: I expected you to do somethin', soldier, not him!
- Honip: Anyway, come talk to me.
Talk to Honip again.
- Honip: I have another task for you. It's about... the rats.
- Honip: See, I really don't think we have your usual type of problem.
- Honip: Come to the hold, I'll explain on the way.
- Honip: We sometimes hear unusually load footsteps, along with some really eerie squeaking...
- Honip: That's why we're not too fond of goin' in... But our gunpowder there! We need it, as pirates!
- Honip: So, I need you to get in... and kill everything, alright?
- Honip: Here goes nothing. Snoo, ya stay there!
Explore the hold and kill the rats
In the hold you will find several small rats, ranging from level 25-28.

Note: If you die to the rats, you will respawn outside the ship, usually in Nemract, but you can go back to the ship and continue the quest by right-clicking the sign at [104, 35, -2282]. Additionally, your quest book will update to say "Go to the Nemract docks to go back to the boat at [104, 24, -2282]".
Once you killed them all, two bigger rats appear, called Giant Rat. These are level 30.
Something's coming...
Defeat the Colossal Rat in the hold
Once the colossal rat goes to its second phase, more smaller rats will spawn in as well, but not continuously, so if you kill them quickly you can focus on just the colossal rat.
After you kill the colossal rat, you can find a gunpowder crate and a cannon fuse in the room.
Additionally, a Dusty Key can be found in the hold at this point.
- [+1 Cannon Fuse]
- [+1 Gunpowder Crate]
Exit the room in the back.
Use the gunpowder and the fuse to activate the cannon and escape
Note: Talk to Honip before you escape, or else you will not get your emerald rewards.
Honip's dialogue here will change depending on which path you chose in stage three.
If you chose to fight =
Dialogue:
- Honip: Hey there! Ya bringin' me good news?
- Honip: You took care of these damn thieving rodents? A... colossal rat you say?
- Honip: Nicely done, I knew I could count on ya! C'mere, take these!
- [+2 Emerald Blocks]
- Honip: Anyway, for now, you can go rest and do whatever you want!
If you chose to wait =
Dialogue:
- Honip: Hey there! Ya bringin' me good news?
- Honip: You took care of these damn thieving rodents? A... colossal rat you say?
- Honip: Well, shiver me timbers! You did redeem yourself soldier!
- Honip: Anyway, for now, you can go rest and do whatever you want!
If you tamed Snoo =
Dialogue:
- Honip: Hey there! Ya bringin' me good news?
- Honip: You took care of these damn thieving rodents? A... colossal rat you say?
- Honip: That sounds absolutely terrifying! And ya did that alone! You know what, her', take these.
- [+2 Emerald Blocks]
- Honip: Anyway, for now, you can go rest and do whatever you want!
You must interact with the book at [-3283, 51, 16397] before you are able to properly interact with the cannon.
Once you have, right-click the cannon when nobody is watching to shoot yourself away.
Dialogue:
- You put the gunpowder in the cannon and attach the fuse...
- Looks like it's fully functional. Make sure the pirates don't see you! Once you leave, you won't be able to come back.
If you get caught:
- Pirate Guard: Hey! What do you think you're doin'?!
If you don't get caught:
- You crawl into the cannon...
- Honip: ...Seth? Have ya seen the soldier?
- Seth: No, but they did a great job in the hold! Some gunpowder went missing though.
- Seth: ...
- Honip: ...
- Seth: Wait a minute.
The cannon fires and you fly away through the sky and land on a small island. On the way there, you will fly through a group of seagulls, which will damage you unless you avoid them.
Find out where you are and a way to flee the island
- It's a coconut.
- It's a palm tree.
- You dig up some sand...
- There's more sand.
- Huh? Something's approaching off in the distance...
- Looks like they're headed toward the island! Is that..?
- Seaskipper Captain: 'ey there soldier! Looks like ya're in a bit of a pickle! How 'bout ya hop on?'
Get on the Seaskipper.
Dialogue:
- Seaskipper Captain: Well... We're headed for Selchar, the heart of the ocean! Which is safer than wherever you were, heh!
- Seaskipper Captain: I was casually takin' a scenic detour when I saw you and your shiny equipment on that island.
- Seaskipper Captain: So, ya gotta tell me what happened!
- Seaskipper Captain: Oh, kidnapped by pirates I see! How unfortunate...
- Seaskipper Captain: I guess that'll show ya, tryin' to avoid using good ol' seaskipper! I'm the only trustworthy one 'round here.
- Seaskipper Captain: Well, I hope they weren't too bad with ya! Here, I'll make you travel to Selchar for free as compensation.
- Seaskipper Captain: Anyway, I can see the shore off in the distance! Hang tight, we're almost there!
Talk to Tasim in Alekin Village at [-158, 73, -1621].
Speak to the strange man at [-175, 74, -1633].
Follow Yahya to his infested mushroom patch at [-214, 79, -1692].
Clear out the spiders from Yahya's favorite mushroom patch at [-200, 77, -1701], then return and talk to Yahya.
In order to complete this stage, the Skittering Spiders  World Event must be completed.
Spiders will then ambush Yahya.
The spiders will then carry Yahya away.
Return to Mayor Alvin at [-181, 71, -1615] with news about the spiders.
Travel to Detlas to request the help of their military at [513, 69, -1628].

If it is your first time traveling to Detlas, a World Encounter will happen within this quest that Tasim will react to. A Corrupted Goliath will appear on the right pile of rocks before jumping down and confronting both Tasim and the player.
Throughout this fight, Tasim will aid the player.
After killing the Corrupted Goliath:
If the player doesn't kill the Corrupted Goliath, the following dialogue occurs when the player reaches the western gate at Detlas.
If the player dies before killing the Corrupted Goliath, the following dialogue occurs when the player respawns in the Detlas barracks.
When at Detlas, head to the Barracks to meet up with Admiral Aegis and a friend from before.
If the player died in the Goliath fight, the following dialogue is played instead.
Talk to The Assistant in Detlas at [491, 67, -1575]
- The Assistant: Heeh...stranger. I...may need your assistance...
- The Assistant: My master...wishes to create a very dangerous potion...a transformative elixir of invincibility...
- The Assistant: I was...in support of this... but then, he accrued essence of...the corruption. I had to run away...
- The Assistant: I fear...that he may be going...too far. I need your help...
- The Assistant: I want...to stop him...but I need you to...get me the necessary ingredients... to neutralize the potion...
- The Assistant: Get me...Red Mushroom, they can be found outside the  behind me.
Slay Mooshrooms near  and bring  to The Assistant in Detlas
- The Assistant: Quickly, get me...  as I asked... go through the Black Road outside the east gate from here.
- How do I get the mushrooms?
- The Assistant: The...the...cows. Steal...from them.
- The Assistant: Good... Hurry..!
- The Assistant: Good...good. You have the mushrooms.
- The Assistant: I'll... return to my master's house...and sneak the mushrooms into...his potion. Wait for me here...
The screen fades to black for a second.
- The Assistant: I...have returned... He came back...just as I finished slipping the mushrooms in and...told me...to get out.
- The Assistant: You must...ensure that it has worked. You...are much stronger than I, stranger...
- The Assistant: Did you see the  witch hat roofed hut when you were gathering the mushrooms?
- The Assistant: That is my master's house, you...must go back out the east gate and enter the hut.
- The Assistant: You must...make sure...he has not managed...to become invincible... Do what has to be done....
Enter the hut at [616, 67, -1616] and slay Essren, and take his coat.
- The Assistant: You must go back out the east gate and enter the hut, it is my master's house.
- The Assistant: Don't forget... Do what you must...
Upon entering the hut, Dr. Essren will be in the center of the room.
- Dr. Essren: Ah, you must be the one my assistant told me about.
Essren walks on top of his desk.
- Dr. Essren: If you are trying to stop me, it's too late. I already drank the pot...
Fire and magic particles appear around Essren.
- Dr. Essren: What is this taste? Mushrooms? This can't b
Essren becomes damaged. A mushroom now sprouts from his head.
- Dr. Essren: Aaaaargh!!!!!
- Dr. Essren: What have you done to this potion, human?! You will pay for it!
After Dr. Essren has been slayed, exit the hut.
- It's time to head back to The Assistant in Detlas and show him the proof.
Bring back Essren's Dusty Coat to The Assistant in Detlas
- The Assistant: I...must thank you, stranger...
- I thought the mushrooms neutralized the potion?
- The Assistant: Don't believe...everything people tell you... If master managed to...discover invincibility... No...too...dangerous.
- The Assistant: This was...for the better...
- The Assistant: Now. I...do not want you saying anything about...these events. Take these, and...never speak of this again.
Talk to Dr. Picard at .
- Dr. Picard: Success! Success, success, SUCCESS! I'm a genius, the smartest man alive!
- Dr. Picard: You there, random bystander! You have witnessed a magical marvel! I have just successfully restored my memories from years ago!
- Dr. Picard: You look to be from Fruma, yes? So you know just as well as I that your memories of your life before have vanished. Poof. Gone!
- Dr. Picard: But with this device... we can change that! Restore what has been lost! Recover the you get the point.
- Dr. Picard: Now, I'm in great need of test subjects... You would do well as one, yes, but I need to be more certain this thing works.
- Dr. Picard: Listen here! I have a proposition to make. You'd like your memories back, yes? Bring me enough test subjects, and I can show you what you've lost!
- Dr. Picard: Let's see, let's see... We need individuals originally from Fruma. There are a few of those around here.
- Dr. Picard: You can start with the would-be sailor, Caid. You'll find him just past Elkurn .
- Dr. Picard: In the meantime, I'll be making adjustments here... It's not perfect just yet. I'm still missing large portions of my memory... Hm? You're still in here? Get going!
Recover the sailor Caid near his boat at .
- Dr. Picard: Well? I've given you an assignment, what are you still doing here? Go find the sailor Caid. You'll find him just past Elkurn .
- Caid: Huh? Oh! I ah, nothing to see here! Just... just taking a look at my good old ship!
- Caid: Picard sent you? The guy cooped up in the tower? Huh. Good to know he's finally finished his work. But what could he want me for?
- Caid: ... Look at my memories from Fruma, huh? I'm not so sure 'bout that. If they're missing, they must be missing for a reason. I'm-I'm happy here! Don't need to know nothin' about...
- Caid: ... Yeah, alright. I'll come with you to get my memory checked out. Just, do me a solid first, alright?
- Caid: I'm something of a builder. Figured I'd try my hand at making a ship, and, here it is! Pretty good, right?
- Looking good!
- Caid: That's what I'm talking about, take that Reynauld! I knew someone would like it!
- Looks like a heap of scrap!
- Caid: Hey! Heh, well you're not wrong. I cobbled it together using mostly junk I found laying around. Still, it's pretty impressive for a scrap heap, don't you think?
- Caid: You'll have to promise me you won't tell Reynauld but... Some of the more exotic components have been comin' from the guard's quarters. Nothing big! Just some stuff skimmed off the top...
- Caid: I only need one more part to finish it off, and well, you see... A shipment just arrived from the blacksmith's... You see where I'm going with this?
- Caid: Get me  and I'll come with you to Picard's tower. I could hardly leave my baby alone unfinished like this now, could I?
Steal the box from the Blacksmith's house at .
- Caid: Have you gotten the box yet? It's , a short walk away from here in Elkurn. Just, don't get spotted!
Go to Elkurn's Blacksmith and  the large box to start the puzzle.
- It's the box Caid was talking about...
- Move the box out of the door to complete the puzzle!
- Use your Movement Keys to  your move, then press Jump to .
- Hold Shift to .
- Leave for now...
- Exits the dialogue
Using movement keys will make the box fall in a certain direction.

lines.title: the solution to the puzzle
lines.text: Left, Left, Left, Down, Right, Right, Up, Left, Left, Left, Down, Down
After completing the puzzle, the box will fall down and explode.
- Seems like the box broke...
- You take a package out of the wreckage.
- You should  with the package before the blacksmith notices...
Bring the package to Caid at .
- Caid: ... You're back! How did it go? Here, I'll take the goods.
- Caid: The blacksmith didn't see anything right? I'm a bit worried Reynauld is on my trail...
- Caid: Ah, whatever! Finally, time to finish this ol' boat of mine!
Caid walks onto his boat and places a bell.
- Caid: There we go! Ta da! How's it look?
- Much better!
- Caid: That's right! Every ship worth its salt's got to have a bell. Wouldn't be the same without one.
- A bell, really?
- Caid: What's with the attitude! Every ship worth its salt's got to have a bell, you know? Do you think the Seaskipper'd be caught dead without one? Didn't think so!
- Caid: Anyway... I guess you've fulfilled your end of the bargain, so I've got no choice but to fulfil mine!
- Caid: Lead the way ! Let's see what's hiding in this big head o' mine.
Bring Caid to Dr. Picard in his tower at .
The bell can be rang on Caid's ship.
Witness Caid's past.
- Dr. Picard: Aha! You've returned! Good, good, this'll be a good test of my changes...
- Caid: ... Right. And this is the doctor we're trusting with my memories?
- Dr. Picard: Now, now, don't underestimate my genius. You'll be fine! Probably. I'd give it a ninety-five, well, ninety percent chance. Now, step up here.
- Caid: Alright... I trust you know what you're doing, doctor...
- Dr. Picard: And now, all I need to do is... Activate the spell here, hit the switch there, and...
- Caid: [?]
The orb will start emitting white particles as the spell begins. A gray flash covers the screen as the Player witnesses Caid and another person in the slums of an area.
- Caid: Right, let's see what we've got here... Edwin, can you check that other crate over there?
- Edwin: Sure thing. Say Caid. How do you keep getting ahold of these things? There's expensive parts in these, and that seems a bit out of your price range.
- Caid: Well... Let's just say the latest resupply package for the guards is slightly lighter than it might otherwise be.
- Edwin: Wait what? Caid, please tell me you haven't been stealing from the guards. You know they won't
- Caid: Edwin, relax. I'm barely skimming off the top of their supplies. They won't notice one or two missing packages out of thirty.
- Caid: 'sides, I'm not scared of them. They're here to protect us, aren't they? I figure they'll just let me off with a warning, like they have all those other times.
- Edwin: If... if you say so. I guess you're right. They don't need all those supplies, really. And we can make much better use of these than they would!
- Caid: Exactly! I'm glad you agree. So, have you found anything goo
A squad of Royal Soldiers arrives at the scene.
- Royal Captain: You two! Hold still, you're under arrest!
- Edwin: G-g-g-guards! Run!!
Edwin runs away.
- Caid: E-Edwin! Get back here, you cowa
- Royal Captain: That's enough out of you. You two, track down the accomplice.
- Royal Soldier: Yessir.
- Royal Soldier: On it.
- Royal Captain: Caid, you are being placed under arrest for repeated counts of theft of imperial property.
- Royal Captain: Your record shows you have received multiple warnings for previous acts. This was your final chance, and you have thoroughly wasted it.
- Royal Captain: Take him to the prison for further questioning, and decide what shall be done with him.
The scene fades back to gray.
- Dr. Picard: Hey! Hello? Bystander-turned-assistant! Get yourself out of that trance, we need to talk.
The Player is brought back to reality.
- Dr. Picard: Hm. Hm hm hm. The memory cut off there...I wonder what we'd see if we could
- Caid: So, that's it, huh...
- Dr. Picard: Yes, it appears so... But perhaps, if I can increase the power, then... Yes! I'm a geniu
- Caid: That's all I am?! Just some thief... Is that all I'm good for?
- Dr. Picard: ...
- Caid: I'm leaving.
- Caid exits the room.
- Dr. Picard: Ah! Bystander-turned-assis you know what, I'll just call you my assistant. Finally out of your trance, I see.
- Dr. Picard: But that's of no importance now! What, however, is important is what we've just seen! Memories relived in vivid detail! Truly, this device will change the world!
- Dr. Picard: ... Though, I will say. I am a little lost as to the timeline of events. Caid was arrested so how did he find himself here in Wynn, as a soldier?
- Dr. Picard: We are in need of more subjects if we are to find out the truth of it! There is a Scout Reynauld on duty today, he is also from Fruma originally, just like yourself.
- Dr. Picard: Yes, hm. You'll find him  to the Roots of Corruption. I'm counting on you to convince him to join our experiment. In the name of science!
Find Scout Reynauld near the bridge to the Roots of Corruption at .
Dr. Picard:
- Dr. Picard: Hm... Where does this barrier lie? Is this magic not strong enough to break through it? Maybe if I increase the power, then...
- Dr. Picard: Gah! Assistant! What are you doing here? Have you spoken to Scout Reynauld yet? You'll find him  to the Roots of Corruption.
Caid:
Caid can be found in Elkurn's Bovine Church at .
- Caid: Just... leave me be. Alright?
Scout Reynauld can be found at the orange post.
- Reynauld: Ah, hello. What seems to be the matter? You look like you want something from me.
- Reynauld: Hm? The strange doctor wants to see me? To restore my memories? I can't say I really trust the man... but I am curious to see if it'll really work.
- Reynauld: Unfortunately, however, I must decline. I couldn't leave my station unattended. What if a corrupted assault were to appear? Elkurn would be left defenseless.
- What if someone kept watch?
- Reynauld: Hm, well. If it's only for a little while, that might work. As long as you promise to help out if an attack does occur.
- Reynauld: Then it's settled. I'll go with you to meet the doctor. However, first we'll need someone to keep the watch. Did you have someone in mind?
- What about... Caid?
- Reynauld: Caid? That... crook. He's been stealing supplies, I know it. I just can't prove it. But, if you think he'll do. I'm sure it will be fine.
- Reynauld: I saw him heading to the temple not very long ago. Perhaps he's had a change of heart. You , I'll be right behind you.
-> Return to Reynauld at .
- Reynauld: Perhaps Caid's had a change of heart. You , I'll be right behind you.
Convince Caid to keep watch over the bridge at .
- Caid: Oh, it's you again. What do you want?
- Reynauld: It's us, and we'd like to ask something of you. Our mutual friend here is attempting to recruit me for some sort of experiment.
- Reynauld: Only, my participation would leave Elkurn undefended. So we're asking if you'd be willing to keep a watch over things while I'm otherwise preoccupied.
- Caid: Really? You're asking me to guard Elkurn?
- Reynauld: Don't get me wrong, I'd rather not leave the security of Elkurn in the hands of a thie... someone like you. You weren't my first choice to say the least, or second, or third
- Caid: Yeah, yeah. I get it.
- Caid: I'll do it.

- Reynauld: You will? Well, that was easier than I expected. Remember if you see any signs of an imminent attack, run to that doctor's tower and alert us immediately. Leave the fighting to the professionals.
- Caid: I wouldn't dream of anything else! But, consider Reynauld, that maybe the past is forgotten for a reason.
- Reynauld: Well, that settles it. Let's , I don't want leave Elkurn's safety in that man's slippery fingers for any longer than I have to.
Bring Reynauld to Dr. Picard in his tower at .
- Reynauld: Let's , I don't want to leave Elkurn's safety in that man's slippery fingers for any longer than I have to.
Witness Reynauld's past.
- Dr. Picard: Ah, assistant! Welcome back, and I see you've brought our next subject! Wonderful!
- Reynauld: Subject?
- Dr. Picard: Now, now, step forward. Don't be shy! Just step right up over here! Look directly into the orb, and concentrate on remembering.
- Reynauld: This is safe, right?
Reynauld walks up to the orb.

- Alfonse: This is insane, why are we here?! We're looking for corruption you know that right?

*To the Mining Operations Manager:
*We were performing our usual routines when suddenly an unknown explosion caused a massive cave-in at the entrance to our main mining supply area.
*Something must be done to remove the debris, we cannot easily continue our mining operations without our supplies.
*There also may be people trapped on the other side, and I would hate to lose even more miners to these catastrophes.
*Maybe we could use the Wrecking Ball to demolish the debris, but if we don't act soon...

Use the wrecking ball by pressing the button at [439, 81, -1103], then enter the opened cave near the note and pick up the Switch Fuse at [471, 78, -1101].
Once you have all three items, report back to Orikal.
Dialogue:
- Orikal: You got 'em all! Excellent, this is exactly what we need.
- Orikal: Alright, stand back. I have actually never made this before, so let's hope I don't cause a disaster.
- Orikal takes the materials you retrieved and puts them in a container. He mutters some words in an unknown language, and suddenly the container turns into some sort of Magical TNT.
- Orikal: Phew, glad nothing tragic happened there. This should be it, now go take it back down to the spike and destroy it once and for all!
Bring the explosive to the spike in the cave and use it to destroy the spike.
Dialogue:
- It appears this magical TNT worked. Now that the spike's roots have been demolished, you should talk to Orikal about your success.
Report to Orikal about your success.
Dialogue:
- Orikal: Oh, do you feel that? It's like a buzzing in my ears I never knew about has just vanished.
- Orikal: I think that worked you know. It seems the power of the spike comes from the root...
- Orikal: But what is it connected to? That's for another day. The main thing is the village is safe.
- Orikal: Here, take this for your help. I found this potato in one of the houses around here, and I sure as heck don't want it!
Talk to General Graken at [242, 50, -1931]
Investigate the house in Ancient Nemract at [226, 49, -1910].
The floor breaks and the player falls downwards.
Explore the tunnel in the basement of the house.
You can see a glowing ruby as you reach the end of the tunnel, but you will fall down a hole and be transported before you can reach it.
Investigate the strange dark realm.

The realm contains a gray/monochrome version of Ancient Nemract, with a few lost soul mobs scattered around. The only source of color is the giant tree around the skull that marks the entrance of the Underworld Crypt dungeon in the normal reality. There is only one path you can follow through the town, and as you go through it you will trigger multiple short cutscenes.
The scout will die and turn into a skeleton.

When you make your way to the dark version of the house in which you first entered this realm, you will be able to walk down into the basement. When you do, a group of spirits will rush out into the basement and dissipate, opening a hole in the wall that you can then pass through.
The mysterious figure will walk up and kill the lost soul, then disappear.
Upon entering the shadow version of the area in which the skull lies, you will be confronted by the figure.
Leave the strange dark realm.

You must continue down the tunnel until you fall and are transported to a copy of the first room of the Underworld Crypt dungeon. The doors in it will open; entering them will take you back to the normal version of Ancient Nemract.
Return the ruby to Graken at [242, 50, -1931]
Talk to the Scout in Detlas at [482, 70, -1585] or find one in another town.
Miliary Scouts can be found in the following towns:
Detlas =
Nemract =
Tempo Town =
Talk to Amerigo in Almuj at [979, 85, -1971].
Go into the area downstairs Admiral Amerigo's room. In it is Lanu, Linton, Admiral Amerigo himself, Aledar, and Mel. Start the meeting to progress.
Amerigo will then exit the room.
Aledar and the others will leave the room. Leave as well to progress.
Rendezvous near the barracks at [1371, 95, -2152].
Storm the barracks at [1348, 78, -2267].
Several Shadow Spears Bandits can be spotted at the Invaded Barracks.
Talk to Linton to continue.
Linton will then set off an explosive.
Linton will then walk into the barracks.
Continue through the barracks.
Throughout the barracks will be several Shadow Spears bandits. Some Shadow Spears Thrashers will ambush the player from the walls.
The player and Aledar will finally reach the room where Takan is, speaking to a crowd of Shadow Spears Bandits.
Aledar will then walk into the room with Takan and all of the Shadow Spears Bandits.
All of the Shadow Spears Bandits will then leave the room.
Defeat Takan.
Takan will turn into a hostile boss.
After defeating Takan, he will go to the center of the arena
Takan will then flee to a hidden room.
Continue up the stairs in the barracks.
After going up the stairs, the Shadow Spears Leader can be spotted in a room.
The Shadow Spears Leader will then walk to a desk that has a key on it.
The Shadow Spears Leader will jump out of the barracks and flee.
After grabbing the key, a Shadow Spears Slicer and a Shadow Spears Thrasher will appear, but they aren't necessary to defeat. Use the key on the door.
Head up the tower and take out Takan.
The tower is a parkour section. Takan will speak throughout.
At the top of the tower is Takan.
Regroup with your companions at [1374, 84, -2179].
- [1] He's dead. I have his badge.
Bring Takan's badge to Amerigo at [978, 86, -1973].
The Lieutenant at [-893, 70, -1910] needs help.
Enter the sewer at [-935, 80, -1918] and find the blockage.
Walk into the sewer pipe.
Explore the sewer and find the blockage.
As you explore the sewer, a strange black figure will sporadically appear and disappear.

Avoid or fight the mobs in the tunnel. A mysterious dark figure will appear partway through the sewer before disappearing. Part of the way through, you will have to do a short parkour. You will then see the figure run across the sewer, then Jenprest will appear at the end of the path.
Find a way to fix the blockage.
You must do another short parkour up to the TNT block, then right-click it to blow up the blockage. You will then be washed away to another part of the sewer as the sewage begins flowing again.
Find a way out of the spooky sewer.
The figure appears and disappears once again. After progressing through the sewer, the Skeleton Reaper miniboss will appear alongside 2 Rotting Skeletons.
The Skeleton Reaper must be killed for the gate to open.
Right-click on the base of the pillar to topple it, creating a parkour path for you to climb up. Once the player moves forward in the new room, the pipe will start to flood.
Parkour to the end of the pipe while outrunning the water to progress. If the player is caught, they will go back to the start.
- [1] There were all these... bodies.
Talk to Jenprest at [-920, 65, -1882]
- [1] Did you feel like there was something... watching you?
Talk to Captain Fenor in front of Detlas at [379, 67, -1569].
Enter the cave behind Captain Fenor at [384, 67, -1557].
Help Miner Linton remove the debris blocking the path.
Right-click the debris to shove it and clear the path.
Clear the cave of possible roadblocks.
Kill the mobs.
Defend Miner Linton by killing all the Zombies. (If you do not kill them, they will not actually attack Linton, but they may swarm you if you let too many live.)
Continue down the cave.
Investigate the small hole to the right of the large pile of debris.
If you try to walk away during this conversation, Drale will say:
Free the cows without being seen by the farmer.
You need to open three gates, with two Scared Cows each.
Defeat the farmer's Guard Golem.
Return to Drale about your success.
Help Drale push the raft with the cows out to sea.
Push the raft.
Return to Miner Linton back in the abandoned cave.
Speak to Sergeant Klafson next to the Ragni entrance of the cave.
Talk to Omango located at the North of Maltic at [-540, 34, -2020]
Go through the cave at [-509, 31, -2017] to find Sayrr on his boat on the other side
Bring back [10 Gudgeon Meat] found in the cave at [-383, 31, -2100] to Sayrr

If you brought Gudgeon Meat before starting the quest, you can simply give them to Sayrr now. If you did not, you can either fish for some in the cave (the best spot is around [-420, 10, -2045]) or find another spot with fewer mobs around. Make sure they all have the same quality (number of stars) when you bring them back to Sayrr.
Explore the crashed ship for a lost treasure at [-537, 34, -2026]
You must wear the Breathing Helmet to enter. There is only one path through the ship for you to follow, although, you will have to swim around many wooden structures on the way there.
Break the crate and bring [4 Old Treasure] to Omango at [-540, 34, -2020]
- Alem: You might want to .
- Alem: There is nothing in  graveyard.
- Alem: This  is private.
- Alem: I have warned you...
- A strong spiritual force pulls you towards the graveyard, making it impossible to leave the area any other way than walking.

lines.title: what to do in the graveyard
lines.text:
There are four locations in the graveyard in which you must complete a puzzle of sorts to trigger a line of dialogue. You can go through the locations in any order you want, and the dialogues will still trigger in the same order.
* One of the locations is the church at [272, 82, -329]. Go down the stairs across from the entrance and into the lava room at [272, 67, -320]. This will trigger a line of fire particles that open the doors across from the lava room (if the second door does not open, try walking away, using /class, and walking back up to it). At the end of the passage, you will find a room with a strange creature surrounded by a few cultists. One of the four dialogues will trigger soon after you enter.
* Another of the locations is the house at [288, 84, -409]. Entering the room to the left at [301, 82, -412] will cause a dead body to fall on the floor, with an Abandoned Key item right next to it. You can use the key to open the door right next to the entrance, by throwing it into the hopper at [290, 83, -411]. Then, go up the newly opened stairs, pick up an Attic Key in the room to the right at [290, 90, -414], and go back up the ladder to the left of the stairs to open another door by throwing the key into the hopper at [299, 94, -417]. Entering the attic will trigger a short cutscene with a ghost and one of the four dialogues.
* Another of the locations is the house at [281, 78, -472]. Going up the stairs to the left, at [293, 78, -482], and into the bedroom, will trigger a short cutscene with some floating books and papers. Walking towards the door opposite the stairs will cause you to fall through the floor and into a stone tunnel. Continue through the tunnel to trigger two cutscenes with skeletons walking towards you - one in the middle, with one skeleton, and one at the end, with eight skeletons on all sides. After the one at the end finishes, one of the four dialogues will trigger.
* Another of the locations is the house at [251, 75, -489]. Go up the stairs to the right, and pick up the Severed Arm in the bedroom at [236, 88, -489]. Take the Arm all the way down the stairs, and around to the hallway at [242, 75, -478] to cause the hanging skeleton to fall and open another set of stairs with the following dialogue:
** XXXXXXX: Oh, my arm.. It's ba...
** Approaching the skeleton without the Arm will instead trigger this dialogue:
** XXXXXXX: Where di.. my arm.? I need my a... I had it somewh... upstairs?
** Once the stairs fall down, go up them and towards the altar at [250, 81, -477] to trigger one of the four dialogues.
* Once you have triggered all four dialogues, you will be taken to a newly opened door at the north end of the graveyard. Enter it to progress.

After completing the sentence, Head to the door at [283, 74, -576] Once you pass through the door you will enter a large dark hallway. In order to pass through the door on the far end, you will need to pick up an Old Crypt Key from the room at [131, 9, 755] and throw it into the hopper at the end of the hallway, at [194, 10, 749].
- This door appears to be locked. Perhaps a key could be used...
After you open the door at the end, enter it to reach a room with a tomb saying "R.I.P Mael Twain A guide and a friend.". Entering the room will trigger a few lines of dialogue and a cutscene.
- ???: You were warned not to enter this forsaken place.
- ???: But since you made it thusfar, I suppose I shall show you the truth...

The cutscene shows a series of clips of the graveyard. First, it shows it in good condition, with Mael Twain helping spirits, however, after Mael dies, it shows the graveyard in its current rotten condition, and the spirits becoming restless.
- Mael: Do you understand now?
- Mael: Now leave, and forget the horrors you have witnessed here today...
- Mael: They are safer here.
'Alem;,
- Alem: I have nothing more to say. Take these.
Speak with Duvale at [-1613, 51, -4964]
Dialogue:
- Duvale: Oh, you there! I wasn't expecting a human soldier to be here, but you've come at a perfect time. I could use some help, see.
- Duvale: I'm certain you know about Guard Golems, yes? They're manufactured here in Gavel, and I bought one recently.
- Duvale: The goblins keep trying to forage in my farms, you see- I needed something to keep them out, and a Golem would have been perfect.
- Duvale: But, shortly after I activated it, the thing attacked me! I nearly got killed- It was ramming itself against boulders and walls...
- Duvale: I obviously was sold a defective model... That golem is a danger to everything around it. Do you think you're up to subduing it?
- Duvale: It's shed a trail of scrap, as you can see. Please, follow the trail of scrap and keep it from causing anyone more damage!
Find the defective Guard Golem in the mountain at [-1655, 59, -5087]

lines.title: finding the golem
lines.text: Follow the scrap trail along the path towards the swamp in the south. Go up the mountain path starting at [-1655, 59, -5087], avoiding all the golem-based mobs attacking you as you follow the path.
Find the defective Guard Golem

lines.title: finding the golem
lines.text: Once at the top of the mountain path, enter the inside of the mountain, then climb down along the branches and follow the path until you reach a door.
Dialogue:
- ???: ...I am... w̶h̴at^s my...na̷m̸e...? I had one...
- ???: Re...remember!! W̵H̸A̶T̸ IS MY N̵A̴M̵E̵? My life?
- ???: REMEMBER!! No...no orders! No dREMEMBER!! No...no o irectREMEMBER!!
You need to collect 10 acidic sludge to open the door. No...no oives!
Dialogue:
- Guard Golem: My name!! My life! I wo̴n't hurt them! The pain helps me reme...who's there?! LEAVE! PL̴E̵A̷SE!
- Guard Golem: No directives!! Who did this?! I can't...s-stop giving me ORDERS!!
- Guard Golem: N- MORE COLDNESS! NO MORE V̴O̸I̶C̴E̷S THAT AREN'T MINE! MY NAME IS [̶E̷R̶R̷O̸R̷]!! [̶E̷R̶R̷O̸R̷]!! NOOO!!
Subdue the defective Guard Golem and return to Duvale at [-1613, 51, -4964]
Dialogue:

- Guard Golem: Falling...apart...this isn't who I I I was... My... My... My my my my my name is. Was. Is. Was. Is. IS...! [̶E̷R̶R̷O̸R̷]... Ma[̶E̷R̶R̷O̸ine... Ma̷deleine!! I'm Madeleine... I... I-I-IIIIIIIIII-
Dialogue:
- Duvale: Were you able to subdue the golem? You certainly look like you're in one piece.
- Duvale: Ach...that stings. I shouldn't be surprised you had to destroy it, but that was still a big wasted investment for me.
- Duvale: Still, it makes me wonder...it sounded like it was talking when I first turned it on- Wait, you heard it too?
- Duvale: Hm. There are some unsavory rumors about the factory, come to think of it... Maybe there's some stock to them.
- Duvale: It said a name? Madeleine? It doesn't exactly ring a bell, but that's...rather concerning. I never mentioned a Madeleine to it.
- Duvale: This is worth sending onto the police, really. I think I might have to write to Olux- the factory is near there.
- Duvale: Til then, here. Consider this your reward for helping me out, brave Human. Good luck out there.
Speak to Detective Hart at [-1745, 66, -5479]
Dialogue:
- Detective Hart: Hotor, Athomo, Arperi, Etyir, Taiyroth, On'omi, Danin, Nesys, Onton. All missing...
- Detective Hart: Etan is the latest. You don't happen to know anything about these people, soldier?
- Detective Hart: Citizens are going missing at an alarming rate. We have lost 10 people in just 3 weeks. There hasn't been a trace of them anywhere.
- Detective Hart: You wouldn't have expected it, with all the guard golems we've been donated recently! Olux should be safer than ever.
- Detective Hart: Of course I have my suspicions, there are rumors floating around about...shady business going on.
- Detective Hart: I don't know who to trust in these circumstances, so if you would be willing to aid in this investigation, I'd be rather thankful.
- Detective Hart: The “Great” Daxe is a man with a criminal past. He knows things the police don't, but he won't talk with me, given my status.
- Detective Hart: Can you try to get some information from him? You can find his hut west from here. Next to that Elven girl's camp.
Follow the west road and speak with Daxe in his home at [-1924, 55, -5466]
Dialogue without Mechanical Reactor:
- Daxe: Oh, so a human wishes to wander into the home of the great Daxe?
- Daxe: Unfortunately for you, I'm not fond of visitors. I've left my criminal past behind.
- Daxe: So go on. I don't have anything to tell you.

- Duvale mentioned rumors about an illegal factory in the swamp... If Daxe's criminal past had to do with this, maybe the [Mechanical Reactor] will cause him to react. Duvale mentioned he had spares, should they be needed.
Dialogue: (with Mechanical Reactor)
- Daxe: Oh, so a human wishes to wander into the home of the great Daxe?
- Daxe: Unfortunately for you, I'm not fond of visitors. I've left my criminal past behind...mh?
- Daxe: What's that device you have there? So you already know about this, then...?
- Daxe: Hm! If you already know, what do you need the information for?
- Guard Golem: BZZT. [ERROR]...? Madeleine...?
- Guard Golem: MADELEINE! Where's...wait! What's happening, where am I? WHO'S VOICE IS THIS?!
- Daxe: Wait, what in the world is going on?! What did you do to my golem?!
- Guard Golem?: They... my daughter... SHUT UP! QUIET! Who's giving me orders- NO ORDERS! Cold! COLD!
- Daxe: Wait, your daughter?! M-Madeleine...? I...h-how...what...?
- Daxe: You...you aren't...dead steel? You remember your name...?!
- Guard Golem?: STOP GIVING ME ORDERS!! I'M...I'M THEODORE! I'M NOT A SERVANT! I...where has my life gone...? Where is...
- Guard Golem?: Madeleine... Where are you- RE-AFFIRMING DIRECTIVES. BZZT. ... ... ...
- Daxe: I... I can't believe it. They didn't...they're still...
- Daxe: Dear god, that...that must...I'll talk. I will tell you what I know.
- Daxe: I broke into the golem factory for petty thievery...and found them. They gave me this Golem... Theodore...later to keep me quiet.
- Daxe: They assured me that they were gone, that every last bit of them was erased. They...those monsters lied to me...
- Daxe: Follow this road west and turn right. Look for Urelix. The factory is hidden in a cabin, it won't look like a factory.
Head to the Golem Factory at [-2119, 55, -5557]
Find a way to deactivate the Guard Golem
- Maybe something can deactivate the golem guarding the entrance

lines.title: how to deactivate the golem
lines.text: Right-click the golem with your Mechanical Reactor to deactivate it. If you lost your Reactor, see Tips.
The guard golem left...but the reactor has stopped working.
Dialogue:
- Urelix: And what do you think you are doing, barging into my humble home like this? Do they not teach humans manners in Wynn?
- Urelix: Ah, yes. You are correct- I oversee the creation of Guard Golems. What of it?
- Urelix: Oh, you believe that our company is illicit somehow? You insult me so!
- Urelix: My golems have protected countless people for years. So if you think my company is corrupt, why don't you take a look around?
- Urelix: Go on, search through my house. See if you can find anything.
Find a way into the factory in Urelix's house

lines.title: how to get into the factory
lines.text: Right-click the lever at (-2118, 57, -5574). This will open the door at (-2108, 57, -5563); go through it and head all the way up the stairs to pick up the key at (-2107, 70, -5563). Go back down to the second floor and use the key on the door at (-2109, 63, -5569), then head to the room at (-2115, 63, -5567) and complete the puzzle by right-clicking the letters in the order A-B-C-D-E. The bookshelves will open, revealing a balcony with stairs to the roof. Enter the door at (-2117, 69, -5570) to get into the factory.
Escape the Golem Factory and find Urelix.

lines.title: 2=how to get out of the factory
lines.text:
1=
Follow the first path, avoiding objects falling from the ceiling. Go through the tunnel, then follow the next path, which will trigger the following dialogue:
*???: Initiating Chip Insertion Machine - All personell in machine be advised, avoid the spikes.
Avoid the spikes pressing repeatedly from the ceiling, then head through the second tunnel, and follow the next path while avoiding the mobs on it. Go through the next tunnel, then stand on the platform to get it to start rising and dodge the flamethrower attacks from the turrets on the walls. Once you reach the top, go across the path, then drop down without hitting any of the blocks. Enter the next tunnel, and head across the next path while avoiding mobs again, then enter another tunnel, triggering the following dialogue:
*???: Intruder Detected - Emergency meltdown initiated. Please evacuate immediately via the emergency exit.
Parkour across the path, avoiding lava and drops, until you reach an open chamber, in which you must kill a miniboss, the Factory Sentinel. Use its drop to open a door and escape.
Talk to Dr. Urelix in his office
Dialogue:
- Dr. Urelix: Well well, look at you, here at the end of my factory. I wasn't expecting you to survive the production line. I thought you'd be one of ours by now.
- Dr. Urelix: That's that, I suppose. Yes, this is indeed where all the iron golems you've ever encountered were made, and if you've gotten here, you know how we make them.
- Dr. Urelix: Yes, metal forged with flesh...an unbeatable combination. Emotions and memories must be repressed in order to maintain obedience, of course...
- Dr. Urelix: Have you ever looked at a golem's eyes? Sometimes they look back, yes. The person they once were is still in there. I almost feel a connection when I make eye contact with them...
- Dr. Urelix: It's odd, honestly. I'm sure they don't feel much except cold, supposing our safeguards stay in place, of course. I have to assume malfunctions happened to have had you find us out...
- Dr. Urelix: Oh, look at me now, rambling! I must say I have been alone for a while...well, lacking any company that converses! So, I shall make you a deal, human.
