Speak to Skyraider Guard at [1479, 84, -4343].
- Skyraider Guard: Back off! No'ne enters 'til the pirate queen is chosen. What's a landwalker like you doin' here?
- Skyraider Guard: Participate? Are ye crazy? Ain't no way a landlubber is wearing the crown.
- Skyraider Guard: Off with ya now! Before I call the gals to gut you. And dun' go wandering around chatting to any skyraiders!
Talk to Hrona at [1486, 86, -4332].
- Hrona: Yer wantin' to be pirate queen, ye? Don' worry, I can help ye.
- Hrona: Y'see, the other pirates ain't fit for the role. They're dumb 'n weak. All they've got is looks.
- Hrona: Yer got the lot! Looks and talent.
- Hrona: Y'know, the guard, she's dumb too. A simple disguise will fool 'er. Issue is, ye dun' look like a skyraider at all!
- Hrona: Yer in luck, though. A skyraider will sell anything for a price - just look around the town and see if ye can persuade anyone to part with their outfit.
Look around the skyraider town at [1442, 83, -4339] and find a pirate outfit.
A skyraider looking to part with her outfit can be found at 1427, 84, -4346.
- Egpla: Aye? A landwalker, wanderin' around our base? Whatcha' want?
- Egpla: My outfit?!
- Egpla: ... aye, I suppose I could be tempted to pass it on to ye... for a price.
- Egpla: Here, these are what I'd trade it to ye for.
- Egpla: If yer thinkin' emeralds... [30 Emerald Blocks] seems like a fair price, heh.
- Egpla: Of course, if you're running low on funds, how about ye grab me [3 Dragonling Eggs] instead? Y'know, the ingredient. I'm 'oping to raise some 'o the lil critters!
- Egpla: But if neither of them tickle ye fancy... I've always wanted [1 Shiny Shell] - they're just so sparkly! Ye can find them in the cave south-east of here, beside the ladders.
- Egpla: Ye can get me one o' those three, landwalker, and ye can have my outfit!
Give an item to Egpla at [1427, 84, -4345].
You can give Egpla 30  Emerald Blocks, 3  Dragonling Eggs, or 1  Shiny Shell for her outfit.
Nearby sources of Dragonling Eggs are on the nearest island northwest of the Skyraider Base.
To get the Shiny Shell, go to the cave at 1493, 100, -4297 and progress through it. Eventually, the Monstrous Crab miniboss will appear, and you have to defeat it for the Shiny Shell.
- What item would you trade Egpla for her outfit?
- [1] [30 Emerald Blocks]
- Egpla: So, landwalker, are ye ready to pay up? I can see emeralds in ye pocket, hand 'em over.
- [2] [3 Dragonling Eggs]
- Egpla: Alrigh'! Those're exactly what I've been lookin' for. Give it here, lemme have a look...
- [3] [1 Shiny Shell]
- Egpla: Aye, landwalker! Is that the sparkle of a shiny shell I spot in ye pocket?! Lemme have a look...
- Egpla: Alright, landwalker. Ye can have me outfit. 'ere, lemme just get changed inside.
- Egpla: Here ye go, landlubber. I hope ye get some kinda use out of it, whatever ye want it for.
Enter the trials at [1483, 82, -4339].
- Skyraider Guard: Another contestant, eh? That outfit looks a bit funny on ye, but I'll let yer in. Hurry up!
Approach the stage.
- As you walk, you hear arguments between other contestants either side of you...
- Angry Contestant: Ugh! Ye can't be the queen, ye can barely fly an airship!
- Angry Contestant: No! I'll be the queen! I'm much more qualified than any of you sky rats!
Listen to the Trials Overseer's speech.
- Trials Overseer: Gather round, ladies. The next Queen is about to be selected!
- Trials Overseer: As ye know, our previous queen suffered a... nasty fate, murdered on her very own airship by a Wynn soldier.
- Trials Overseer: But in the ashes of her honor, a new queen shall rise! Three trials. That's what ye all face now.
- Trials Overseer: Only one, who passes all trials laid before her, will pass and gain the title of Skyraider Queen.
- Trials Overseer: Now, I introduce ye all to the first trial, to test yer capability at a vital skill for queenship - combat!
- Trials Overseer: Ladies, you may now Begin!
Defeat the armory room of the combat challenge.
Defeat the brig room of the combat challenge.
Defeat the cockpit room of the combat challenge.
Listen to the trials overseer's speech.
- Trials Overseer: Arr, that weeded out the weak. A queen must be strong to lead.
- Trials Overseer: Now, to the second challenge - the task of flight! Ye can't be a queen if ye can't fly yer airship!
- Trials Overseer: Make sure ye bring yer eyes, girls, one false move and death awaits.
- Trials Overseer: This task should get rid of the rest of ye unworthy.
Defeat the challenge of flight.

The challenge of flight is structured like a flappy-bird styled game. You press the stone button to change the vertical movement of your airship. The challenge ends once you get to the checkered line. If you hit any obstacles or reach the bottom of the screen, you will crash and have to start over again. If you get to the top, you will not crash, but instead will not change your vertical position until you get below it again.
Listen to the trials overseer's speech.
- Trials Overseer: Well lookie here, an amateur made it through her flight.
- Trials Overseer: Well let’s see how you hold up in the final task ladies.
- Trials Overseer: Yer ain’ a pirate at all if ye can't steal, but this is different.
- Trials Overseer: This is the real deal. Stealin’ from a highly secure mansion.
- Trials Overseer: Yer job is to steal a priceless treasure from the richest family in the sky.
- Trials Overseer: We'll be waiting with a getaway airship at the extraction point, everyone else'll left behind.
- Trials Overseer: Remember, this be the real thing, and the consequences of failure will be severe. Good luck, ladies.
- Trials Overseer: This here is the garden you we'll tunnel into, and yer'll 'ave to find a way into the Mansion, maybe yer can just ask nicely, heh.
- Trials Overseer: Then yer'll have to sneak through these corridors to reach the treasure - and don't let the guards find yer, or they'll lock yer up and throw away the key.
- Trials Overseer: This, o' course, is the mythical treasure that yer gonna want to grab and get outta here, stat. I'm sure there'll be some extra defenses, though.
- Trials Overseer: And finally yer'll have to escape outta this window right 'ere - I'll be waitin' with an airship to carry all of ye out.
Break into the mansion.
- Skyraider: Aye', think ye ready to try grabbin' that treasure, eh? Just 'ead outta this hole and try to find yer way into the mansion.
There will be several items you can grab to toss at the window and try to break it. The location of each are found at the following locations:
The five above do not break the window, however, the  Rock found at -17271, 15, 21161 will do the trick.
- Perhaps you can try throwing this at the window?
Go in front of the window on the ground to select an item to break it.
- What item would you like to throw at the window?
- [1] [Grape]
- It looks like your grape didn't do anything... you should find another item to throw.
- [2] [Leaf]
- It looks like your leaf didn't do anything... you should find another item to throw.
- [3] [Flower]
- It looks like your flower didn't do anything... you should find another item to throw.
- [4] [Apple]
- It looks like your apple didn't do anything... you should find another item to throw.
- It looks like your egg didn't do anything... you should find another item to throw.
- [6] [Rock]
- The rock broke the window! Now you've just got to find a way up there...
Do some parkour after breaking the window to get into the mansion.
Sneak past the guards and steal the treasure.
- Looks like you're inside the Mansion... now you've got to find your way to the treasure.

lines.title: how to sneak past the guards
lines.text: The ones past the fountain don't attack or move, just walk through the maze without walking in front of them, walk behind them.
(If you get caught)
- Mansion Guard: Oi', you! Whatcha' think yer' doin' sneakin' around these parts? This be a restricted area! Yer' headed to the jail cell!
Get the treasure to the trials overseer outside of the mansion's window.
- Mansion Guard: Aye', men! Tha' treasure has been stolen! Prepare the defenses!
(If you fall in a hole)
- Mansion Guard: Aye, we caught the nasty thief! We'll be lockin' him up till' he rots!
- Trials Overseer: Ah, I thought yer might be the first one back. Yer got a queenly look about ye...
- Trials Overseer: Head to the airship behind me, lassie. We'll wait a second before the others.
Exit the Mansion onto the airship outside.
Listen to the trials overseer's speech.
- Trials Overseer: Aha! I figured it'd be ye to win o'er the rest of that lot… Ye've earned the proper sovereignty of bein' our ruler, our queen of the Skyraiders.
- Trials Overseer: Don't be worryin', we got this airship armoured somethin' heavy, and we’re miles away from their cannons… Nothin' to be afraid of, we're safe in this ship.
- Trials Overseer: But, first things first, let’s take a look inside that fancy box ye got, see what mythical treasures lay guarded behind those grubby guardsmen, shall we?
- Trials Overseer: By the skies and seas…
- Trials Overseer: I hafta wonder now if this weren't bein' guarded for a bit of a nefarious reason. This be... Quite the weapon. It'd be deadly if this got used.
- Trials Overseer: Well, thanks to ye, us Skyraiders might have it now, but using this weapon against civilization would be beyond terrible. We might be pirates but we ain't heartless!
- Trials Overseer: I think we'll just have to keep this locked up nice n' tight once we get back. We'll be sure to tie this little cataclysm-in-a-box down much safer th'n those idiot men did.
- Trials Overseer: Aha! Just gettin' back now. Let's head down and start the ceremony, shall we?
- Trials Overseer: I am pleased to introduce our 734th Skyraider Queen. Fer the sake of our people, let her reign last more than two weeks.
- Trials Overseer: I, on behalf on the rest of the Skyraider people, have the honor of decoratin' you with the highest decoration of the Skyraiders, The Queen's Headpiece.
- Trials Overseer: Please use your sovereignty to lead us to the riches we deserve.
Talk to the trials overseer.
- Trials Overseer: Yer Majesty. What an honour to have such a beautiful queen.
- Trials Overseer: Now, we must crown ye, and give you yer reward.
- Trials Overseer: Benefits of being a queen I 'spose.
- Trials Overseer: Please accept this, your majesty.
Speak to General Elix at [758, 164, -4463] in Kandon-Beda.
- General Elix: ... Alright, let's see here... Private! Give me a report!
- Private Walder: Sir, our readings are postive! Stablility is at 96%, and shows no sign of dropping.
- Private Walder: Readings are positive!
- General Elix: Excellent. Keep an eye on everything, and let me know if something comes up. Now, I need to go find...-
- General Elix: Hmph. And who exactly are you? This site is off-limits to civilians.
- [1] Just an adventurer passing through.
- General Elix: Adventurer. Of course. Well, as it stands, we're doing rather dangerous work here. I'll have to ask you to-
- [2] What's this device for?
- General Elix: ... The stabilizer? We're doing rather dangerous work here, keeping the thing beyond that cliff passive. So, I'll have to ask you to-
The ground will then shake beneath you.
- Private Walder: General! Stability is dropping, and fast!
- Private Walder: General!
- General Elix: What?! Of all times for it to-
- General Elix: Urgh... Soldiers, follow protocol! Secure what you can, and leave what you can't! And- you! I haven't forgotten about you. As soon as this all cleans up, we'll-
- General Elix: Gah! This damned Colossus! What I wouldn't give to...
- General Elix: ... It's over. Walder! Survey the damages to our equipment! Morec! Take count of injuries around the base, make sure everyone's safe!
- Private Walder: Yes sir!
Two scientists named ??? will walk up to the stabilizer.
- ???: General! We came as soon as we could- we were down in the library and the exit co- Oh. Wow.
- General Elix: Well, Rhay, you're here now, yes? What do you think, can you fix it? We'll need to get it working before-
One of the scientist's names changes to Rhay.
- Rhay: Can I- No, of course I can't fix it! Not on my own, especially since we don't have the proper equipment around here! Ugh, how long has it even been since last time?
- ???: It has been... three days... give or take. Rhay... you know we can't keep-
- Rhay: The stabilizer has been working so far, Ineos! It's some of the finest technology our province has had to offer, and it has been working!
The other scientist's name changes to Ineos.
- Ineos: Rhay, you know... as well as I do... that it is getting worse. The Protector is... growing resistant to... your machines. We need... a new plan.
- Rhay: Yes, well, as soon as you come up with one, I'll be glad to hear it! But so far, you've barely gotten anything-
- Rhay: ...
- Ineos: ...
- Rhay: ... Sorry. I'm sorry, I didn't mean that. General, to answer your question... The stabilizer itself is damaged, but you should have what's needed to repair it here.
- Rhay: The issue is that the controls look like they're fried! And we don't have any replacement parts stored here. We'll have to travel back to Corkus, and...
- [1] Is there anything I can do to help?
- General Elix: ...Right. You. You're an adventurer, yes? And you appear to be well-equipped. Then you'll be traveling to Corkus with Rhay, and assist with whatever is needed there.
- Rhay: Huh?
- Rhay: Wait, General-... Right. Alright. In that case... I'll give you time to prepare. We'll take the Hot Air Balloon to travel to Corkus, so I'll meet you there. We don't have any time to waste.
- Ineos: And I will... return to the library. I trust... you will succeed... But we must... prepare for the... worst.
- Ineos: Alright...
Rhay will then run towards the Hot Air Balloon while Ineos heads towards the library.
Meet Rhay at the Hot Air Balloon at [770, 162, -4385]
- Rhay: Ah, you're here! Well, if you're ready, then we'd best be off. Just hop aboard this balloon, and the captain will take us where we need to go.
- Rhay: I can tell you more while we travel, but we need to get going quick. There's no telling how much time we have before-
- Rhay: Right, right. Don't mind me, I'm just a little on edge, for... well, obvious reasons. Just hop aboard.
Travel to Corkus City via the Hot Air Balloon at [775, 165, -4382]
- Rhay: Well, there it is! The Canyon Colossus itself. The source of all our problems here at Kandon-Beda.
- Rhay: So! How much do you already know? I know we dragged you into this without telling you much, so... I can fill you in on the details.
- [1] I heard the General mention it. So it's the source of those earthquakes?
- Rhay: Oh, he did? Right, that makes sense. Well, you're right in that it's the source of the earthquakes, but there's more to it than that.
- Rhay: You've seen the Sky Islands, right? Heard of the Fracturing. From what I can tell, what happened to that region a thousand years ago is happening again, here and now.
- [1] And the Colossus is what's causing it?
- Rhay: Yes, exactly. It's been malfunctioning for a long time now, and it's starting to tear the canyon apart. That's where we come in.
- [2] I don't know much about it. Can you tell me about it?
- Rhay: Well... To start with, it's an ancient thing. It was built long before even the doguns can remember, and they've lived in this region for thousands of years.
- Rhay: According to Ineos, the doguns used to be responsible for keeping it calm, but ever since the dwarves came in and started their war, that knowledge has been lost to time.
- Rhay: Which is... a problem! The Colossus has been malfunctioning for hundreds of years, and it's reaching its breaking point. If we don't stop it, it'll tear the canyon apart.
- [1] Alright. How do we stop it?
- [3] I've seen the kinds of things it does to the canyon.
- Rhay: Oh? So you've traveled the canyon, then. Yeah, then you've seen how the canyon twists and changes.
- Rhay: It destroys peoples' homes, it traps them deep within the maze-like valleys... And, more recently, it has been tearing a hole into the void.

- Rhay: This thing is ancient, and we don't know how it works. The best we can do is try to keep it from reaching its breaking point, and prevent the canyon from meeting the same fate as the Sky Islands.
- Rhay: So, Gavel's government contacted us in Corkus some time ago, requesting our help to deal with this threat.
- Rhay: Our council agreed, and we got to work designing a machine that could replicate the dogun magic that pacified that Colossus long ago.
- Rhay: We've had Ineos' help on that front. He and I have been working here in Kandon-Beda to ensure things are running smoothly. Which... evidently, they are not.
- Rhay: ... We'll be fine! We're going to meet up with my husband at Corkus, and he'll know what to do. He always does.
- [1] What are we going to do at Corkus?
- Rhay: Our people there will be able to get us the parts we need to repair the device. This... this isn't the first it's exploded. I had hoped that this time we would have gotten it stable, but...
- Rhay: But, hey! We have it under control. We're always able to repair it quickly enough to keep it running while the Colossus is active.
- [2] Your husband?

- Rhay: Oh! Yeah. He's the one responsible for the design and production of this device. He's got a talent for designing these sorts of things, without him... well, we'd be in a much worse situation than we are now.
- Rhay: I'll be glad to see him again. It's been a while since I last had to travel to Corkus, and... Well, I'm confident he'll know what to do here. He always does.
- Rhay: ... Right! Hey, it looks like we're almost there. We'll be able to get this all sorted out, and we'll be back to Kandon-Beda in no time.
Find the contact in the factory at [-1529, 71, -3083]
- Rhay: Alright, let's just head on in. My husband should be around here somewhere...
Maxie will then walk out of the factory.
- Maxie: Rhay, love! You're back already? Our next routine maitenance isn't for another- Wait, ? What are you doing here?
- Rhay: I... You two know each other?
- Maxie: Of course we do - they're the one who helped me with all the Factory stuff! How did you two meet?
Rhay will then turn to look at you.
- Rhay: They just showed up at Kandon-Beda and agreed to help us with... - Why didn't you bring this up earlier?
- [1] Must have slipped my mind.
- Rhay: It must have...- right. Well, if anything that makes you even more qualified to help us out, I guess! I can't believe I didn't recognize you...?
- Maxie: Okay, right, back to the question - what are you two doing here already? There's another few days or so until our next routine maitenance, isn't there?
- [2] Wait, Maxie, you got married? Why wasn't I invited?
- Maxie: I did send you an invite! I gave it to... you know, that that one captain who ferries people around! But then you didn't show up to the wedding, so I guess it didn't reach you...
- Maxie: Look, you're a hard person to reach! You've been all over the world at this point, including Kandon-Beda of all places- speaking of, why are you two here?
- Rhay: !!!
- Rhay: Right! Right. Got a little distracted there... Uh, we've run into a problem back at Kandon-Beda. We experienced an undetected seismic event, and the device was heavily damaged.
- Rhay: We should be able to finish most of the repairs with what materials we have there, but we're missing a Magmaflux Capacitor for the control panel.
Nodise will then walk up behind Maxie.
- Maxie: ... Oh. That's going to be a problem. We haven't had an opportunity to make more parts yet - it hasn't been long enough since our last maitenance. So... I'm not sure what we-
- Nodise: I overheard the conversation from over there- good to see you Rhay, by the way- But. We may not have any capacitors left up here, but I know where you can get one.
- Nodise: We repurposed this factory for our needs, but it was built here to process resources from the mines below.

- Nodise: Though it was discontinued, it's still very likely that there are still miner mechs down there- and some of the more powerful models made use of very similar circuits to the capacitors we use today.

- Maxie: ... You're right! If they're still down there, we should be able to scrap one of the bots and reuse its circuits. , we can send you down into the mines to find what we need, while we prepare up here!
- [1] Alright, I can do that.
- Rhay: Alright... Good luck down there! Find the bot, destroy it, and bring the capacitor back up! Just step on the platform in the middle of the factory when you're ready.
- [2] I need to prepare first.
- Maxie: Okay. That's fine, just make it quick! You know we can't waste any time here.
Retrieve the part from the cave at [-1529, 69, -3104]
- Maxie: Door opening in 3...
- Maxie: 2...
- Maxie: 1...
- [!] Central bore tunnel opening! Exercise extreme caution around the deep drop.
The door below you will open, sending you to the cave with the mechs. As you make your way through the cave, it will start to shake.
- Mining Robots: INTRUDER DETECTED. HOSTILE ENGAGEMENT AUTHORISED.
The Mining Robots will then spawn, and you must kill 4 to proceed.
- Mining Robots: DEPLOYING SECONDARY ANTI-INTRUDER MEASURES.
Another wave will spawn, requiring you to kill 8 more.
- Mining Robots: DIVERTING ALL AVAILABLE UNITS TO HALT INTRUDER.
A final wave of 12 mining robots will spawn. Kill them all to get to the boss.
- The Mother Drill: THIS IS A RESTRICTED AREA. REQUESTING AUTHORISATION FOR USE OF LETHAL FORCE AGAINST INTRUDER.
- The Mother Drill: AUTHORISATION GRANTED.
The ground will then shake as the Mother Drill comes out of the ground.

The Mother Drill's fight is fairly simple, as it has a custom spell, Drill, which will teleport the Mother Drill to a certain spot in the arena. The spot is telegraphed by several dirt particles coming out of it. Once the boss is as 65,000 HP, it will call for backup.
- The Mother Drill: DIVERTING MINER MECHS TO HALT INTRUDER.
You will then have to kill 12 of the mining mechs that were fought prior to the boss fight. Once all 12 have been killed, you can then go back to fighting the Mother Drill.
- [+1 Magmaflux Capacitor]
Return to the hot air balloon at [-1526, 71, -3067] with the Magmaflux Capacitor.
- Rhay: Amazing work! I'll get us back to Kandon-Beda with that capacitor as quick as possible.
- Maxie: Good to see you again, . Good luck with the colossus. And Rhay... come home as soon as you can.
- Maxie: Fly safe, both of you.
Return to General Elix with the Corkian Stabiliser
- Rhay: Well... that went better than expected, really. I still can't believe you didn't tell me you already knew Maxie.
Rhay will then walk to General Elix and Ineos.
- Rhay: Oh, wow. It looks like they've managed to fix up the machine pretty well, all things considered. Just this part left to get it running again...
- General Elix: Hmph. Rhay, there you are. Seeing as you've returned, I gather everything went smoothly at Corkus?
- Rhay: Smoothly enough, General! We have what we need to repair the control panel. We'll be able to get the stabilizer running again!
- General Elix: Well?! What are you waiting for? Finish the repairs, we can't afford to lose any time with this damned Colossus looming over us.
- Rhay: Yes, sir! Alright. , just slot the capacitor in right... there. I'll make sure it runs smoothly.
Right-click the machine to insert to Magmaflux Capacitor.
- [-1 Magmaflux Capacitor]
The machine will start up.
- General Elix: There we are. Now, let's get this thing running again! Walder, keep an eye on stability! And... Rhay. You're confident this will work?
- Rhay: I-I'm sure. This is our last chance. We have to hold out hope that the stabilizer will hold.
The ground will then shake.
- Rhay: Alright, alright... It's now or never... Hold, stabilizer, hold!
The ground will keep on shaking as fire comes off of the stabilizer, before eventually exploding.
- Rhay: ... Oh. That's... that's it, then. It's over. We failed.
- Ineos: I... am sorry, Rhay. I had... hoped it would work. In truth... I do not have... a plan... either.
- Ineos: The Elders... would have known... what to do... But they are... long gone. Nothing but... ruins remain.
- [1] The Elders?
- Ineos: The Elders... They were... the greatest... of doguns. As old... as the oldest stones... and wise... as the earth itself...
- Ineos: They were capable... of magic... beyond what any... of us could achieve. They alone... could calm our... Protector.
- [1] What happened to the Elders?
- Ineos: They were... sealed away. Frozen in... the deepest... of ice. When the dwarves... slew Garaheth... the Elders... fell with him.
- Ineos: Such atrocities... The war... My people... But it is not... to dwell on, now. There are... more important... things at hand.
- [1] But the war is over. The dwarves and doguns have made peace.
- Ineos: I... I did not... know of this. My people... are free? How long... has it been... since I have seen... my home?
- Ineos: You... Adventurer. We must... speak to my people. Our chieftain... will know... how we may free... the Elders.
- General Elix: If there is a chance... We have to take it. Ineos, , take the balloon. We'll do whatever we can here. Now, go! There's no time to waste!
Meet Ineos and Rhay at the Hot Air Balloon at [770, 162, -4385].
Rhay and Ineos will be by the Hot Air Balloon. Once you get in, you will fly over Ahmsord before landing in the Dogun Settlement in the Molten Heights.
- Ineos: I have never... seen the Heights... from above. I wonder... if their glow... holds the same strength... it does from below...
- Ineos: I only hope... the Elders... are not gone... for good. We greatly need... their wisdom.
- Ineos: Ah... I believe us... to be landing...
Travel to Molten Heights with Ineos via the Hot Air Balloon at [770, 162, -4385]
Korzim and two other Doguns will appear alongside him.
- Korzim: ... Hello. What a... strange sight... to see you landing... at our village... in such a contraption...
Korzim turns to face Ineos.
- Korzim: And... is that... Ineos? We thought... the dwarves... had turned you into rubble...
- Ineos: I escaped... It is a long... story, Korzim. We do not... have time. Where is... your father?
- Korzim: He is... below. They are... freeing the frozen... in New Taloka. Why do you... wish to speak... with him?
- Ineos: The Protector... is angered. We must find... the Elders. They will know... how to calm it.
- Korzim: The... Protector... I understand. I will... bring you two... to him. Sidio... Raetin... I leave you two... in charge.
The Dogun on the left has its name changed to Sidio, while the one on the right is changed to Raetin.
- Korzim: Now, let us... travel. Through flame... and through stone...

Dialogue:
- Maxie: You're back, and you have the key!

Find the vault in Corkus City at
Dialogue:
- Corkus Delegate: Mo'in...
- Bertil: Uh- No need to worry! We accidentally...
- Reiva: Blew a hole in the wall! Yep!
- Corkus Delegate: Stop. Maxie, was right. I'm sorry. Mech X pierced the vault like it was nothing and took the key.

Dialogue:
- Maxie: Psst! Over here, in the field!
- Maxie: Mo'in. See that guy up there? He hasn't moved an inch since I got here.
- Maxie: I don't think he's actually a farmer. Follow me.
- Farmer: HELLO... I AM A... HUMAN... FARMER.
- Farmer: DO YOU... HAVE... ANY BUSINESS... WITH ME?
- Maxie: Nice try, mech! Not convincing enough for me!
- S-63 Mech: REPORT... COVER HAS BEEN COMPROMISED... TWO UNAUTHORIZED INTRUDERS... OUTSIDE OF BASE.
- S-63 Mech: NEW OBJECTIVE... EXTERMINATE-
- Maxie: Oh no you DON'T!
- Maxie: That model was a S-63, meaning it has warned the others. Follow me.
- Maxie: See. We're locked out now.
- Maxie: Stand back, I'll open the door.
- Maxie: I think we can safely assume this is the right place.
- Maxie: You storm in and find what we need. I'll cover you from out here.
- Maxie: You need to find and destroy that new factory mech.

lines.title: Spoiler
lines.text: Go up the stairs and press the button to open the door at coordinates [-1331 120 -2398]. Then, go down the stairs at [-1332 103 -2426] and continue down the stairs that will appear in the middle of the room..
Dialogue:
The basement door has been opened.
- Mech X: INTRUDER DETECTED. DESTROY.
- Mech X: Corkus has to suffer... They shut down the Factory, locked us up in there. Once we have both keys we can open it and you are NOT getting this one.
Find Maxie and give him the key.
Dialogue:
- Maxie: Mo'in. Did you get the key?
- Maxie: Amazing. Now we need to meet at the factory. Now the real hard part begins.
- Maxie: Follow the northwestern road and enter the factory from the west side. I will meet you there.
Find Maxie outside the factory at
Dialogue:
- Maxie: Mo'in. Are you sure you are ready?
- Maxie: This won't be your average fight. The factory is cutting edge. Run by a being of pure electromagic.
- Maxie: The smartest man on Corkus, Cerid spent years making a being smarter even than he is...
- Maxie: Now it runs the factory with a twisted sense of morality. It's easy to see why it was shut down.
- Maxie: Also.. I- I made you these boots using my magic. It turns out I am pretty good at making stuff.
- Maxie: I just wanted to say thanks, too. I really feel like I made a difference fighting with you. When you are ready, just walk up to the factory doors.
Visit the workshop at [-1731, 134, -3267] (Requires completion of The Envoy Part II)
Dialogue:
- ???: Oh?! Hold on, is anyone there..!
- Ava: Why hello there! Whatcha doin' here? I'm Ava!
- Ava: Want a quick job? How 'bout helpin' me out?! That was perfect timing!

- Ava: Look, I think I got a breakthrough invention. If it works... Oh man...

Dialogue:

- Ava: I'll take that chance to sneak behind the throne, where our sacred totem is. I'm not stealing it, don't worry!

Distract the Avos Chief at [-1819, 131, -3071]
Dialogue:
- Avos Chieftain: Greetings, human. Welcome back.
- Avos Chieftain: So, what brings you here, hm?
- Avos Chieftain: Oh, you want to learn more about us... Of course, of course!
- Avos Chieftain: We have a room where I can show you some of our history.
- Avos Chieftain: You're in luck, I'm in a good mood. Follow me then.
DISTRACT!
Interact with the different items in the room by clicking on them. You're limited with what you can interact with, though! You need to hold the chief busy for one minute.
Right Click on the chief to begin.
Info: The bar represents the chief's suspicion level. Make sure it doesn't fill up!
When clicking on the books:
- Avos Chief: Gah! What are you doing?!
- Avos Chief: It's alright, these books aren't important... Be careful though.
Note: Clicking on the books will increase the chief's suspicion, rather than decrease it, so it is better to avoid them.
When clicking on the potted plant:
- Avos Chief: Ah, our wisteria tree! Yes...
- Avos Chief: It's one of a kind! We planted it eons ago. It has never ever grown an inch. Or moved.
- Avos Chief: Never died or anything either. For all we know, it might predate your corruption too!
When clicking on the floating book:
- Avos Chief: Oh, this is quite the important tome.
- Avos Chief: This book has a signature from all Avos chiefs ever since we discovered ink!
When clicking on the feather in a crate:
- Avos Chief: Right, the feathery crate!
- Avos Chief: It's a custom for every Avos chief to keep their feathers somewhere. I guess I left that here.
When clicking on the shelves with a plant on them:
- Avos Chief: And here's some important history!
- Avos Chief: Though, we don't really have the time to sit down and read all of it, do we?
After a minute has passed:
- Avos Chieftain: What was that?! I'll check.
A cutscene of Ava breaking out of the totem room will play.
- Avos Chieftain: Someone broke in? But why? Anyone can use our totem...
- Avos Chieftain: I don't get it. They could've just asked...
- Looks like Ava left. She probably went back to the Workshop.
Report back to Ava in the Workshop at [-1731, 134, -3267]
Dialogue:

Dialogue:

Ask for an Enhanced Microchip at [-1436, 134, -3109]

Find the control panel near the shop at [-1436, 134, -3109]
Dialogue:

lines.title: finding the control panel
lines.text: The control panel is located underneath a trapdoor on the north side of the shop, which you can open using 16 tokens dropped from the mobs around the shop.
Dialogue:
- Ava: Here we are! Good job! Alright, let's see...
- Ava: Wait... Why are there... Buttons... Everywhere??
- Ava: I feel like soaking everything would be quite the mistake.
- Ava: And none of them are labelled! What is that?!
- Ava: Look, your choice. What should we neutralize first?
If you choose the left panel:

- Ava: Alright, let's soak this.
- [!] Safety teleportation sequence activated!
- Ava: TELEPORTATION?!
- Ava didn't get teleported with you! You're on your own!
If you choose the middle panel:

- [+1 Enhanced Microchip]

If the microchip is an Enhanced Potential Microchip:

- Ava: Huh! This wasn't that bad. And... I see something poking out, hold on...
- Ava: Haha! I think that's what we're looking for!

If you choose the right panel:

- [!] ERROR: Defense protocols shutdown!

- Ava: Well, good job. I still want to make it up to the poor guy though.

Meet Ava in the workshop at [-1731, 134, -3267]

If you chose the left panel:
Dialogue:

If you chose the middle or right panel:

In Ava's workshop:
Dialogue:
- Ava: I can't believe it! It's working! Look! Look at it!

Meet Ava outside of the Workshop and help her operate her machine at [-1719, 173, -3348]
Dialogue:
- Ava: Alright, it's just on the hill next to us, but I can bring you there if ya want!
- Ava: Just don't get too used to me, alright? Tell me when you're ready.
If you fly up with Ava:
- Ava: Here we go!
If you choose to walk:
- Ava: Or I guess you could just leave, that's cool too...

Dialogue:

- Ava: I'll do a quick rundown of how to operate this. It's not automatic yet.

If you choose to fly with Ava:
Dialogue:

- Ava: Gah! If I can't get myself to do it now, I'll never do it!

At the Chief's hut:
Dialogue:
- Avos Chieftain: Ah, human! Welcome back. Good timing...
- Avos Chieftain: Did you happen to see... An oddly dressed Avo around here recently?

- Avos Guard: That's it, I-

- [-1 Growth Accelerator Remote]

- Ava: Let me just...

Dialogue:

- Avos Chieftain: I recognized extracts from the totem too. You're the one who stole from us, right?

Meet Ava near Corkus City at [-1573, 86, -2762]

lines.text: One sentry will stand near the large throne. One will walk between balconies on the south side of the room. Two will walk back and forth between the room's entrance and the elevator, and two more will walk around between the elevator and the balloon.

There's some clothes here. They're dirty though.
[+1 Dirty Clothes]
There must be a way to wash those somewhere nearby.
After washing the clothes at a sink in the room at (-1470, 95, -2936):
You start washing the clothes...
[+1 Emerald-Encrusted Outfit]
The Azure Outfit can be obtained simply by going to the wardrobe at -1466, 96, -2917.
Looks like there's an outfit ready right here!
[+1 Azure Outfit]
You can give it to Ava, or you can look around the other rooms for more options.

The Power Outfit is the most difficult one to get. You first must grab a bone from -1476, 84, -2905 by heading downstairs, going into the banquet hall, going through the right-most entrance into the kitchen to find a  Bone. You then bring the Bone to Pip at -1492, 95, -2910, and Pip will then run to a location. Follow Pip and he will lead you to a bookshelf that will then open to reveal a secret hideaway, which contains the Power Armor, along with two  Fiberglass Frames with the chest located at -1482, -2948, and sixteen  Protective Fabrics with the chest located at -1480, -2948. Unlike the other outfits, the Power Armor will be behind you when selecting the outfits, so be wary of that when it comes to selecting the outfit.
Getting the Bone:
You pick up a particularly tasty-looking bone.
[+1 Bone]
Getting the Power Armor:

lines.title: how to find the invitation and an optional thing to do
lines.text:
Go around to the back entrance of the inn at (-1652, 67, -2954). Go up the ladder at (-1649, 68, -2952), then up the stairs at (-1650, 75, -2945). Go into the room to the left, and pick up the key near the furnace. Take the key back down to the door at (-1651, 74, -2945), and enter the far room. You will find a written contract for the armour merchant to hide the invitation letter.
In the room directly after the door key, you can go to -1657, -2940 and find a key. Right-click it to get an Oddly-Shaped Key, then head back upstairs into the room with a ladder. Climb up the ladder and use the key on the trapdoor, which will open it. Up here there will be two chests, with each being at -1655, -2937, and -1650, -2949. The former chest contains 6 Tender Pork Fillets, 4 Lockpicking Kits, and 64 Emeralds, while the latter chest contains 320 Emeralds.
After finding the contract (you will not be able to get in if you haven't yet), go to the armour merchant's shop, and go up the ladder at (-1639, 68, -2908). The invitation letter is in the room to the left; take it back to Ava, and tell her to follow you.

lines.title: how to find the invitation and an optional thing to do
lines.text:
Go around to the back entrance of the inn at (-1652, 67, -2954). Go up the ladder at (-1649, 68, -2952), then up the stairs at (-1650, 75, -2945). Go into the room to the left, and pick up the key near the furnace. Take the key back down to the door at (-1651, 74, -2945), and enter the far room. You will find a written contract for the armour merchant to hide the invitation letter.
In the room directly after the door key, you can go to -1657, -2940 and find a key. Right-click it to get an Oddly-Shaped Key, then head back upstairs into the room with a ladder. Climb up the ladder and use the key on the trapdoor, which will open it. Up here there will be two chests, with each being at -1655, -2937, and -1650, -2949. The former chest contains 6 Tender Pork Fillets, 4 Lockpicking Kits, and 64 Emeralds, while the latter chest contains 320 Emeralds.
After finding the contract (you will not be able to get in if you haven't yet), go to the armour merchant's shop, and go up the ladder at (-1639, 68, -2908). The invitation letter is in the room to the left; take it back to Ava, and tell her to follow you.

Dialogue:
- Maxie: ...Huh.
- Maxie: The Avos chief did mention her once, but this place is crazy!
- Ava: You... I assume you're here to take me.
- Ava: Go ahead, then. Do it. I don't have anything to lose anymore. I've already lost everything.
- Maxie: Ava... I-
- Ava: I don't want your pity. I have no one. You're making this harder for yourself.
- Maxie: The president didn't sentence you to death or anything... Quite the opposite, actually.
- Ava: What do you mean? Why should I trust you?
- Maxie: Well, it's just that-
- ???: Don't bother, Maxie. I'll explain myself.
- Efena: Nice place. I can clearly see how our culture got to you.
- Ava: So you're here. Are you... Forgiving me?
- Efena: Oh, "forgive" is a really strong word, Ava. Look.
- Efena: I do believe we can all learn a thing or two about this. Ava...
- Efena: You broke the law, and as such, you're not allowed in town. Ya understand?
- Ava: First the Avos, then you, huh. So it's come full circle.
- Efena: Look, that machine of yours is impressive. I'm not lying. You're talented.
- Efena: But you've definitely made quite the mistake. I did too.
- Efena: I guess you and I really learnt what acting in the heat of the moment means, huh.
- Efena: I have some sort of... Compromise. For us. Maxie?

- Maxie: You're clearly better at Electromagic than I, so...
- Maxie: I'm willing to provide you with what you need. Help you out from time to time.
- Efena: You've been alone for so long, Ava. I'm lending you Maxie!
- Maxie: Hey, don't say it like that!
- Efena: *chuckles* I'm kidding. The rest of the council isn't aware yet.
- Efena: They're not gonna like this, but I'll handle it.
- Efena: You know I can't kill you. Can you imagine how the Avos would take it? Even though you're banished...
- Efena: But I don't want to either. As for you, ...
- Efena: I'll give you some stuff. I can't imagine how things would've gone if it weren't for you.
- Efena: Now, you're banished from everyone Ava. I know that's no happy ending.
- Efena: But that would've been too easy, don't ya think?
- Efena: Maybe later, you'll get your happy ending. But you can settle with not being alone anymore, right?
- Efena: Goodbye, Ava. Who knows, maybe I'll stop by sometimes.
- Ava: ...? If you stop by the Workshop later, maybe I'll have some things for you as well.
- Ava: Bye. Thanks. For everything.
