lines.title: collectibles information
lines.text:
You will need 12,288 Emeralds, or 3 Liquified Emeralds to purchase all 3 items.

Item 1/3 –  Siegfried Mug (2048 E) – Llevigar [-2122, 53, -4570]

Item 2/3 –  Siegfried Mask (4096 E) – Cinfras [-453, 47, -4981]

Item 3/3 –  Siegfried Autograph (6144 E) – Ahmsord [1032, 110, -4589]
- Scavenger Hunt Collector: You’re back! Let me see your items.
- Scavenger Hunt Collector: This… Wow, all of them? Let me take a look at these…
- Scavenger Hunt Collector: They’re all authentic! You must be ri-I mean, you must be a huge fan of Siegfried!
- Scavenger Hunt Collector: Give me a moment here…
- Scavenger Hunt Collector: Okay, I’ve entered you into the draw. The event’s taking place at the Golden Eagle Theatre.
- Scavenger Hunt Collector: Just turn toward the bank and follow the signs, the winner will be selected when everyone gets there.
Go to the Golden Eagle Theatre behind the Bank in Ahmsord at [1119, 124, -4555] for the winners to be announced.
- Announcer: Welcome, welcome everyone! We’re only waiting on a few more people before we begin.
- Announcer: Ah, there we go! I believe we’re all set now.
- Announcer: Welcome everyone, to the monthly SIEGFRIED FESTIVAL SCAVENGER HUNT!
- Announcer: Today, we are once again celebrating the heroic deeds of Siegfried!
- Announcer: All of you, my fellow gavellians, have adventured far and wide to gather rare items across the province.
- Announcer: And yet, I cannot announce the winner…
- Announcer: BECAUSE SIEGFRIED WILL!
- Siegfried Fan: SIEGFRIED!!
- Siegfried Fan: It's SIEGFRIED!
- Siegfried Fan: It's him!
- Siegfried Fan: SIEGFRIED PICK MEEE!
- Siegfried Fan: SIEEEGGFRIEED!
- The above Siegfried Fan will run up on the stage before being stopped by a Siegfried Agent.
- Siegfried Agent: Stay back!
- Siegfried Fan: SIEEEGGFRIEED!
- Siegfried: Hello, Citizens of Gavel!

- Siegfried: Thank you all for participating in this fantastic scavenger hunt around Gavel! Siegfried: The winner of this hunt will have the privilege of going on a once-in-a-lifetime, fully authentic, adventure with me!
- Siegfried: Now, without further ado: I shall announce the winner!
- Siegfried: And the winner is…
- Siegfried Fan: Finally!
- Siegfried Fan: I better win, I bought his mug!
- Siegfried Fan: Maybe I'll win this time?
- Siegfried: !! Congratulations!
- Siegfried Fan: THE HUMAN?!
- Siegfried: , please head to the backstage area to my right for your adventure. Thank you everyone!!
Meet Siegfried backstage in the Golden Eagle Theatre to go on your adventure!
- Siegfried: Welcome ! Congratulations on winning the scavenger hunt!
- Siegfried: Today, you’ll be going with me on one of my glorious adventures.
- Siegfried: And to get there, we’ll ride in the great Siegfried Airship!
- Siegfried: It’s up at the airship docks – I’ll teleport us there!
- Siegfried: (translated: Gavellian) MAGICAL MAGICKY MAGIC MAGICSPELL. Teleport!
- Siegfried: TELEPORT!
Travel with Siegfried on his airship at the Ahmsord airship docks at [1101, 129,-4513]
- Siegfried: Here, follow me onto the airship!
- Siegfried:  And away we go!
- Siegfried: Impressed by my piloting skills? Dodging these islands isn’t a challenge at all for the mighty Siegfried!
- Siegfried: I rode an airship much like this one when I saved Ahmsord from the dragon.
- Siegfried: Right now we’re heading to a cave on the far east of the region.
- Siegfried: We’ll have to navigate its treacherous corridors and defeat terrible beasts to get to the treasure at the end.
- Siegfried: Why don’t you go get my map from the upper level of the airship, and we’ll get ready for our adventure.

lines.title: upper and lower decks
lines.text:
Grab both Siegfried’s Map and the Rope in the upper level.

Additionally, you can go to the lower deck to find Siegfried's actual pilot.



* Siegfried's Pilot: *whistling*
- Siegfried: How much lon- Oh, you brought the map!
- Siegfried: We’ll need to use this map to navigate the dangerous cave we’re going to.
- Siegfried: How did I get this? Well-er- I always prepare before my adventures!
- Siegfried: Anyway, we’re about to land now – be careful not to fall off!
Enter the perilous cave on the eastern edge of the Sky Islands with Siegfried at [1493, 104, -4805]
- Siegfried: Here we are, the great Cave of Treasure-Hoarding Evil Creatures!
- Siegfried: Speak to me when you’re fully prepared for this dangerous adventure.
- Siegfried: This cave is exceedingly dangerous, so make sure to follow my instructions.
- Siegfried: I’ve got decades of experience bravely adventuring in these caves, so I know what I’m doing.
- Siegfried: Onwards! , stay right behind me!
Follow Siegfried through the cave on the eastern edge of the Sky Islands at [1493, 104, -4805]
- Siegfried: You sure took your time getting here! No matter.
- Siegfried: I adventure in caves such as these often to get rid of the evil beasts dwelling within.
- Siegfried: If it wasn’t for me defeating them before they could even--
- Siegfried: Woah, stop! This might look like a harmless decoration, but it’s a trap!
- Siegfried: Stay behind me, I’ll open it with my magic spell. (translated: Gavellian) OPEN!
- Siegfried: Aha! I’ll protect you from the guardian, you deal with the rat!
- Siegfried: Take THIS!
- Siegfried: Ow- I mean, hah! That was easier than swatting a fly for the mighty Siegfried!
- Siegfried: Seems like we’re done here! That must have been a very difficult fight for you.
- Siegfried: The caves I adventure in are filled with terrifying beasts similar to those.
- Siegfried: WAIT! Don’t move, that boulder is about to fall!
- Siegfried: Wow, that was close! Of course, I saw that coming and had no risk at all.
- Siegfried: You might say that we can’t go further, as it’s blocking our way. But I can fix that!
- Siegfried: And no more boulder! Only one as powerful as I can do that.
- Siegfried: All we must do now is cross a perilous bridge over the Endless Chasm.
- Siegfried: Aa, why did- Woah, careful! It looks like the bridge fell.
- Siegfried: But this is not such an obstacle as you might think, for I can, uh, jump over this chasm!
- Siegfried: Here I go!
- ???: WAIT!
- Siegfried: The spell--
- Siegfried: AAAAAAAAAAAAAH!
Jump after Siegfried into the pit at the end of the cave.
- You should jump in after him.
- He’s unconscious. Perhaps there’s something around here to wake him up?
Find a way to wake Siegfried.

lines.title: waking up Siegfried and an optional thing to do
lines.text:
Collect the Ancient Bucket & Mining Explosive. Head to the body of water and fill the bucket. Additionally, there is a Mining Log which can give some dialogue for an optional way to progress onward.
* It's an old mining expedition's log:
* Supplies are limited, excavation yielding little success.
* We've attempted going around the portcullis, but the beast in the only way past it killed one of our crew.
* Apart from the portcullis, there are no signs of villagers or of the town itself. The team is beginning to doubt its existence.
* The return crew is lowering the crane tomorrow, so it's unlikely we can find anything before then. Logs will be left for use of any future excavations.
* The rest of the log lists geological information about the cave and a supply manifest.
- This should wake Siegfried.
Find a way deeper into the cave and lead Siegfried there with you.
- Siegfried: AAAAAAGH!
- Siegfried: Aaaaggggh my LEGS MY LEGS AAAGGH SO COLD!
- Siegfried: SO COLD so PAINFUL…
- Siegfried: Why couldn’t I THINK when I signed that STUPID CONTRACT that I’d end up here!?
- Siegfried: …Well, this is it.
- Siegfried: They aren’t gonna come rescue us, you know. We’re on our own.
- Siegfried: Why are you so calm? DON’T YOU SEE?!
- Siegfried: WE’RE ON OUR OWN! This is REAL now! No coming back after ‘dying’, no more obvious traps, no more Siegfried. If I die here, I DIE! No coming back!
- Siegfried: I.. I can’t do this. We’ll just starve here, in this cave… where nobody will ever find our bodies.
- Siegfried: Stop looking at me! You figure out how to get us out of here, I’m just a worthless actor! Tell me if you find anything, I- I need a moment alone.

lines.title: deeper into cave
lines.text:
Investigate opening in the cave at 4468, 11, -5333
You can get Mining Explosive from 4458, 24, -5354
- Siegfried: You found something? Ok. I’ll… follow you then.
- Siegfried: WHAT WAS THAT SOUND?! A- are you sure we should go into there?
- Siegfried: MY ARM! IT HIT MY ARM!
- Siegfried: … I think I can manage.. OW!
Venture deeper into the cave with Siegfried.
- Siegfried: You.. You got us out of there!
- Siegfried: I didn’t think we’d ever find a way out of there…
- Siegfried: … Well, I guess we should keep going. M- Maybe there’s a way out?
- Siegfried: L- Look! There’s plants and light up ahead! A WAY OUT!
- Siegfried: Come on, follow me!
- Siegfried: AAAH!
Rescue Siegfried from the trap OR leave him there.
Rescue Siegfried

lines.title: saving Siegfried
lines.text: There are two ways to save Siegfried: Either place the Mining Explosive against the wall or complete the parkour at [4567, 25, -5223] to break the rope anchor.
- Siegfried: W- What just happened?! I’m trapped in here!
- Siegfried: … It’s… some sort of trap. I can feel the ground heating up!!
- The cage fell! You should go help Siegfried out.
- Siegfried: T-That was terrifying… Y-you saved my life. Thank you … I wasn’t prepared for real danger like this.
Leave Siegfried
- Siegfried has died in the cage. You'll have to find your way out yourself.
Mobs
Rest before continuing through the cave.
Rescue Siegfried
- Siegfried: …What? Houses, and a well? All the way down here?
- Siegfried: It’s… empty. And the houses sure don’t look like anyone’s lived here for.. centuries.
- Siegfried: OW! MY LEGS! And my arms, too! E- Everything hurts so much.. I need to sit down. I think I turned my arm the wrong way.
- Siegfried: I’ll just.. rest here a bit. W- would you mind taking a look around for something we can eat? I can.. hardly move.
- There’s some small caves around here.. Maybe there’ll be something edible there?

lines.title: feeding Siegfried
lines.text: Head to the small cave opening to the right of the large house, and go all the way up until you see a nest surrounded by Ravenous Crawlers. Right-Click the nest to get a Soft Slime. You will need this for later, so DO NOT THROW IT AWAY. Then, head to the large house, up the stairs, and into the cave opening, and you will find a Stale Sandwich on the right side.
Sandwich:
- Siegfried: … Was this a sandwich at some point?
- Siegfried: It barely has any resemblance to one.
- Siegfried: Well… I doubt there’s anything better around here. I- I’ll take it.
- Siegfried: OW!! I think I broke my teeth! This is like eating stone!
- Siegfried: … I th-ow-ink I’m ready to- ow- move on. Let’s get go-oow-ing.
Cooked Spider Eggs:
- Siegfried: ... Is this the food you found?
- Siegfried: I guess it's... the best that could be found here. You say you cooked it yourself?
- Siegfried: I'll give it a try, then. Doubt there's anything better around here.
- Siegfried: These are... amazing!
- Siegfried: Thank you, ! I feel much better. I can head deeper as soon as you're ready.
Uncooked spider egg:
- Siegfried: ... These look disgusting.
- Siegfried: I guess... I'll eat it, if it's the only food around.
- Siegfried: Let's see... How do i even eat these?
- Siegfried: Ugh... These are awful.
Note: Feeding Siegfried uncooked spider eggs will cause him to die in Stage 18.
Leave Siegfried
- This area seems like a good place to rest before moving on. Siegfried would have been overjoyed to see this.
Mobs
Venture deeper into the cave.
Rescue Siegfried
- Siegfried: You know… my name is actually Gurix.
- Gurix: Sound extremely Corkian, I know. They made me use Siegfried because it sounds less foreign, I suppose.
- Gurix: AAAH! Get away!
- Gurix: OW! , I think this web is poisoned! Quick, get me out with one of your spells!
- Gurix: Thank you . I’ll.. I’ll follow you from now on. Clearly you’re more prepared than I am.
Find your way through the spider burrows.
Rescue Siegfried
- Gurix: ? I think that giant web there is being held up by the platforms on the walls.
- Gurix: I think… Maybe you can cut them down? I’ll stay here, I think it’s the safest place. I’ll call for you if a spider webs me again.
- Those lines of silk from the big web are holding it up. If you cut all three, it might break.
- Gurix: You did it! The web fell!
- Gurix: Let’s head onwards, I don’t want to deal with any more spiders.
Leave Siegfried
- Maybe that web would fall if you cut the ones supporting it?
- The Big Web has been cleared!
Mobs
Venture deeper into the cave.
Rescue Siegfried
- Gurix: Hey, wait up! Thanks for saving me there.
- Gurix: Woah... This is enormous! Who knows what this used to be?
- Gurix:  seems to be  maybe we can reach them?
Mobs
Find a way to escape through the skylight at the end of the cave.
Rescue Siegfried
- Gurix: Another town? Or another part of the same one? I’m not sure..
- Gurix: This one even seems to have a forge and a tailor.. It was a full, proper village!
- Gurix: That.. is that sunlight?
- Gurix: , look! I can see the sky from here! M- maybe there’s a way to get up!
- Gurix: I think.. what if we can this geyser somehow? It looks dormant, but I feel like we can activate it again.
- Gurix: You take a look around, I’ll be resting a little. I don’t think I’ve ever walked this much in my life…

lines.title: geyser solution
lines.text:
Use the Ancient Bucket and head to the forge at 4942, 44, -5192, and fill the bucket with lava. Then, place it into the geyser to activate.
* Note: If you lost the bucket you can re-obatain it at 4996 45 -5215
- Gurix: Woah! The geyser’s active!
- Gurix: W-Wait.. that’ll be quite a long fall after we get launched up. Can you try making some safety equipment, like a parachute or some really soft boots?

lines.title: boots & parachute solution
lines.text: Get cloth from the tailor's building at 4964, 46, -5225. Use the rope and cloth to make a Makeshift Parachute, and the Soft Slime to make Well-Cushioned Boots.
- Gurix: You’ve already made something? Let me see.
- Gurix: This looks… usable? It’s something, at least.
- Gurix: Probably the best we’ll get down here. Are you sure you don’t need anything for yourself? No? Okay.
- Gurix: I can’t wait to see the look on their faces when we get back. We’ve just saved the legacy of Siegfried!
Leave Siegfried
.. Is that sunlight at the other side of the cave?
Maybe you can use this geyser to escape?

lines.title: geyser solution
lines.text:
Use the Ancient Bucket and head to the forge at 4942, 44, -5192, and fill the bucket with lava. Then, place it into the geyser to activate. Then, go near it and you will be blasted out.
* Note: If you lost the bucket you can re-obatain it at 4996 45 -5215
Escape the cave!
Rescue Siegfried
- Gurix: Woah! The parachute worked!
Rescue Siegfried
- Gurix: W-we made it? …, WE DID IT! WE’RE BACK! HAHAAA! I’M ALIVE!
- Siegfried: Hello there! It is I, Siegfried, and I just stopped the threat that was this cave!
- Siegfried: Hah, that’s a great costume you have there! Looks just like me!
- Gurix: What? I- I’ve been REPLACED?
- Siegfried: Hah, don’t mind the jokester over there. He does have an impressive costume though!
- Gurix: W-what's going on here? You can't replace me!
- ???: This way, please.
- Siegfried: Look over there! Those must be fireworks to celebrate my victory!
- Gurix: Wait, wha-
- Siegfried: Well, anyways! You had a really bad fall in that cave there. I carried you out myself, you must’ve had some wild hallucinations.
- Siegfried: Even though it was your own mistake, I’ll return you the emeralds you spent on the scavenger hunt.. and some more as compensation. That'll be.. [5 Liquified Emeralds]!
- Siegfried: I must return to Ahmsord for the celebration now. Perhaps we will meet again at the next scavenger hunt!
Leave Siegfried
- Siegfried: Hello there, human! It is I, Siegfried! You must have just missed how I expertly ended the threat of this monster-ridden cave!
- ???: Wait!
- ???: *inaudible*
- Siegfried: , I'm glad to see you managed to get out alive. That must have been quite a fall into the chasm.
- Siegfried: Of course, I got out easily using my spells and great knowledge of caves! Well, I must be off now. Maybe we may meet again if you win the next scavenger hunt!
- ???: As compensation for your unfortunate accident, Siegfried will return you the emeralds spent on purchasing scavenger hunt items.
- ???: That should amount to... 5 Liquid Emeralds. We apologize for the difficulties you encountered during your adventure with Siegfried!
Speak to Narder.
Dialogue:
- Narder: A Human! Agh! Don't worry about getting me medical attention, I've got this under control...
- Narder: It's a broken leg. I'm already getting it treated, but I have a job to do elsewise- and a time sensitive one, too.
- Narder: I won't be able to do it like this, but it doesn't matter if I'm the one who carries it out. It just needs to be done.
- Narder: I don't work for villagers, I was hired to come here by other humans... there's something you must keep secret.
- Narder: Swear it! If you're going to take the job, and my payment for it, you must be silent about it!
- Narder: Do you agree?
- Narder: Good. To business then.
- Narder: There is a hidden town in the canyon here. Up in the mountains- it was built and run by humans.
- Narder: Now, the villagers have very strict rules about humans living in their lands, and it's VERY illegal.
- Narder: I was contacted by the Mayor because he is aware that the town may have become... compromised.
- Narder: The job is to figure out who and why, of course. To let this slip could collapse the treatise between our races.
- Narder: I've never been to the city in the mountains, but I was given instructions. Here, I'll write down the location in your book.
- Narder: Be aware though, they won't let you in unless the area is safe. They can't risk villagers wandering in.
- Narder: Good luck.
Head to [890, 47, -5388] to find the human town.
Dialogue:
- Curious Villager: Hm? Oh, a fellow adventurer, I see! I'm sorry, but this discovery is mine to make. There's something strange about that door...
- Curious Villager: Deadly gasses? Nonsense! As you can see the two of us are breathing just fine.
- Curious Villager: You want me to leave? Why, so that you can have all of the glory for yourself? Ha, not a chance!
- Curious Villager: The only way I'm leaving is if I can get that door open or if the whole cave starts crashing down on us.
Cause the cave to collapse

lines.title: causing the collapse
lines.text: Go up the ladder and follow the path until you get to the rock spire on the ceiling. Use a spell on the rock to cause the fall.
Dialogue:
- Curious Villager: Gweh! I just had to go running my mouth about the cave collapsing! I'm out- if you have any sense you'll leave too!
- A loud mechanical noise can be heard coming from the door.
Go up to the door and inspect the noise.
Back inside the cave there is a structure. Upon getting close to it, the inside will be destroyed and you can pass through to talk to the guard. [984,109,-5437]
Talk to Eltom Guard.
Dialogue:
- Eltom Guard: Thank you for getting rid of that curious villager! We thought he'd never leave.
- Eltom Guard: I've never seen you before. Who gave you access to the town?
- Eltom Guard: You're here in place of the detective the mayor hired?
- Eltom Guard: Normally, I wouldn't believe that, but come in. We're desperate.
- Eltom Guard: If you ever need to leave and get back, I can simply open the way.
- Eltom Guard: You probably should be going now. Our mayor can get impatient.
Talk to Mayor Eoric in the town hall.
Dialogue:
- Eoric: What are you doing here? I'm writing an important letter, this better be worth my time.
- Eoric: What? Narder sent you? Why'd he send a Ragni soldier?
- Eoric: I didn't think the army were authorized to know about Eltom, especially Fruma recruits.
- Eoric: Anyway, Eltom's secrecy is in great danger. We have found evidence of the traitor.
- Eoric: We have locked down all of the exits. No one leaves or enters without my permission.
- Eoric: We need a detective to sniff out the traitor and expose him.
- Eoric: Start by asking the citizens around here about anything suspicious they've seen.
- Eoric: When you find the culprit, remember to leave him alive! The guards will take care of him.
Ask Eltom Citizens about the note.
Dialogue:
- Reder: Sorry, detective, but I haven't seen anything suspicious. In fact, I haven't even left my house for the last week.
- Nichye: The only suspicious thing I've seen is a hooded man walking around. There's not many people in Eltom so it's weird.
- Sybeth: If you want to find out anything, the best person to ask is Lumilda. She's in her bakery, next to the Scroll Shop.
- Lumilda: Ah, detective! What brings you to the sweet Lumilda's Bakery?
- Lumilda: Hm, yes, there is a weird person coming through.
- Lumilda: It's a hooded man. Never seen the face. A trouble maker, if you ask me!
- Lumilda: He's been here a few times, usually writing things on a piece of paper. That man's a real mystery. No one even knows where he lives.
- Lumilda: One time my grandson couldn't resist and followed the man. Last thing he saw was the man leaving through the Eastern Exit.
- Lumilda: Ain't that a place to start, sweetheart?
Inspect anything beyond the Eastern Exit.
Dialogue:
- There appears to be a cave up above.

lines.title: Solving the Memory Puzzle
lines.text: To solve the puzzle, remember the block colors and click the button on the block that has changed in each of the three patterns. If you have trouble remembering, you can take a screenshot.
Inspect the house.
Dialogue
- ???: Ah. You must be the detective then. None of those half witted Eltomites would figure it out.
- ???: I guess the Grook is out of the pen then.
- ???: This town shouldn’t even be here. Humans aren't allowed to settle in Gavel.
- ???: These Humans couldn’t be bothered to fight their own war, so they hid an entire city here.
- ???: Traitor? I’m no traitor. I'm just looking to carry out the law where it needs to be carried out. Nothing personal, yes?
- Ardulf: Maybe they'll actually use "Ardulf" instead of saying "freak" once they've seen the good I can do for them!
Read the note on the table.
Dialogue:
- Notes:
- - Airship leaves Eltom 6:15 to Thesead
- - Mayor's office on the top layer of Thesead
- - Remember to set up Dwarven bank account
Head to Eltom's Airbase.
Talk to Hilan.
Dialogue:
- Hilan: H-h-help!
- Hilan: Hooded man... Climbed tower...
- Hilan: Requested to use a ship... I refused...
- Hilan: He beat me up... And left...
- Hilan: Hurry!
Head up to the Airbase's Tower to confront the hooded man.
Board the Eltom Cargo Ship.
Dialogue:
- You feel a very heavy blow to the back of your head. You wake up here.
- Ardulf: What are you doing here? Why are you protecting this illegal town?
- Ardulf: The Villagers will not be happy about Eltom. This could seriously harm the Gavel-Wynn relationship.
- Ardulf: You can't stop me. You wouldn't murder one of your own, would you?
- Ardulf: I will tell the mayor of Thesead all about this place, and claim my reward for doing so. I will be rich and if you want to stop me you will have to do it yourself!
- ...you got snuck up on and knocked out. Where are you now?
Escape your cell and find a way to sabotage the ship.
Dialogue:
- To escape your cell, you must pick this weird lock. It seems that the spinning a ring inside will spin the rings next to it another way

lines.title: solving the lock picking puzzle
lines.text: To solve the first puzzle: Press the left cyan button 5 times and the left gold button 5 times.
- Note:
- To Hilan.
- The ship you're running is a mess. This is the third time I've had to repair a coolant leak here.
- The Corkian machines are great, but they aren't eternal. At this rate, you'll need a new ship every winter.
- Is it that hard to understand that no liquid should enter the engine?
- -Engineer Bertin

lines.title: solving the puzzle
lines.text: Punch the pipe in the room with the note. Go up the stairs and right click the brewing stand to get Nemract Whiskey. Right click the whiskey on the broken pipe.
-> Go down the cargo hatch.
Talk to Thesead's Mayor at the top of Thesead.
Dialogue:
- Thesead's Mayor: What brings a human to my office?
- Thesead's Mayor: A letter? Oh, that. The one about Eltom? Don't look so worried. The secret is safe with me.
- Thesead's Mayor: Yes, I know about Eltom. After all, its mayor is my ex-husband.
- Thesead's Mayor: It may seem weird, a love between a villager and a human. I know, but our race did not stop us from being in love.
- Thesead's Mayor: The person who left the letter about Eltom is our son, Ardulf. As soon as Eoric found out about our child, he panicked and left me.
- Thesead's Mayor: Ardulf will never be accepted as a half breed... Still, I hope he's OK.
- Thesead's Mayor: Huh, oh yeah, one more thing. The switch under the table... go on, press it!
Find Dejol at [452, 28, 4456]
- Dejol: Ho, traveler! I need the help of a true explorer, I can see it in your eyes, you are an adventurer like me!
- Dejol: While you are here, adventurer, I could use your help with something. I have gotten myself into a small predicament in my travels.
- Dejol: You see, me and three others were on a grand expedition to explore the entire canyon! Unfortunately, we ran into a slight problem...
- Dejol: The Canyon of the Lost is clearly called that for a reason, within hours, we had lost each other!
- Dejol: Luckily, we were prepared for it. We each carried a flag so if we ever got lost, we can raise it to be found.
- Dejol: They were all meant to come to my blue flag, but they must all be trapped in some predicament! The canyon can be a dangerous place.
- Dejol: I can see all three red flags from here, but it would be terrible if I went looking and they came back to this flag to find me gone!
- Dejol: Do you think you could go and check if they're all alright? I'm sure I can find some reward for you if you help!
Find the three lost crew members at the red flags around [452, 28, -4456]
Fetu
Fetu's flag and task are located at 458, 56, -4501.
- Fetu: ...AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!! HEEEEEEEEEEEEELLLLLLLLPPPPPP!!!!!! THERE ARE BIIIIIIIIIIIRDS!!!!!!
- Fetu: HUMAN! YOU, DOWN THERE! HELP ME! I was just trying to find my way back to my friends...
- Fetu: When this GIANT BIRD KIDNAPPED ME and threw me in her nest! I think she thinks I'm one of her chicks!
- Fetu: The Canyon's movements must've dislodged her eggs from her nest-
- Fetu: O-OH GROOK, SHE'S PECKING ME! FIND HER EGGS NEARBY AND THROW THEM UP HERE... QUICKLY!!
The eggs are located in the following areas:
- Right by the bird's nest in a small indent on the ground at 452, 54, -4492
- In the bushes by 456, 58, -4512
- After doing some parkour around the bird's nest, you will find an opening at 441, 63, -4494
- Right by the bridge in an opening at 445, 59, -4514
- Fetu: YOU HAVE THE EGGS?? GOOD! THROW THEM UP HERE, PLEASE!!!
- Fetu: W-WOAH, STAY BACK, BIRD! I have a... uhh... I DON'T HAVE A WEAPON, HUMAN! PLEASE HURRY UP!
Right infront of the bird's nest will be a hologram telling you to throw the eggs up there.
- Fetu: YES YES YES!!! THANK YOU, HUMAN! Oh, thank grook, this bird's leaving me alone now... It worked!
- Fetu: I'll head back to Dejol, now... And I'm never going to go near another bird again!
Yuge

Right by Yuge's flag at 338, 104 -4464, there will be a sign warning people of unstable rocks. To get to Yuge, you have to parkour up the rocks, however, the green rocks will be unstable, and will shake up your screen if you land on one.
- Yuge: A-ah, hello. I'm g-guessing Dejol sent you?
- Yuge: W-Well, I was just walking through the c-canyon, when... the ground suddenly rose up underneath me and launched me all the way up here!
- Yuge: N-Now, I'm... embarrassed to admit it, but I'm REALLY afraid of heights, s-so I don't know what to do... Do you have any ideas?
You will then have to knock Yuge off of the mound by left-clicking her.
- Yuge: AAAAAAAAHHHHH!!!
- You should probably get down to check to see if she's okay.
You can follow Yuge by jumping down into the pool of water.
- Yuge: Y-YOU JERK!! I COULD HAVE DIED!! WHAT THE HELL IS WRONG WITH YOU???
- Yuge: P-Please NEVER do that again! That was the worst thing I have ever done in my entire life!!
- Yuge: ...Ugh! I-I'm going to head back to Dejol now. I hope I NEVER have to see you again!
Gordon
Gordon is located near 328, 123, -4352. To get to Gordon, parkour into the house.
- Gordon: Hey there! I'm in a bit of a pickle right now, you see. This house I took refuge in, well... The original owner must have left for a reason!
- Gordon: It's so sad... So many people are constantly displaced by the canyon's movements destroying their homes every year. I remember hearing a story once, it was about-
- Gordon: Wait... Hey, do you hear that?
You will be blinded as explosion particles occur around you, and several earthquakes happen. You wake up in the house's rubble.
- Gordon: Hey! You alright down there?! Oh, lord, how are we going to get out of this? I'm up here, come find me.
Gordon will be on top of the house's remains.
- Gordon: Oh... Well, this isn't good! The house just went and collapsed on us!
- Gordon: See what I was talking about, human? The canyon isn't really a good place to be. Now we're stuck in this pit!
- Gordon: Although... there is a crafting table over there... Hey, maybe you could collect some supplies and make something to get us out of here?
The location of each material are as follows:
- The  Plank of Wood, opposite to Gordon at -12735, 22, 1934
- The  Chunk of Rock, at -12731, 22, 1928
- The Piece of String, at -12719, 19, 1930
After collecting all of the materials, you will then go to the crafting table to make a catapult.
- Well, that's certainly one way out of here. You should talk to Gordon.
- Gordon: Heh, that's certainly one way to get out here! You made an entire catapult, huh?
- Gordon: So we're just going to launch ourselves out of this pit? You got it!
- Who should be launched out of the pit first?
- [1] You
- Gordon: Alrighty, I'll be right behind you!
- [2] Gordon
- Gordon: Me first? Okay, I'll do just that!
- Gordon: Alright, here I... GOOO!!
- Gordon: Hey, I made it!! You should come up as well, now.
You and Gordon will then be launched out of the pit.
- Gordon: Woah... That's certainly a lot of fun! Anyways, come talk to me.
- Gordon: Thanks for the help, friend! I couldn't have done it without you!
- Gordon: I'm gonna go find my friend Dejol now- wait, you know who he is??
- Gordon: Oh... Wow, guess it's a small world, huh? That's funny! I'll see you down there later, then!
Return to Dejol at [452, 28, -4456] to tell him of your success
- Looks like you've found all three of Dejol's crew members! You should head back to Dejol.
- Dejol: Ho, adventurer! Looks like you had some adventures helping out my crew!
- Dejol: Thank goodness they all found their way back unharmed. Mostly. Yuge's pride seems to have taken a hit.
- Dejol: Anyway, we ought to get back to our exploration - and we'll stick together closer this time!
- Dejol: You were a huge help, though, so please take this as a reward!
Explore the abandoned drill at [585,89,-457]
Dialogue:
- It looks like a mining machine that's hundreds of years old. What was it mining though?
- It has no fuel left, maybe you can start it again?
Find some sort of fuel in the Ruined City.

lines.title: Location for fuel
lines.text: The area where you have to go is enter the massive cave in the northeast corner of the city at 697, -555.
Explore the cave for the fuel
- The crystalized magic on the floor seems unstable. Maybe something can shatter it...
When Eyed Shade is killed:
- A pathway has been created.
When the spike shatterer is used on the crystalized magic:
- The strange shard is reacting to the floor...
Collect [32 Fuel Sprites] and bring it back to the machine.
- [32 Fuel] should be more than enough.
Head back to the machine at [585,89,-457]
- [-32 Fuel Sprites]
- The machine started!
- The loud machine is bound to attract the creatures of the expanse.
Defend the machine from the incoming attackers.
- It looks like the machine is about to break through!
Enter the opened crypt.
Find out what's happening at [167, 6, -5184]
Dialogue:
- Coulmis: This is just a disaster... I pray nothing goes awry with the recovery team.
- Coulmis: I'd never be able to live it off if I'm responsible for more deaths.
- Coulmis: But I must do what it takes to prevent Thanos from any more disaster.
- Atila: Sir! Coulmis, sir!
- Coulmis: Atila, you're back! Give it to me straight, did they succeed? We can't afford any more losses.
- Atila: No, sir... I'm afraid not.
- Atila: The elevator leads right in to where the dragon lays. Without knowing when it's asleep, it's a gamble.
- Coulmis: So we truly do need to go through the vault. But with the defense systems gone haywire...
- Atila: I'm sorry sir...
- Coulmis: Think nothing of it, let's get back to the drawing board.
- Atila: Yes, I'll get to it immediately.
- Coulmis: You there, human! What's your business here? Come speak to me.
- Coulmis: What's your business here? This place is off limits, the vault is very dangerous right now.
- Coulmis: Now that I look, say, that gear of yours is pretty high-quality, yeah? What's your name?
- If you did The Qira Hive:
- Coulmis: ... where have I heard that name before... Oh, I remember! You're that guy who defeated that Qira woman, yeah?
- If you did Dwarves and Doguns Part IV:
- Coulmis: ... where have I heard that name before... Oh, I remember! You're the one who helped resolve the whole Dogun thing, right?
- Otherwise:
- Coulmis:  I see, I haven't seen you around before.
- Coulmis: Nevertheless, Thanos is in danger. To put it simply, a dragon is living uninvited in our depository.
- Coulmis: Perhaps, you've seen its lair above our city. Normally she leaves us unharmed, but one day she suddenly made her way in to this vault.
- Coulmis: My great friend Atila has been leading a recon squad, he's discerned that she's nesting an egg.
- Coulmis: We've tried at our greatest expenses to steal the egg, and bring it back to her nest, so that maybe she would leave... But, as you've heard, it's not going well.
- Coulmis: I don't normally ask this of strangers, but we've run ourselves thin. Do you think you're up to help? I'll make sure it's all worth your trouble.
- Will you help Coulmis?
- [1] Tell me what I should know.
- Coulmis: So you'll help!? Thank you so much! I'll make sure it's worth every moment!
- Coulmis: You'll have to go through this chamber behind me to reach the depository. Our only other way in is right where the dragon is...
- Coulmis: Atila knows some of the inner workings of the vault. I bid you good luck and will be praying for your success. Your courage will inspire Thanos.
- [2] I'll pass.
- Coulmis: Oh, so it wasn't meant to be I suppose...
- Coulmis: Well, if we cross paths again, I'll always much appreciate your help... Back to the drawing board...
Enter the vault at [167, 8, -5145]
Head to the Thanos Depository at [171, 21, -4977]

There will be a few earthquakes on your way to the depository, and then the Depository will detect an intruder, activating its defense system. During the fight, the defense system will aim at an area, causing it to smoke up and then flare up. If you stand in one of those areas, you will be damaged by the defense system.
Find a way through the depository.

There will be flamethrowers blocking some areas that you cannot go through. However, there will be cannons that you must stand in the range of for a few seconds that will then break a wall it is facing towards.
There will also be a few levers that will raise wooden platforms to serve as a safe passage through lava. Eventually, you will arrive upon the exit.
Ride the minecarts to get further in to the depository

There will be a Track Controller that can be picked up near the minecart section. To use the Track Controller, right-click it as you are arriving towards a gap. At times, you need to drop down on purpose to avoid a dead end. In one place, you need to reactivate the track below you after dropping down. Timing is important.
Steal Ozoth's egg and escape the depository.

This section is a red-light, green-light minigame. There will be an eye in the black abyss that, when opened, you should stand still, and when closed, you should run towards the egg. If you move when the dragon's eye is open, then you are sent back to the beginning.
You grab the egg by right-clicking the egg at the green particles. When you grab the egg, you have to run back towards the lift, which will take you up to Ozoth's Spire.
Use the lift to escape.
- Atila: Oh-oh my gosh!! I took you for dead, and thought the dragon was sending me up a corpse!
- Atila: You really got it!? Hurry, then, the nest is up through this cave! Maybe Thanos can finally be rid of its woes...
Place Ozoth's egg back in her nest at [169,199,-5208].
Some time later...
Ozoth will fly to its nest, covering the egg with its wings.
Talk to Atila.
- Atila: She's a beauty, isn't she? A monster though, nevertheless.
- Coulmis: ! Over here... Atila told me the news, I came as fast as I could!
- Coulmis: You're a hero, lad! With the dragon out of our city, Thanos no longer has to live in fear.
- Coulmis: I've prepared your reward. The people of Thanos will remember your contribution for years to come.
Speak to Abramod at [-1381, 51, -648].
Upon approaching Abramod:
- Abramod: Halt, stranger! If you value your life, do not take another step forward.
- Abramod: I have nothing left to give you! Leave, you and your kindred!
Abramod shoots at the player.
- Abramod: You're completely unscathed? You must be powerful indeed, no changeling could defeat you.
- Abramod: Still though, I have nothing for you. I even lack a medallion to prove my own identity...
- Medallion?
- Abramod: Ah, you have lost yours too? Kindred spirits we are, dead to our worlds!
- Abramod: Lost to my clan, dead to my family, assumed to be a brute beast of the worst sort... I am sure you can understand, being in the same state as myself?

- Abramod: It is some small comfort to find one in the same situation as myself. I will not pry into you, I know the value of secrets as well as anyone. But please, will you allow me a measure of catharsis and lend me an empathetic ear so I may tell my tale?
- Yes
- Abramod: Then, let me tell you a story about losing your identity in the Mistwoods. About burning your medallion.
- A cutscene with Abramod walking through the Mistwoods begins.
- No
- Abramod: Ah, I understand. I need not burden you with the miseries of an old man
- The dialogue ends here without progressing the quest.
Talking to Abramod again after selecting "No" previously:
- Abramod: You have returned! Now, are you willing to take a moment to listen to my tale?
- Yes (See the above dialogue for this choice)
- No
- Abramod: Ah, I understand. I need not burden you with the miseries of an old man.
- Abramod: The forest here is safe, I ought to return home.
- Abramod: ...Brother?
- Lishvil: Abramod... I want to come home now.
- Lishvil: If you give me your medallion, I can be with you again.
- Abramod: If you can't show me your medallion, how could I know you are really you?
- Abramod: There are creatures that take the shape of any man, and they want to kill us! It would be ignorant to not take it with you!
- Lishvil: Give me your medallion. I can become one of you.
- Abramod: You are not Lishvil. And judging by that, he disposed of his before you could get to it.
- Abramod: If it means you won't deceive my clan, I'll  my medallion, like Lishvil did! You can kill me, but you will never be me!
- Abramod: Watch this, vile deceiver!
- Abramod: Hyup! There, if you want it so bad, go get it!
- Lishvil:
The cutscene ends.
- Abramod: That is my story. It is unfortunate it cannot have a happier ending, unless...
- Abramod: I do know how to make a new medallion, but it is a difficult task. Collecting the materials required for it would be more dangerous for my frail body than fending for myself out here...
- Abramod: With you however, we might be able to gather them. If you prove yourself trustworthy, I could even help you make one as well. How does that sound?
- Yes
- Abramod: Thank you, truly!
- Abramod: First, we will need a wooden base for the medallion.
- Abramod: There's an old, lightning struck tree to the south that we traditionally go to.
- Abramod: I will write the directions to it for you and meet you by it.
Abramod runs off towards the tree.
Meet Abramod near the lightning struck tree at [-1434, 62, -532].
- Abramod: This tree was struck by lightning many generations ago. And yet it has remained standing, even after death.
- Abramod: The bark from it has proven sturdy enough that it works well as a medallion's base.
- Abramod: However it might be a bit, ah, difficult to reach. It is in part why I need your help.
- Abramod: I will... assist you in climbing the tree. On your way down, you will need to hit  so we have enough bark.
- Abramod: I'll need to stay down here so I can collect the bark as it hits the ground.
- Abramod: Are you ready?
- Yes
- Abramod: Alright, here you go!
- The player is thrown above the redwood tree.
- No
- Abramod: If you need time to get your bearings, I understand. Come back when you're ready!
Hit at least 5 out of the 7 healthy branches, indicated by the leaf blocks, while falling down the tree. Use "Shift" to rotate around the tree, and "F" to change direction.
After failing the minigame:
- Abramod: Looks like you didn't quite hit enough branches...
- Abramod: Try again?
- Yes
- Abramod: Remember, you need to hit .
- Abramod: Here you go again!
- No
- Abramod: I understand. Talk to me again when you've caught your breath.
After successfully completing the minigame:
- Abramod: Good! This should be enough for the bases.
- Abramod: Next we'll need to collect some resin to lacquer the medallion with.
- Abramod: High in a mountain meadow to the , a fern grows that excretes a resin that works well for the task.
- Abramod: I'll write you some instructions on how to get there and see you once you arrive.
Abramod runs off to the mountain grove.
Meet Abramod in the mountain grove at [-1164, 118, -578].
- Abramod: This meadow is home to a rare fern that we collect resin from to make our medallions.
- Abramod: Do not go searching for it just yet though! It is also home to a poisonous fern that appears very similar to the one we need.
- Abramod: My eyes aren't so good anymore, so I'm going to need your help to tell them apart!
- Abramod: I'm going to toss the plants for you. You can pick them up by right-clicking them - even while they're still in the air!
- Abramod: Place the greener, healthier looking plants to . And you'll need to burn the poisonous, more sickly looking plants .
- Abramod: We'll need  to extract enough resin. But make sure the poisonous ferns don't build up too much or it could be dangerous for you!
- Abramod: You'll only be able to pick up one at a time, so good luck!
- Abramod: Ready?
- Yes
- Abramod: Here you go!
- The minigame begins.
- No
- Abramod: I understand. I'll be here whenever you are.
Collect 8 of the correct ferns. The good ferns need to be taken to the green particles to the north, while the poisonous ferns need to be taken to the flames to the south.
After failing the minigame:
- Abramod: Looks like you didn't get enough!
- Abramod: Want to try again?
- Yes
- Abramod: Here we go again!
- No
- Abramod: Alright, I understand.
After successfully completing the minigame:
- Abramod: That should be enough resin!
- Abramod: There's only one final thing we need: knives to cut the bark with.
- Abramod: Put that away, we don't need just any knife!

- Abramod: Tradition dictates we have to descend to a cave beneath this mountain where much of the fog of the Mistwoods settles. Deep inside are stones we've used for generations in carving our medallions.
- Abramod: I'll write down the directions for you again and meet you there.
Abramod runs off to the cave.
Meet Abramod outside of the cave at [-1138, 45, -620].
- Abramod: This cave here is where much of the mist pools. You can't tell from here, but it's very windy in there!
- Abramod: At its end is an outcrop of rock with some of the sharpest stalagmites you've ever seen formed from those harsh winds.
- Abramod: You'll need to head in and reach that outcrop. I'll try and call out to you if I see any bursts of wind heading your way, but you'll have to dodge them on your own!
- Abramod: If you get hit you'll be blown back, but try not to be blown back too far.
- Abramod: You can walk in once you're ready to start.
While walking through the cave, wind bursts will appear. Text in the middle of the screen will display "Left", "Right", "Jump", or "Sneak" to indicate how the player should move to dodge the burst.
After reaching the end of the cave:
- You snap off a piece of the rock and return to Abramod.
The player is teleported back to the entrance of the cave.
- Abramod: Excellent work!
- Abramod: I'll meet you back at my campsite.
- Abramod: Thank you so much again for all the help you've granted me!
''Abramod runs off to the campsite.'
Return to Abramod's camp at [-1379, 51, -654].
- Abramod: Hello!
- Abramod: We are going to make the medallion now, are we not?
- Abramod: It looks like I marked out for you the spots on the medallion that have to be cut out.
- Abramod: All you have to do is cut them. Easy.
- Abramod: Ready?
- Yes
- Abramod: Good! I will drag the knife down. And you will push it in to cut!
- No
- Abramod: You're not ready!? Then get ready, quickly! We do not have time to waste.
Craft the medallion.
Talking to Abramod again after choosing "No" or after failing the minigame:
- Help Abramod make the medallion now?
- Yes (See the previous dialogue for this choice)
- No (See the previous dialogue for this choice)
There are six stages to the carving minigame, with each stage using a slightly more complicated pattern than the last. Making 3 mistakes results in failure.
After successfully completing the minigame:
- Abramod: Good! Good! Look at how beautiful it is!
- Abramod: The intricacy! The style! With this, I will be able to get into any clan I want!
- Abramod: But... there is a loose end isn't there. Even if I can go anywhere I want... you will always know, won't you?
- Abramod: You are a danger that cannot be allowed to persist!
The player is transported to a combat arena.
Defeat Abramod.
Abramod is seen standing near the tent before transforming into a Banshee Stag.
After defeating Abramod:
- You pick up the medallion off the changeling's corpse.
Read the noticeboard at [-1310, 46, -757] near Aldwell.
- Bulletin Board: The board is plastered full of old notices, but a newer one catches your eye:
- Bulletin Board: THE FESTIVAL OF THE WICKER HAS RETURNED AGAIN! JOIN THE ENTIRE MISTWOODS IN ALDWELL FOR THE FESTIVITIES
- Bulletin Board: It looks like the festival starts tomorrow afternoon. Would you like to attend?
- Yes (Choosing this option progresses the quest to the next stage.)
- No
- Bulletin Board: Maybe another time then.
Enter the Festival of the Wicker at [-1301, 47, -720].
Interacting either Aldwell Guard:
- Aldwell Guard: Welcome to the Festival of the Wicker!
- Aldwell Guard: May I see your medallion?
- I don't have one (This option appears if you do not have the medallion from  Burning Bonds)
- Aldwell Guard: Then you cannot be trusted. Leave.
- Maybe if you look around, you can find a way to sneak in?
- (This option appears if you have the medallion in your inventory.)
- Aldwell Guard: Thank you, enjoy the festival! You can grab a mask inside.
If you do not have a medallion, there is a path through the wall directly to the right of the guards.
- The guards don't look like they saw you sneak in. Grab a mask and you should be able to blend into the crowd.
Interacting with the Noticeboard again:
- Bulletin Board: The board doesn't have anything else on it that catches your eye.
Attempting to enter without a Medallion:
- Aldwell Guard: We can't let you in without seeing your medallion!
Take a spare mask.
Interacting with either Aldwell Guard again:
- Aldwell Guard: Once you get inside, make sure to put your mask on.
There are three options of mask on the table: Owl, Fox, and Deer. You can only choose one of them.
Interacting with the Owl/Fox/Deer mask:
- Do you want to wear the owl/fox/deer mask?
- Yes
- Now that you have a mask, you can enjoy the festival.
- No
Talk to festival attendees.
There are several optional NPCs around the festival grounds that can be interacted with. Alternatively, go speak to the Festival Organizer at [-1254, 46, -698] to continue the quest.
Interacting with the mask table again:
- You already have a mask.
Interacting with either Aldwell Guard:
- Aldwell Guard: I hope you're enjoying the festival!
- Stall Attendant: Welcome to Festival of the Wicker's premier food stall!
- Stall Attendant: What can I get you?
- Rabbit Roast -
- Stall Attendant: Enjoy your rabbit roast!
- Anything Else? (The dialogue options return here.)
- Green Tea -
- Stall Attendant: Enjoy your green tea!
- Anything Else? (The dialogue options return here.)
- Fortune Cookie -
- Stall Attendant: Enjoy your fortune cookie!
- Anything Else? (The dialogue options return here.)
- Nothing
- Stall Attendant: Have a nice day.
Eating Rabbit Roast causes the player to bounce around uncontrollably for a few seconds.
Drinking Green Tea causes the screen to turn a green hue, and the following text displays on the screen:
Eating a Fortune Cookie shows the following dialogue:''
- You unravel your fortune. It says:
One of the following messages is chosen at random:
- Fortune Cookie: 'A clan member you hate will soon change your life.'
- Fortune Cookie: 'Foxes in threes bare good tidings.'
- Fortune Cookie: 'A new love will soon enter your life!'
- Fortune Cookie: 'Do not forget the danger of outsiders or someday you will have great trouble.'
- Fortune Cookie: 'Avoid the forest floor, a great calamity awaits you.'
- Fortune Cookie: 'Love with the same passion that you hate or both will consume you.'
- Fortune Cookie: 'Your suspicion which no one else believes will someday be right.'
- Fortune Cookie: 'Be careful around squirrels.'
- Fortune Cookie: 'Beware some of those closest to you! They may not be what they seem.'
- Fortune Cookie: 'Mist is pretty from a distance, but do not lose yourself in it.'
- Fortune Cookie: 'Restrain your curiosity, especially around odd beatles.'
- Fortune Cookie: 'You will live an uneventful life, unremarkable in every way.'
- Fortune Cookie: 'A river will both give and take what you love most.'
- Fortune Cookie: 'Make the most of your life, it will come to a nasty end.'
- Fortune Cookie: 'Beware an uncomfortable encounter with an eagle.'
- Fortune Cookie: 'Your suspicion which no one else believes will someday be right.'
- Stall Attendant: I'm sorry, I'm still setting up, maybe I'll have something at a later date.
- Stall Attendant: Come to redeem your tokens?
- Redeem tokens
- Stall Attendant: What would you like to buy?
- Wicker Doll -
- Kaleidoscope -
- Nothing right now (Choosing this option ends the dialogue.)
- Buy tokens
- Stall Attendant: How many would you like to buy?
- 1 Token -
- Stall Attendant: There is your token, enjoy the festival!
- 10 Tokens -
- Stall Attendant: There are your tokens, enjoy the festival!
- 25 Tokens -
- Stall Attendant: There are your tokens, enjoy the festival!
- I don't need any
- Stall Attendant: You can come get some at any time during the festival.
- Not right now
- Stall Attendant: Make sure you do before the festival ends!
If you don't have enough Tokens after trying to buy a reward":
- Stall Attendant: I'm afraid you can't afford that.
Using the Bottle of Mist creates a misty particle effect around the player.
The Wicker Doll can be used to play a form of Rock, Paper, Scissors. The player's selection is displayed over their head when activated.
- Wickerman - Represented by a plank block.
- Flame - Represented by a magma block.
- Changeling - Represented by a leaf block.
The Kaleidoscope can be used to give the screen and randomly chosen color hue.
- Festival Attendee: H-hi. I, um, hope you're having as good a time as I am.
- Festival Attendee: Hello.
- Festival Attendee: It really is fun to finally get a chance to relax.
- Festival Attendee: I love being a part of the Kalkalrah clan, but at times like this it's nice to have the chance to be alone.
- Festival Attendee: Staring across the pond, enjoying the festival, surrounded by people I love.
- Festival Attendee: It's a sort of quiet, safe calm. One unlike the rest of the year.
- Festival Attendee: It's the festival again! And you know what that means...
- Festival Attendee: Green tea!!! I never know how to get this stuff outside the festival.
- Festival Attendee: I'm going to spend all night standing right here, drinking as much of it as I can!
- Stall Attendant: Do you want to watch the next round of fox races?
- Sure -
- Stall Attendant: Get ready then, because they're ready to go!
- (The options for which fox to support appear.)
- How do I play?
- Stall Attendant: The rules are simple: you pick the fox you think will win a race around the wickerman and back.
- Stall Attendant: Costs 5 tokens to enter, you get your tokens back if your pick is 2nd, double it if it gets first.
- Stall Attendant: I'll give you a banner you can use to cheer your fox on. It should be helpful, although sometimes they can get a bit overwhelmed.
- Stall Attendant: Best of luck if you do choose to play!
- No thanks
- Stall Attendant: We'll be holding more races all night if you change your mind!
If you don't have enough Tokens after choosing "Sure - ":
- Stall Attendant: I'm afraid you don't have enough tokens to watch a fox race.
- Stall Attendant: If you need more, you can buy some at the Reward Merchant to the east.
There are three colors of fox to support in the race.
- Green Fox - Do you support the gregarious green fox?
- Blue Fox - Do you support the bashful blue fox?
- Purple Fox - Do you support the prideful purple fox?
After selecting a fox:
- Stall Attendant: May the best fox win!
The fox race is a short loop around the wicker. The outcome is mostly random, but using the banner can either positively or negatively influence your chosen fox.
After using the banner, one of the following effects can occur:
There is a short cooldown on the banner. When it's ready, the following message appears:
- Your voice has recovered and you can cheer again.
When it's not ready, the following message appears when trying to cheer:
If the chosen fox gets first place:
- Stall Attendant: Wow! Your support for your fox was really impressive.
- Stall Attendant: You've easily earned these tokens. Enjoy!
If the chosen fox gets second place:
- Stall Attendant: Looks like you helped your fox want to win!
- Stall Attendant: It just wasn't strong enough to come in first.
- Stall Attendant: Second's not bad though! You've earned these tokens back.
If the chosen fox gets third place:
- Stall Attendant: Aww, it looks like your fox didn't manage to pull off a win.
- Stall Attendant: Maybe one of you needs to put in a bit more effort next time?
If you go too far away from the race area:
- You went too far from the race and your fox finished without you!
- Festival Attendee: Hmm, in the last race, blue looked like it was going to...
- Festival Attendee: Oh, hi. Don't worry about me, I'm just analyzing the performances of the last few races.
