- Sovereign Zhiraok: ...I need to converge at the Roughworks, handle her work for a while. That, and the next Crown Festival is soon. I feel like...it'd be a disservice to miss it.
Group up with the remaining members at [-1468, 32, -585].
Talk to Yusanu and Sui near the tent by the underground river in the Mistwoods.
- Yusanu: ...
- Yusanu: What are you doing?
- Sui: I'm... thinking.
- Yusanu: About what? What could you possibly be thinking about right-
- Sui: I don't know, Yusanu! Maybe about what to do next? How we can- h-how we-
- Yusanu: There's nothing we can do! We're stuck in unfamiliar territory, all lone, our family and friends all captured, or- or worse-
- Sui: Don't. Don't say that.
- Yusanu: Urgh! I can't believe I let her convince me stealing this... this thing was worth it! If I hadn't, then... then our agreement wouldn't have fallen through, and none of this would have-
- Sui: Don't you dare pin this on Rex. You heard what that Sovereign said, they- th-they knew what we were planning for ages!
- Yusanu: ...then maybe it'd have been best if you left us out of it.
- Sui: You-
- ???: Intruders! Owls, to arms!
A group of masked people run towards the tent.
Fight the ambushers at [-1473, 33, -591].
Defeat 2 waves of 2 ??? enemies to progress the quest.
Talk to the stranger at [-1473, 33, -591].
- ???: Woah woah woah woah woah! Alright, let's all take a step back, shall we?
Another masked individual appears in a cloud of smoke.
- ???: Owls! Step down! Bit of a leap, jumping straight to violence- we reserve that for the obviously crown-aligned, eheheh.
- Rurie: Allow me to introduce myself! The name's Rurie, member of the Canopy, captain of the Owls division! Apologies for the roughhousing, seems everyone's a little enthusiastic today, eh?
- Sui: The... Canopy...?
- Rurie: Questions, questions! I'm afraid it's our turn first- I've called the owls off for a time, but don't think you're off the hook just yet, young lady!
- Owl Fighter: ...captain, are you certain about this? For all we know, they could be spies-
- Rurie: Ah ah ah! Trust in the process, my friend. Spies or not, information is valuable.
- Rurie: Besides! We know how to... ah, deal with spies, as it were. Risk factor is minimal!
- Yusanu: So... what, are you also resisting-
- Rurie: Hold it there, mister! Didn't you hear me? We'll be asking the questions here first.
- Rurie: Seems you're the only one who hasn't spoken yet! Well now, don't be shy. Tell me - where are you lot from?
- The Auburn Forest.
- Rurie: Really? Quite far afield, aren't you? Finding your way from there to here is quite an endeavor.
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- Timasca.
- Rurie: Ahhh! Now the pieces are clicking together! I think I get it now.
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- Wynn.
- Rurie: Ohoho? Really now? How very, very curious. You're either a verrrry clever spy, or...
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- Sui: H... hey! Listen! I don't know who, or, or what you guys are, but--
- Rurie: How many times must I repeat myself? I said no que-
- Sui: Shut UP! We just BARELY escaped Timasca after we- after we tried to KILL the Queen! The rest of our friends are... captured, or d- dead!
- Sui: So- so either leave us alone, or I'll- I'll make sure you never see your loved ones a- again!
- Rurie: Uh huh!
- Sui: I- I will!! Don't... don't-
- Rurie: Ohoho, she's sure got some temper, huh?
- Owl Fighter: Rurie... her story could explain what-
- Rurie: Yes, my friend, I was just thinking the very same thing. Well well, new folk, if what you're saying is true, the Canopy might just be able to assist!
- Rurie: I may have information regarding your allies.
- Sui: You- you do? Really...?
- Rurie: Ah- but! But but but, see- trust is a currency here in the Mistwoods. I can't just spill all my secrets at once, can I?
- Rurie: And if you'd like to earn our trust... I'll need you to, ah, deal with some things for me.
- Yusanu: What kinds of things?
- Rurie: Oh, nothing too difficult... I'll tell you on one condition! I'll be taking one of you with me as leverage! Eenie, meenie, money... you, little man!
- Yusanu: M- me?!
- Rurie: You, indeed! Worry not, for I'll be sure to keep you safe, but... well, you understand the need, yes?
- Sui: We can't! We can't lose... we can't lose anyone else. Please, there has to be something-
- Yusanu: Sui... it's... fine. I don't think we have a choice. Just... do what they ask of you.
- Rurie: Goodness, so melodramatic! Come on, I'm a trustworthy fella! You've got nothing to worry about from me.
The dialogue options here do not have any differences.
- Fine.
- We'll be back for you, Yusanu.
- Yusanu: ...okay. We accept your terms, Rurie.
- Rurie: Ah-mazing! I'm glad you chose to be reasonable. In that case - I'll need the remaining two of you to go and sabotage .
- Rurie: Now, go and say your goodbyes, then come grab the  from me!
Talk to Rurie before heading out at [-1484, 34, -598].
Talking to Yusanu:
- Yusanu: Hey. You'll be fine. I'll be fine.
- Yusanu: I think we can trust them for now, at least. Not like we have an alternative...
Talking to Sui:
- Sui: We really... don't have a choice, do we? We, we need their support.
- Sui: I just... hope Yusanu will be safe.
Talking to any of the Owl Fighters:
- Owl Fighter: Ugh... Captain's being reckless as usual...
Talking to Captain Rurie:
- Rurie: Have we finished with the heartfelt goodbyes? Excellent. Truly, I am glad you took me up on this generous offer.
- Rurie: Don't worry about your little friend over there! He'll be safe and sound amongst our Canopy.
- Sui: ...and how can we trust you? To not... hurt him?
- Rurie: Ah, isn't that the issue at the heart of it all? You can't. But as I said, trust is valuable in these woods. That must go both ways!
- Rurie: Well, newbies! You've a list of the structures I need you to sabotage, so it really should be a simple task.
- Rurie: Just find a way to... disable them! However you manage it, I can't say I really care - so long as it gets done!
- Rurie: Well?
- Why are you getting us to do it?
- Rurie: Why, because it's a golden opportunity! The work needs doing, and you need a way to prove yourselves...
- Rurie: So why not? It's less work for me to do, so I'm not complaining!
- The dialogue options return here.
- Newbies?
- Rurie: Newbies! That's what you are, isn't it? New to the woods, new to the world...
- Rurie: ...maybe new to Fruma, even? Ah ah, wipe that expression of shock off your face! I won't tell if you don't either.
- The dialogue options return here.
- Rurie: Inspired as ever! Good!
- Rurie: Once you're done, find me back here! Just don't take too long, eh? Wouldn't want to get bored!
- Rurie: Ta ta, newbies! Good luck out there! And just a word of advice - stay on your guard. You never know what the mists may be hiding.
- The dialogue ends here.
Select the structure to sabotage using the checklist.
All three structures must be sabotaged to progress. They can be done in any order.
- § Military Watchtower
- § Water Pump
- § Mining Drill
Note: If you lose the taskbook, a new one can obtained by talking to Rurie at [-1473, 33, -591].
Talking to Rurie again:
- Rurie: Still a bit lost? Just use your  to find the things I need broken!
Military Watchtower
-> Head to the watchtower at [-1461, 46, -661] and sabotage it using a spell.
The task has the following description in the taskbook:

- "Just a nice old watchtower they like to use to spot members of the Canopy! Not some of the crown's finest work, admittedly - they're quite a ways off from actually finding any of us, but being cautious has never hurt before! - Love Rurie"
Upon approaching the destination:
- Sui: So is this... the place? "Military... Watchtower..." I guess so.
- Sui: Those  look rather unstable, don't they? I wonder...
Talking to Sui again:
- Sui: C-can you deal with them, please?
Cast a spell by the support at [-1464, 46, -670].
- Watchtower Guard: Huh?! We're under attack - it must be the Canopy!
Kill the 2 Watchtower guards.
After defeating the mobs:
- Sui: That's one down... ugh.
- Sui: Let's just get this over with.
If there are still tasks to complete:
- Sui: Check the , where should we go next?
If this was the last task:
Water Pump
-> Head to the water pump at [-1354, 43, -788] and sabotage it.
The task has the following description in the taskbook:
- "A water pump used to provide the Citadel with high-quality water. Supposedly, the mist adds a unique flavor... personally, I'd blame the algae, but whatever they say goes! - Kisses Rurie"
Talk to Sui at [-1352, 43, -791].
- Sui: Alright, water pump it is...
- Sui: I think we can work together for this one. Go, um, blast some  on the structure, and I'll... see if I can reverse the water flow.
- Sui: Let's just... get rid of this hunk of junk.
Talking to Sui again:
- Sui: You, um, should try to blast some of the  with your magic.
There are two weak points on the water pump. One is found at [-1361, 51, -791], and the other is at [-1379, 51, -791].
After casting a spell on the weak points:
- Sui: Did you manage to apply some pressure on the pipes?
- Sui: Good, then it's... time for my part, I guess. Um,  to me when you're ready.
- Sui: Okay... okay. Breathe. I need to... focus.
- Sui: After... after, um, everything that- that's happened, I've been... struggling with my cur-... ugh. You get what I mean.
- Sui: It all feels so... so... hopeless! We've lost everyone, and now- now we've lost Yusanu too, and I... I couldn't do anything!
- Sui: And the last thing we did before was... argue! And now, he's... he's safe, probably, but... I don't know. I wish we hadn't.
- Sui: Every time I think about- about any of it, I get so... angry! And the swirling ocean around me starts raging more and more and more, and... and...
- Sui: I'm scared, Player. I'm scared for Mora... Syndra... Rex, Zeph, the whole Steel Feather- for all of them! And I... there's nothing I can do...
- Sui: What if... what if they're all gone? And, and, and it's just us, forever...?
- We have to keep moving.
- Sui: I... I know, Player, I know! I'm... I'm trying, okay?!
- Sui: It's just... too much.
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- We can't give up hope.
- Sui: I don't know if I, ha, have any left. Everything's... moving so fast...
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- Sui: I... I never wanted any of this. I just... I just wanted to live...
Sui walks over to the edge of the pond.
- Sui: Sigh... okay. Sui, focus. You can do this.
Sui freezes the entire pond and nearby piping.
- Sui: Aaah! Wh- what was that?!
- Sui: That's... I don't... how did I...
- Sui: It... the ocean, it... stopped. I pulled at it, and it... it stopped moving, and...
- Sui: There's... there's no time to, to think about it. It worked, so... so that's good.
If there are still tasks to complete:
- Sui: Just... check the , what's our next stop?
If this was the last task:
- Sui: I... I think that was the last one. Let's go  that it's, um, done.
Mining Drill
-> Head to the mining drill at [-1294, 53, -854].
The task has the following description in the taskbook:
- "They ruined the southern lands just to start messing with ours. I don't even know what they are mining for. They don't seem very productive! - Hugs Rurie"
Upon approaching the destination:
- Sui: That's... definitely the drill.
- Sui: It looks... durable. Like, um, it'll be hard to just... . We need to find another way...
- Sui: There- there isn't any water nearby. So, so if any soldiers show up... please, can you deal with them?
- The monitor is keeping the machine running.
- Maybe something  can break it...
- Day 8 - Materials:
- - Dirt
- - Rocks
- - Traces of more rock
Using the Frail Sweeper on the monitor.
- The sweeper did no damage to the monitor...
Using the Dirt Covered Rake on the monitor.

lines.title: How to destroy the drill
lines.text: Pick up the rake at [-1298, 48, -856] and right-click the monitor at [-1293, 50, -847] using the rake.
The mining drill explodes.
- Mistwoods Captain: Aha, saboteurs! You won't get away with damaging the crown's property, not on my watch!
Defeat Mistwoods Wings Captain Shen.
After defeating the captain:
- Sui: Um... good job, Player. I didn't think about breaking the controls...
If there are still tasks to complete:
- Sui: We should check the , and find our next stop.
If this was the last task:
- Sui: Was that the last one? Let's head back to  and... and tell him it's done.
Return to Rurie at [-1484, 34, -598] and discuss the next step.
- Rurie: Well well! So the newbies return! Tell me, how did you find your trial?
- Sui: We did what you asked, so... so tell us about our friends, already!
- Rurie: Ah ah ah! Not so fast! I'm afraid you're not done quite yet!
- Sui: Are you kidding me?!
- Rurie: Deadly serious, I fear! That, dear friends, was but the first part of your task.
- Do you not believe we did it?
- Rurie: Oh, but on the contrary! I received word immediately once you had done the deed.
- Sui: Ugh... we had an agreement! You can't just-
- Rurie: But I can. If you want our support, you'll do what we ask. If it is any consolation, this is the last I will ask of you before our deal is concluded.
- Sui: ... Fine. What do you want?
- Rurie: I would ask of you to kindly... ehm, transport an Aldwell citizen here. Do make sure you aren't spotted by anyone else! That could cause... issues.
- Sui: Are... are they expecting us?
- Rurie: Ah! Allow me to rephrase. You need to kidnap them.
- Sui: Wh- what?!
- Rurie: Yes, indeed! Kidnap them, bring them here, and we will deal with the rest.
- Sui: You want us to just... just snatch a random citizen from their home? And, and what do you mean "deal with the rest?"
- Rurie: No questions, young lady! Not if you'd like to ensure the safety of your friend, that is.
- Sui: You-... how-... what-...
- Sui: You didn't even tell us who we're looking for!
- Rurie: Ahaha, apologies, my mistake! You'll be looking for the man named . Bring him here, but don't take too long!
- Sui: Nisen. Fine. Player, let's... talk about this outside the cave.
Leave the cave and discuss the plan with Sui at [-1522, 42, -650].
Talking to Rurie again:
- Rurie: Chop chop! I'll be waiting.
Talking to Sui:
- Sui: This... this is just getting ridiculous.
- Sui: We, we need to find a way to get Yusanu back, and... and get out of here.
- We don't know where he is.
- Sui: I know, I know, I know! And if we start looking, they'll, they'll notice.
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- We just... need to do what he says.
- Sui: I'm... sick and tired of following that clown's orders. But you're right...
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- Sui: It's just... weird. This last task. I don't get it.
- Sui: Even if Rurie's out of his mind... I don't see him just- just killing an innocent person. Especially if they're, um, a resistance group.
- Sui: Ugh. I don't know. Maybe if we investigate this Nisen person, we'll... figure out Rurie's reasoning.
- Sui: Let's head to .
Head to Aldwell at [-1276, 77, -701] and locate Nisen.
Talking to Sui by the cave again:
- Sui: I'll meet you in  then.
Take the zipline at [-1237, 50, -700] to reach the upper area of Aldwell. There are several NPCs in the area that you can talk to, or head to Nisen's house at [-1313, 77, -679] to progress the quest.
Talking to Sui at [-1270, 77, -694]:
- Sui: Phew. Getting up here really wasn't the easiest... the Red Fox back in Auburn really, ha, pales in comparison.
- Sui: I've been trying to get information on Nisen, but... people don't seem to like me much.
- Sui: Maybe you'll have some better luck?
Talking to Shu at [-1283, 77, -696]:
- Do you know of anyone named Nisen?
- Shu: ...nope, sorry.
- Shu: I'm a bit busy, so...
- The dialogue ends here.
- Fine day today, right?
- Shu: ...it's okay.
- Shu: Mist is a bit thick.
- The dialogue ends here.
- Goodbye.
- Shu: Hm. Bye...
- The dialogue ends here.
Talking to Masah at [-1273, 77, -707]:
- Masah: ...
- Do you know of anyone named Nisen?
- Masah: ...no.
- Masah: Why're you asking, stranger?
- The dialogue ends here.
- How are you doing?
- Masah: ...I'm fine.
- Masah: Is that all?
- The dialogue ends here.
- Goodbye.
- Masah: Hm...
- The dialogue ends here.
Talking to Jamie at [-1298, 78, -701]:
- Jamie: ...uh. ...hello...stranger.
- Do you know of anyone named Nisen?
- Jamie: ...
- Jamie: ...I don't...see it. You haven't got one Er. I. I mean. Nothing. No. Definitely, uh...definitely not.
- Haven't got one...what?
- Jamie: I can't look, I'm really not supposed to be talking to you at all, and Wait, that counts as urgh!
- You definitely know him.
- Jamie: ...I'm. I. You. ...ugh, I'm no good at this.
- Jamie: ...well. ...sorry. Nisen... I. I do know. I shouldn't be telling you, but I do know. Please don't hurt me.
- Jamie: You need to take the  Not the one that goes upwards, though.
- The dialogue ends here.
- You seem tense.
- Jamie: ...stop...stop looking at me that closely.
- Jamie: ...am...am I about to die?
- Player: ?
- The dialogue ends here.
- Goodbye.
- Jamie: ...rrrright.
- The dialogue ends here.
Search Nisen's house for any [-1321, 77, -679] clues regarding him.
After reaching Nisen's house:
- This must be where Nisen lives...
- Sui: Um, let's hope he's not home...
There are several interactable objects in Nisen's house, but only the diary upstairs at [-1319, 84, -679] is required to progress the quest.
- It looks like someone's diary. The latest entries are dated 118 IA.
- - Entry 1: Mother came by today. She is taking their separation quite poorly.
- - Entry 2: Father tried to bring me fresh produce today. I asked him about mother, and he left.
- - Entry 5: I stopped talking to Father. Mother came by my work at the market. We went for food after.
- There's a note with information slipped between the pages: Parents divorced. Working at market.
- There's a thin layer of dust on top of the bed.
- Seems like no one has slept here in a while.
- It looks like someone's diary. The latest entries are dated 120 IA.
- - Entry 131: I had a normal day today. Helped my friend carry some food to their house.
- - Entry 132: Stayed in and slept all day. Was very tired.
- - Entry 133: Slept in. Boss wasn't happy with me, has me working extra shifts next week.
- The entries stop after this point...
- Sui: That's odd... the latest entry's dated from weeks ago.
- Sui: It's like they stopped writing them abruptly...
Leave Nisen's house quickly at [-1319, 77, -679].
After reading the upstairs diary:
- Nisen: Is someone in there?
- Sui: Eep! That must be Nisen! We need to think of an excuse...
Despite what the quest stage says, you have to talk to Nisen directly in order to progress to the next stage.
Talking to Nisen:
- Nisen: Excuse me? What are you doing in my abode?
- Nisen: If I am not mistaken, stumbling into other people's abodes is not a custom.
- Sui: Oh... I- I'm so sorry! I- I- we- we thought this was the... bakery.
- Nisen: The... bakery...?
- Nisen: Oh. Yes, wrong building. The bakery is down at ground level.
- Sui: Oh! Thank you for the directions. We are... so sorry for the misunderstanding.
Regroup with Sui at the main square at [-1283, 77, -706].
Talking to Nisen again:
- Nisen: Please, leave now.
- Sui: That was close... I'm, um, surprised he believed us.
- Bakery? Really?
- Sui: I- I panicked, okay! But it worked, didn't it?
- Sui: He was... surprisingly chatty. That's a nice change compared to everyone else.
- Sui: Though, um, he was a bit... odd. He didn't seem too certain about his answers...
- Sui: I don't know. What are you thinking? Any theories?
- He's been brainwashed.
- Sui: I... was thinking the same thing. It'd explain the diary entries stopping abruptly...
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- Maybe he's just like that.
- Sui: Maybe... I guess he could be. I might just be jumping to conclusions.
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- We've entered a parallel universe!
- Sui: Uh... let's workshop that one a little.
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- Sui: Look, I managed to snag a schedule off his bedside table.
- Sui: Listen to this. "Deliver hunting tools from weaponsmith through southern exit at noon."
- Sui: It's weird, right? Something's definitely off with him... but still, kidnapping him and handing him off to some... some random bird-man! I don't like it.
- Sui: But... we don't have much of a choice. Let's camp outside the  and wait...
Prepare to kidnap Nisen at [-1295, 65, -629].
Upon approaching the destination, Sui calls out to the player from atop a wooden platform on a tree.
- Sui: Hey!
There is a short parkour path through the tree that leads up to Sui.
Talking to Sui at [-1293, 69, -623]:
- Sui: Guess we'll just have to wait...
- Sui: I... ha, I've been feeling really out of my depth, here. I've never had to do this much without... um, without their support.
- Sui: But... you're here to help, so. Um. Thanks for- for sticking with me. I... I don't think I'd have made it this far without you.
- Sui: Oh! There he is!
Time passes until noon. Nisen walks down the path from Aldwell, and Sui jumps down on top of him.
- Sui: Ouch... dumb move...
- Sui: Um... I think it worked, though. Can you help me?
Talk to Sui at [-1292, 50, -624].
- Sui: That was... easier than I expected it to be.
- Sui: I kind of just, um, landed on top of him? And... and here we are.
- Sui: We should... probably get moving. I don't want anyone to- to see us!
- Got your magic under control?
- Sui: Um! Control is... maybe not the right word. I... ha, I tried to freeze him. So... still working on it. I guess.
- Sui: ......how are we going to move him?
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- So, how do we carry him?
- Sui: Um! I... didn't think about that.
- The dialogue branches combine here.
Rurie lands next to Sui and startles her.
- Rurie: Well well, newbies! Looks like you could use a hand!
- Sui: Aah! Wh- where did you come from?!
- Rurie: Why, from the trees, of course! I see you've managed to subdue the good mister Nisen over here, well done, well done.
- Sui: ...we've done everything you've asked for. Now- now tell us what you know!!
- Rurie: Oh, dear, you thought you two were done? Ha! Ahahaha!
- Sui: ...what?!
- Rurie: Kidding! Kidding, kidding- goodness, the looks on your faces! What's a little practical joke between friends, eh?
Sui runs up and hits Rurie.
- Rurie: Fine! Fine, fine, I get it! Jeez, lady...
- Rurie: I'll cut it with the jokes... for now. Good news! You've passed the test!
- Sui: So, will you-
- Rurie: Yes, yes, settle down, I will tell you. Give me a moment! Goodness. You're an impatient one, aren't you?
- Rurie: I'll be bringing you two to the Canopy! But, ah, one little precaution- I'll have to blindfold you till we arrive, Just a security measure!
- Sui: Ugh... you know what, I don't even care anymore. Just... bring us to Yusanu.
- Rurie: Perfecto! Let's head off then!
- Selecting this option progresses the quest.
- Give me a minute.
- Rurie: Ugh! Fine fine fine! But hurry up.
- The dialogue ends here without progressing the quest.
After choosing "" the player and Sui are transported to the Canopy.
- Fuhue: Rurie, care to explain yourself? Why did you bring these outsiders here?
- Cileon: One was enough...
- Rurie: Ah, you know how it is, Fuhue! I was oh so bored on patrol this morning! You lot aren't exactly the life of the party..
- Fuhue: You know Azael has clear rules on recruiting. Did you file the necessary paperwork? Because I didn't see anything on my desk regarding this.
- Rurie: The... ah, the paperwork was real? I always thought it was something you were making up for the fun of it.
- Fuhue: No. We have the protocols in place for a reason, Captain Rurie. Will you find the time to review them yourself, or must I have Captain Cileon run you through them?
- Rurie: Yes, yes, I understand the importance- though, I believe Cileon shares my views on the protocols. Isn't that right, Cileon?
- Cileon: Dumb. Throw 'em off platform.
- Sui: H- hey! Don't just act like, like we aren't right here!
The Captains turn to look at Sui before continuing to talk amongst themselves.
- Fuhue: Cileon! That is also against our protocols. We wouldn't want to leave a body for the crown to find, we have far simpler forms of disposal.
- Rurie: And of course, we need to torture any necessary information out of them first - I have heard this a dozen times over.
- Sui: I got ignored...
- Fuhue: Ah! You were listening! Good, Captain Rurie. We'll knock some sense into you yet.
- Fuhue: I did have some deerlings bring Nisen into our processing room earlier. Thank you for your service, Captain.
- Rurie: Ah, no problem! Hardly even broke a sweat!
- Rurie: Well, I'll be catching up with you later! I suppose if we're following protocols, I'll need to hand these kids off to Azael.
Rurie walks over to talk to the player and Sui.
- Rurie: Hey hey, friends! I'm a bit thirsty, so I'll be leaving you now! Think you'll manage to  yourselves?
Rurie departs up the tree.
Find the leader inside the Canopy at [-1392, 154, -537].
Talking to Captain Cileon:
- Cileon: Hm. Rurie told you to find Azael.
- Cileon: What is it?
- Who are you?
- Cileon: Cileon. Fox Captain.
- Cileon: Swordsman, too.
- The dialogue options return here.
- Where's Azael?
- Cileon: Azael...?

- Yuman: Well, Zeph, Player, and I've already been through it! Some cool moves from you both! Man, getting to see a cursed one in action was awesome...
- Sui: ...it was?
- Yuman: Yeah! Like, I'd hear all the stories, and think... man, having those kinds of powers sounds so cool. Sometimes I wished I could have em! Without, uh, being evil, of course.
- Yulie: You'd be even harder to deal with if you did, bro. But on that subject- Quill said something about you all practicing... what was the word he used... "magic?"
- Yuman: What?! Ey, princess, why didn't you show anything off the other day?
- Zeph: O- oh, I- I- I-
Yusanu enters.
- Yulie: Don't be insensitive, Yuman. It isn't something people just... pick up.
- Yulie: From what little I've heard from Quill, it can take years of study to master a blessing... so I wouldn't be surprised if they couldn't even make a spark! Uh, no offense.
- Zeph: W- well... maybe we'll s- sur- surprise you!
- Yusanu: Ha, think you're the only ones with hidden talents? I've got a trick or two up my sleeve too!
- Yuman: Bro, you don't have sleeves...
- Yusanu: It's an expression, dumbass. Like you're one to talk. Why are you half-naked?
- Yuman: To show off my abs? Obviously. Anyway, Player, why don't you ?
Talk to each member at [-2123, 6, -727].
Rex, Zeph, Sui, Mora, Yuman, and Yulie all need to be talked to in order to progress the quest.
Talking to Yusanu.
- Yusanu: Who, me? Sorry, but I'll sit this one out until you're all done.
- Yusanu: Got to save the best for last, right? Heh.
Talking to Rex after she shows off her archery.
- Rex: I'll have to add arrows until my bowstring runs out of space next time...
Talking to Zeph after he shows off his magic.
- Zeph: I'll h-have to come back here a-again tonight!
Talking to Sui after she shows off her magic.
- Sui: It's like there's ripples gently spreading within me...
Talking to Mora after he shows off his magic.
- Mora: To see my powers growing this clearly...
Talking to Yuman after he shows off his guitar.
- Yuman: So. Impressed yet?
Talking to Yulie after he shows off his blaster.
- Yulie: Dang, I think I overloaded it. I'll have to put it through a charge cycle...
Talking to Rex:
- Rex: Oh, my turn?
Rex walks to the center of the area.
- Rex: So. Magic, curses, blessings... whatever you want to call it, it hasn't worked for me. It just doesn't... click.
- Mora: Ah, not to worry, Rex! Even without it, none in the province could match your accuracy with a bow.
- Zeph: Y- yeah! And if you d- did get magic, it'd j- jus- just be unfair for the rest of us!
- Rex: Yeah, yeah, sure. Either way, I've been practicing a new technique... let's see if I can pull it off.
Rex fires a barrage of several shots at the target.
- Yulie: ...are you sure that's not magic?
- Rex: Yep! I just place every arrow on the string at once, which lets me shoot at a much larger area!
- Yulie: But... how'd you manage to hit each arrow right on target?! That's... insane!
- Rex: Ha. Go on, keep praising my skill. That was actually the first time I tried that many arrows at once... glad it worked out!
- Yulie: The... first... You said you'd practiced it, man! What do you mean that was the first time?!
- Rex: Yeah? I practiced theoretically. In my head. Keep up, Yulie.
- Rex: Okay, so, who's next?
Rex rejoins the group.
After Yulie sees any member show off their combat abilities (including Yuman):
- Yuman: Couldn't even make a spark, eh?
- Yulie: Alright, alright! I've been proven wrong.
Talking to Zeph:
- Zeph: It's my t-turn, huh?
Zeph walks to the center of the area.
- Zeph: So... I w-want to first say that I've been c-coming here every night.
- Zeph: I was e-embarrassed that I just didn't g-get it.
- Zeph: I mean, j-just look at how fast your m-magic developed, Mora!
- Zeph: And you, S-sui! You are a natural, a-after all.
- Rex: I still don't know any form of magic. Why feel so embarassed?
- Zeph: Rex, you don't even n-need magic to be a valuable asset! You're the best archer in the w-world!
- Zeph: I don't h-have that skill! My blade skills a-aren't good enough! You've h-had to save me time and time a-again.
- Zeph: And Player, I felt like I had l-let you down after all the k-knowledge you had given me.
- Yusanu: I may not have talked to you a lot, Zeph. But from what I know of the science behind magic, you don't have to blame yourself for not getting it.
- Yusanu: A lot of people study magic their whole lives. I'm sure you'll get there eventually.
- Zeph: Thank y-you, Yusanu. However, I think I f-finally figured it out...
Zeph shoots two wind slashes, then disappears into a cloudy mist.
- Yuman: Yo! Where'd he go?
''Zeph reappears on top of the target, then walks back over to everyone.
- Zeph: I think I'm finally g-getting this magic thing somewhat down!
- Zeph: I will n-not stop practicing! N-not until I can m-m-match you all!
Zeph rejoins the group.
Talking to Sui:
- Sui: Do I, um, have to?
- Yuman: Come on, man! Show us what you've got!
Sui walks to the center of the area.
- Sui: ...okay. I've tried to, um, practice a bit, now that I'm... yeah.
- Sui: I haven't fully developed it, but, I have this new skill...
- Sui: Okay! I'm going to try it!
Sui creates a ball of water in the air.
- Zeph: W- woah! It's like you ma- made that out of n- n- nothing!
Sui loses the water.
- Sui: ...ugh! It takes so much concentration... even a word makes me fail...
- Sui: Also. It's not, um, out of nothing.

- Sui: It's like... there's an ocean of swirling energy, all around me. If I can get a bit, in, like... a bucket, I can use it. But... I don't know how to get it without, um, falling into it and getting overwhelmed.
- Sui: ...does that, um, make sense?
- Zeph: Uh... n- not- not really, but-
- Sui: Let me try again!
Sui concentrates.
- Sui: Come... on... do it!!
Sui summons several columns of water around the training area.
- Yuman: Woah!!
- Mora: Sui!! Are you alright?
- Sui: I... I'm fine. No, even... more than that...
- Sui: It's like... I finally felt this power's ebb and flow, not just... it pouring out, I...
Sui darts her eyes around the group.
- Sui: ...ah! Is everyone fine? You... you all seem fine. Okay...
- Sui: I think... I think that's all from me.
Sui rejoins the group.
Talking to Mora:
- Mora: Very well! This is as good an opportunity as any to show off my progress!
Mora walks to the center of the area.
- Mora: Although I am proficient in combat with my hammer, that is... standard. So, allow me to show my magic instead, as that is what I have been training!
Mora creates a tangle of roots on the floor directed to the target.
- Mora: ...oh, dear. I did not expect it to have become so powerful! It seems I must still master control over it...
- Mora: I apologize for the damage I have caused. If you would ask for compensation, I would gladly provide it.
- Yusanu: Eh, don't worry about it. It's just a training room. Besides, all this junk in here doesn't even work anymore.
- Mora: What a relief.
- Yuman: Yo, that was badass, man! Your curse is awesome.
- Mora: Is it! I suppose it is, haha! I am glad to have had the oppurtunity to learn to use it.
- Mora: That is all, then. Who will go next?
Mora rejoins the group.
Talking to Yuman:
- Yuman: Lemme show you just what I can really do, man.
Yuman walks to the center of the area, then looks at Zeph.
- Yuman: Watch and learn, princess. Not every day you get to see me shred.
- Yuman: Alright, let's rock!
Yuman jumps over and attacks a training dummy.
- Yuman: Yuman But wait! That's not all!
Lightning strikes the attacked dummy.
- Yuman: My Sonic Boomer can help out with defense too! I'm no one trick pony - I can cover every genre of combat!
Yuman creates a temporary barrier in front of himself.
- Yuman: And bam! That's it from me and Sonic Boomer for today.
- Yuman: Who's next?
Yuman rejoins the group.
Talking to Yulie:
- Yulie: I suppose it's my turn.
Yulie walks to the center of the area.
- Yulie: I'll say, I'm not as... direct... as Yuman. But I can hold my own in a fight.
Yuman fires a shot from his blaster, with the recoil sending him backwards.
- Rex: A ranged weapon, huh?
- Yulie: I mean... yeah? Yusanu made this thing for me, and he calls it the Electric Blaster.
Yulie walks back into the center of the area.
- Yulie: It's also able to fire a much larger blast with way more power, but that does make it less... precise.
Yulie fires a wide, high-power shot.
- Yulie: That's all from me. Next one!
Yulie rejoins the group.
After everyone else has shown off their abilities, Yusanu walks to the center of the area.
- Yusanu: Alrighty! Let's see... where to start...
The alarm in Yusanu's forge starts to ring.
- Yusanu: Oh, you have gotta be... again?! Really?! Ugh!
- Yusanu: Yulie, Yuman, can you check the tunnels for any intruders?
- Yulie: If you need us to. Keep us updated, would you?
- Yusanu: Sure. Get the others to help you, I gotta run and check on things!
Yusanu exits.
- Mora: Of course we can help, just tell us what to do!
Rex walks into the middle of the group.
- Rex: Player and I actually have some important tasks Syndra needed done!! Will you be okay without us?
Yusanu's alarm stops ringing.
- Yulie: We will. It shouldn't be too hard for us, anyway- just routine check ups.
- Yuman: Yep, yep! Alright guys, follow papa!
Yuman, Yulie, Mora, Sui, and Zeph all leave the training area.
- Zeph: Wh- what? Ugh... put some c- cl- clothes on, a- at- at least.
- Yuman: Ha! Getting flustered, eh?
- Rex: Wait for them to leave...
- Rex: Okay! They're gone.
- What was that?
- Rex: I needed a way to get everyone else out of here so we could talk!
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- Syndra didn't give us any tasks.
- Rex: Yeah, obviously! It was the best excuse I could come up with in the moment.
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- Rex: So, look. Yusanu's been really hard to get a read of! He's barely ever around- I'm honestly surprised he even showed up today!
- Rex: But anyway, when you and Zeph headed out with Yuman during the last alarm, I wanted to check in with Yusanu and see what he was up to.
- Rex: But guess what? He was gone! Walked into his workshop and never walked out. Isn't that weird?
- Rex: I don't know what it means, and I don't know if he's a risk to us or not. But what I do know is that he's suspicious!
- Why ask me and not anyone else?
- Rex: Because they'd all probably tell me not to do anything impulsive right now. Which isn't even true, I've thought this plan out extensively!
- Rex: Come on, meet me outside his workshop! I just want to look. If it's nothing, then it's nothing! But I don't think it's nothing.
Meet up with Rex at [-2114, 6, -697].
Talking to Rex at the training area:
- Rex: I'll meet up with you at the workshop.
Upon reaching the destination, Rex runs over to the workshop.
- Rex: Any signs of him?
- Seems empty.
- Rex: Sure does, huh.
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- Not yet!
- Rex: See? I told you! He's just... gone.
- The dialogue branches combine here.
Rex runs to the back room of the forge.
- Rex: Not even a trace... Seems like I wasn't distrustful for nothing. But how?
- Rex: He has to have gone somewhere! He couldn't have just... vanished.
- Rex: There has to be something else going on here! Do you see why I suspect him now?
- Rex: Let's snoop around a bit and make sure he's not posing a threat to us.
- Yeah, this seems off.
- Rex: I'm glad you feel that way. Makes me feel less... horrible... about it.
- Rex: I guess we can be horrible people together, then.
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- I don't like this...
- Rex: I get it, trust me. They've taken us in and given us a place to stay, and now...
- Rex: If we're wrong, if I'm wrong, then we both might get thrown out.
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- Rex: The blame will land squarely on us both. I really hope that even if we are kicked out, the rest can still stay here...
- Rex: ...no time to dwell on that. He must have left the workshop through an exit somewhere. Let's  and see what we can find.
Try and find Yusanu in his workshop at [-2114, 6, -697].
There is a hole covered up in the back room of the workshop at [-2129, 6, -697]. Click it to open the path.
- Rex: Aha! And you thought I was just being paranoid.
- I didn't say that.
- Rex: But you were thinking it, I could tell!
- The dialogue ends here.
- You were!
- Rex: Okay, fine, maybe a little. But I was right to be!
- The dialogue ends here.
Reading the note left in the hidden tunnel at [-2138, 6, -700]:
- If you're reading this note, please turn around!
- These vents are broken, and were blocked off for a reason. Proceeding further will be dangerous!
- Please, trust me on this. -Yusanu
The following dialogue only plays when the note is read for the first time.
- Rex: That's confirmation. Though, not like we needed it...
- Rex: Let's keep moving!
Approaching the closed door at the end of the cave.
- Rex: Hmm... the door's shut.
- Rex: Yusanu's really puulling out all the stops to make sure nobody follows him!
- Rex: Too bad we're persistent, though. There's got to be some way to open it, we just need to !

lines.title: Opening the Door
lines.text:
Two levers can be found in the cave behind wooden covers. Click the covers to remove them.

One is at [-2156, 3, -714].

The other is at [-2171, 3, -682].
After opening the door:
- Rex: Whatever you did seems to have worked, the door's open!
Follow the bridge in the middle of the cave to reach the opened door.
Upon reaching a large hole in the floor of the vent:
- Rex: Wait up!
Rex walks over to the hole.
- Rex: Dead end? No, I see something on the other side...
- Rex: How do we get across? I guess you could try to use your magic... but I don't want you to put yourself at risk just cause I dragged you along for this.
- Rex: Think, Rex, think!
- Rex: Oh! Yusanu has to have taken this way, there aren't any other options. So, there's a trick to it...
- Rex: Look, over there! Do you see the button on the other side? I bet he uses it to close off this path whenever he takes it.
- Rex: It's a good thing you have the best sharpshooter in all of Fruma on your side! A shot like that is nothing to me.
- Rex: Just a moment... need to line it up... just right...
Rex fires and hits the button across the gap.
- Rex: Got it! Oh, that's more precarious than I expected. Be careful!
Complete the parkour across the gap to continue. Then, simply follow the paths to the end of the tunnel.
Talk to Rex at [-1697, 40, -468].
The chain in the vent can be climbed upward.
Talking to Rex:
- Rex: ...okay, why are we right outside the Sovereign's mansion?!
- Rex: This place is so heavily guarded, and he just has a secret tunnel directly to the front door?!
- Rex: Okay... okay, okay, okay. Calm.
- Rex: We can't just leave it here, obviously, but we're definitely not getting through the front door...
- Rex: Loko, up there. The arch connects to the main structure, and probably has a way inside.
- Rex: Maybe we can get up by climbing this building over here!
Travel up the nearby building at [-1714, 47, -465] and enter Soosu's mansion.
Follow the parkour up the building, then go across the bridge at the top that leads to the mansion.
Sneak through Soosu's mansion looking for Yusanu at [-1685, 54, -480].
After entering the mansion:
- Rex: ... Hey, stay on your guard. We don't want to get caught in here.
- Rex: Though... it's kind of quiet in here. Weird.
Enter the elevator at [-6558, 94, 11474] to progress the quest.
- Rex: Okay. Okay okay. That's a lot of buttons.
- Rex: So these two say up and down... over here it looks like a list...? Office, Workshop, Quarters, Workshop 2, Roof Workshop... And why is there a lever? It's not even labeled.
- Rex: Ugh, I can never figure out Roughworks machines. Always overly complicated...
- Rex: Well, what about you? Any thoughts?
- We should go up.
- Rex: Okay. Sure! As good a suggestion as any.
- Rex: ...so, which one of these is up?
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- Push all the buttons?
- Rex: Okay. Thanks for the input. I'm... not going to do that! That sounds like an awful idea- has Zeph been rubbing off on you?
- Rex: And I thought one of him was bad enough...
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- Rex: Oh, whatever! Let's just try something.
Rex starts pushing random buttons.
- Rex: ...uh. What's-
The elevator door closes with Rex and the player inside.
- Rex: What's going on?!
''An intense jingle plays and the elevator moves upward before reaching its destination.
- Rex: That was... I don't want to talk about it.
Rex exits the elevator.
- Rex: Wait! Player, quietly, come look at this.
Head toward the middle of the hall to progress the dialogue.
Two "Bouncy Golems" can be seen in the hallway: One named Sparkles, and one named Glitter. The Golems start to head towards Rex and the player.
- Rex: Shoot, they're coming this way! Follow me!
Rex goes up the nearby staircase.
Follow Rex up the staircase. Staying in the hallway or in the elevator will reset the quest back to the bottom of the elevator.
- Sparkles: Did – you also – see that?
- Glitter: I'm sca-a-a-a-a-a-ared!
- Sparkles: What – if – it's a – GHOST?!
Glitter jumps backwards in fear.
- Glitter: N-O-O-O!!! Mother w-o-o-o-ould know what to do!
- Rex: ...let's just... go.
Rex continues the rest of the way up the staircase.
- Rex: Those "guards" don't seem very normal, do they? Isn't this supposed to be the Sovereign's mansion?
- Rex: They didn't even see us... oh, whatever. Let's keep moving.
Trying to enter the hallway with the Golems:
- Rex: Hey! Get back.
Attempting to go back down the staircase:
- It wouldn't be a good idea to go back down there.
Viewing the bookshelf at [-6610, 106, 11474]:
- There are various books...
- – Soosu
- – Soosu
- – Soosu
- – Soosu
Continue past through the path to the door at the other end of the room.
Yusanu and Soosu can be seen sitting at a desk below.
- Yusanu: Why did you call me here again so soon? I was just here yesterday.
- Sovereign Soosu: Oh, don't play dumb! Dead soldiers! Killed on the job! Sound familiar??
Rex walks over to the edge of the balcony.
- Yusanu: Uh...
- Sovereign Soosu: Well, it better! Again - dead soldiers!! We had an agreement, Yus, and you've clearly gone and broken it!
- Yusanu: I- I know. And I'm sorry that it happened. But- it happened while I was here, working! What do you expect me to have done about it?!
- Sovereign Soosu: Hmph! You're smart, aren't you? Smart enough to be able to grasp the fundamentals of conductivity and electrical currents! You could have found a way.
- Sovereign Soosu: It's such a shame... you were one of my favorites, Yus. And now you've really let me down.
- Yusanu: ...I know. I- I'll find a way to fix it. Tell me what to do, and- and I can. Whatever I need to- so I can keep them safe- I'll, I'll do it.
- Sovereign Soosu: Oh, Yus, you're so silly. There's nothing you can do to fix this now. The damage is done, and nobody around here will shut! Up! About it!!!
- Sovereign Soosu: I let you live in that abandoned trainyard because I thought you'd be quiet. But this isn't quiet! I can't focus now that everyone is-
Sparkles and Glitter enter and interrupt Soosu.
- Sparkles: MOTHER! MOTHER!
- Glitter: A GHO–O–O–OST! SPARKLES HEARD A GHO–O–O–O–OST! WHAT DO WE–E–E–E DO???
- Sovereign Soosu: Ugh! Not now!! Can't you see mommy's busy?!
Soosu uses her blessing to deconstruct the Golems.
- Yusanu: ...Oh. I liked those two...
- Sovereign Soosu: ...They'll be fine. I'll just bring them back later!
- Sovereign Soosu: You know, they've been getting better and better at replicating human behavior! My latest constructs were at an estimated 86.3% accuracy-
- Sovereign Soosu: ...Um. Where was I...
- Sovereign Soosu: Right! Here's what you can do for me, Yus. This isn't going to go away. I need someone to pin this on, so they'll all shut up and move on from it!
- Sovereign Soosu: Especially that loudmouth from the north! Would it kill him to leave me alone and stop meddling in my business??
- Yusanu: Uh...
- Sovereign Soosu: Don't answer that. Look, this is the only way. You need to hand over whoever is responsible for this whole thing. That's the only way we can keep our peace and keep being friends.
- Yusanu: Wh- you can't be serious! I can't do that, Soosu! You- you really expect me to give up one of my friends or family?!
- Sovereign Soosu: No, Yus, what I expected from you was to keep your "friends and family" quiet! But we're past that point now. Something needs to happen.
- Yusanu: I-... I understand. I need to think. I'll... I'll let you know soon.
- Rex: What is he doing?! Sneaking around, meeting with the Sovereign?!
- Rex: We need to cut him off. I'm not letting him get away with this. , quickly!
Rex goes back into the previous room.
Follow Rex out of Soosu's room. There will be a window that can be entered by right-clicking.
Talking to Rex by the window:
- Rex: Come on! Let's see if we can cut him off before he enters the tunnel!
Wait for Yusanu's return at [-1696, 40, -469].
The window exits nearby the bridge that was previously used to enter the mansion. Rex will run back to the opening of the tunnel that returns to the Steel Feather hideout.
Talking to Rex:
- Rex: Okay. This is as good a place as any to hide out and wait...
Rex will move behind some of the nearby objects.
- Rex: I can't believe this! I can't believe him! How long has he been doing this?
Yusanu walks out of Soosu's mansion.
- Yusanu: I... uh, I'll see you guys later, I... guess.
- Rex: Here he comes!
Yusanu begins walking back to the tunnel, but Rex jumps out in front of him.
- Yusanu: Ahh!
- Yusanu: What are y-
- Rex: Not a word, Yusanu. You are in no position to be asking questions!
- Rex: Secretly meeting with the Sovereign? Really? Are you insane?!
- Yusanu: You- you... followed me... oh, no... no no no, no... you weren't seen, were you? You're going to ruin ev-
- Rex: We're going to ruin everything?! And not you, the guy always sneaking off to meet the Sovereign?!
- Yusanu: You don't understand! The only reason we're safe down there is BECAUSE I struck a deal with her!!
- Rex: You WHAT?!
- Yusanu: I work as her assistant in her workshop, help her with whatever projects she's working on, and in exchange she allows us to live in the station!
- Yusanu: As long as we don't cause any trouble with soldiers, at least- which, might I remind you, you people caused? So don't- don't act like...
- Rex: Oh my god, you idiot. How long were you planning to keep this a secret? Were you ever going to tell anyone?
- Yusanu: I-
- Rex: You were just gonna let it sit until, inevitably, someone was going to piss off the soldiers? Because, trust me, that would have happened eventually. With or without us.
- Yusanu: ...it seemed safer this way.
- Are you going to hand one of us over?
- Yusanu: Ack! You- you heard that part too?
- Rex: Duh?
- Yusanu: Ughhh.... I don't know! I don't know. I don't want to, obviously! You're all good people, and it'd break every single one of our guidelines to throw someone out like that!
- Yusanu: But... I don't think I have a choice. The Steel Feather's safety is on the line, and I could fix it by just- just- handing someone over, but- I- I can't. I can't do that.
- Rex: Okay. You were doing what you thought was right. I can understand that. But this - keeping secrets, following their rules - it was never going to end well!
- Rex: We can get past this choice by doing what we were already doing - trying to take down the crown! If we succeed, there won't be any more risk for you all.
- Yusanu: ...but-
- Rex: This is your chance to make it right, Yusanu! You have information. Tell us what you and the Sovereign were working on. Is it important?
- Yusanu: ...I don't know much about... what it is. I know it's not a weapon, at least- Soosu was clear on that. It's... an important assignment from the Queen.
- Yusanu: It's- it's strange. Very, very strange. It uses science that sounds... impossible. I think we're building over an existing device, something the Queen already had.
- Yusanu: Soosu... she's stressed about the project. She needs to get it done, but it- it seems like an impossible task. There's something on the line for her.
- Rex: ...mysterious device, important to the crown... got it. Player, Yusanu- we need to steal it. If it's important to the crown... whatever it does, it's better if they don't have it.
- Yusanu: Wh- what?! You can't be serious! We can't just-
- Rex: We can, and we should! The Sovereigns aren't your friends, Yusanu, they're complicit in and responsible for everything wrong with Fruma!!
- Rex: If we can hurt them, then we can hurt the crown. And if we can hurt the crown... we might actually stand a chance.
- Yusanu: ...okay. Okay, fine! You're right. You're... right.
- Yusanu: I can get you to it. Uh... how did you get in, anyway?
- Rex: We'll show you. Come on,  we go.
Enter the mansion again at [-1686, 54, -478].
Follow the same parkour path as in Stage 9, then enter the mansion.
Talking to Yusanu on the ground:
- Yusanu: ...this had better be worth it.
Follow Yusanu to Soosu's workshop.
Yusanu and Rex enter the mansion.
- Yusanu: Right, we'll need to be fast. Soosu tends to spend most of her time in the workshops...
- Rex: What if she shows up?
- Yusanu: I... would probably be fine. But if she sees you two, then...
- Rex: So don't get caught, got it. I'm guessing we wouldn't stand a chance fighting her?
- Yusanu: No!! No, no, absolutely not. Her blessing... I haven't seen her use it in combat, but knowing what it can do...
- Yusanu: Being able to mold matter... it means more than just putting together machines. So...
- Yusanu: It won't come to that. Come one, let's get going.
Yusanu and Rex walk through the mansion and into the elevator.
Upon entering the elevator:
- Yusanu: Alright, before we descend - Soosu has a bunch of golems walking around her workshop.
- Yusanu: They're more... uh, advanced than Sparkles and Glitter. If they see us, they'll sound the alarms. So don't get caught!
Yusanu pushes an elevator button.
- Yusanu: How did you two even manage to find me?
