- Maripe: Oh, you lost my notes. Don't worry, it happens. Do you think you can find the spots on your own, or do you want me to write a new copy down for you?
- Maripe: Okay, one sec...and...here! Remember to  for where to go!
- I'll be fine
- Maripe: All the spots I listed are , but if you're having trouble, I'll write you up a new set if you ask!
Right-clicking with Maripe's Notes will show 3 locations for giving invites.
- Note: One of my friends lives on the edges of Espren. She usually listens to the chimes to pass the time.
- Cousullo: Oh, hello there. I certainly haven't seen you around here before.
- Cousullo: Is there something you wanted to speak with me about?
- Cousullo: E-excuse you? What's reopening soon?
- Cousullo: Oh, OH! Pishlas? The hot springs? Sorry, it's been so long that I nearly forgot the name.
- Cousullo: I have such vague memories of going there as a child, but I couldn't imagine them after seeing how the place was abandoned.

- Cousullo: Maripe did tell me some time ago he would be working on renovating it. I'm to suppose his work has paid off, then! I'd intended to visit him again soon, but this provides a nice excuse, as well.
- Cousullo: ...I might have to spread the word to his family for him. Even if Maripe's father is too busy looking after his wife, I'm sure he'll be delighted to hear about this.
- Cousullo: Well, I hope to see you there, stranger!
- Note: There's a nice spot in the outskirts by the road. Groups often gather there before heading out.
- Mont: Well, this is a sight, for sure! What can we do for you, fella?
- Group: Wait, Pishlas? The hot springs?
- Nerod: It's been ages, right...? That place, it's been in a state of disrepair for as long as I can recall...
- Mont: They're finally going to be open again? And fully renovated? Sounds-
- Feri: Sounds tempting. It's been ages since I've been able to bathe in hot water or relax properly...
- Mont: We'll surely all be there! These old bones could use a nice, long soak, I think!
- Mont: The tourist returns! Anything else you wanted to talk about?
- The normal dialogue options will appear.
- Note: A large notice board in the middle of Espren. You could probably hang a poster there!
- It's Espren's communal notice board. It's full of messages, old and new...
- Is there anything of interest here?
- Plenty of papers have been posted over, and there's a weathered old advertisement in the middle. Surely it's lost relevance by now, so...
- There. That should be a good spot for it. How much effort did Maripe put into the poster? It really stands out from the rest of the notices.
- There isn't a world that exists where someone doesn't see this advertisement.
Head back to Pishlas to participate in the celebrations at [-1762, 16, -1000].
- That's everyone! You may as well head back and join in on the fun.
When approaching Pishlas:
- There's so many people here! It'd be a shame to not .
Talk to 4 guests at Pishlas to progress the quest. Maripe can also be spoken to for progress.
- Maripe: Okay. Phew. Wow. Okay. Alright, alright, it's...
- Maripe: It's...it's done. It's all... It's all done, wow, I... There's. There's people... And they're here, and they're enjoying it, and, and...
- Maripe: And I don't have to think about this anymore, and my parents can relax about having let the place go, and...

- Maripe: And, and, and, the, the Sovereign, he'll, Ill get to tell him I'm done, and I'll get that, and... Ohhh my stars I'm done but I'm even more anxious now that it's done than I was before, aaah-
- Maripe: Okay, come on, keep your head on straight, Maripe! Now's the time to relax a bit... Deep breaths now- Oh, hey!
- Maripe: Uh, I...I need a minute, eheh. How about...you, uh, talk to everyone else, first, and just...yeah?
- Cousullo: I'd say I barely recognize the place after all the renovations...but honestly, it feels like I'm right at home, like I'm that little fox kit I used to be.
- Cousullo: Maripe tried to talk you up like you did all the work! I practically had to pry a confession out of him that you just came in at the end to help with the finishing touches.
- Cousullo: He's always been a humble sort, but I think that just shows his gratitude. And believe me, I'm grateful to you as well! I think you gave him the kick he needed.
- Denis: Ohhhohoho that's the spot. Man...I never knew what I was missing. Sort of an old style name, Pishlas, but...
- Denis: Phew, I'm definitely going to be coming back here again. A long day of Liff hunting, then a long night's soak... Oh, that sounds like a satisfying routine...
- Feri: Maripe, hm. That boy has done good. Certainly couldn't have done better myself, at my age. He's got an eye for carpentry, for decoration, for the respect of his ancestors...
- Feri: And heck, he's even got free towels provided! I'll be a regular from now on, that's for sure! Hope he's prepared for daily business!
- Nerod: Wow... I'll have to tell Timot what he's missing out on. This is fantastic. Perfect view, perfect water, perfect service...
- Nerod: Family concerns are dfinitely more important than a warm bath, but... I'll have to share some leaves with him, buy his ticket for next time. He deserves a free soak.
- Mont: Ahhh, that hits the spot... Youngster, do yourself a favor- never get as old as I am. 90 years, I've got...and this... Goodbye, aches, my dear old enemies...
- Mont: It's heavenly to feel them wash away in the water, but boy would I love to not creak when I sit down to begin with. Good on you for helping out, by the way- especially for a tourist!
- Fiscu: After the community notice board got vandalized so badly a couple years ago, I thought not to trust it again. I'm quite glad I broke with that and gave it a look now.
- Fiscu: Have you seen the owner of the springs, by the way? He's had a few foxes around him all day- normally, they're not the ones doing the chasing like that!
- Estur: Oh, it's lovely to be back. Having visited this place as a teenager, it had always saddened me that it closed. My heart really does go out to Maripe's mother.
- Estur: Honestly, if the Sovereign can manage all his business, his father should've been able to keep up. But either way, Maripe has outdone himself- and the Auburn Amaretto is such a fine vintage!

- Marseled: I've enough years on me to remember how Maripe's grandparents used to run this place. Maripe has outdone himself- this is, at barest minimum, up to their standard. No one can say otherwise.

- Marseled: It always was something of a...blemish, on his family's name, this place. I understand his mother fell ill, and that's certainly no one's fault, but abandoning a family business for any reason...
- Marseled: People judged them all, whether they realized it or not. Hopefully now with Pishlas open, that will end. It feels as if a cloud has lifted, really. Hmhm, or maybe that's just the tea.
- Marseled: Either way, this is marvelous work. And I can take my harvest without having to worry about disgusting cockroaches crawling all over me! So thank you for that, as well.
Interacting with the fox to the left of Maripe:
- It's sleeping lightly, as if it could wake up at any moment. Feels like it's keeping an eye on the springs...or like a proud parent surveying their child's work.
Interacting with the fox to the right of Maripe:
- It's sleeping soundly. Its breaths are soft, like they could lull you to sleep if you listened for long enough...like a proud parent tucking you into bed.
- It looks very comfortable in its sleep. Maripe must have been mindful enough to lay a towel below it.
- It's slowly dozing off. It appears to be... savoring the moment?
- It's basking in the shade. Even despite all the people around, it seems content...or maybe, it's because of all the people around?
- It seems to enjoy watching the visitors.
Talk to Maripe at [-1774, 17, -989]
- Maripe's waving in your general direction. He must've calmed down enough to talk coherently now.
- Maripe: I think I said earlier- with so many different little things piling up, I just couldn't think straight. i've been stuck at 'almost done' for a while now.
- Maripe: You showing up, offering to take care of all the little things cluttering up my brainspace...that made this...possible! I don't think I could've done it without you!
- Maripe: It really is jsut like I remembered it being. Everyone getting together and relaxing, talking about whatever strikes their fancy, just letting their woes disappear...
- Maripe: It even feels like I've got my grandparents right here with me. ...though, maybe that's just these two. These foxes have been following me all day...I hope they'll stick around.
- Maripe: It's this feeling of... a weight off my chest, but the knowledge there's a new task ahead of me- keeping up with this place. With Pishlas. It's...refreshing, I think.
- Maripe: Do... I know you're just a tourist, but...do you think... Do you think my grandparents would be proud of me? For all this?
- Surely...
- Player: Surely they would be. You've done a great job.
- Maripe: ...
- Maripe: ...oh gosh, I promised myself I wouldn't cry...a-and here I am doing it anyways. Haha... Stars, I'm tired after all this. So, so tired...but. But the good king of tired, you know?

- Maripe: You might need to go home soon, since you're just visiting...but come back any time. It'll be free, for you- and these should go pretty far in the Highlands, I think. I just- Thank you...so much.
- The dialogue ends and the quest is completed.
- Does it Matter?
- Player: Does it matter? It's more important that you've done it, instead of what people might think.
- Maripe: ...you know...you might have a point. I've been so weighed down by what everyone might think, that I could barely focus on the work. I should try and let that go, shouldn't I?
- Maripe: You know, for a tourist, you sure are generous with the help. So, I should be generous too! How's free access for life...and a personal gift from me sound? Again...thank you, so much!
- The dialogue ends and the quest is completed.
- I can't say.
- Player: I can't say. They're gone, after all.
- Maripe: ...heh. I guess that would make sense. But...I'd like to think they would be. I really would.

- Maripe: So... For one thing. You get free access! For another...here's a personal gift from me! After all, you didn't HAVE to help...but you did! You'll get a lot more use out of these than I will. SO...thank you, so much!
- The dialogue ends and the quest is completed.
See what's going on at [-1364, 113, -1287].
- Military Recruiter: I am disappointed in you Perin.
The recruiter punches Perin.
- Military Recruiter: When I meet new recruits, I expect them to look at least somewhat in shape!
- Military Recruiter: Yet here we are... Have you even done any training since we sent you the letter?
Perin jumps up.
- Perin: I have been training! I swear!
- Military Recruiter: Oh really, has a mentor been preparing you? Surely your family could afford one.
- Perin: Mentor? Y-yeah, of course I have one!
- Perin: They're right there! We were just about to start my training for the day actually.
Perin directs everyone's attention to the player.
- Military Recruiter: Hmmm...
- Military Recruiter: So you're Perin's mentor huh? There's no other way to say this, but you must be terrible at your job...
- Military Recruiter: You certainly look fit to be a soldier though. Perhaps training isn't your strong suit.
- Military Recruiter: So how about I take you to join the Fruman military instead of Perin?
- Military Recruiter: That sounds great! Meet us near the south Hyloch entrance, then we will take you to Fort Tericen.
The recruiter and guard leave down the alley.
- Military Recruiter: Oh, and don't keep us waiting. Or it might end up on your record.
Perin looks down at the ground.
Talking to Perin again:
- Perin: I hope you enjoy MY spot at Tericen!
- Perin: My mom's gonna kill me...
Meet the recruiter near the south entrance to Hyloch at [-1376, 109, -1182].
- Military Recruiter: There you are! Didn't I tell you not to keep us waiting?
- Military Recruiter: Get into the carriage, we'll take you to Fort Tericen.
- Military Recruiter: You don't want to miss the opening speech from the famed Sovereign Majin!
Talking to the Carriage Driver before the recruiter:
- Carriage Driver: Watch out for the horses, they can be a bit nippy.
Talking to the Military Guard before the recruiter:
- Military Guard: Talk to the recruiter.
Talking to the Military Recruiter again:
- Military Recruiter: Head into the carriage and then we'll go to Fort Tericen.
Talking to the Carriage Driver after the recruiter:
- Carriage Driver: The carriage is ready to go, we're just waiting on you.
Talking to the Military Guard after the recruiter:
- Military Guard: Don't keep us waiting, get into the carriage.
Interacting with either Carriage Horses will either cause it to make a horse sound or bite the player. When it bites, the following message is displayed:
- The horse bit you!
Walk into the carriage to continue.
- Military Recruiter: You shouldn't worry about Perin anymore. Trust me, I am doing him a favour by taking you instead.
- Military Recruiter: Although, he will surely be shamed by his community for not becoming a soldier, but frankly, he deserves it.
- Military Recruiter: You must be very excited to become a recruit, I can see it on your face!
- Military Recruiter: But let me warn you, the process is not all sunshine and rainbows.
- Military Recruiter: The training is grueling and competitive, every single facet of your physical ability will be tested!
- Military Recruiter: Think you're up for it? Well, I think you could manage. You'd certainly do better than Perin!
- Military Recruiter: Fort Tericen is run by the esteemed Commander Ferreo. When you meet him, it's very important that you show him his due respect.
- Military Recruiter: The Commander's been serving since as long as I can remember. He's probably the most accomplished man in the Highlands, aside from Sovereign Majin of course!
- Military Recruiter: Ah, I hope you're ready, we should be arriving soon.
Enter Fort Tericen at [-1224, 91, -1088].
Talking to the Military Recruiter:
- Military Recruiter: We're here, just head on in and I'll meet you up ahead inside!
Talking to the Carriage Driver:
- Carriage Driver: I don't mind, but did we really need to take the carriage?
Talking to the Military Guard at [-1200, 92, -1087]:
- Military Guard: Thank the Queen, I won't have to follow this idiot around anymore, now that the recruiting process is done.
Talking to either Military Guard around [-1217, 92, -1105]:
- Military Guard: Welcome to Fort Tericen.
Fort Tericen can be re-entered here later if you leave the quest area.
-> Return to the Tericen entrance at [-1224, 91, -1088].
Talk to the Uniform Tailor, then go see Commander Ferreo.
Talking to the Secretary before talking to the tailor:
- Secretary: Welcome to Fort Tericen recruit!
- Secretary: This is where you will be staying until you become a soldier.
- Secretary: Please see the tailor across from me to get your uniform, then see Commander Ferreo in the next room.
Talking to the Military Guard or trying to walk through the door before talking to the tailor:
- Military Guard: I can't let you enter until you get your uniform, speak with the tailor.
Talking to the Uniform Tailor and Arnol:
- Arnol: Are you also here as a recruit?
- Arnol: I'm Arnol, it seems like we've made it just in time!
- Arnol: I'll let you get your uniform. We should talk after the speech.
Arnol walks into the next room. The Military Recruiter walks into Fort Tericen and goes into the next room as well.
- Uniform Tailor: Welcome to Fort Tericen! Congratulations on getting accepted to become a soldier!
- Uniform Tailor: You must be from the Highlands. The rest of the recruits have already gotten their uniforms.
- Uniform Tailor: Your uniform colour will be yellow.
- Uniform Tailor: What is your name? I need to write it on your uniform.
- Type and send your name in chat.
Type a nickname for yourself using the in-game chat. This  will be used for the rest of the quest.

lines.title: Secret Name Modifiers discovered during the quest
lines.text:
Note: Some of these modifiers substantially increase the difficulty of the quest. They cannot be disabled later.

* Resilience
** The Shield room has five turrets the first day and seven on the second day. The turrets also use more complicated patterns.

* Leap
** The Parkour room has smaller platforms and more precise timing.

* Adder 
** Enables an optional secret fight with Adder on the second night.

* Tericen
** Commander Ferreo is instead fought as The Iron Commander.

* Cursed
** Enables the effects of Adder, Tericen, Leap, and Resilience, and also grants the  Iron Medallion necklace as a quest reward.
Entering "Zhiraok", "Soosu", "Gikyo", or "Majin" for a nickname will give a unique response:
- Uniform Tailor: Very funny... Now tell me what your real name is.
The option to enter a name appears again.
- Uniform Tailor: Alright, this will only take a second or two.
- Uniform Tailor: All done, here is your uniform recruit!
- You put the uniform on over your armor.
- Uniform Tailor: Now go see Commander Ferreo, he is waiting for you in the next room.
Talking to the Uniform Tailor again:
- Uniform Tailor: Go see Commander Ferreo, he's in the next room.
Talking to the Secretary:
- Secretary: I see you've been given your uniform. It looks good on you!
- Secretary: Need help with anything?
- Where should I be right now?
- Secretary: Commander Ferreo is waiting for you in the next room.
- Secretary: Once you are done speaking with him, you'll be hearing a speech from Sovereign Majin in the stage room!
- Tell me about being a recruit.
- Secretary: Recruits are separated by their divisions, their uniform colours reflect this.
- Secretary: Those with red uniforms are from Auburn, cyan uniforms are from the Industrial district, white uniforms are in the Wings division...

- Secretary: Green uniforms are in the Mistwoods division, they are recruits selected from other regions based on a test that decides if they are suited for the dangerous conditions in the Mistwoods...
- Secretary: Since you are in the Highlands division, your group leader is Recruiter Effal.
- Tell me about Fort Tericen.
- Secretary: Fort Tericen is the largest and most prestigious military training camp in Fruma, headed by the equally prestigious Commander Ferreo.
- Secretary: Many of the most famous soldiers of Fruma have originated from here, you should be proud to be a part of our program!
- Tell me about the Fruman military.
- Secretary: Most recruits already know this before coming to Fort Tericen... I suppose there is no shame in asking if you don't know.
- Secretary: The Fruman military is composed of nine divisions, being seven regional divisions, the Constable division, and the Wings division.

- Secretary: Yes, you heard that right, seven regional divisions not six. The seventh being the Xima division which recruits soldiers directly from the Auburn division, which is why most people lump them together.

- Secretary: The Constable division has an authority level higher than all the regional divisions, and the Wings division has authority over both of them. Be careful not to step on their toes when you become a soldier!

- Secretary: Within each division is a ranking system used to separate leadership roles. In ascending order of authority; there are soldiers, captains, commanders, and finally a single general that manages the commanders.
- Secretary: The Wings division has some additional positions within it, like the Gendarmes. They're a group of Wings soldiers that only operate within Aelumia.
- What will happen after I complete my training here?
- Secretary: Don't worry, this question is more common than you'd think.
- Secretary: In about a month, if everything goes to plan, you and the rest of the recruits will attend a ceremony and officially become Fruman soldiers!
- Secretary: From there, you'll work in a group with other Highlands soldiers. If you are able to impress your superiors, you can be promoted to captain or even commander!
- Secretary: Another thing that can happen if you demonstrate exception abilities is promotion to the Constable division or maybe even the Wings division!
- Secretary: There truly is fame and glory waiting ahead of you. If you are able to prove yourself.
- No, I don't have any questions.
- Secretary: Alright, good luck on your training!
Talking to the Military Guard in the entry room:
- Military Guard: Speak with the secretary if you're lost.
Talking to the Military Guard or trying to walk through the door on the south side of the next room:
- Military Guard: You may not enter yet, talk to the commander and then enter the stage room across from us.
Talking to the Military Guard or trying to walk through the door on the west side of the next room:
- Military Guard: You may not enter yet, talk to Commander Ferreo.
Talking to the Military Guard or trying to walk through the door on the north side of the next room:
- Military Guard: I can't let you enter until you talk to Commander Ferreo.
Talking to Commander Ferreo and the Military Recruiter:
- Commander Ferreo: You have you brought me Effal, this is not Perin.
Effal begins to sweat.
- Recruiter Effal: You will have to excuse me Commander, but I did not deem Perin as fit to be a recruit.
- Recruiter Effal: The boy had done no training, he would not have lasted a day here!
- Recruiter Effal: I told him this myself, and while I was reprimanding him... Erm...
- Recruiter Effal: ... Had overheard our conversation and begged that I take them instead.
- Recruiter Effal: Seeing that they looked more suitable than Perin, and hearing their reasoning as to why they should be a recruit, I decided to adhere to their request.
- Commander Ferreo: So you deliberately acted against the directions given to you?
- Recruiter Effal: Well... Yes... I-I truly apologize for violating the orders given to me...
- Commander Ferreo: Do not go against what you are told to do again.
- Commander Ferreo: Nevertheless, if what you say about Perin is true, perhaps it is for the best that he does not become a recruit.
- Commander Ferreo: Welcome to Fort Tericen, recruit. Enter the room to the right so that we may begin the opening speech.
- Recruiter Effal: Thank you Commander! Now, let me lead you to the stage!
Effal and Ferreo walk into the stage room.
Listen to the speech from Sovereign Majin.
Talking to the Secretary:
- Secretary: Shouldn't you be listening to a speech right now?
Talking to the Military Guard or trying to walk through the door on the south side of the room:
- Military Guard: You may not enter yet, enter the stage room across from us.
Talking to the Military Guard or trying to walk through the door on the west side of the room:
- Military Guard: You may only enter after Sovereign Majin's speech.
Talking to the Military Guard on the north side of the room:
- Military Guard: There's no time for chit-chat, the speech is about to start!
Shortly after the player enters the stage room, Commander Ferreo joins Sovereign Majin on the stage.
- Commander Ferreo: The speech may now begin.
- Sovereign Majin: Welcome recruits, to the start of your training in becoming a Fruman soldier.
- Sovereign Majin: You have all been carefully chosen by a group of experienced recruiters.
Majin walks to the right side of the stage.
- Sovereign Majin: They have closely reviewed your performances in physical tests of strength and agility since you were children, and have decided that you belong here.
- Sovereign Majin: Do not prove to me that they were wrong.
- Sovereign Majin: Use the opportunities given to you to show us that you deserve to be amongst your superiors.
- Sovereign Majin: Your instructors will expect the best from you, so you must show them the best. Those who refuse or are unable to do this have no place here.
- Sovereign Majin: Your role will be the most important in Fruma. Ensuring the safety of the population is no small task, trust me.
Majin walks back to the center of the stage.
- Sovereign Majin: So, like I have, each of you must prove yourself worthy of being called a soldier of Fruma.
- Sovereign Majin: Let my words serve as motivation for you during your training.
All of the recruits give applause. Majin departs from the stage.
- Robin: Wow...
- Saldin: Amazing!
- Wilton: What an incredible speech!
Everyone stops clapping.
- Commander Ferreo: We are thankful to Sovereign Majin for taking time out of his responsibilities to deliver the opening speech.
- Commander Ferreo: Now we will be bringing you to your first training session of the day, I hope you all are ready.
- Commander Ferreo: Each of you will be separated into groups depending on your division. For each challenge, your group will be paired with another group.
- Commander Ferreo: The leaders of each region grouping will be the recruiter who originally sent you the invitation letter.
- Commander Ferreo: They will be the ones leading you to where you're supposed to be for the first couple of days here, following an assigned schedule.
- Commander Ferreo: You are expected to be at your designated area, on time and ready.
- Commander Ferreo: However, if for whatever reason you get lost, go to the secretary at the main lobby desk and she will tell you where to go.
- Commander Ferreo: Now, go convene with your recruiters in the main room to your left, then they will take you to your first training session.
Ferreo and the recruits leave the stage room. Arnol walks over to the player.
- Arnol: That was a pretty good speech, I was a bit nervous, but now I am ready to start the training!
- Arnol: I'm Arnol, I come from the nobel Highlands Tasa family, Fruma has done so much for us, so I am ready to help her.
- Arnol: I'm glad that you're from the Highlands. That means we're in the same group!
- Arnol: How about you and I stick together during our training?
- Arnol: My family tells me that recruits often end up very... competitive...
- Arnol: So I think we can both benefit from sticking together, and watching each others' backs.
- Arnol: Anyways, we should head to our group's leader, I think his name is Effal?
Arnol walks out of the stage room.
Talk to Recruiter Effal then head to the challenge room at [-10247, 112, 5288].
Talking to the Secretary:
- Secretary: Hey there recruit! Need help with anything?
- Where should I be right now?
- Secretary: After corresponding with you recruiter, head to the room straight across as soon as you enter the next room then go down the stairs on the right.
- Secretary: From there, head into the challenge room your team leader told you about.
- Secretary: Good luck on your first challenge, I believe in you!
(For the secretary's other dialogue options, see § Stage 4.)
Talking to the Military Guard on the north side of the room:
- Military Guard: Good luck with your training, recruit. But I'll warn you, Commander Ferreo is no pushover.
Talking to Recruiter Alena:
- Recruiter Alena: Do you need help with something recruit? Your team leader is Recruiter Effal, go see him for instructions.
Talking to Robin or Robyn:
- Robin: You know it's not too late to turn back. You risk losing more than just your pride here.
- Robyn: Definitely not going to happen. After hearing that speech from Sovereign Majin, I feel like I could take on the entire resistance!
Talking to Verdi:
- Verdi: Are you nervous like me? We're about to start the training and I still don't feel ready.
- Verdi: I shouldn't worry, if anything goes wrong, I know Recruiter Alena will be there to help.
- Verdi: But at the same time, It's hard not to be scared...
Talking to Arnol:
- Arnol: Alright... I can do this...
Talking to Lynn:
- Lynn: Ugh... How did Arnol end up here?...
Talking to Priscilla:
- Priscilla: That speech from Sovereign Majin was amazing...
- Priscilla: I was almost brought to tears... I wish with all my heart that I may serve under him one day!
Talking to Dogi:
- He appears to be shaking. It would be best not to disturb him.
Talking to Recruiter Ezero:
- Recruiter Ezero: Sorry, but I'm not your team leader, since your in the Highlands group, your team leader is uhmm... Ah, it's Recruiter Effal.
Talking to Matilda, Kerry, or Holger:
- Holger: I'm so glad to finally be out of the Roughworks. Although, after the training, we will have to go back...
- Matilda: I figured you'd be used to it after spending your whole life living there.
- Kerry: I think Holger is just impressed by the luxuries of the Highlands. I'd imagine even the slums here are fancier than the Roughworks.
Talking to Wilton:
- Wilton: Excuse me, Ezero sir, is it true the soldiers around here call Commander Ferreo 'The Iron Commander'?
- Recruiter Ezero: I believe he used to go by that nickname in his younger years, he was quite the fearsome leader.
- Recruiter Ezero: You should be careful not to get on his bad side... The last guy that did got exiled to Wynn...
- Wilton: R-really? What did they do?...
- Recruiter Ezero: Heh, I'm just messing with oyu kid, you don't have to worry about him, he's softened up a lot over the years.
Talking to Recruiter Riva:
- Recruiter Riva: I am not your team leader. Go find Recruiter Effal, the person wearing the same coloured clothes as you.
- Recruiter Riva: Shouldn't be too hard to do, I'd think.
Talking to Halbe or Katze:
- Halbe: Alright, time to put these skills to use! Are you ready for this, Katze?
- Katze: I'm ready! Let's show everyone we're the best!
Talking to Kyren:
- Kyren: Are you from the Highlands? I recognize everyone in that group except you, strange...
- Kyren: Well, just a word of advice, be careful when picking your friends, it means everything here.
- Kyren: If you know the right people, you can climb the ranks quickly. But you must also have to have the abilities to go along with it of course.
Talking to Recruiter Ollisy:
- Recruiter Ollisy: You look lost, don't worry, I can help you! Go find Recruiter Effal, he's wearing a yellow headband and is near the center of the room.
Talking to Petur:
- Petur: ...
Talking to Madelen or Yvonne:
- Yvonne: How do you feel about being accepted into the Mistwoods division? I am pretty excited about it, glad Recruiter Olissy noticed my value.
- Madelen: As someone from Auburn, I'm a bit unsure still, but the recruiters know what they are doing, so I will trust their judgement.
- Yvonne: I don't know much about the Mistwoods either, but I guarantee we will be ready for whatever is in store for us there!
Talking to Recruiter Strumon:
- Recruiter Strumon: I'm not the person you're looking for, go see Recruiter Effal.
Talking to Adder:
- Adder: I have spent nearly my entire life training to become a soldier. I wonder how many other recruits here could say the same.
- Adder: The Fruman military is in somewhat of a dire state right now, with resistance attacks becoming more brazen than seemingly ever.
- Adder: The duty will fall to us to return things back to normalcy. I am up to the task, and I hope you are too.
Talking to Saldin:
- Saldin: Oh hey, you're from the Highlands! I'm from Aelumia but I grew up in Hyloch.
- Saldin: I was assigned to the Wings group though, I'm a bit worried about meeting those expectations...
- Saldin: Heh, Oh well, that's what training is for, right?
Trying to enter the cafeteria or the room to the west:
- You should talk to your recruiter before leaving.
Talking to Recruiter Effal:
- Recruiter Effal: There you are. Didn't I tell you? Ah, never mind...
- Recruiter Effal: Listen, remember that talk we had with Ferreo, how about that just stays between us ok?
The recruits and leaders in the other divisions leave through the door to the west.
- Recruiter Effal: I better not see you gossiping to other recruits about it, that would make me very upset!
- Recruiter Effal: The first test for our group is the shield challenge, everyone follow my lead.
Effal leads the Highlands recruits to the challenge rooms.
Talking to the Military Guard at the left hall in the statue room:
- Military Recruiter: This area is only for soldiers and injured recruits, and well... You don't look injured.
Talking to the Military Guard at the right hall in the statue room:
- Military Recruiter: Sorry recruit, only soldiers are allowed to enter this area.
Interacting with the statue plaque at [-10230, 126, 5303]:
- The statue engraving reads: "Honour is not given"
After walking through the Shield Challenge door:
- Military Instructor: Welcome recruits to the shield challenge.
- Military Instructor: Defense is one of the most important aspects of combat. You should not expect yourself to be able to dodge every incoming attack.
- Military Instructor: A shield can be an incredibly useful tool for a soldier, but holding them up constantly can often interfere with your mobility.
- Military Instructor: Knowing when to hold up your shield to defend yourself against incoming arrows or attackers, is thus, a vital skill to learn.
- Military Instructor: Your training today will revolve around holding up a shield against arrows that are being fired from turrets.
- Military Instructor: The turrets will give an indication of when they are about to fire, however, the shields provided to you have many weights embedded into them.
- Military Instructor: Most of you will only be able to hold your shield up for a second or two at a time, so you must do so wisely.
- Military Instructor: I have set up a turret here that you can use to practice getting used to handling the weighted shield.
- Military Instructor: Simply stand where I am now, then click the button behind me.
- Military Instructor: Good luck recruits, I will be judging you from an overlook point. If you haven't already, take a shield from the shield rack next to Recruiter Effal.
- Military Instructor: When you're ready to start the challenge, enter the large door behind me.
The instructor and most of the recruits head into the challenge area.
Enter the next room and complete the challenge.
Talking to Recruiter Riva:
- Recruiter Riva: Stop lingering around. The sooner you get this challenge done, the sooner I get to have lunch.
Talking to Kyren:
- Kyren: That's it, holding up a shield against turrets? What a bore.
- Kyren: It seems like the instructors are basing these challenges off of the idea that we haven't done any training beforehand.
- Kyren: They are wasting our time. Anyone who would struggle in a challenge like this has no hope of amounting to anything.
Talking to Arnol:
- Arnol: These shields are really heavy, it feels like I can only hold them up for around half a second...
- Arnol: There's no point in overthinking this, I'm sure we'll both do well!
Arnol walks into the next room:
Talking to Recruiter Effal:
- Recruiter Effal: Don't worry , this one is the easiest of the three challenges.
- Recruiter Effal: Or was it the endurance challenge that was the easiest? Hmmm, I forget.
Interacting with the turret button while not holding a shield:
- You should have a shield before starting the turret.
Interacting with the turret button while not standing on the stone block:
- You should be standing in the right position, marked with stone, before starting the turret.
Trying to enter the challenge room without a shield:
- You should get a shield before entering the challenge room.
Grab a shield from the rack near Recruiter Effal.
Turrets have an indicator above them to tell you when they are about to shoot. The color changes from dark green, to green, to yellow, to red. The arrow will fire immediately when the color is red.
Walk through the door on the west side of the room to enter the challenge. The challenge lasts for 60 seconds.
- Military Instructor: It's your turn , stand on that plate to start the test.

lines.title: using certain names
lines.text:
If the nickname the Player uses is "Resilience" or "Cursed", then there will be five turrets in this room instead of three. Up to three turrets can fire in quick succession, requiring precise timing to block all arrows within the 1.5-second timeframe.



If the challenge is too difficult, then your nickname can be changed using a nametag on a table at the northern side of the room. Renaming yourself cannot be undone.
After completing the challenge:
- Military Instructor: Well done, now exit through the door across from you.
Head to the second challenge room after you speak to Arnol.
After leaving the shield challenge, Adder can be seen entering the next room. Effal and Arnol are standing in the hall.
- Recruiter Effal: You've really made a habit of testing my patience...
- Recruiter Effal: Your performance better make up for it. Now, follow me to the next challenge.
Effal walks into the Endurance Training room:
Talking to Arnol:
- Arnol: Hey , I am ashamed to say it, but things didn't go well for me...
- Arnol: I wasn't able to complete the challenge...
- Arnol: I couldn't even manage to raise the shield up to block a single arrow! After a while, the instructor just told me to move on.
- Arnol: I should have seen this coming... What about you, how did things go for you?
- I completed the challenge without failing.
- Arnol: Good job ! I am glad that one of us was able to do well. I'd like to learn about how you did it later.
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- I had trouble with it at first, but was able to succeed in the end.
- Arnol: Good job ! I am glad that you managed to finish. We should talk more about it later.
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- How were you unable to block any of the arrows?
- Arnol: Well, maybe you just had more strength training than me. The shield was just too heavy to hold up, I don't know what else to say.
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- Arnol: We should go to our next challenge now, let's hope Effal doesn't erupt at us for being late.
Arnol walks into the Endurance Training room:
Trying to walk back upstairs:
- You should not leave this area yet.
Listen to the challenge instructions then enter the next room and complete the second challenge.
- Military Instructor: Now that everyone's here, we may finally begin.
- Military Instructor: As a soldier, you will be defined by your endurance, it is your will to carry on through the fight!
- Military Instructor: The terrain you battle on will never be optimal, so you must be able to adapt to it to ensure your success.
- Military Instructor: As part of this training exercise, you will be jumping from platforms until you reach the end of an endurance course.
- Military Instructor: If you fall, you will have to go back to the start and continue from there.
- Military Instructor: We have installed jump pads on the platforms to help ease you into making riskier leaps.
- Military Instructor: To use the jump pads, simply stand on them and jump. The mechanism will detect the sudden weight loss and boost you.
- Military Instructor: I've installed a jump pad in this room to the right of me if any of you want to practice before starting the course.
- Military Instructor: Soon you'll all hopefully be able to complete a course similar to this one but without the crutch.
- Military Instructor: You may enter the large door behind me to begin. Oh, and your performance will be judged on how quickly you reach the exit.
The instructor and most of the recruits head into the challenge room:
Talking to Arnol:
- Arnol: I'm going to take my time on the jumps. After what happened in the first challenge, there's no point in rushing through.
- Arnol: Alright, I think I'm ready, let's sit together in the cafeteria after this.
Arnol heads into the challenge room:
Talking to Recruiter Effal:
- Recruiter Effal: Yeah, it was this one that was the easiest challenge for me!
- Recruiter Effal: Just get through the platforms as quickly as you can and you'll be fine.
Talking to Recruiter Strumon:
- Recruiter Strumon: What is it, do you want advice?
- Recruiter Strumon: Well, I can recommend that you go quickly, but you must also be aware of your surroundings.
- Recruiter Strumon: The rest is up to you, think carefully about how you want to approach this.
Talking to Adder:
- Adder: I am surprised by the amount of recruits who rush head first into these challenges.
- Adder: Why not think about your approach beforehand? They are all setting themselves up for failure.
Walk through the door on the west side of the room to enter the challenge.
- Military Instructor: You're up , good luck!

lines.title: using certain names
lines.text:
If the nickname the Player uses is "Leap" or "Cursed", then the endurance challenge will have smaller platforms and more difficult jumps.



If the challenge is too difficult, then your nickname can be changed using a nametag on a table at the beginning of the room. Renaming yourself cannot be undone.
Find the cafeteria and sit next to Arnol at [-10186, 129, 5328].
- Good performance:
- Recruiter Effal: Not a bad time, of course, not as good as mine, but it's fine since you're still learning.
- Poor performance:
- Recruiter Effal: Wow, you really took your time in there, don't worry, you'll get better... You, will get better? Right?
- Recruiter Effal: It's time to head to the cafeteria for lunch with the other recruits. Follow me, I'll show you where it is.
Effal walks up the stairs.
After following Effal upstairs:
- Recruiter Effal: Go through that corridor and then enter into the room on the right. Try not to eat too much, alright?
Effal leaves down the office hallway.
Talking to the Secretary:
- Secretary: Hey there recruit! Need help with anything?
- Where should I be right now?
- Secretary: It's lunch time recruit, your food and the other recruits are in the cafeteria. It's the room to the left as soon as you enter the next room.
- Secretary: Enjoy your meal, you deserve it!
(For the secretary's other dialogue options, see § Stage 4.)
Talking to Arnol:
- Arnol: There you are , come sit next to me so we can talk about the second challenge.
- Right click the chair next to Arnol to sit next to him.
Interacting with the buffet:
Talking to Lynn, Katze, or Halbe:
- Halbe: The chef did a great job with these meals. They must be from Aelumia!
- Lynn: It's a shame that the lesser recruits also get to have it. I would have had them eating from a trough with the horses!
- Katze: I certainly don't look forward to having to sleep in the same room as the Auburn recruits...
Talking to Priscilla:
- Priscilla: I can't stop thinking about Sovereign Majin's speech, it was just... Perfect!
- Priscilla: We must remember those words, especially the part about the importance of proving ourselves.
Talking to Kyren or Dogi:
- Kyren: So, the challenges, how did they go for you?
- Dogi: Well! Things went well! They were a bit difficult but I managed.
- Kyren: That's good to hear, we want to make sure everyone in our circle does well on them, so try to keep it that way.
Talking to Petur:
- Petur: ...
Talking to Yvonne or Madelen:
- Yvonne: I hope our training gets tougher, I'd hardly call them challenges given their current difficulty.
- Madelen: We were accepted into the Mistwoods division, it makes sense that these challenges are easier for us.

- Yvonne: Yeah, you're right, Recruiter Olissy told me herself that she sees great potential in us. We should try our best to live up to her expectations, and the expectations set for us as future Mistwoods soldiers as well!
Talking to Adder:
- Adder: I have been watching many of the recruits, seeing how they act and communicate with each other, and frankly, it worries me.
- Adder: Many of them are treating Fort Tericen like some sort of children's school, they do not seem to understand what awaits them.
- Adder: Of course, it is still only the first day, so hopefully this behaviour does not persist.
- Adder: And if it does. I trust that Commander Ferreo will deal with it.
Talking to Saldin:
- Saldin: Commander Ferreo has been working for the Fruman military for a long time, we're lucky to be training under him.
- Saldin: I hear he was offered a blessing early on in his service, back when he was still in the Highlands division. He was very famous back then, everyone in Hyloch and Aelumia knew him!
- Saldin: I hope I can accomplish ending up as half the soldier he was!
Talking to Matilda:
- Matilda: None of my friends ended up being chose to become a recruit like I was, I feel like a complete stranger here.
- Matilda: But that's fine, we aren't here to socialize, we are here to prove ourselves worthy of the title of soldier!
Talking to Wilton:
- Wilton: I didn't do too well on the first two challenges, I hope I can make up for it on my last one.
Talking to Robin, Robyn, or Kerry:
- Robin: Really Holger? You get access to a giant buffet and all you get is a salad and a small fish?
- Robyn: You idiot, not everyone needs to stuff their face with food like you! This is why mom says I'm the smarter one.
- Robin: Well who does she say the stronger one is? That's what really matters!
- Kerry: Can you two go five minutes without arguing with each other?
Talking to Holger:
- He seems to be too busy chewing his food to talk.
After sitting next to Arnol:
- Arnol: It's nice to finally eat something. I skipped breakfast today, I was too worried that I'd end up hurling it back up.
- Arnol: Anyways, about the endurance training. It took some time, but I figured out the perfect strategy to get through the course!
A guard walks into the room to the table behind Arnol and the player.
- Military Guard: Katze, you must come with me.
- Katze: Uhm... Ok...
- Arnol: I definitely am better at agility tests, I wonder if the instructors will take that into account when grading us.
Katze follows the guard, who walks up behind Arnol.
- Arnol: How about you, did you struggle with the jumps, or finish the course quickly?
- I finished the course quickly.
- Arnol: Well done! I knew you'd-
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- I managed to find a way through the course after a while.
- Arnol: It sure was tricky, but at least-
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- Why would I tell you?
- Arnol: Oh... Well, I guess you don't-
- The dialogue branches combine here.
Arnol is interrupted by the guard.
- Military Guard: You are Arnol, yes? You must come with me.
- Arnol: I am in the middle of eating, can't I go after I finish my meal?
- Military Guard: No.
Arnol, Katze, and the guard all leave the cafeteria. Shortly after, Recruiter Effal walks up to the table behind the player.
- Recruiter Effal: Head down to the dueling room, I will meet you there.
- Priscilla: Alright.
- Dogi: On it.
Lynn, Priscilla, and Dogi all leave the cafeteria. Effal walks over to the player's table.
- Recruiter Effal: You're not sitting with anyone? You're a strange one, .
- Recruiter Effal: The last challenge of the day will be dueling, the other Highlands recruits are already heading there, follow me.
Effal heads down to the training area.
Talking to Kyren or Halbe:
- Kyren: What was that about, where do you think that guy took Katze?
- Halbe: No clue, but it seems like that Arnol kid was also asked to go with them.
- Kyren: Whatever it is, it doesn't seem good...
Go to the challenge room and receive instructions for the final challenge of the day at [-10238, 112, 5295].
Talking to the Secretary:
- Secretary: Hey there recruit! Need help with anything?
- Where should I be right now?
- Secretary: If you're done with your lunch then wait for Recruiter Effal to pick you up for the next challenge in the cafeteria.
- Secretary: And if Recruiter Effal already came to pick you and your group up then... you should be with him in the dueling room.
(For the secretary's other dialogue options, see § Stage 4.)
After entering the challenge room, the Mistwoods division recruiter and recruits enter behind the player.
- Commander Ferreo: Your final challenge today will be singular combat against another recruit.
- Commander Ferreo: When up against the enemy, you may find yourself in a similar situation. You must be prepared for when this happens.
- Commander Ferreo: This test serves as a way to further gauge your skills, as well as an opportunity to show off the strategies you have developed in melee.
- Commander Ferreo: The most important skill to have in a duel is patience, to know when you have an opening to attack. But of course, agility and strength are also deciding factors.
- Commander Ferreo: Use your agility to avoid attacks, but if you find yourself unable to dodge,
- Commander Ferreo:
- Commander Ferreo: You weapon is a wooden training estoc. The edges are dulled, so you will not need to hold back your strength.
- Commander Ferreo: Your performance will be judged by me, if I see one side clearly winning over the other I will declare a victor.
- Commander Ferreo: Make sure to get yourself an estoc before entering the challenge room, I will oversee the challenges shortly, so do not start until I get there.
Most of the recruits walk into the challenge room.
Complete the final challenge of the day.
Talking to Recruiter Effal before talking to Commander Ferreo:
- Recruiter Effal: It seems like the commander wants to see you, just look at how he's staring at you...
- Recruiter Effal: Well whatever it's about, try not to make me look bad, ok?
Talking to Recruiter Effal after talking to Commander Ferreo:
- Recruiter Effal: I hope your talk with Ferreo went well.
- Recruiter Effal: I'll just assume things went well, based on the fact that you're still in this room.
Talking to Recruiter Ollisy:
- Recruiter Ollisy: Sorry recruit, there's not much advice I can give you here, I wasn't that good at this challenge during my training.
- Recruiter Ollisy: I just could never bring myself to go all out on a fellow recruit, what if I accidentally hurt them?
- Recruiter Ollisy: Ah, here's some advice! Don't do what I did, and you'll do fine!
Talking to Yvonne:
- Yvonne: Dueling against other recruits seems strange to me... Won't we be working together when we become soldiers?
- Yvonne: It's fine, I don't want to question Commander Ferreo. He's dedicated his life to protecting others, I trust his opinion more than mine.
Talking to lynn:
- Lynn: So, it looks like your buddy Arnol quit early, what else is new?
- Lynn: From the moment I saw him here, I knew he wouldn't be able to last a day.
- Lynn: But, if it turns out that he didn't leave, I wouldn't stick with him, if I were you.
- Lynn: You don't want his weakness to rub off on you.
Trying to enter the next room before talking to Commander Ferreo:
- Commander Ferreo: I would like a word with you first.
Trying to enter the next room before taking an estoc:
- You should get a wooden estoc before entering the challenge room.
Talking to Commander Ferreo:
- Commander Ferreo: I've been looking forward to speaking with you, one on one.
- Commander Ferreo: I want you to remember that the only reason you're here is because I allowed you to be here, and because I see some potential in you.
- Commander Ferreo: If you are unable to realize this potential fully, or become more trouble than you're worth, I won't hesitate to have you kicked out.
- Commander Ferreo: So, for your sake, I hope you do well on these challenges.
Ferreo leaves through the door behind him.
Interacting with the table of estocs:
Walk through the door to the south to begin the duel. Today's opponent is Madelen.
- Commander Ferreo: Step up, and the duel may begin.
- Left-Click to attack,  Hold Right-Click to block.

You can block continually by holding right click. Blocking an attack or letting go of right click will leave you unable to block for 0.5 seconds. You can perform a  by right-clicking shortly before the opponent attacks. A perfect block has no cooldown, allowing you to block again immediately.
[?] Madelen duel
After winning against Madelen:
- Commander Ferreo: Alright, I have seen enough.
- Commander Ferreo:  is the victor.
- Commander Ferreo: Now, both of you, exit the room and take a look at your final rankings of the day.
Madelen leaves the challenge room.
Leave the challenge room and check your ranking, then talk to Arnol.
After leaving the room, Commander Ferreo is found waiting for the player.
- Commander Ferreo: That was the last training exercise for the day.
- Commander Ferreo: Your ranking can be found on the board over there. Be sure to take a look, I hope it can serve as motivation.
- Commander Ferreo: Once you're done here, head up to the recruit barracks and rest for the night.
- Commander Ferreo: The barracks are up those stairs in the room directly across from the staircase.
Ferreo departs up the stairs.
Talking to Matilda:
- Matilda: What a day huh? I hope you ended up with a ranking that you're proud of.
- Matilda: If, like me, you didn't do well, don't think too hard about it. A good night's rest will cheer you up.
- Matilda: It's not as big of a deal as the other recruits will lead you to believe, trust me.
Talking to Madelen:
- Madelen: Could be better, but after all, training is supposed to reveal our weaknesses.
Talking to Halbe:
- Halbe: Wow, that Adder guy sure is something...
- Halbe: I shouldn't be surprised though, him and Saldin are on a different level from the rest of us.
- Halbe: I too will reach that level soon, I will prove my worth to the Commander!
Talking to Lynn or Priscilla:
- Lynn: Look at that disappointment moping in the corner, I think 18th place suits him well.
- Priscilla: Arnol? Well... It was only the first day. He could improve...
- Lynn: What?! Oh wait... You didn't do too well either, did you?
- Priscilla: ...
Talking to Yvonne:
- Yvonne: How could I have ranked so low? I must try harder to show my worth as a soldier!
- Yvonne: I hope Recruiter Olissy will forgive me for this...
Talking to Robin or Robyn:
- Robin: Looks like brawn beats brains again, huh sis?
- Robyn: More like luck beats brains! If our training was more realistic then everyone would see that I am clearly better.
Talking to Adder:
- Adder: It is just as I expected. Despite it being the first day, many recruits struggled catastrophically in their training.
- Adder: Their scores will only go down from here. I doubt any of them have the will to dig themselves out from the dirt.
- Adder: I wonder how long it will be until something is done about this.
The Ranking Board can be viewed to see every recruit's ranking.  also appears in the list, but the ranking is different depending on the player's performance, so it is excluded here.
# Adder
# Halbe
# Saldin
# Kyren
# Lynn
# Robin
# Robyn
# Kerry
# Yvonne
# Holger
# Priscilla
# Madelen
# Dogi
# Petur
# Matilda
# Wilton
# Katze
# Verdi
After viewing the rankings:
- You should talk to Arnol now.
Talking to Arnol:
- Arnol: Hey . It feels like it's been a while since we've last seen each other.
- Arnol: It's been a long day, I feel so tired already. Heh, it's pathetic...
- Arnol: I've been avoiding it because it's embarrassing, but I think you deserve to know.
- Arnol: Regarding what happened in the cafeteria, another recruit and I were taken to the guard's barracks.
- Arnol: They wanted the room to be spotless before the end of the day... It was a punishment for not doing well enough on the training.
- Arnol: After that, they took me to the dueling room, an instructor hastily explained what to do. And, well... The duel didn't last very long...
- Arnol: I just wished they would give me more of a chance to prove myself. I know I can do better!
- Arnol: This isn't what I expected Tericen to be like. It feels absurd to subject your recruits to that on the first day!
- Arnol: There's something I want to tell you in a more private area . Before you go to bed, talk to me in the barracks.
Arnol heads upstairs to the barracks.
Speak to Arnol in the barracks, then go to sleep at [-10215, 127, 5337].
Talking to the Secretary:
- Secretary: Hey there recruit! Need help with anything?
- Where should I be right now?
- Secretary: You're done for the day, there are no challenges left.
- Secretary: Now go get a well deserved rest. Head to the room straight across as soon as you enter the next room, and from there, enter the room to the left.
- Secretary: Sleep well, good night!
(For the secretary's other dialogue options, see § Stage 4.)
Talking to Kerry or Wilton:
- Kerry: So how do you feel about all of this after the first day?
- Wilton: It was alright, I don't see the point in the ranking system though, we're all going to become soldiers in the end.
- Kerry: It's just something to keep us engaged, to make sure everyone is doing their best in the training I think.
Talking to Kyren or Dogi:
- Kyren: You lied to me... Don't ever think about talking to me again until you get at least 3rd place in the rankings!
- Dogi: I'm sorry! I was just too embarrassed to tell you the truth!
- Dogi: I-I can make up for this! Please! I don't want to be alone here!
Talking to Katze:
- Katze: Are you here to humiliate me further? Go ahead, laugh, I don't care!
- Katze: I'll make you and everyone else who mocked me east their words!
- Katze: I'll become stronger, stronger than all of you! I-I just need more time.
Talking to Petur:
- Petur: ...?
Talking to Arnol:
- Arnol: I want to apologize to you . Earlier today, when I told you my reason for wanting to become a soldier, I lied.
- Arnol: I didn't come to Fort Tericen out of any noble duty to serve Fruma. I came here because it was a last resort for me.
- Arnol: I originally wanted to become a scholar at the royal university. If I were a member of a more powerful house, I would have been accepted in, no question.
- Arnol: They made me take a test to be let in, and I failed it. On top of that, they refused to let me retake it.
- Arnol: My father was furious with me, he was concerned with how I could bring honour to our house. So he turned to his friends in the military.
- Arnol: He pulled some strings, and here I am, becoming a soldier in order to bring more respect to house Tasa.
- Arnol: I am not telling you this because I want you to pity me. I want you to know why this is so important to me.
- Arnol: If word went around that a member of house Tasa was forced to clean the guard barracks as a punishment...
- Arnol: Well... Everything my father has done for me could be wasted, and I would be an even bigger failure than before...
- Arnol: That's all I wanted to tell you. I hope you can understand why I lied to you, I just didn't know if I could trust you with this, but now I do.
Interact with the bed next to Arnol to go to sleep.
Sneak around to find information on the Fruman military.
At 12:00 midnight, the player wakes up.
- You should search the barracks for any information useful to the resistance.
There are several items that can be collected during the night at Tericen. Alternatively, head to the medical room at [-10792, 126, 5314] to continue the quest.
- 4  Damp Hairs in the bathroom at [-10791, 126, 5331].
- 3  Torn Fabric in the entrance area at [-10719, 126, 5312].
- 2  Glaive Heads in the weapon storage room at [-10798, 127, 5320].
- 4  Damp Hairs in the guard bathroom at [-10830, 126, 5254].
- Diary Note 1 behind the stage at [-10752, 130, 5261].
- Diary Note 2 above the barracks beds at [-10763, 134, 5354].
- Diary Note 3 in the weapon storage room at [-10801, 128, 5315].
- Diary Note 6 near the challenge areas at [-10779, 116, 5281].
- Discarded Letter in the guard barracks in a bin at [-10817, 127, 5266].
Interacting with the bookshelf at [-10763, 126, 5316]:
- "The Heroes of Fruma: How they Shaped the Province"
- It's a book about a variety of famous Fruman military leaders.
Interacting with the bookshelf at [-10763, 126, 5290]:
