Reading Diary Note 1:
- Today I will start my training to become a recruit at Fort Tericen. It's hard to believe after all this time, my dreams are finally coming true!
- Soon, recruiter Rosei will come to my house and escort me to the barracks. I am shaking with excitement and nervousness even while writing this.
- I hope I can appear presentable when I meet Commander Ferreo.
- There is a strange message at the bottom of the page.
Reading Diary Note 2:
- My first day at Tericen went amazingly well! I didn't stutter when introducing myself to the Commander, did great in the training exercises, and was able to befriend a fellow Highlands recruit!
- Her name is Darea, and we ate lunch together. I spent most of that time talking to her about Commander Ferreo. She seemed somewhat freaked out with how much I knew about him.
- Tomorrow we will have dueling and shield training. The instructor for dueling training will be Commander Ferreo himself!
- Oh dear Queen... Please give me the courage to ask him how he managed to reach that level...
Reading Diary Note 3:

- I still couldn't do it... I can't just ask him a question like that outright, I need to show that I am "worthy" first. I've done well in the challenges but I still can't make it into the top three on the ranking.
- Those Wings recruits are just too good, compared to the rest of us. It sometimes scares me how strong they are. If I want any chance of reaching that level, I need to start taking risks.
- With that credit behind me, I may finally get the courage to ask Commander Ferreo about his biggest secret.
- How a vagabond was able to become one of the most famed military commanders, and even receive an incredibly powerful blessing.
- There is a strange message at the bottom of the page.
Reading Diary Note 6:
- Tomorrow I graduate from Fort Tericen and become a soldier. The days seem so similar to me, I've been forgetting to write these diary entries.
- In the past I may have been considered for promotion to captain, now, all of that has slipped away. My rankings have been steadily decreasing over the days, becoming lower than ever before.
- I spend most of my time thinking about what could have been, it feels like I am detached from reality.
- Yet, even still, the thought manages to appear in my head. Was Commander Ferreo right?
- There is a strange message at the bottom of the page.
Reading the Discarded Letter:
- Dear Sovereign Majin, it has been a while since I last wrote to you, or spoken to you, face to face. Coincidentally, I am writing this letter about the last conversation we had.

- I has asked you about potentially becoming a field Commander again. You were hesitant to grant my request, given my age, but would reconsider it if I showed my value as head of the recruitment program.
- I have heard troubling rumours coming from outside the Highlands, namely of the growing strength of a hidden resistance group in the Mistwoods.
- As a Wings commander, it is my duty to defend Fruma with my life. I believe I can be of far greater use out there rather than in-
- The letter ends there.
Picking up Damp Hairs in either bathroom:
When entering the guard barracks:
- You are entering the guard barracks, stay sneaking while moving so as to not alert the sleeping guards.
Walking without sneaking while in the guard barracks:
- Groggy Guard: GET BACK TO BED RECRUIT!
- You must stay sneaking to avoid waking the guards.
Trying to enter the kitchen:
- The chef might catch you if you get too close.
Trying to leave Fort Tericen:
- There is still valuable information to be learned here.
Interacting with the clothes bin near the entrance:
- You rummage through the clothes bin...
Interacting with the weapon crate in the weapon storage room:
Trying to walk further than the weapon storage room in the hallway:
- The guards might catch you if you get too close.
Interacting with the bin in the guard barracks room:
- You rummage through the trash bin...
Picking up the diary piece behind the stage:
Picking up the diary piece above the barracks beds:
Picking up the diary piece in the weapon storage room:
Picking up the diary piece near the challenge rooms:
Walking into the medical room:
- You can overhear Commander Ferreo talking to someone in the room ahead.
- Continue looking around Tericen.
- Commander Ferreo: So how did it go, is Verdi alright?
- Military Doctor: I'm afraid not Commander, his injuries are severe. I recommend sending him home to recover.
- Military Doctor: Maybe after he regains his former strength, he will be able to rejoin the program, but it's difficult to say...
- Commander Ferreo: To think that this damage was done with a training sword... It's... Incredible.
- Recruiter Strumon: What do you think should be done, Commander, should Adder be punished for harming a fellow recruit?
Ferreo takes a moment to respond.
- Commander Ferreo: No. This is an opportunity, Strumon, one that I do not want to let slip. Verdi will be sent home, and that recruit of your's will not be punished, but praised.
- Commander Ferreo: If Majin wants better results, this is how we do that... Just make sure to keep Adder in line, we don't want him going too far.
Strumon nods.
- Military Doctor: Who is that? Is someone watching us?...
- Quickly run back to your bed before Commander Ferreo Catches you!
Quickly run back to your bed at [-10765, 127, 5337].
Trying to run somewhere that isn't toward your bed:
- That's the wrong way!
Getting caught by Commander Ferreo:
- Commander Ferreo: Stop right there recruit!
Tell Arnol what you heard last night.
- Arnol: Hey, , are you awake? You slept through the alarm bell.
The player wakes up.
Talking to Arnol:
- Arnol: Everyone has already gone to start the training for today, I told Effal that I'd wake you up.
- You tell Arnol what you saw last night.
- Arnol: What! A recruit was injured so badly during the dueling training they had to be sent home?!
- * Arnol: And Adder was the one to do this? I did see that he got the highest ranking in the challenges yesterday...
- Arnol: It must have been an accident, maybe Adder forgot to hold back? I've heard people say that the strength of one Wings soldier is equal to three regional soldiers.
- Arnol: This doesn't seem right, ... Why would Commander Ferreo see that as an "opportunity"? What could that mean...
- Arnol: We have to get down to the bottom of this. How about we confront Adder during lunch, and ask him what happened during his duel on the first day.
- Arnol: But we need to get going now, I imagine Effal and the other recruits aren't happy waiting for us. Follow me, I'll lead you to the training room.
Arnol heads to the training area:
Go to your first challenge, then listen to the challenge instructions at [-10247, 112, 5274].
Talking to the Secretary:
- Secretary: Hey there recruit! Need help with anything?
- Where should I be right now?
- Secretary: All of the other recruits are probably in their challenge rooms right now.
- Secretary: You should join them. Head to the endurance training room, it's the same one as yesterday.
- Secretary: Things aren't going to be as easy today, good luck!
(For the secretary's other dialogue options, see § Stage 4.)
Enter the Endurance Training room. The Highlands and Aelumia groups are present.
- Military Instructor: Well, it looks like we can start now that everyone's here.
- Military Instructor: Most of you did well on the first course, so we're going to be upping the difficulty this time. I trust that you're all ready.
- Military Instructor: Make sure to watch where you're going, this course will have false platforms to trick you up if you're not paying attention.
- Military Instructor: Like before, you'll be judged based on how quickly you can complete the course and reach the exit.
- Military Instructor: I left the jump pad in here in case you want to get used to the feeling again. Enter the large door behind me to start the course when you're ready.
The instructor and most of the recruits head into the challenge area.
Complete the first challenge of the day.
Talking to Recruiter Effal:
- Recruiter Effal: You realize your bad behaviour makes me look even worse for bringing you in, right?
- Recruiter Effal: If I catch you sleeping in, going where you're not supposed to, or doing anything out of line again... You'll come to regret it...
Talking to Dogi:
- Dogi: I've been disgraced by my friends for getting ranked low yesterday... Now I don't feel like I have the will to do anything...
- Dogi: D-Do you think I could regain their trust by getting a high ranking? No... I'm still not strong enough...
Talking to Arnol:
- Arnol: This is the challenge I did the best on yesterday. It should be mostly the same, hopefully. Slow and steady wins the race.
- Arnol: I'm not going to rush into these challenges like yesterday, I need time to think about what I am going to do.
Talking to Recruiter Riva:
- Recruiter Riva: Took you a while to find your way here, did you get lost or something?
- Recruiter Riva: You're lucky Effal is a pushover, if you were in my group, you'd be out of here without a second thought.

Head into the door to the west to enter the challenge. Day 2's version of the challenge is slightly harder, since there are many platforms that do not have jump pads, and the required jumps are more difficult.
After entering the challenge:
- Military Instructor: You're up , do your best!

lines.title: using certain names
lines.text:
If the nickname the Player uses is "Leap" or "Cursed", then the endurance challenge will have smaller platforms and more difficult jumps.



If the challenge is too difficult, then your nickname can be changed using a nametag on a table at the beginning of the room. Renaming yourself cannot be undone.
Enter the next room and receive instructions for the next challenge.
Recruiter Effal's dialogue changes depending on the player's performance.
If you did well:
- Recruiter Effal: Not a bad time you had there. Keep this up and you might end up making me no longer regret letting you in here.
- Recruiter Effal: Up next is shield training, you're still not out of the woods yet. We are expecting big things from you.
If you did poorly:
- Recruiter Effal: Well... That was a disappointment. You've been given many second chances and this is what you do to give thanks>
- Recruiter Effal: If your mediocrity persists, I'll have no choice but to let you go, for both of our sake's. Now follow me to the next training room.
Effal heads into the Shield Challenge room.
Trying to leave the training area:
- You should not leave this area yet.
Talking to Arnol:
- Arnol: Hey , I think the challenge went well. I managed to complete it at least, although I can't say for certain if I made a good time.
- Arnol: I couldn't help but feel off about what the instructor said when I started the course... "Good luck Arnol... Not that it would matter...".
- Arnol: What is that supposed to mean? I thought instructors were supposed to encourage us, helping us to do better in the training.
- Arnol: I'm beginning to think that this training program is more about shaming us rather than preparing us to become soldiers. I wonder if the other recruits are starting to believe this as well...
Enter the Shield Challenge room. The Highlands and Industrial District groups are present.
- Military Instructor: Welcome recruits to day two of your training in the shield challenge.
- Military Instructor: I'll keep the summary short since I'm sure most of you remember the gist of the test from yesterday.
- Military Instructor: This time, instead of three turrets shooting at you, the number has been upped to five.
- Military Instructor: On top of that, the three central turrets have been elevated.
- Military Instructor: I've also adjusted the turret timings a little.
The instructor looks at Arnol.
- Military Instructor: I noticed that some of you struggled with lifting the shield on the first day...
- Military Instructor: Perhaps those people would like some sort of crutch to help them perform better, but I must say that no such thing will be granted.
- Military Instructor: I believe that failure can be an excellent teacher. Some of you may still need to learn that failure should elicit a change from yourself.
- Military Instructor: For those recruits, until this lesson is fully learned, continued failure will be far more valuable than success.
- Military Instructor: With that being said, I wish all of you lulck on the challenge! Pick up a shield on the rack next to Recruiter Ezero if you haven't.
- Military Instructor: Then, once you're ready, enter the large door behind me to start the test. Oh, and the training turret is still here if you need it.
The instructor and most of the recruits enter the challenge area.
Enter the next room and complete the second challenge.
Talking to Recruiter Effal:
- Recruiter Effal: Five turrets already? Seems like they're doing things a bit quicker than usual.
- Recruiter Effal: Just don't look at it as increased difficulty, instead, look at it is an increased chance to show your might!
Talking to Arnol:
- Arnol: That wretch... Looking directly at me while he talks about failure...
- Arnol: I'll make him eat those words... Maybe not today, but eventually... I'm done with letting people walk all over me!
- Arnol: Thank you for being here to listen to me, , I don't know where I'd be right now without you...
- Arnol: After this, we'll meet in the cafeteria, and discuss what you saw last night with Adder.
Talking to Lynn:
- Lynn: Heh... It seems like the instructor had a specific person here in mind when he talked about failures!
- Lynn: When will Arnol realize he can't keep playing pretend soldier?
Talking to Wilton:
- Wilton: Not this again... I think I can already guess how this will go for me...
- Wilton: Do you think if I duck when the arrow comes, the instructor will count it as a block?
Talking to Recruiter Ezero:
- Recruiter Ezero: Ah the shield challenge... Back when I was a recruit this test was the bane of many of my peers!
- Recruiter Ezero: It was a lot different back then, yet it seeks that it's reputation hasn't changed much. Funny little coincidence I suppose.
Grab a shield from the rack near Recruiter Ezero.

This challenge is similar to the first shield challenge, except now there are 5 turrets, and two turrets have a chance to fire in quick succession, which can only be blocked with a single shield use. As before, Turrets have an indicator above them to tell you when they are about to shoot. The color changes from dark green, to green, to yellow, to red. The arrow will fire immediately when the color is red.
Walk through the door on the west side of the room to enter the challenge. The challenge lasts for 60 seconds.
- Military Instructor: Alright, , stand on that plate in front of you to start the test.

lines.title: using certain names
lines.text:
If the nickname the Player uses is "Resilience" or "Cursed", then there will be seven turrets in this room instead of five. Up to four turrets can fire in quick succession, requiring precise timing to block all arrows within the 1.5-second timeframe.



If the challenge is too difficult, then your nickname can be changed using a nametag on a table at the northern side of the room. Renaming yourself cannot be undone.
After completing the challenge:
- Military Instructor: Good job recruit, exit through the door across from you.
Leave the challenge room then talk to Arnol and Adder in the cafeteria at [-10192, 129, 5327].
Talking to Recruiter Effal:
- Recruiter Effal: You're all done now. Was the added difficulty too much? It seemed like it was for your friend Arnol, he stormed out after he finished.
- Recruiter Effal: That's definitely not how a soldier should act, even I know that! Maybe you can teach him some manners at lunch.
- Recruiter Effal: Anyway, you probably know the drill by now. Head up to the cafeteria and go enjoy your meal.
Effal heads upstairs to the guard offices.
Talking to the Secretary:
- Secretary: Hey there recruit! Need help with anything?
- Where should I be right now?
- Secretary: It's lunch time recruit, your food and the other recruits are in the cafeteria. It's the room to the left as soon as you enter the next room.
- Secretary: Enjoy your meal, you deserve it!
(For the secretary's other dialogue options, see § Stage 4.)
Grilled Mahseer =
Juicy Apple =
Interacting with the buffet gives a random food item. Eating it brings up the following dialogue:
- You feel satiated.
Talking to Kyren or Lynn:
- Kyren: That Wings recruit, Adder, do you know anything about him? Why did he refuse to sit with us?
- Lynn: He seems like a complete nobody, I don't think he's from the Highlands or Aelumia. I wouldn't bother with him, personally.
- Kyren: Well I didn't ask for your thoughts on the matter... I just want to know how a complete unknown like him was able to score higher than all of us!
Talking to Priscilla:
- Priscilla: Two other have been expelled from our friend group... Will I be the next one to go?
- Priscilla: Oh... Dear Queen... Please give me the strength to do well in the training. I can't end up like the others!
Talking to Saldin or Halbe:
- Halbe: How were you accepted into the Wings division? It's my goal here to be able to become a Wings soldier!
- Saldin: Well honestly, I'm not sure. I guess Recruiter Strumon just saw something in me? I was also stronger than my friends, so maybe that was it.
- Halbe: Hmmm... So if I can impress Recruiter Strumon then I might be able to make it into your group?

- Saldin: Well not exactly. Recruiter Strumon only accepts recruits. If you want to be promoted into the Wings division as an Aelumia soldier then you'd need to impress a Wings Commander, or Sovereign Majin...
- Halbe: Darn... That sounds harder than I thought it'd be...
Talking to Madelen or Yvonne:
- Madelen: Did you speak to Recruiter Ollisy about your ranking from yesterday's training, what did she say?
- Yvonne: She assured me that it was not that big of a deal, and I have lots of time to improve. I suppose I was being a bit overdramatic...
- Madelen: In the Fruman military's eyes, we already passed the test. We're all going to be soldiers after the training, the ranking just encourages us to constantly improve.
- Yvonne: That's true, I will use my poor ranking as a reminder that I have much to improve on. I will make sure that today, my ranking will be higher!
Talking to Petur:
- Petur: ...
Talking to Adder:
- Adder: I've seen you and Arnol together a lot. I am confused with what you see in him. Is it because of his family name?
- Adder: If that is the case, I can assure you there are better options. Ones that will not hold you back.
Talking to Dogi:
- Dogi: So... This is how it feels to eat alone at lunch... I hate it...
Talking to Matilda:
- Matilda: These challenges have been so difficult... I wonder if my performance will end up on my record, I hope not...
- Matilda: Ha! What am I worried about, this is only the second day of a month of training! I'm sure I will get better before then.
Talking to Holger:
- Holger: This is my third serving, you really ought to take advantage of this buffet! Oh... I hope I don't get a cramp...
Talking to Robin, Robyn, or Kerry:
- Kerry: Hey, wasn't there someone else in your group, what happened to them?
- Robyn: Eh? I'm not sure, they seemed really jumpy, my guess is they couldn't handle the pressure and wanted to go home.
- Robin: Maybe you should take their example sis. I can tell already that you're struggling to keep up with everyone else!
Talking to Wilton:
- Wilton: It seems like things are starting to look better for me in these challenges! Maybe if I keep this up, I can manage a spot in the top five!
Talking to Arnol:
- Arnol: Ah, you're here, , come on, let's go ask Adder about how his duel went yesterday...
Arnol walks up to Adder.
- Arnol: Hey there, you're Adder right? I saw that you were first on the ranking yesterday, great job!
- Arnol:  and I were wondering how the duel went for you yesterday. We erm... Both did poorly on it and wanted to know how you won yours, just tell us what happened during the fight.
- Adder: You want to know how my duel went yesterday? Well, when it started I didn't engage immediately, I wanted to gauge the strength of my opponent.
- Adder: Despite leaving myself open for attack many times, my opponent couldn't even land a single hit on me. When I grew tired of that farse, I brutally retaliated...
Adder gets up from his seat.
- Adder: Even after he was yelling for me to stop, yelling "I yield!" at the top of his lungs, I continued. People like that should not become soldiers.
- Adder: I stopped after he finally finished yelling, he had to be carried out by two guards. Commander Ferreo was watching the whole time, and did not intervene.
- Adder: You wanted to know how the duel went, that is how. He never should have been here in the first place, and I did the Fruman military a favour by making sure he will never come back.
- Arnol: You monster... He wanted to dedicate his life to serving the Queen and the people he loved, and you took that all away from him...
- Adder: The will to do something means nothing, no matter how strong it is, if you do not have the ability to do it.
- Adder: He would have just gotten himself killed, or worse, gotten others killed. What I did was serve Fruma to the best of my ability, I am no monster.
- Arnol: No true soldier would ever intentionally injure an ally... Let's go,  this conversation is over.
Arnol leaves and sits at the same cafeteria table as before.
Sit next to Arnol.
Talking to Adder:
- Adder: Are you the one who told him to ask me about that? Who are you exactly?
Talking to Arnol:
- Arnol: Come sit next to me, I want to discuss what just happened.
After sitting next to Arnol:
- Arnol: I expected the worst yet was still surprised by that... That fiend really did it on purpose, and Commander Ferreo let it happen...
A Military Guard and Recruiter Effal walk into the cafeteria. Effal stops at the table behind the player.
- Recruiter Effal: Head down to the dueling room.
Lynn and Priscilla leave the cafeteria. The guard stops by Matilda.
- Military Guard: Matilda, come with me.
Matilda follows the guard, who walks up behind Arnol. Effal walks over to Dogi.
- Recruiter Effal: Go to the dueling room.
Dogi leaves the cafeteria. Effal joins the guard behind Arnol.
- Arnol: I suppose we should talk about how the shield challenge went. That might end up making me angrier, but I should tell you...
- Arnol: I started the test, confident, ready to make that instructor eat his words, show him that I am not a failure. And I still couldn't block a single arrow.
- Arnol: He wouldn't even let me retry it, just told me to leave the room. I protested, I said that wasn't fair, but he insisted...
- Arnol: And what about you, how did the shield challenge go?
- I was able to complete the challenge.
- Arnol: That's great to hear, maybe you can show me how you did it sometime-
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- Like you, I was not able to complete the challenge.
- Arnol: I'm sorry to hear about that, we're in this together-
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- Why do you care?
- Arnol: I-I was just wondering... No need to get-
- The dialogue branches combine here.
Arnol turns around to see Effal and the guard.
- Arnol: Ah, you again... I've decided that I won't be going with you, I have done nothing to deserve such punishment, and will not stand to be treated like this.
- Recruiter Effal: Don't talk to him like he's one of your servants, Arnol. Your family name means nothing here, if he asks you to go with him, you must go!
- Military Guard: This childish tantrum of yours will be noted. Now come with me before you start a scene. You are here to serve us, not the other way around.
Arnol looks back at the player before leaving the cafeteria with the guard and Matilda.
- Recruiter Effal: Wow, I didn't think Arnol had it in him to talk back to someone like that... Anyway, are you ready for dueling? Follow me.
Effal leaves the cafeteria.
Talking to Kyren:
- Kyren: Poor Arnol, he's going to become a soldier and yet he still can't control his temper tantrums.
- Kyren: What's next? Is he going to ask Commander Ferreo if he can change his diaper for him?
Head to the challenge room and recieve instructions for the final challenge of the day at [-10238, 112, 5295].
Talking to the Secretary:
- Secretary: Hey there recruit! Need help with anything?
- Where should I be right now?
- Secretary: If you're done with your lunch then wait for Recruiter Effal to pick you up for the next challenge in the cafeteria.
- Secretary: And if Recruiter Effal already came to pick you and your group up then... you should be with him in the dueling room.
(For the secretary's other dialogue options, see § Stage 4.)
Enter the Dueling room. The Auburn group walks in behind the player.
- Commander Ferreo: This will be the last of your training for today. Singular melee combat against another recruit.
- Commander Ferreo: The rules are the same as the day prior. Grab a training sword if you have not from the table and enter the large door when you are ready.
- Commander Ferreo: I will be unable to oversee your challenges today as there is somthing I must attend to. I have asked another instructor to do so, they are waiting in the dueling rooms.
- Commander Ferreo: Now go start the duels, good luck recruits.
Most of the recruits enter the next room:
Enter the next room and complete the final challenge of the day.
Talking to Recruiter Alena:
- Recruiter Alena: Remember not to take things too seriously here. Being a good soldier is not always about winning.
Talking to Recruiter Effal:
- Recruiter Effal: Commander Ferreo wants to speak with you, don't keep him waiting.
Talking to Robyn:
- Robyn: Don't tell him I said this, but my brother, Robin, has the advantage over me in this challenge.
- Robyn: As long as I never go up against him though, he won't realize that, that's why I am letting him go on ahead without me.
- Robyn: Maybe if I win against my opponent and he loses, he might be convinced that I am stronger!
Trying to enter the challenge room before talking to Commander Ferreo:
- Commander Ferreo: Speak with me first, .
Trying to enter the next room before taking an estoc:
- You should get a wooden estoc before entering the challenge room.
Talking to Commander Ferreo:
- Commander Ferreo: I don't want you to start the duel yet, your opponent has yet to arrive. Let's wait together for him.
A Military Guard walks in the room, with Arnol following behind.
- Commander Ferreo: There you are, Arnol. I was told that you had an outburst during lunch. You will come to know that such things are unacceptable here.
- Commander Ferreo: This is who you'll be dueling against Arnol. You two are friends, yes? Well this duel will surely teach both of you a valuable lesson.
- Arnol: Valuable lesson? What is that supposed to mean Commander? Is this a trick? What is the point of me dueling my friend?
- Commander Ferreo: You should know better than to question the orders of your superior, Arnol. Now both of you, into the dueling room.
Ferreo departs through the door behind him. Arnol looks at the player before grabbing an estoc and entering the dueling arena.
Talking to the Military Guard:
- Millitary Guard: Teach that boy a lesson.
The guard leaves through the entrance.
Interacting with the table of estocs:
Walk through the door to the south to begin the duel.
- Commander Ferreo: Step up, and the duel may begin. If either of you hold back, I will make you start the duel again, as many times as is needed.
- Left-Click to attack,  Hold Right-Click to block.

You can block continually by holding right click. Blocking an attack or letting go of right click will leave you unable to block for 0.5 seconds. You can perform a  by right-clicking shortly before the opponent attacks. A perfect block has no cooldown, allowing you to block again immediately.
[?] Arnol duel
After the fight:
- Commander Ferreo: You did better than expected Arnol. Yet the result was still what I imagined it would be.
- Arnol: Then what was the point of this duel, if you knew I would lose! Were you trying to humiliate me further? Haven't you done that enough already?!
- Commander Ferreo: Your arrogance truly has no bounds. How many punishments will I have to give you until you start to take things here seriously?
- Commander Ferreo: You're becoming a lost cause, Arnol. Now go, there is something I would like to discuss with  in private.
Talking to Commander Ferreo:
- Commander Ferreo: Your kindness towards him is doing him no favour. Arnol must know what pain is like before he can become stronger, and your friendship is preventing that.
- Commander Ferreo: For both of your sakes, I insist you sever your bond with him.
Ferreo departs out of the arena.
Leave the dueling room, then go to the barracks to sleep at [-10215, 127, 5337].
- Commander Ferreo: Do not take my advice for granted.
Talking to Kerry:
- Kerry: Am I the only one who is unimpressed with these challenges? They don't seem that related to being a soldier.
- Kerry: Eh, oh well. At least they're kind of fun, I'll give them that. I just wish the other recruits took them less seriously.
Talking to Madelen or Yvonne:
- Madelen: Well done, you kept your promise to get a better ranking! I am sure Commander Ferreo and Recruiter Olissy are proud.
- Yvonne: I used my shame from my first ranking as a driver to try harder on today's challenges. I am happy that I did poorly initially, because now I know must be constantly trying to improve!
- Yvonne: I will set the same promise now, tomorrow my ranking will be higher than it is now!
Talking to Saldin or Halbe:
- Halbe: I've failed... Now I'll never be able to become a Wings soldier...
- Saldin: Don't you think you're being a bit over dramatic? I think you did great, it's not like you're at the bottom of the ranking.
- Halbe: Easy for you to say... You're already in the Wings group, you didn't have to work for anything, you were just born good! You'll never know what it's like to be a failure!
Talking to Holger:
- Holger: I can't believe we're done with the second day already. Enjoy being a recruit while it lasts, it won't get any easier from here.
Talking to Priscilla or Lynn:
- Lynn: You're on thin ice, Priscilla... You didn't improve at all from yesterday! What will people think if I let a weakling follow me around?
- Priscilla: Please Lynn! Just give me a second chance! I promise I will get into the top 10 tomorrow!
- Lynn: Make it top 5! And if you fail... I'll never speak to you again!
- Priscilla: Top 5!? That's... Eh... Fine, I will make it into the top 5 tomorrow, I promise!
The Ranking Board can be viewed to see every recruit's ranking.  also appears in the list, but the ranking is different depending on the player's performance, so it is excluded here.
# Adder (-)
# Saldin ()
# Lynn ()
# Kyren (-)
# Halbe ()
# Yvonne ()
# Kerry ()
# Robyn ()
# Robin ()
# Holger (-)
# Madelen ()
# Priscilla ()
# Wilton ()
# Petur (-)
# Dogi ()
# Matilda ()
# Katze (-)
Head upstairs to go to sleep in the barracks.
Talking to the Secretary:
- Secretary: Hey there recruit! Need help with anything?
- Where should I be right now?
- Secretary: You're done for the day, there are no challenges left.
- Secretary: Now go get a well deserved rest. Head to the room straight across as soon as you enter the next room, and from there, enter the room to the left.
- Secretary: Sleep well, good night!
(For the secretary's other dialogue options, see § Stage 4.)
Talking to Kyren:
- Kyren: You're not worth my time. Do me a favour and buzz off.
Talking to Adder:
- Adder: I am willing to put the incident at lunch today aside. You just need to tell me how you or Arnol discovered what happened in my duel on the first day.
- Adder: I'm not easily fooled, I don't buy the made up story that you two were looking for advice.
- Adder: You should take this proposition seriously. I am not the type of person you would want as your enemy.
Talking to Robyn or Robin:
- Robin: It was a fluke, that's the only explanation of how you were able to beat me by one singular point! It means nothing!
- Robyn: Right... Keep telling yourself that, but in the back of your mind you know that I beat you. I'll never make you forget that fact!
Talking to Matilda or Wilton:
- Wilton: They've been at it for a while now. Which one do you think will beat the other tomorrow?
- Matilda: I'm not sure... What do you think will happen if they tie?
- Wilton: I hope that doesn't happen, they would probably be up all night arguing about who's better.
Talking to Arnol:
- Arnol: Could this day have gone any worse?
- Arnol: The honourable Commander Ferreo did nothing as Adder beat a fellow recruit to a pulp...
- Arnol: The instructors of the esteemed Fort Tericen recruit program seem to have no interest in actually training us...
- Arnol: And I am starting to doubt the idea of bringing honour to my house...
- Arnol: At least I'm not alone though...
Sneak around to find more information on Commander Ferreo's plans.
At 2:00 AM, the player wakes up.
- You should search the barracks for information on Commander Ferreo's plans.

The kitchen and the hallway that were previously inaccessible no longer have anyone guarding them, and new items can be found in these areas. Additionally, any items that were not collected in the previous night are still available to collect.
- Knife Handle in the kitchen at [-10734, 126, 5348].
- Screwdriver Head in the maintenance storage room at [-10804, 126, 5318].

After collecting both the Knife Handle and the Broken Screwdriver, the two items combine and give the player the  Repaired Screwdriver. This can be used to open the vent on the spiral staircase at [-10825, 136, 5330].
- Diary Note 4 in the kitchen at [-10739, 127, 5358].
- Diary Note 5 at the bottom of the spiral stairs at [-10823, 127, 5339].
- 1  Aged Cheese in the kitchen at [-10745, 132, 5352]. This item cannot be collected from the ground. Instead, you must parkour up into the rafters to grab the item.
- 3  Torn Fabric in the uniform storage room at [-10815, 126, 5320].
After collecting all six diary pieces, the items combine and give the player a compiled book, titled  Recruit Diary Entries.
See § Stage 15 for items that were first available during the first night stage.

lines.title: the door at the top of the spiral staircase
lines.text:
Combining the letters given at the end of the 6 diary pieces spells the phrase: "MY NAME IS NIREN". When asked for a name at the door at the top of the staircase at [-10832, 154, 5335], type "Niren" in the in-game chat to activate a secret interaction.




Interacting with the door:
* A large wooden door stands before you.
:* Knock on the door.
::* ???: Who is there? State your name!
::* Type and send an answer in chat.
::If an incorrect name is given:
::* ???: Go back to bed recruit, you'll need rest for your training tomorrow.
::If too much time passes before giving a name:
::* ???: Hmm, I must be imagining things...
::After typing "Niren":
::* ???: Do you have them all?
:::* Yes
:::: The door open and Niren walks out.
:* Leave




* Niren: You found all of my diary entries, well done.
* Niren: It's been so long since I've hid them, I was beginning to forget about them ever existing.
* Niren: Don't expect a medal or anything, I can answer some questions that you may have about them though.
** Why are you here?
*** Niren: It was Commander Ferreo's final insult. That's the reason I am here, as a guard in Fort Tericen.
*** Niren: After I graduated from the recruit program, my average rankings were seen as too low to join a field Captain or Commander's service.
*** Niren: So Ferreo himself stepped up and took me in, stationing me here to waste away. I think it's some form of punishment...
** Why did you hide your diary entries around the barracks?
*** Niren: I'm not sure to be quite honest. Maybe I was hoping for a sly recruit like yourself to find them, and not make the same mistakes I did.
*** Niren: It may have just been out of boredom though. I can't remember what thoughts were going through my head back when I hid them, after I became a soldier.
*** Niren: Deep down... Maybe I wanted Commander Ferreo to find those notes. I wonder what he would have though after reading them...
** Did you ever end up discovering Commander Ferreo's secret?
*** Niren: I had a feeling you'd ask me that. And surprisingly, yes, I did discover the truth about Commander Ferreo's success. There is no secret. He did it all through a fierce determination to become greater.
*** Niren: When Commander Ferreo was young, he had nothing, he was a vagabond in Hyloch. Not living, just, surviving.
*** Niren: Sometimes the Fruman Military would come to visit, and everyone in the town gathered together to see them. Ferreo saw how everyone loved and praised them for their valiance.
*** Niren: He desperately wanted to be praised and loved like that too. So he made it his goal to reach that position, overcoming the countless obstacles in his way.
*** Niren: Through sheer strength and expertise, he quickly became a Wings Commander, breaking military records in the process.
*** Niren: There were rumours that he would push further and attempt to become a Sovereign, even though all the positions were full at the time...
*** Niren: He had finally reached the level of fame and admiration that he had set out for. But I imagine the potential for even greater heights tormented him.
*** Niren: Not many know this, but just before he was given his current position, Commander Ferreo had a meeting with Sovereign Majin and The Queen.
*** Niren: We can only speculate at what the discussed, but quickly after said meeting, Majin appointed Commander Ferreo as head of Fort Tericen. My guess is that he was punished for his ambition...
** I should be heading back to bed now.
*** Niren: Good luck on your training recruit. I recommend you take it more seriously than I did.


Trying to walk into Niren's room:
* Niren: Sorry, but I still can't let you enter.
Reading Diary Note 4:
- Finally, I've done it! I've managed to rank first in training! The Commander has surely noticed my gradual ascent in strength.

- In the back of my mind I'm still unsure about going through with it... But I've put too much effort into this, I can't abandon everything now! I will speak to Commander Ferreo tomorrow, after dueling training.
- I'm certain, whatever his answer is, it will have an immense impact on me.
- There is a strange message at the bottom of the page.
Reading Diary Note 5:

- I am crushed... After defeating my opponent in the dueling training. I mustered my courage and asked Commander Ferreo how he went from being at the bottom of the totem pole, to reaching the top of it.
- He paused for a second before asking what my business was knowing that.
- I fumbled up a response, saying that I've seen him as an inspiration for all of my life, and have always wondered how he managed to claw his way up to the top.
- He told me that those who set out to achieve a goal out of envy will never be able to reach it.
- No matter how hard I tried, I would never be able to become a commander, nor receive the accolades that he has. Although he may be right... That wasn't what I wanted to hear...
- I feel like such an idiot.
- There is a strange message at the bottom of the page.
If the Player is nicknamed "Adder" or "Cursed", then the following dialogue appears when the Player wakes up:
- It seems someone left a note under your pillow...
The duel is optional, you can still obtain the  Iron Medallion if you skip the duel. Go down to the dueling room and grab a  Wooden Estoc. Walk into the arena to meet with Adder.
- Adder: Well, you actually came...
- Adder: I grew suspicious of you when I heard you get up in the middle of the night yesterday to sneak around.
- Adder: And somehow you were able to discover the results of my first duel... The only conclusion I can come to is that you have been spying on Commander Ferreo.
- Adder: For this, you deserve to be exiled, executed, or imprisoned.
- Adder: But... I have been looking to challenge myself, so far the training has been underwhelming. I would like to see what a resistance spy is capable of.
- Adder: If you can best me in a duel, I won't report you to Commander Ferreo. The first person to land 10 hits on the other shall be declared the victor.
- Adder: As a show of good faith, I will let you land the first hit on me.
Despite Adder offering himself to take the first hit, he immediately blocks and his secret duel will begin.
- Adder: I changed my mind.
- Adder: Whoops...
- Adder: Is that it?

Unlike the earlier duels, Adder will physically harm the Player upon being hit. He cannot be damaged unless the Player performs a , opening up a small window to attack. Adder will use the following abilities in his duel:
- Swipe: Telegraphed by a grunt and angry particles, Adder will swipe his estoc at you. Perfect blocking this attack will stun him, allowing you to counterattack.
- Sidestep: Telegraphed by a grunt without angry particles, Adder will hop to the side.

- Lunge: Telegraphed by a grunt and angry and blue particles, Adder will lunge forward and charge with his estoc. This attack deals damage twice, once at the start and once at the peak of the lunge. Perfect blocking the last hit will stun him.

- Swipe Chain: Telegraphed by angry and green particles, Adder will continuously swipe his estoc in front of him while running towards the Player for several seconds. Perfect blocking the last hit will stun him.
If the Player loses the duel, Adder will make a remark above his head.
- Adder: What a disapointment...
- Adder: Wish your friend good luck tomorrow...
- Adder: It's over, you lost.
The Player is then prompted to either return to the duel or go back to Fort Tericen.
Winning the duel:
- Adder: Absurd... Even after everything I have been through, I still am not strong enough...
- Adder: You've won, now leave...
Trying to enter the office hallway in the first part of the night:
- You can hear Commander Ferreo's voice faintly coming from his office.
Trying to enter the medical room:
- The doctor might catch you if you get too close.
Interacting with the knife handle in the kitchen:
- It's a knife handle, missing its blade.
Picking up the diary piece in the kitchen:
Picking up the diary piece in the tower staircase:
Picking up the last diary piece will replace the normal message with these lines:
Trying to reach the pot with the Aged Cheese from the ground:
- It's just out of reach.
Interacting with the pot containing the Aged Cheese from the rafters:
Interacting with the broken screwdriver in the maintenance storage room:
- It's a screwdriver missing a handle.
When collecting the second piece to construct the screwdriver, the second line is instead replaced with these new lines:
- You socket the broken screwdriver into the knife handle.
Interacting with the clothes bin in the uniform storage room:
- You rummage through the clothes bin...
Make your way through the vents.
While walking through the vent, a single mouse appears. Upon getting closer, the mouse becomes a hostile Hungry Mouse and hits the player before immediately dying.
At the end of the vent is a grate that allows the player to overhear Commander Ferreo and Recruiter Strumon talking in the office below.
- Commander Ferreo: We've found ourselves in a terribly difficult situation, Strumon...
- Commander Ferreo: We have a spy amongst our recruits and know who they are, yet that messenger expects us to not do anything about it until Sovereign Majin gets here!?
- Recruiter Strumon: I think it is important to be cautious here Commander, if this spy is as powerful as the messenger implied... This could spell the end for all of us...
- Commander Ferreo: Yes, you're probably right. Nevertheless, once Sovereign Majin arrives and sees that I let a spy into the recruit program... I fear that all that I have worked for will be lost...
- Commander Ferreo: I will not give up so easily, nor will I do nothing while we wait for Sovereign Majin to arrive...

- Commander Ferreo: I want Effal to be exiled to Wynn immediately for treason. He let the spy in, and must be punished for that. Find a guard to replace his position as Recruiter, anyone would be more competent than him.
Strumon turns around to face the guard by the door.
- Recruiter Strumon: Relay this to the other guards and recruiters. Effal should be out of Fruma by tomorrow!
The guard leaves.
- Recruiter Strumon: Now, Commander, there is another issue I would like to bring up with you, the reason why I came to your office this late into the night in the first place.
- Recruiter Strumon: Your plan yesterday went along perfectly. I checked in with the doctor and he told me Katze will need to be sent home.
- Commander Ferreo: Excellent, tomorrow Adder will duel against Arnol. His family name can no longer make up for his weakness!
- Recruiter Strumon: Commander... Is this really the best option? The spy seems to have grown a liking towards Arnol. I fear doing this could trigger a retaliation from them...
- Commander Ferreo: Does upsetting a single cursed one really frighten you that much, Strumon? Besides, I expect Sovereign Majin will have arrived by then, your concerns are unfounded.
A guard runs into the office.
- Military Guard: Commander, Recruiter, there is an urgent matter that requires attending to. Please, follow me!
The guard, Ferreo, and Strumon all leave the office.
Unscrew the vent, then head back to the barracks to wake Arnol at [-10765, 127, 5335].
- Use your screwdriver to escape the vent, then quickly wake up Arnol to escape Tericen together!
After unscrewing the vent:
- Your screwdriver broke!
Waking up Arnol:
- Arnol: Ugh...
Arnol gets out of bed.
- Arnol: What is this about, ? Why are you waking me up so early in the morning?
- You tell Arnol that Commander Ferreo plans for him to face off against Adder in the duel tomorrow.
- Arnol: What!? I'd stand no chance against Adder! He might even end up killing me if I face him! I guess I should have expected Commander Ferreo would do something like this though...
- Arnol: If you're telling me this now, you must have some idea on how to help me with this mess. What is your plan, ?
- Arnol: Hmmm... Ok, I trust you. Let's go before anyone wakes up.
- Arnol: Hmmm... Ok, I'll go with you.
Escape from Tericen at [-10711, 127, 5303].
Run out of the front door of Tericen.
Escape through the Tericen entrance at [-1253, 93, -1106].
- Arnol: We're leaving through the main entrance? What if a guard spots us?
- We can try to find a way around them.
- Arnol: Alright, I'll try to stay close.
- I'll deal with them if they spot us.
- Arnol: Uhm... Ok...
After walking closer to the entrance:
- Arnol: Weird... There seems to be no guards on duty...
Trying to walk the wrong way:
- Arnol: That's the wrong way.
After walking through the front gate, a purple barrier appears and separates the player and Arnol.
- Arnol: Ahhh!
- Arnol: Where did this come from!?
''Arnol hits the barrier a few times. Shortly after, Commander Ferreo appears in the area with the player outside the gate.
- Arnol: Oh... It's him...
- Commander Ferreo: Where are you off to? I don't remember dismissing either of you.
- Commander Ferreo: I would have thought that by now you'd both know insubordination isn't tolerated here. Neither is treason...
- Commander Ferreo: Does Arnol know you're a spy? Imagine what his family would think, if they found out he's conspiring with the resistance.
- Arnol: ...
Ferreo points his staff at the player.
- Commander Ferreo: I'll let them deal with him. But you... the responsibility of prosecuting you has been lended to me.
Ferreo hold up his staff. The area turns into an arena.
Defeat Commander Ferreo.
Commander Ferreo =
- Commander Ferreo: There is no hope for you or your kind in Fruma!
The Iron Commander =
- Commander Ferreo: I've never lost a duel, don't fool yourself into thinking I'd let you change that!
After depleting Ferreo's HP, the barrier around the area breaks down. Shortly after, Ferreo stands back up.
- Commander Ferreo: I won't die here! Not to the likes of you!
''Ferreo raises his staff again. Arnol walks up, grabs the sword that the Commander left in the ground.
- Commander Ferreo: Goodbye, traitor!
Arnol stabs Ferreo through the chest.
- Arnol: That's enough Commander, you're clearly outmatched.
Arnol looks at the player.
- Arnol: Thank you... For looking out for me after everything, even though you had no reason to...
- Arnol: I've spent my whole life drifting, aimless... But now I know what my purpose is, thanks to you...
- Arnol: My purpose is to make sure that tyrants like Commander Ferreo meet their just end. It seems like this may be your goal as well.
- Arnol: I must go out on my own now, I hope that one day we meet again. I promise you I'll be stronger by then!
Talking to Arnol again:
- Arnol: I was raised to believe that the cursed ones were wicked, yet you've been nothing but helpful. Seems like that was just another lie...
Talk with the citizen in despair at .
The following dialogue lines loop automatically before talking to Fichu.
- Fichu: I can't believe this!
- Fichu: That stupid raccoon!
- Fichu: Now I'll never deliver my gift in time...
- Fichu: I spent so much time on it...
- Fichu: What will I do?
- Fichu: If I see that raccoon...
Though talking with Fichu is a quest stage, it is optional. Instead, the quest can be started by going to , following a Raccoon to the sewer entrance at .

lines.title: Obtaining the Decorated Rubber Duck
lines.text:
The Decorated Rubber Duck is an alternate quest reward that can only be earned by meeting certain requirements during the quest.

The requirements are as follows:
* Collect the Empty Cage
* Collect the Shiny Jewelry
* Collect the Firecracker
* Collect Fichu's bag at 10006, 41, 18289
* Don't let the boat take too much damage when transporting Fichu in the last section to keep Fichu happy.
** Note: Fichu's status can be reset at the final checkpoint by scuttling the boat.
Talking to Fichu:
- Fichu: H-Hey, you! Have you seen a raccoon anywhere?
- Fichu: I spent all my free time making a gift for Soosu, and that devil snatched it from me! It would be a shame if I never got the chance to give it to her...
- Fichu: This might be a big ask, but- do you think you could help me?
- Fichu: Y-You will? I knew there was still some good left in this world!
- Fichu: Right! Last time I saw that raccoon, it was running into an alleyway . It can't have gone too far!
- Fichu: I will resume searching for that fool as well. Best of luck to you!
- The dialogue ends and the quest progresses to the next stage. Fichu leaves through the nearby alleyway.
- Sorry, I'm busy.
- Fichu: ...I get it. If you change your mind, .
- The dialogue ends without progressing the quest.
- A raccoon?
- Fichu: Yes! A raccoon! You've seen them before- surely? They're rampant around here!
- Fichu: ...
- Fichu: You know, those furry gray creatures with the weird striped tails?
- Fichu: ...I hope you know what a raccoon is.
- Fichu: Will you help me?
- The dialogue options reappear.
Talking to Fichu after choosing the "Sorry, I'm busy" dialogue option:
- Fichu: Oh- you're back! Are you able to help me now?
Talking to Fichu in the basement at  after choosing the "" dialogue option:
- Fichu: ...
- Fichu: I really think it would be better if we split up to search, don't you agree?
- Fichu: If you forgot, you should try searching . But you do you, I suppose...
Confront the raccoon at .
A raccoon can be seen with a package at the destination. When the player gets closer, the raccoon gets startled and runs away with the box. Follow it to the hole at .
Enter the drainage hole at .
Enter the hole at the destination to enter the sewers.
Note: If you are no longer in the quest area later in future stages, return to these coordinates to re-enter it.
-> Enter the drainage hole at  to continue the search.
Dive deeper into the sewer network.
The raccoon is seen nearby and runs away when the player gets close.
Interact with the valve at [10005, 40, 17995] to release water and clear the blockage. Then continue forward through the sewer.
In the second part of the sewer, pick up the valve handle at [10013, 40, 18057] and put it into the nearby slot at [10010, 40, 18042].
Using the Valve Handle in the slot opens the door to a new room directly across from it.
There is a rake in the side room at [9988, 41, 18061]. Use the rake to collect five leaf piles around both areas, then put the collected leaves into the generator.
After harvesting all five bushes:
- That looks like enough leaf litter. You should  to fuel it now.
Place the leaf litter into the generator and use the lever to turn it on.
The player will be teleported back to the lever in the main room, which is now functional.
Interacting with the valve handle:
Interacting with the rake:
Interacting any of the five bushes:
After placing the leaf litter in the generator:
- The generator hums to life.
Interacting with the valve slot without the valve:
- It looks like a  could fit into this slot.
Interacting with the lever while it is unpowered:
- The lever appears to be jammed. Maybe it ?
Interacting without all five leaf litter:
- The generator needs  before it can be activated.
Explore past the flood gate.
Enter the newly opened gate.
After jumping into the water below:
- You hear someone in the distance.
- Maybe it's best to continue forward...

Travel into the large pipe across from the waterfall. The player is taken to a new room, where the raccoon is found in the middle. It runs further in when the player gets close, then it escapes through a pipe.
- This water looks too dangerous to swim in.
- Maybe there's  to get across...
- Different materials around the room can be used as .
- Some raft parts may have .
- Place the raft parts on the  to construct your raft.
Find a way to get across the flooded section of the sewer.
The raft pieces available are as follows:
- 1 Propellor
- 1 Seat
- 7 Planks
Building a raft requires all 9 spaces to be filled with parts.
An example of a functional raft is shown below.
Pilot the raft by selecting a controllable piece such as the Propellor using the swap-hands key,  F by default. Once the piece is selected, it can be controlled with the left and right mouse buttons.
The raft must be maneuvered to the goal, indicated by a box surrounded with bobbers and particles. Wait in the goal without moving to complete each section.
Use the Scuttle Raft item to sink the raft and restart.
At the end of this raft section is a lever and a door that leads to the next area. Opening the door reveals another raft section and the raccoon, which quickly runs away through another pipe.
The raft pieces available are as follows:
- 2 Propellors
- 1 Seat
- 6 Planks
This section requires the raft to be able to move to the left as well as straight, so the two propellors must be placed correctly in order to reach the end.
An example of a functional raft is shown below.
After completing the raft section, the Empty Cage can be picked up at [10003, 29, 18337].
Continue through the tunnel. Upon reaching the end, a shadowy figure can be seen higher up and dialogue will play.
- ???: Huh, is there someone down there?
- ???: Wait- what's that? HEY!
The shadowy figure leaves through the hole in the wall.
Activate the nearby lever to call an elevator down, then stand on it travel up to a pipe that leads to the next area.
If the Player is standing directly underneath the elevator as it is descending, the screen will flash black as the Player is moved out of the way. The following line of dialogue plays:
- That hurt.
While the elevator is ascending, the Player can run onto a ledge. The ledge leads to a short corridor with a purple bag. The following dialogue plays:
- Looks like someone dropped this in a rush.
Continue chasing the raccoon through the sewers.

The pipe leads to a parkour found above the area explored in Stage 5. The raccoon falls down from the ceiling and jumps across the pipes to escape. At the end of the parkour is another lever that opens the door to the next raft section.
The raft pieces available are as follows:
- 1 Rudder
- 1 Propellor
- 1 Seat
- 6 Planks
The rudder is used to steer a raft. It turns the raft in the direction the player is facing automatically, but only while the raft is moving.
An example of a functional raft is shown below.

There is another raft section immediately following the previous one, but this time it is a bit longer with more obstacles. The pieces are exactly the same as well, so an identical raft can be constructed and used.
The raft pieces available are as follows:
- 1 Rudder
- 1 Propellor
- 1 Seat
- 6 Planks
Upon reaching the final turn of the tunnel, the shadowy figure from before can be seen chasing the raccoon across a beam above the water.
- ???: You aren't getting away from me now!
Open the door using the lever and take the elevator behind it to continue.
Encounter a familiar face in the sewers.
Met Fichu =
- ???: Ah ha! I've got you now, thief!
- ???: Wait- No! Get ba-
The raccoon and Fichu both fall down from above. The raccoon escapes further down the tunnel.
- Fichu: OW! My leg!
- Fichu: ...
- Fichu: Player! You're here! I was wondering where you went!
- Fichu: I've been chasing that raccoon the whole time! What in the world have you been up to?
- Fichu: Whatever. I'm struggling to keep up the chase at this rate. But fortunately, I have just the thing that'll help you!
Fichu places down a broken grappling hook.
- Fichu: MY GRAPPLING HOOK!
- Fichu: It's broken! How will I ever catch up with that crook at this rate?
- Fichu: ...Maybe this is all a lost cause. You can try fixing it, I guess, but it's not worth it.
- Fichu: I'm going that direction to see if I can catch that pest. You go the other way, we'll meet again soon.
Fichu leaves through a door on the side of the room.
Did not meet Fichu =
-> Encounter the stranger in the sewers.
- ???: Ah ha! I've got you now, thief!
- ???: Wait- No! Get ba-
The raccoon and Fichu both fall down from above. The raccoon escapes further down the tunnel.
- Fichu: OW! My leg!
- Fichu: ...
- Fichu: Huh?
- Fichu: Who are you? What are you doing here?
- Chasing a raccoon.
- Exploring.
- Fichu: Ah, exploring the sewers? That's fun! I've basically been to every corner of Timasca's sewers.
