- Rurie: Oh, what do you know?! Why don't you try to land gracefully in a- in- in a-... see how you do!!
- Rurie: Ahem. Shall we get moving then? Over the hills and down the road, to the meet up spot we go!
- Sui: ...Player, Yusanu. When we get to safety, we... we should talk about what to do next.
Rurie walks over to Sui.
- Sui: Rex, Zeph... Mora... if- if they're here, then... then...
- Yusanu: Don't worry, Sui, I... I get it. We'll do whatever we can to get your brother out of there. Promise.
- Rurie: Speaking of the prodigal son and his companions, are we! My my, what a tragic tale... but perhaps I have an inkling of their present whereabouts.
Sui and Yusanu turn to Rurie.
- Sui: You- you do? Why... why didn't you tell us sooner?!
- Rurie: Ah ah! Sensitive information is for sensitive ears alone. I believed it best to wait for better circumstances... too many unknown faces back at the Canopy.
- Rurie: Well, silent owls? Fly forth, update the others at the hideout on our whereabouts! I'll keep an eye on our little doves as we discuss matters further.
- Canopy Owl: ...you're the boss, Captain. If you say so.
- Rurie: And I do say so! Well, chop chop, get it moving, wouldn't you?
The two Canopy Owls leave into the woods.
- Rurie: Ah... authority is its own sort of treat, isn't it?
- Yusanu: Rurie, you said you had a lead. What is it?
- Rurie: So impatient! So so impatient. Yes, fine, there is a military outpost just to the east, a flap of the wings as the bird flies! I will take you there.
- Yusanu: Uh... isn't that dangerous? You said that's where all the ch-
- Rurie: Yes well not everything can be so easy, can it?! Be brave! Take risks! Et cetera, et cetera.
- Rurie: And with all the guards and soldiers and riffraff mobilized to the Canopy, it certainly will be simpler to sneak in! You do want to save your brother do you not?
- Sui: ...still. We- we aren't much of fighters! If... if we get caught...
- Sui: I- we can't, keep putting all the work on Player's shoulders. We need a better plan!
- Rurie: Alas, it is now or it is never. Tick tock tick tock, time's running out, little doves! Onwards we shall fly, to save friend and family alike!
Follow Captain Rurie to [-1375, 45, -721].
Upon approaching the destination:
- Yusanu: ...Rurie. Why did you stop?
- Sui: Is... is there a problem...?
- Rurie: A problem? No... no, no no, there is no problem here! All is just as it should be.
- Sui: Are... are you- are you sure? You're... you're starting to scare me, Rurie.
Rurie looks around before using a grappling hook to escape up the nearby tree.
- Yusanu: H- huh?! Wh- what's going on?!
- Sui: ...oh. YUSANU! WATCH OUT!!
Sui creates an ice shield above Yusanu's head and blocks two daggers from the sky.
- Yusanu: I- I- I-
- Yusanu: Th- thank you, Sui, that... I don't... you- you're really, uh, getting the hang of that ice stuff, aren't you?
- Sui: I... I didn't even... do that intentionally. It was... reflexive...
- Sui: B-but, more... more importantly- what happened? Where's- where's Rurie?
Defeat the attackers at [-1375, 45, -721].
- Sui: C-canopy members?!
After defeating the mobs, Captain Fuhue is seen on the side of the tree readying a talisman.
- Yusanu: Are you two okay?!
- Yusanu: Those... those must have been changelings!
Fuhue throws the talisman at the player, Sui, and Yusanu, and it explodes and knocks everyone away. Fuhue descends from the tree to talk to the player.
- Fuhue: Oho! Impressive stuff. Simple pieces of paper in appearance... but they pack a punch. Rather useful!
Captain Fuhue transforms into Captain Cileon.
- Cileon: Easier than expected. Should use more- eugh, no no no, don't like this one at all.
Captain Cileon transforms into Captain Rurie.
- Rurie: Ah, much improved! Now this - what an enjoyable form it has been, yes yes yes! The drama, the intrigue! Perhaps it would do to use it more, hm hm hm!
- Who... who are you?
- Rurie: Who am I? Why, I am Captain Rurie, leader of the owls! Master of the mists, eyes and ears of the trees - runaway FOOL from higher lands!!!!
- Rurie: Oh but no no no, I should think you have it figured out by now! Is it not obvious?
Captain Rurie transforms into Sovereign Gikyo.
- Sovereign Gikyo: What a delight! This before you is the form of the Ranger Mistwoods, Sovereign to these secretive little ants! The name it was given is Gikyo.
- Sovereign Gikyo: To think there has been a struggle to take you in so far yet the task proved simple and easy! How delightful! The Sovereign Forest will be furious!
Gikyo walks up to the player.
- Sovereign Gikyo: But that is enough talk and secrets spilling. It is time, crown's wanted! Time for you to go...
''The player is knocked out, and everything goes black.
Talk to Sui and Yusanu. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-1053, 110, -733].
The player wakes up in a jail cell at an unknown location. Sui and Yusanu are also inside.
- Sui: ...oh. You're up.
- Yusanu: Is this really it, then? Ordeal after ordeal and this is where it leads?
- Yusanu: Will it ever end? What's the point? The crown's after us now, and- and they're not going to stop!! Why- why even try?!
- Sui: Yusanu! Y-you need to... to get yourself together! Please, d-don't lose your head now... n-not here, of all places.
- Sui: I... ha, I- I know it feels hard. Im-impossible, even! A-and maybe I'm, I'm just putting on a brave face... I- I want to lie down and j-just wait for the, the inevitable, as much as you do!!
- Sui: But... b-but not now. We're- we're here, a-and they're so close. Mora, Rex, Zeph... we- we have some hope! S-so... don't give up. Not now!
- Yusanu: ....
- C'mon. Let's get out of here.
- Yusanu: ...okay. Then... where do we start? They... they took all of our belongings... and you can't cast spells without your weapon, can you?
- Sui: I... I still have my magic. I can... I can try.
Sui attempts to use magic on the front of the cell, but she just ends up overflowing the toilet.
- Sui: ...hmph.
- So... what's the plan?
- Sui: N-not... that. I... ugh, why is this so hard all of a sudden...?
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- Didn't work, huh?
- Sui: Oh, sh- shut up! I- I'm trying, okay!
- The dialogue branches combine here.
''Yusanu walks over to the glass of the cell wall.
- Yusanu: Hmmm....
Yusanu hits the glass in a few spots.
- Yusanu: ...oh. Oh, oh- I think I know a way out!
- Yusanu: Look, this- this appears to be tempered glass!
- Sui: Um... I... I have no idea what that means.
- Yusanu: No, look- it's one of the inventions I assisted Soosu with. I didn't know what its purpose was at the time, but... I guess this fits.
- Yusanu: Tempered glass is incredibly strong and durable. It resists most attempts to break it, except - except for striking the edge of the glass with a sharp object.
- Yusanu: And, Sui! If you could make an icicle with your magic... and strike the edge...
- Sui: ...then we could get out? I... m-maybe. But, y-you just saw me- um, nearly flood our cell with... sewage...
- Yusanu: Sui. You were the one just giving me a pep talk. Come on, you can do it!
Yusanu gets up on the bed to watch.
- Sui: ...okay. Okay, you- you're right! I can... I can do this. I can.
- Sui: Here goes nothing...
Sui creates an icicle in the air, then turns around excitedly.
- Sui: I- ha, I, I did it!!
- Yusanu: That's the first step! We've got the sharp object, now... aim for the corner!
Sui fires the icicle and shatters the glass wall.
- Sui: It- it worked! Ha... hahaha... oh, it worked...
Find Captain Rurie. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-1053, 110, -733].
- Sui: L-let's go, then! Let's find the others, and- and get out of here!
Sui and Yusanu leave the cell.
Rurie is found in the cell directly beside the group. Walk up to the cell to progress.
- Rurie: Well! Hoo hoo, my little friends!
- Yusanu: Rurie?! You're... you're here?
Rurie gets up from the bed.
- Rurie: Uh... duh? That devilish snake got the drop on me when I went up to the owls' nest! Those changelings certainly do not play fair, let me tell you...
- Sui: How... how can we know for sure it's, um, really him?
- Rurie: What?! Is it not obvious that I am who I say I- oh, whatever, something something it's protocol. Fine.
- Yusanu: Hm... I don't think changelings have access to memories, do they? Rurie, where did we first meet?
- Rurie: Yes, finally, some sense! It was in that cave! My owls and I captured you as leverage, and if I do recall correctly, you nearly cried like a little baby! Ah, memories...
Yusanu turns around slowly to face Sui.
- Yusanu: Ugh. Okay, it's definitely him.
- Rurie: Finally! Now then, time for us to get moving!
Rurie pulls out a kunai.
- Yusanu: THEY LEFT YOUR KNIVES ON YOU?!
Rurie throws the kunai and shatters the glass, then he walks out of the cell.
- Rurie: Oh, no, no no no. They certainly did take them, alright! Seems they missed a few in my boots, though! Lucky me!
- Rurie: Now, I simply couldn't help but overhear you little loudmouths, so I came up with a plan while you were debating whether I was real or not!
- Rurie: Yusanu. That device of yours is quite important, isn't it? I'll help you fetch it - hopefully add a few more to my kill list along the way, eh?
- Rurie: And Sui... go find your family. Important to hold onto those you love, isn't it? You and Player can handle this, I'm sure, but... be careful.
- Sui: Rurie... thank you.
- Rurie: Well then! Let's skedaddle, kiddos! Good luck out there!
Rurie and Yusanu leave through the nearby door.
- Sui: Let's... try and find our stuff. We, ha, can't really handle a whole fort of changelings without your weapon, can we?
Find your weapon before you proceed further. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-1053, 110, -733].
The equipment is stored in the box at [1035, 18, 3092].
Bookshelf at [-1034, 17, 3111].
- - Leave no gaps in the cell. Subjects may transform into small creatures in order to escape.
- - Subjects require sustenance based on the form they are currently using.
- - Provide subjects with daily stimulus. Enquire with instructors on current curriculum.
- - Shall a subject misbehave, withhold food until they start behaving.
- There are many other steps...
- ''- Player. Wanted. Will be held until Sovereign Majin arrives. Very dangerous, do not approach!
- - Sui. Wanted. Will be held until Sovereign Majin arrives.
- - Yusanu. Wanted. Will be held until Sovereign Majin arrives.
- - Subject #151. Refused to take part in training and displayed hostility towards guards.
- - Subject #211. Stole food from cafeteria.
Interacting with the crate again:
- The crate is empty...
Walking through the door at [-1022, 17, 3108] without finding the equipment.
- Sui: Hey! We can't leave without our belongings.
Interacting with the equipment box again:
- The chest is empty...
After finding the equipment:
- Sui: ...oh! Is that all your gear?
- Sui: Should... should we continue, then?
- Are you prepared for a fight?
- Sui: I... I hope so, but... I'm not sure. The ocean still feels... off. Like, like a step to the left.
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- Did you get everything?
- Sui: I... don't really, I don't have anything worth grabbing, here...
- The dialogue branches combine here.
- Sui: Uh, I found this map... come here.
Sui lays a map on the table at [-1030, 17, 3105].
- Sui: Hmm...
- Sui: "Fort Hegea, Changeling Facility." So... this whole place is, um, probably crawling with them.
- Sui: This... this m-might be, um, harder than I thought it might be. B-but! I can't give up. They're so close... where are they...?
- Sui: I think we're... here.
- Sui: And the Sovereign's office looks like it's at the very back of the building...
- Sui: There's a, another block of cells right outside. If we're careful enough... maybe we can avoid a confrontation with the Sovereign.
- Sui: ...th-thanks for being here, Player. I... I would've given up a long time ago if you weren't.
Continue exploring the Changeling Camp and look for your friends. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-1053, 110, -733].

lines.title: How to progress to the next quest stage
lines.text:
- Head to the cafeteria at [-971, 17, 3103].
* Defeat the Fort Hegea Chef inside to get the Employee Access Key.
* Use the Employee Access Key to open the door at [-929, 17, 3108].
* Pick up the Training Facility Key at [-914, 18, 3111].
Main Room:
Interacting with the Training Facility door at [-994, 17, 3132] without the key.
Interacting with the exit door at [-994, 17, 3092].
- Do you want to leave?
- (Transports the player outside of the building)
- Not yet. (Exits the dialogue)
Interacting with the books at [-969, 18, 3121].
- 06:30 - Wake-up call.
- 06:45 - First meal.
- 07:00 - First class of the day.
- 09:00 - Physical Training.
- 11:00 - Second class of the day.
- 13:00 - Physical Training.
- 15:00 - Break and second meal
- 16:00 - Third class of the day.
- 18:00 - Fourth class of the day.
- 20:00 - Break and final meal
- 21:00 - Physical Training.
- 23:00 - Fifth class of the day.
Interacting with the cabinet at [-966, 18, 3123].
- Subject 62:
- - Forms: Human, Fox, Owl
- - Strength Index: 62%
- - Number of Strikes: 4
- The list goes on with various... odd statistics.
Interacting with the bookshelf at [-976, 17, 3120].
- Changelings are a great asset to any army. They are proven excellent spies.
- Their biology makes them easily adaptable to any situation, they can easily become heat resistant or cold resistant.
- Training a Changeling is a challenging, but worthwhile investment. They require active conditioning from the moment they emerge.
- They have a tendency to change into the first form they encounter, they are also the most receptacle to learning at that time.
- During their first month they require constant stimulus otherwise they easily adapt to the form that fits into the current setting.
- There are various other pages...
Cafeteria at [-971, 17, 3103]:
Interacting with the crate again:
- The crate is empty...
Menu board at [-953, 19, 3080].
- Today's Menu:
- - First meal: Apples and carrots.
- - Second meal: Mystery stew.
- - Third meal: Mystery stew.
Bunker door at [-929, 17, 3108]:
Interacting with the Bunker door without the key:
- The Bunker door is locked. A worker must have an employee key...
Barracks room at [-929, 17, 3108]:
Interacting with the key at [-914, 18, 3111]:
Continue to the Officer's Quarters in the southern wing. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-1053, 110, -733].

lines.title: How to progress to the next quest stage
lines.text:
- Use the Training Facility Key to open the door at [-994, 17, 3132].
* Head to the room at [-979, 17, 3175] and defeat the Changeling inside.
* Pick up the Officer's Quarters key at [-938, 17, 3175].
* Use the Officer's Quarters Key on the door at [-994, 17, 3184].
* Head to the room at [-968, 17, 3209] and listen to Sui's dialogue.
Officer's Quarters door at [-994, 17, 3184]:
Interacting with the door without the correct key:
- The Officer's Quarters are locked.
- ???: Here for a duel?! I love duels?! I love fighting?! I love life?!
After defeating the Changeling:
- The storage door opened.
Interacting with the key at [-938, 17, 3175].
Bookshelf at [-1016, 18, 3188].
- ''Current Research: Soldier Superfood
- Create a food that provides all necessary nutrients without the need for taste or texture.
- You open the records cabinet... Inside, you find dozens of file folders.
- Project Hallowground, est. 88 IA.
- Research Lead: Sovereign Selium.
- Our Polymorph supplies are dwindling. With each new specimen we extract from the wastes, the span between emergences grows wider and wider.
- If this trend continues, within the next century, we will lose our access to Changeling spies.
- Sovereign Oru suggests we drill deeper to uncover new sources, but I disagree. The fault lies with the well. It is drying up.
- ''If we can no longer rely on the natural, we must imbue that spark of life ourselves.
- There's more. Will you continue reading?
- Yes. (Continues the dialogue)
- No. (Ends the dialogue)
- Construction Report, 90 IA.
- The old research site has been refurbished and modernized to suit our needs. The facility grounds have been greatly expanded.
- Construction broke through the earth and uncovered a large undisturbed reservoir. Sovereign Oru suggests we stop here. I disagree.
- The reservoir will serve as a solid base for our research and experiments.
- There's more. Will you continue reading?
- Yes. (Continues the dialogue)
- No. (Ends the dialogue)
- Incident Report, 92 IA.
- Southward underground expansion has unearthed a massive cave system lurking deep below the surface.
- Construction was paused. Three workers disobeyed orders and delved further into the caverns. Only one returned.
- Multiple sentences have been redacted...
- Contacted the Spymaster, Inquisitors were called in to handle the situation.
- The cavern is to be sealed immediately, and all workers in contact are to have their memories removed.
- There's more. Will you continue reading?
- Yes. (Continues the dialogue)
- No. (Ends the dialogue)
- Observation Log, 95 IA.
- Formless, mindless... they come from the earth, charged with its primordial life.
- But how? How do they come to be? What ignites that spark?
- My blessing grants me a limited understanding, but not nearly enough. What is the source? I do not know.
- I have asked Sovereign Gikyo for their insight. They laughed me out of the room. I suspect I will glean nothing from these attempts.
- ...perhaps I should ask the earth itself.
- There's more. Will you continue reading?
- Yes. (Continues the dialogue)
- No. (Ends the dialogue)
- Observation Log, 97 IA.
- We have come so close... so close, yet so far. I have heard its echoes, surfacing from the depths below. A broken, fractured thing...
- The spark... I have lit it once more. That which animates the dark pools of essence into beings we control...
- But the vessels, they are not mindless... not in the same way. Being drawn forth from unlife into being instills a madness in them that I cannot resolve.
- The Spymaster has a suggestion. An external Scientist, one who has studied the inner workings of a similar madness.
- Ten years. Ten years here, he has spent on his studies, and not a single step of progress. And this is the best option we have...?
- This is the best option we have. It will be done. It will be over soon.
- There's more. Will you continue reading?
- Yes. (Continues the dialogue)
- No. (Ends the dialogue)
- Warden's Log, 98 IA.
- The inner workings of the Hallowground Facility fell apart at 9:38 PM.
- ''Schedule interrupted. But urgency demands a response.
- Multiple sentences have been redacted...
- Spymaster suggests ceasing mining operations in the west. Order approved.
- Quotas will fall short. Prisoner work hours will be increased until the situation is resolved.
- No sign of Sovereign Selium. Presumed dead.
Upon reaching [-994, 17, 3200] in the Officer's Quarters hallway:
- Sui: C-careful! That's... Sovereign Gikyo's office up ahead. Let's, um, try and avoid them.
Upon entering the room at [-989, 17, 3209]:
- Sui: What are these... holes...?
Interacting with a cover on one of the holes:
- The hole appears empty...
Interacting with the key in the hole at [-976, 12, 3214]:
Upon entering the room at [-968, 17, 3209], Sui walks into the room and inspects the pool of blood on the floor.
- Sui: No... n-no, no no no, no- no...
- What is it?
- Sui: It's... it's a ticket. From the... Steel Feather... the ones... Quill gave us...
- Sui: All... all this blood...
- Sui: There- ha, there, th-there's no way s-some-someone could, ha, survive... this...
Sui walks back out to the previous room.
- Sui: How... h-how dare they... how DARE they?! Th-they have to pay for this, Player, they- they have to!!
- Sui: Come on... come on, come on, we- we need to confront Gikyo, we- come on!!
Head to Sovereign Gikyo's office to confront them. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-1053, 110, -733].
Talking to Sui again:
Enter Gikyo's office at [-994, 17, 3218].
Gikyo is seen standing over Mora, who is dying.
- Sui: M- M- Mora...?
- Sovereign Gikyo: Well well, look who has stumbled on in! If it is not the crown's number one wanted and the silly weak sister! Were you not locked up?
Gikyo kicks Mora's body into the corner of the room. Sui runs over to Mora.
- Sui: No... you... wh- what did you... what did you DO?!
- Sovereign Gikyo: Hehehehahaha! Oh, this? Why it's the prodigal son of course! Go on, say hello to your little sister, big brother!!
- Sovereign Gikyo: You should know I did offer the opportunity to speak, yes yes indeed! If only he would have spat up all those deep deep secrets on your group... could his pain have been avoided?
- Sovereign Gikyo: But but but but but sad as it is, he refused to say a word! What a shame indeed, indeed. A long deep dark painful agonizing death it was!
- Sovereign Gikyo: Well since you are here and the rest are taken it would seem it was for naught! I have every little dove just where I want them, yes yes I do.
- The others?
- Sovereign Gikyo: Yes! Shooty girl and wind boy! Rex and Zeph I believe it was?
- Sovereign Gikyo: Wind boy was always crying and screaming... how pathetic. But shooty girl... yes shooty girl was a delight.
- Sovereign Gikyo: Never let out a word no matter the pain! The ones like her are always the most most most fun to crack, yes they are.
- Sovereign Gikyo: Alas... all good things must come to an end it would seem! The killjoy Sovereign Highlands, swooping in and ruining ALL my fun...
- Sovereign Gikyo: Noooo Gikyo you cannot keep your prisoners no matter how much you wish, no no no, the people Highlands demand their girl returned and well who am I to stand against them?
- Sovereign Gikyo: And so ended the fun that was being had! But I had the last laugh, ehehehaha. The Athassa girl could take one and not both of the companions! A choice? A choice!
- Sovereign Gikyo: Oh the noble hero that he was, he chose to stay! What a bore. But what a joy! What a joy joy joy joy joy!
- Sovereign Gikyo: And now where is he? Bleeding out, dying, fading, vanishing with each and every passing moment! And it would seem perhaps he is the lucky one!
- Sovereign Gikyo: Well then! Would you care to join him in this dance? To the end of days - yours end HERE and NOW!
Defeat Sovereign Gikyo. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-1053, 110, -733].
Note: Dying gives you the option to respawn at Fort Hegea or Aldwell. The fight can be re-entered by returning to Gikyo's office at [-994, 17, 3218].
After defeating Gikyo's sixth phase, a cutscene starts.
- Sovereign Gikyo: Ufft! You're a tough nut to crack.
The camera changes to Sui, who is trying to heal Mora.
- Sui: Come on...
Gikyo transforms back into their normal form.
- Sovereign Gikyo: But you.... you seem weak.
Gikyo heads over to Sui, who gets up and turns around.
- Sui: You... you...
Sui summons a huge wave that throws Gikyo back into the wall.
- Sovereign Gikyo: Oof!
- Sui: YOU KILLED HIM!
Sui unleashes a barrage a water magic on Gikyo.
- Sui: YOU TOOK HIM FROM ME!
- Sui: GIVE! HIM! BACK!!!
Sui summons several icicles and fires them at Gikyo.
- Sovereign Gikyo: Woah ho ho, now now, settle d
Gikyo walks towards Sui, but is quickly impaled on a large ice spike. Gikyo bleeds out a pool of purple goo.
Check up on Sui. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-1053, 110, -733].
Interacting with Mora:
- Mora is... gone...
Interacting with Gikyo:
- The sovereign has been impaled. They aren't moving...
Talking to Sui:
- Sui: He's... he's my brother... give... give him... back...
- Sui?
- Sui: What?!
- Sui: He's dead. He's... dead he's dead he's dead, but so is that BASTARD!!!
- Sui: And it... it... it doesn't even matter. I killed them, and... and... and what now? M- Mora, he's- he's still...
- Sui: I... I failed.
- You didn't fail.
- Sui: No?? Then what do you CALL this?! Rex and Zeph are gone and Mora is- h-he's... he... he's...
- Sui: We... we weren't fast enough... we took too long to get here, a-and now... and now...
- We'll get revenge.
- Sui: I already GOT revenge, Player!! I didn't... I didn't know I... it- it happened so fast, and... and... I killed them. I got revenge and... and I still feel hollow.
- Sui: He's... gone. He's gone, and- a-and I can't... I can't get him back...
- Sui: We- we need to g-get out of here, I- I- I can't... I can't be here. I can't... I c-can't look at him.
- Sui: ...this is all my fault, isn't it?
- What?
- Sui: I- I- all I've been DOING this whole time has been crying, worrying, and- and- and being USELESS!
- Sui: I was so afraid of my cur-... why, why, WHY can't I break that habit?! Magic. Magic magic magic magic MAGIC!!
- Sui: I was so afraid that I never even tried!! If I had, if I- I- if I'd have learned more, been stronger...
- Sui: I... I could have... I could have saved him. I could have protected him, I could have healed him, I could have-
- Sui: But no, of COURSE NOT!! Because I'm worthless and useless and can't help ANYONE!!
- Sui: Rex and Zeph are- they're still out there. Player, Player, we can still save them. We- we know where they are!!
- Sui: We just... we just need to find the Highlands Sovereign. He has them, he- he has to. He... he has to.
- Sui: ...let's go. We can't- we can't let this happen again.
Meet up with Yusanu and Captain Rurie at [-1151, 62, -758].
Talking to Sui again:
Leaving through Gikyo's office door teleports you outside of Fort Hegea.
After talking to Rurie and Yusanu, Sui walks out of the fort, but doesn't look at them.
- Rurie: Hello, dear friends! I see you have returned to us safe and sound!
- Yusanu: We found everything we were looking for, and- and more!! Plans, Sui, plans!! Of Deraj prison!!
- Rurie: It would seem our dear Changeling Sovereign worked closely with the prison's warden... for what purpose remains unclear, though I imagine something changeling-adjacent?
- Yusanu: Sui, with- with these plans, we could... we could stand a chance of breaking everyone out! We could- we could get them all back!
Sui turns to look at Yusanu.
- Yusanu: ...
- Yusanu: Sui... where... where are they...?
Sui looks at the ground.
Yusanu walks up to Sui.
- Yusanu: Sui...?
Sui looks back up.
- Sui: They're gone, Yusanu! Mora's- Mora's dead.
Yusanu jumps back.
- Sui: The Sovereign, they... they killed him.
- Yusanu: ...what? What- what about the others...?
- Sui: Just... gone. Taken to the Highlands. But, Mora is- he's-
- Sui: So. So, I- I'm glad you have hope! For... for getting your people back! Good for you!!
- Rurie: Emotions are... certainly running high right now, aren't they! Why don't we, ah, regroup with the rest of the Canopy, and... take some time?
- Sui: Take. Some Time? No. No, I'm done taking time. I'm done crying, I'm done worrying! I'm so... so... angry! At the Crown, at myself, at- at Mora!!!!
- Sui: At all of you for treating me like I can't handle anything myself!!!
- Yusanu: S-Sui, please, I- I understand, but-
- Sui: DO YOU?! Do you understand?! Because it SOUNDS like everything's all just fine for you! Your brothers are still alive! You even have a plan to get them back!!
- Sui: Rex and Zeph, they... they need me. Need us! And... and I'm not letting anyone else get hurt, or- or- or d-die, not if I can stop it!!
- Sui: The Crown... the Sovereigns... the Queen... they'll pay. They'll pay for everything they've done to me, and my- m-my... my family...
- Rurie: And how exactly do you expect to be able to take vengeance in your current state, Sui? I beg of you, please rest before doing something so extreme!
- Sui: Every minute I waste is another chance for something to go wrong!!! "Fading with each and every passing moment..."
- Sui: If- if only we were there sooner, then- th-then... so- so, no. No, I can't rest! I will be getting my family back!
- Yusanu: Sui, we... we can't just storm off into a new district without a plan! The Canopy, they- they can help us! And Soosu's device, I'm so close to a breakthrough, I just need-
- Sui: Then stay behind, Yusanu. I... I don't need you, anyway.
Yusanu looks down.
- Yusanu: ...what?
- Sui: I said, I don't NEED you, Yusanu! What have you even done this whole time we've been in the Mistwoods?! Taken as hostage, tinkering with- with- with that STUPID device!
- Sui: YOU haven't had to do any of the work! YOU didn't have to- to run random tasks without explanation! YOU didn't have to- to f-fight and k- k- kill a Sovereign! You... you...
- Yusanu: ...
- Sui: ...sorry.
- Yusanu: Is... is there nothing I can say to convince you not to go?
- Yusanu: Fine. I... I can't follow you, Sui, I can't. I'm going to stay with the Canopy... I'm going to save everyone from Deraj... and I'm going to keep working.
- Rurie: ...well, this doesn't have to be goodbye for good, does it? We shall go our separate paths, for a time, then link back together further down the line!
- Sui: Yeah... sure. Why not.
- Rurie: Hm. If you're set on this path, you'll surely be dealing with the Highlands Sovereign. Ah, Majin of House Thalas... what a delightfully horrible man he is.
- You have experience?
- Rurie: Experience? Ha! Hahahaha! Yes, I suppose you could say that! Goodness. Experience.
- Rurie: A word of warning... he's an easy man to underestimate. All confidence, bluster, so insufferable you could hardly believe there's anything beneath it all!
- Rurie: But his self-proclaimed "number one" position amongst the Sovereigns isn't just for show! His confidence, his demeanour... all of it is earned. As much as one may wish otherwise!
- Rurie: And there's nothing he loves more than to exert his influence over those beneath him. Which would be, ah... everybody?
- Sui: ... If he has my family, then... it doesn't matter. I won't let him get in my way.
- Rurie: Ooh, frightening. Well, I've said my piece. The rest shall be up to you!
- Rurie: If you ever have need of us again, we'll have set up camp in . You remember the one, yes? Where I-
- Yusanu: Sui, I... I'm sorry for Mora. I hope you can... I hope you can save the others. I really do. Please... don't get yourself killed.
- Sui: ...I- I'm not planning on it. Bye, Yusanu.

Entrance Area
The first area of the dam interior has a tunnel with a few enemies that leads to a room filled with pipes.
After reaching the end of the tunnel, there are various pipes around the room that can be entered using right-click. These pipes are indicated by the swirling green particles.

lines.title: The order of pipes to reach the next area, and an optional path
lines.text:
Enter the pipes in this order.
* First: Head straight to [-15420, 53, -41].
* Second: Head straight to [-15420, 60, -53].
* Third: Turn east to and go to [-15408, 64, -57].
* Fourth: Head straight to [-15408, 53, -67], then do a short parkour over to the other raised ledge to the west.
* Fifth: Take the pipe with the black glazed terracotta at [-15439, 59, -64].

Instead of taking the fourth pipe, there is an optional pipe at [-15436, 53, -56] that leads to two Tier 2 Loot Chests.
Central Area
After exiting the pipe, there is another longer tunnel section. Follow the path to the end, the door is at [-15335, 89, -65].
The door takes the player outside of the dam. There is a large lever at [-1603, 70, -1237] that can be activated.
After activating the lever:
- The water should be active now. You should .
After re-entering the dam:
- The water is flowing again. You should  to see where it goes.
Back-track through the central area to the very beginning of the tunnel. The water will activate a waterwheel and open the door at [-15389, 63, -47].
Steam Vents Room

This room has a unique parkour mechanic in the form of steam columns. While in the column, the steam will push the player upward, and, upon exiting the column, launch the player in the direction they are looking (e.g. looking forwards launches the player forward, looking downwards launches the player downward).

lines.title: An optional path
lines.text: Just past the first steam column, there is an optional pipe at [-15368, 63, -51] that leads to a parkour with two Tier 2 Loot Chests.

Towards the back of the area is a parkour that uses both steam columns and pipes. Scale up the parkour to reach the switch at [-15360, 97, -48]. This will open another door that allows what to flow on a different path in the central area; progress through the area in a similar manner as the first time. The water will activate a waterwheel and open the door at [-15379, 78, 7].
Gear Room

There is a short hallway behind the door, with a Tier 1 Loot Chest at the end. Going through the nearby pipe transports the player to a large arena surrounding the Erroneous Gear miniboss. There are also several steam columns in the arena.

Shortly after depleting the Erroneous Gear to around 80% HP, the gear becomes invulnerable, and Commander Balsura arrives through the pipe in the wall as a secondary boss. However, only the Erroneous Gear is required to be destroyed in order to progress.
- Commander Balsura: So this was your plan! Here to sabotage the game... trying to steal water for yourself? Or did you mean to bring destruction? Cause a flood?
- Commander Balsura: I'll not be letting you get away with such heinous crimes. Lay down your weapons!

After destroying the gear, the bridge the in the central area rotates and directs the flow of water across the gap. Follow the water to the west until reaching the exit of the dam at [-15476, 52, -8]. A short cutscene plays where the water fills up the river.
