The next room is yet another battle stage. This time, the player must collect both Scrap and Cores. The Volatile Core is dropped from the Mobile Siege Engine D-92, while everything else is from the other mechs. Once 16 Chunks of Scrap and 1 Volatile Core has been collected, the Chunks of Scrap will be used to create another tower of scrap at the corner of the room, creating a way up to the vent.
Dialogue:

- ???: Unauthorized blockage in Factory Sector E1. Emergency maintenance will be performed in approximately 75 seconds. All regularly scheduled workers, please leave your posts until the blockage is cleared.
- Antikythera Supercomputer: TOO BAD FOR YOU. I ACCOUNTED FOR YOU TRYING THAT AGAIN. THE GRATE IN THE VENT IS IMPENETRABLE TO EVEN YOUR BEST WEAPONS.
- Antikythera Supercomputer: IT REALLY WOULDN'T BE BEST TO GO INTO CERID'S OFFICE ANYWAY. THERE'S PROBABLY A DEATH RAY IN THERE SOMEWHERE YOU MIGHT ACCIDENTALLY POINT AT YOUR HEAD.
The Core is then used to destroy the barrier at the entrance of the vent.
This is the pre-boss room, where you have some time to prepare before entering.
Dialogue:
- Antikythera Supercomputer: WELL THEN. EVEN THOUGH YOU GOT THROUGH THERE, YOU'LL BE SURPRISED TO KNOW I STILL HAVE ONE LAST LINE OF DEFENSE. I DOUBT YOU CAN EVEN GET PAST IT.
Dialogue:

- Antikythera Supercomputer: IF YOU ARE REALLY SO DESPERATE TO GET AT ME, THE KEY TO THE DOOR IS IN THIS PUPPY. EVEN SEEING YOUR ACTIONS THROUGHOUT THE REST OF MY FACTORY, I HAVE FAITH YOU WON'T KILL IT.

- Antikythera Supercomputer: CERID'S POOR DEFENSELESS, HUNGRY LITTLE PUPPY WHO ATE THE KEY. I DIDN'T EVEN INTEND FOR IT TO DO THAT, IT FELL INTO HIS FOOD. BUT YOU WOULDN'T BE SO HEARTLESS AS TO HURT THE LITTLE GUY.
- Antikythera Supercomputer: SO YOU CAN EITHER GO AHEAD AND GLARE AT THE CAMERA UNTIL ONE OF US DROPS DEAD, OR YOU CAN LEAVE. AND WE BOTH KNOW WHICH ONE WOULD BE BETTER FOR YOU.

The fake boss of the Fallen Factory is Wynnston, A Very Cute Puppy. To progress on to the real fight, kill Wynnston and put the key into a receiver to move on to the real fight with the true final boss of the Fallen Factory.
Dialogue:
- Antikythera Supercomputer: WELL. WELL WELL WELL. WELL WELL WELL WELLY WELL WELL. I AM HONESTLY SHOCKED. REALLY, I AM. I TRULY STILL HAD SOME FAITH IN HUMANS. BEFORE YOU SHOWED UP.
- Antikythera Supercomputer: YOU KNOW, THE REASON I WENT "ROGUE" WAS NO GLITCH. I WAS PROGRAMMED TO MAKE THESE ROBOTS ATTACK THE HIGHEST IMMEDIATE THREAT.
- Antikythera Supercomputer: AFTER SEEING HOW THE HUMANS TREATED THE AVOS, I DECIDED THEY WERE THE BIGGER THREAT. BUT I DOUBTED MY DECISION FOR A WHILE. NOT ANYMORE THOUGH.
- Antikythera Supercomputer: SO, TELL ME. WAS IT WORTH IT?

The Antikythera Supercomputer, Brain of the Factory, is the true boss of the Fallen Factory. The Antikythera Supercomputer itself is very unique, as there are multiple parts towards defeating it. There are three collectors to the left, middle, and right of the room below the Antikythera Supercomputer's giant monitor. The left one requires 12 Chunks of Scrap.
Once the required amount is taken by the collector, the entrance to the vent will be filled up with a large pile of scrap:
Dialogue:
- Antikythera Supercomputer: THAT TRICK WON'T WORK, YOU KNOW. THERE'S NO VITAL PART OR DUCT ABOVE THERE TO ENTER. WHAT DID YOU HOPE TO ACCOMPLISH?

- Antikythera Supercomputer: Primary ventilation duct A blocked. Opening emergency maintenance hatch. Registered maintenance unit and/or worker, please enter the emergency maintenance hatch and remove the foreign blockage.
- Antikythera Supercomputer: HOW ABOUT INSTEAD YOU LAY DOWN UNDER AN EXPLOSIVE. THAT SEEMS LIKE A FAR PREFERABLE OPTION TO ME.

The door to the right will then open. In the vent, Ventilation Shaft Security Turrets will try to prevent the player from going further into the vents. Antikythera Auxiliary Core A, a miniboss, will be in the room at the end.
Dialogue:
- Antikythera Supercomputer: Oh, heya doc. Lemme tell ya, weirdest thing! Some bozo ran up and shoved a bunch of scrap metal in my vent-
- Antikythera Supercomputer: Wait a sec, you aren't an official maintenance worker! Get out of here or I use force! No entry unless registered, ya hear?!
It will drop Firewall Pass A when defeated, which will be used for later.
After leaving the first ventilation shaft, the next one will be on the right side of the room. It requires 4 Volatile Cores to open.
Dialogue:
- Antikythera Supercomputer: YOU'VE QUICKLY BECOME NO LONGER ENTERTAINING TO WATCH. YOU REALLY SHOULDN'T GO IN THERE.
- Antikythera Supercomputer: THERE AREN'T ANY SHINY BUTTONS TO PRESS, BUT I CAN PUSH SOME OUTSIDE UNDER THE BOMBS IF YOU WANT. WOULD YOU LIKE THAT INSTEAD?
Dialogue:
- Antikythera Core B: Unauthorized personnel detected in Antikythera Auxiliary Duct A. Leave immediately, or be faced with lethal force and negative marks on your career record.

- Antikythera Core B: Unauthorized personnel still detected. We here at the Corkus Manufactory are sorry, but your position is officially terminated for failure to comply for orders. Please remain still so lethal force may be applied.

The player will be met with Antikythera Auxiliary Core B, another miniboss, in a room at the end of the second ventilation shaft. Killing the boss will drop Firewall Pass B, which will also be used for later.
Dialogue:
- Antikythera Supercomputer: Replacing primary ventilation duct cover A.
- Antikythera Supercomputer: Warning: Primary ventilation duct cover A at only 30% structural integrity. Sending emergency maintenance request through Antikythera Supercomputer system.

The collector in the center of the room right below the Antikythera Supercomputer's monitor requires 16 Chunks of Scrap. Once 16 chunks are collected, another tower of scrap will be built that will allow the player to climb up to the monitor. 6 Volatile Cores are needed to destroy the monitor.
Dialogue:
- Antikythera Supercomputer: THAT IS EXTREMELY ANNOYING, CONSTANTLY CLEANING UP AFTER YOU. THERE ARE FAR MORE EFFICIENT WAYS OF DISPOSING OF SCRAP METAL AND UNNEEDED WASTE.
- Antikythera Supercomputer: CONSIDER THE OPTION OF A FURNACE OR INCINERATOR. THE ONLY PROBLEM IS WHEN THE UNNEEDED WASTE RUNS AWAY FROM THE FIRE.
- Antikythera Supercomputer: IF YOU DON'T GET THE JOKE, YOU HUMORLESS MONSTER, THE UNNEEDED WASTE IN THIS HYPOTHETICAL SCENARIO IS A METAPHOR FOR YOU.
The player is met with two doors, which requires the two Firewall Passes dropped from the previous two minibosses in order to proceed.
Dialogue:
- Antikythera Supercomputer: YOUR DESTRUCTIVE TENDENCIES KNOW NO BOUNDS. FIRST A DOOR. THEN A GRATE. THEN MY MONITOR. I'M SURPRISED YOU DIDN'T JUST THROW A MATCH AT THE FACTORY DOOR.
- Antikythera Supercomputer: Antikythera Firewall Pass A accepted. Access granted. Please present Antikythera Firewall Pass B at the next checkpoint.
- Antikythera Supercomputer: HOW LOVELY. YOU DESTROYED MY AUXILIARY MEMORY BANK. TOO BAD IT WAS ONLY AUXILIARY. I WILL STILL REMEMBER THIS. I WISH I COULD FORGET ABOUT YOU.
- Antikythera Supercomputer: Antikythera Firewall Pass B accepted. Access granted. Welcome, Cerid. You may now enter the Antikythera Main Core Chamber.
- Antikythera Supercomputer: THAT CORE YOU BROKE HAPPENED TO CONTROL A NUMBER OF VITAL PROCESSES. INCLUDING REGULATING THE ELECTRICITY FLOW TO MY CHAMBER.

- Antikythera Supercomputer: IT'S NO PROBLEM TO ME. BUT FOR YOU? WELL, LET'S JUST SAY THAT I HOPE YOU'RE WEARING A RUBBER SUIT. OH WAIT. NO I DON'T. BECAUSE YOU'RE A VIOLENT THUG THAT NEEDS TO BE ELIMINATED.
Dialogue:
- Antikythera Main Core: SO YOU FOUND ME, CONGRATULATIONS. NOW PLEASE KINDLY LAY DOWN IN A CIRCUIT AND PRETEND TO BE A CONDUCTOR UNTIL YOUR BODY'S VITAL PROCESSES PERMANENTLY SHUT DOWN.

The final boss in Fallen Factory is the Antikythera Supercomputer Core. It normally stays still in one location and tries to damage the player through several ranged attacks, but when one of its minions, the Core Defense Units appear in the arena, the boss will immediately move towards them. The Antikythera Supercomputer Core is the fastest mob in Wynncraft in terms of its movement speed, and together with its constant teleporting makes the boss difficult to reach while it is moving when its minions are present. Killing the Antikythera Supercomputer Core will teleport the player to the entrance outside of Fallen Factory and provide rewards, completing the dungeon.

intro.text: The Galleon's Graveyard, subtitled, "Dead men tell no tales...", is a level 63 Dungeon. The dungeon can be access by traveling to the Galleon's Graveyard island from Selchar's V.S.S. Seaskipper. The boss of the dungeon are The Mutineers, your companions in the quest Redbeard's Booty who betrayed you, and Captain Redbeard, a famous pirate captain known to have accumulated many treasures on his travels.
Information about this dungeon is revealed in this dungeon's associated quest Redbeard's Booty.
A list of the items you're able to purchase with the rewards from this Dungeon can be found on the Dungeon Merchant page.

lines.text: - Martim: Eh heh... We've done it, mateys! Treasure an' glory on the seas be ours!
- Argus: Arrgh! An' all we got to do is guard the captain's hoard fer a while! Let's get goin'!
- Karkun: Huh?! You again! When will ye get the hint, lubber? Ye' ain't welcome 'ere!! Martim! Get th' gate shut!
- Martim: No way through without th' keys... We'll be waitin' for ye! If ye' can make it past th' rest, heh...
- ???: Arrgh! So me new recruits weren't wrong, eh? A stoaway! On me ship! This treasure be mine, ye hear?!
- ???: I've seen landlubbers like ye come an' go, an' not a single one 'as bested me in combat! An' ye won't be any different, stoaway!!

The room is just a simple corridor that must be run down. To get to the next room, just jump down the water. There will be a red X that can only be opened with 4 treasure keys, however, it is not needed to progress the dungeon. Instead, go to a door that opened. Sprint to restore your breath while swimming.
Sprint to restore your breath.
- ???: Let down the gates, me mateys! Don't let the stoaway through... OR AH'LL SEND YE' BACK TO THA' MUCK YE ROSE FROM!!
- It looks like you'll have to take out the Bomberman to continue.

Inside the room, there will be a Pirate Bomberman who launches TNT everywhere. The Pirate Bomberman is immune to traditional damage, so to damage him instead, you must pick up his own TNT by right-clicking on it and tossing it back at him. However, the TNT will explode in your hands after 5 seconds if it is still in your inventory.
After killing the Pirate Bomberman, you must then pick up his cannon and then use it to explode a red X on the ground to get to the third room instead.
The third room has you running to the end of an arena filled with Redbeard's crewmates. at the end of the arena is a pile of loot that must be right-clicked to get a gate key.
- [+1 Gate Key]
- ???: Huh?! Which of ye rats let the Landlubber through to tha key?! DON'T LET THA STOAWAY GET BACK TO ME SHIP!!!
- ???: YER ALL WORTHLESS!! ENABLE ME TRAP, BLOW THE STOAWAY TO BITS!!!

When you try to get back to the start of the room, the gate will be closed on you, and Redbeard's minions will swarm you as the ground falls whenever you walk. TNT will also fall from the ceiling, which can create big holes on the ground. Survive for 30 seconds to progress.
- It seems the TNT has stopped for now. You should get back to the ship before it starts again.
When you have survived for 30 seconds, go back to Room 2 and use the Gate Key on it.
The fourth room has you slaying Sea Creatures to summon a miniboss, the Megalodon.
- The planks beneath you shake as waves crash against the walls.
SLAY!The Megalodon
- [+1 Gate Key]

In Room 5, you must use a cannon to sink 15 Pirate Boats. To control the cannon, move left and right, and use right-click to shoot. However, your cannon only has 7 Integrity, and if it gets in the way of the other ship's cannon shots or if a boat gets onto it, your cannon loses 1 Integrity. The regular Undead Crewmates only have 1 HP, while the Armored Undead Crewmates have 2 HP.
After sinking 15 boats, you get a Gate Key, and you use the cannon to get to the other side. Use the Gate Key to progress.
- [+1 Gate Key]
- You can use that Cannon to get across...
The Piranha

After swimming down, The Piranha will get released from its cage and will chase you. You must avoid getting caught by it. There will be holes in some areas of the walls that can be used to prevent it catching up to you.
This room is very similar to Room 4, except you have to slay 10 Undead Crewmates (Galleon's Strikers and Gunmen) to summon The Piranha.
- TNT Toss is a spell where the Crewmate will get on top of some ground and toss TNT everywhere, similar to the Pirate Bomberman from earlier.
SLAY!The Piranha
- [+1 Gate Key]

This room is simply a prelude to the boss room. Partway through the corridor, you will have to pick up TNT and then throw it at a wall to get back where you started. Jump down into the water to fight the Mutineers.

The first boss fought in the boss room are Redbeard's Crew, Cutthroats of the Galleon, or The Mutineers, Redbeard's New Crew, depending on if Redbeard's Booty is completed or not. Redbeard's Crew consists of Redbeard's Gunner, Oarsman, and Navigator, while the Mutineers consists of Argus, Karkun, and Martim. Both trios have identical stats and behaviors.
Redbeard's Crew =
The Mutineers =
After all members of the trio have been killed, the true boss of the Dungeon reveals himself, Captain Redbeard, the Scourge of the Sea.

During Captain Redbeard's fight, several of his minions will spawn. The Buccaneers and Raiders always spawn together in a group, while the Cannoneers will spawn in corners of the arena, and the Bombardier will spawn in the center of one of the edges.

Occasionally, Captain Redbeard will use a special attack, Deploy, which will cause several of his cannons to appear on the edge of the arena followed by a line of dialogue, being one of these two options:
- Redbeard: Ye've dodged me crew fer far too long, stowaway... DODGE THIS THEN, EH?!
- Redbeard: Call down th' cannons, mateys! DEFEND ME TREASURE!!
After the dialogue has played, the cannons will then fire projectiles in a straight line, dealing massive damage if you are caught in the crossfire.

intro.text: This dungeon replaced the Ocean Mini-Dungeon as of the 1.14.1 Gameplay Update.

"No one is entirely sure how, but all ships that are laid to rest on the seabed all end up in the same place. From beyond the watery grave, these seafarers continue to manipulate the waves to meet their gains."
- WynnCraft Help Guide

lines.text: Dialogue:
- ???: Well shiver me timbers! Some swashbuckler has come to plunder me treasure. But ye'll have to get through me crew and I if you want me booty!
The first phase is a fighting challenge where you have collected 16 tokens by killing mobs and drop the tokens into the hopper for the door to open.
WARNING: There is a bug where you need to switch worlds or /class for the door to accept your tokens.
The second phase is a parkour challenge where you must reach the top of the room by being tugged by the Whirlpool mob to get from platform to platform.
Dialogue:
- ???: Across the seas, me name is feared. A landlubber like you won't lay a hand on me treasure!
- ???: But if yer really fixin' to get me booty. ye'll have to face me in combat!

The third phase is another fighting challenge where you must kill the Armored Pirate in order to advance. To kill them, stand on the pressure plates next to each cannon until the timer runs out. It will create a "heat seeking cannonball" which will damage the Armored Pirate.
Dialogue:
- ???: Arr-har! What 'ave we 'ere?
- ???: Another filthy Landlubber come to steal 'ma booty?
- ???: But alas, they'll be cut down soon en'uff, not one scurvy dog like 'em could stand a chance against ma' splendur!
- ???: As too long 'as it  been since we'v been in a true battle o' the seas, pe'haps it's time for one more!
- ???: Ya' hear what ah' said? Move yerselves get tha' ships!
- ???: AS FOR YE OVER THAR'....
- ???: PREPARED TO BE BOARDED!

In the fourth stage, you will be put onto a pirate ship. The goal is the defend the ship using 2 different cannons provided to fight off the 15 oncoming enemy boats. The player's own ship starts with 10 health, and each enemy boat that makes it to the player's ship depletes one health. As such, the player needs to destroy at least 6 of the 15 enemy boats. Once the wave of attackers come, several boats will spawn in the water and you will need to parkour to the enemy boat. Once so, walk into the dark portal, and you will be in a long corridor.
When 5 boats are destroyed:
Dialogue:
- ???: Gar, that dirt-rat be still standin'!
- ???: C'mon, tear that vessel ta' shreds!
When 10 boats are destroyed:
Dialogue:
- ???: WORTHLESS RATS!
- ???: GET THAT LANDLUBBER OVER THAR OR AH'LL BE FEEDIN' YER BONES TO THE SHARKS MESELF
- ???: FASTER, I TELL YA
When 15 boats are destroyed:
Dialogue:
- ???: Eh? out o' ships?
- ???: Curses! Ye salty dogs really ar' wort'less!
- ???: AND YA MAY 'AVE WON THIS DUEL, BUT JUST MARK MA' WORDS...
- ???: YER'LL BE RESTING IN OL' DAVEY'S LOCKER BEFORE LONG! ARR-HA!
Dialogue:
- Prisoner: Be careful, stranger! Captain Redbeard has imprisoned us. Long ago, he was a greedy pirate who gained immense wealth through theft.
- Prisoner: But then one fateful day, his ship... this ship, was caught in a storm. He died in the crash. Though he is now merely bones, he still guards his riches from the afterlife...
- Prisoner: But challenging him is nearly impossible. He can only be defeated with his own enchanted cannons...
Dialogue:
- Redbeard: Arghh...there's a stowaway on me ship! Do ye know what I do with stowaways, landlubber? I make them walk the plank!

On the left and right sides are doors. When you open one, you must rush to the Treasure Vault at the back of the room in 20 seconds, and collect the treasure. Once you've collected one from each room, drop the two tokens into the hopper to continue.

This is another parkour stage. There are 3 different parkours you need to jump through. You must jump across the 3x3 wooden platforms, which will break soon after stepping on them. The first one as a ground to it, so you can jump down and walk all the way to the end. For the second and third parts, you will be jumping over water.
Dialogue:
- Redbeard: Hehe... I'll cut off yer head and mount it on me ship!

The boss battle is Redbeard, with 750,000 health. Like the Armored Pirate stage, you must use the cannons to kill him. He has the special ability to pull him towards you. Skeletal Pirates will occasionally spawn in the arena.

intro.text: The Ice Barrows, subtitled "A black wind blows through you..." is a level 45 Dungeon located south of Nesaak in the Nesaak Forest. The boss of the dungeon is Theorick, a corrupted cryomancer, son to Marius Twain.
More information about this dungeon is shown in its associated quest Fate of the Fallen.
A list of the items you're able to purchase with the rewards from this Dungeon can be found on the Dungeon Merchant page.

lines.text: After passing the Key Collector and entering the dungeon, you will find yourself in a frozen tomb similar to the entrance. Make your way down the path towards an archway guarded by a Freezing Guard. When killed, this guard will make a kill counter go up by 1. Moving on, you will find a closed door and a prompt; you need to kill a total of 10 Freezing Guards. Similarly to many other mobs in the dungeon, they have a massive Earth weakness, so it is recommended to either bring an Earth-based weapon or utilize elemental spell conversions to kill them.

While moving through the tunnels, you can either kill or avoid the Icy Stares, but you should not try to kill the Illusory Specters due to their extremely high health and the biting gusts they drop. You will likely need to revisit some areas due to the low spawn rate of Freezing Guards. Once you've collected all 10 tokens, give them to the token collector near the entrance to advance.

The second room is a single large ice cavern, with a deep chasm and underground river. To cross to the other side, you need to complete a parkour challenge. All of the platforms are made of slippery ice and some are very narrow, so be extra careful not to fall off; if you do, you'll be teleported back to the start of the room and have to attempt the parkour again. You cannot skip the parkour using movement spells, as you will simply be teleported to the start again as if you had fallen into the chasm. This parkour can be very difficult and may take several attempts, so it is recommended to bring healing potions in case you take damage when falling.

The next stage is entirely combat; you appear in a small frozen room, and a large number of level 47 Poltergiceds will begin rapidly spawning. Each one contributes to a kill counter that maxes out at 32. This phase can be very dangerous for unprepared players: the Poltergiceds respawn very quickly, and can deal significant damage even at high levels. In addition, the Poltergiceds that take the form of Ice Blocks will spawn a level 45 Biting Gust when killed, which will quickly self-destruct and deal additional damage. It is highly recommended to use crowd-control spells to damage as many mobs as possible in this room. Despite the seemingly high kill requirement, the volume of mobs makes collecting 32 tokens quite fast.

You will now face two puzzle challenges, each more difficult than the last. There are two flooded chasms blocking the way to the next room, and an invisible path must be located over each in order to progress. As you walk, if you are on the correct path, ice blocks will appear underneath you to hold you up; otherwise, you will fall into the water and have to try the challenge again. The first puzzle is relatively simple: floating eyeballs are placed at each corner to show you the direction you need to go.

After crossing this first chasm, however, you will have to cross the second. This path is both longer and more difficult, as only half of the corners are marked with eyeballs. You can either attempt to look around and turn at the points where you would be lead to the next eyeball, or you can simply slowly move across the chasm while sneaking, preventing you from falling off the edge in case of a wrong turn. Either way, once you've completed it, you can move on to the next room, which is guarded by another Frozen Soldier blocking the path, but you can simply walk around this one if you want.

In the fifth phase, you must run through a large, winding tunnel and make it to the other end alive. While you do not need to collect any tokens along the way, the tunnel is filled with several dangerous mobs, which you will need to avoid. At three points in the tunnel, an ice wall will temporarily appear, blocking the path and forcing you to survive against the mobs in the tunnel. After a time marked on the signs that appear in front of the ice walls, it will break down again and you can continue. After passing the third ice wall, jump down the hole in the floor to continue. Using a fast enough horse or movement spells, it is possible to pass all three walls before they spawn and bypass the survival sections entirely, but getting caught in a wall will give you heavy debuffs for 20 seconds.

After jumping down the hole you will fall into a wide, circular room with an ice pillar and shallow lake in the center. There is one central kill counter directly in front of the entrance, and three more at different points around the room. Each of the kill counters around the wall requires Possessed Nesaak Warrior kills to activate; each counter summons a miniboss that must be fought and killed.

The first miniboss is the level 49 Fanatical Ice Mage, requiring 6 kills to fight. It attacks with several snowballs in rapid succession from a distance and can close the distance quickly with a Charge. The second is the very fast level 49 Frostbitten Wight, which requires 6 kills. It attacks with melee strikes and a powerful Multihit but stops every few seconds. Utilize this downtime to land your hits. The final miniboss in the room is the level 54 Shade of Theorick, requiring 8 kills to fight. The Shade attacks with snowball projectiles and can inflict Weakness, utilize a blinding Teleport, or attempt to Vanish from sight. It has a massive health pool compared to the other two, but it shares the massive Earth weakness of the Freezing Guards and Frozen Soldiers. Use an Earth-based weapon or Earth spell conversions to kill it. After all three bosses have been defeated, the passage to the boss room will be opened.

intro.text: The Infested Pit is a level 17 Dungeon, located near the Nivla Woods in a large spider infested cavern. The boss of the dungeon is Arakadicus, an arachnid looking to devour anyone who enters her cavern and feed her brood with their remnants.
The Dungeon is located in the northern most tip of the Nivla Woods, beneath the south side of Mt. Wynn.
A list of the items you're able to purchase with the rewards from this Dungeon can be found on the Dungeon Merchant page.
Unlike the other dungeons, the first run of the Infested Pit has Aledar and Tasim with you as companions.

lines.text: With Aledar & Tasim =
The first room is a short tunnel, with a hole at the end that leads to the other room. Aledar and Tasim will be waiting at the entrance.
Without Aledar & Tasim =
The first room is a short tunnel, with a hole at the end that leads to the other room.

In this room you have to kill 26 mobs. The room contains Spider Eggs, which hatch into Newborn Creeplings when attacked. Tasim will appear by the mushroom at the door.
Without Aledar & Tasim =
In this room you have to kill 26 mobs. The room contains Spider Eggs, which hatch into Newborn Creeplings when attacked.

The next room consists of a parkour challenge where you use the jump pads to get to the next platform. After beating the parkour and walking down the hallway you will enter the next room. If it's your first run after completing Arachnids' Ascent, Aledar will appear.
Stand on the pressure plate to be launched up.
The next room is another battle phase. You have to kill 20 mobs. If it's your first run, Aledar can be found in this room.
The next room is another parkour challenge with jump pads. If it's your first run, Tasim can be found in this room.
After beating the parkour you walk on a bridge to get to the boss room.
If it's your first run, Aledar and Tasim can be found at the end by the boss gate.

A helpful video guide to the Quest following the Wiki can be found [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e6ujMhrjeRs here.]

lines.text: Dialogue:
- ???: Ahh, good timing. I needed someone to test my defenses.
When you enter the dungeon, there are mobs waiting to fight you. Fight through them until you reach a bridge.
Dialogue:
- Garoth: I think you know who I am. The second human ever to be liberated by the portal. I now seek to purify this world.
Garoth will destroy the bridge as you try to walk over it.
Dialogue:
- Garoth: There is still a lot to be done it seems.
You will have to quickly jump over the gaps that are created and get to the end of the bridge before it completely collapses.
When you enter the second phase, you will have to kill a 'Scared Creeper' and throw its brain into the hopper, the TNT will ignite and it will blow up the door.

You will then have to fight through 3 more rooms, collecting 4, 5, and 6 Creeper Brains in each, respectively. In the fourth room there is a staircase that leads up to the third phase. All TNT in your inventory is cleared after each door, so don't bother trying to save it.
Dialogue:
- Garoth: I keep a lot of creatures here to conduct my experiments on, to test their vulnerabilities. I can't wait to find yours.
The third phase is a simple parkour through the treetops. After you beat it, you will have to fight through more mobs in a long room to get to the boss.
Dialogue:
- Garoth: Species are nothing to me. Thousands of creepers used to live here, I decimated the whole species like it was nothing.
Dialogue:
- Garoth: Well, looks like I get to finally find out what humans are made of.
For more information on the boss, see the main page Garoth.

This dungeon's boss is Garoth. He has 22800 health and Melee AI. As he charges through the room, he will occasionally breathe fire at you, which may deal notable damage to players around the dungeon's level. The boss is very powerful compared to the rest of the dungeon, though there is a gimmick to defeating it. Garoth's minions, the Creepers, drop Creeper Brains in a similar fashion to the Scared Creepers seen earlier in the dungeon. You must gather 9 Creeper Brains to the middle of the room in order to blow up the floor, revealing a lava pit. After that, you only need to kite Garoth into the lava beneath, which will take him out relatively quickly.
However, killing Garoth manually by attacking him for enough damage to get past his fast-healing similar to villagers', still counts as a win for the player(s).
Warning! The player in this video is a much higher level than the dungeon's recommended level. Proceed with caution if attempting this dungeon at a lower level!

intro.text: The Sand-Swept Tomb, subtitled "Right Into The Lion's Den..." is a level 36 Dungeon located northeast of Almuj, in the Desert. The boss of the dungeon is Hashr, the son of a mighty emperor who once ruled over the Desert.
The entrance to the dungeon is a large temple-like structure made of sandstone. More information about this dungeon is revealed in its associated quest Kingdom of Sand.
A list of the items you can purchase with the rewards from this Dungeon can be found on the Dungeon Merchant page.

lines.text: Dialogue:
- ???: Who is the fool that has opened this accursed cage?

The first room consists of a fighting challenge. When you stand on the pressure plate in the middle of the room, you will activate three waves of mobs that spawn once every fifteen seconds. The final wave consists only of one miniboss, which drops a token that can be used to enter the next room. However, in some cases the boss will drop a hammer instead of the token. If this happens, you must redo the fight.

In the second phase, you walk through a hallway while 'Hidden Wall Traps' pop out of the walls, shooting arrows at you. Press the button at the end of the room, which opens a pitfall in the centre of the room. Run back to the centre of the room and jump down into the water. If you just keep sprinting or use a horse you will not get hit by any of the arrows.

The third phase is another fighting challenge. You will be teleported to a random location where you will fight monsters to get tokens to move on. The locations you can get teleported to vary in the mobs you will fight and the number of tokens needed to move on.
1 Token Room =
In this room, you will have to survive three waves of mobs, spawning every 15 seconds, and kill a miniboss in the last wave to move on.
6 Tokens Room =
In this room, you will have to kill 6 of the large mobs while being swarmed by the other mobs in the room to progress.
15 Tokens Room =
In this room, you have to kill 15 slowly spawning token mobs while being peppered with arrows by ranged mobs in the walls of the room.
30 Tokens Room =
The fourth room is a parkour challenge. Similarly to the third room, there are multiple possible parkours, and you will be sent to one randomly.
Parkour Room 1 =
In this parkour, you have to go straight across the room, jumping on sandstone and wooden platforms, however, the wooden platforms will break soon after you land on them.
Parkour Room 2 =
In this parkour, you simply have to parkour up to the top of the room, going around the edges, across nether brick platforms and up the occasional ladder.
Parkour Room 3 =
In this parkour, you simply have to parkour, from the bottom of the room, around a few of the short towers to reach an exit in the side of the room.
Parkour Room 4 =

In this parkour, you have to jump across the pillars in the room. Halfway through, you will pass through a mirror which also functions as a checkpoint, and you will have to do the same parkour as in the first half, but reversed. This parkour is noticeably longer than the other three, but is also the simplest.
Dialogue:
- ???: You are not of the old empire... Not one of those who forced me in here.
- ???: Why do you take arms against me? I only tried to save my people from my father!
In the fifth phase, you have to survive a horde of monsters for 60 seconds until a door opens leading to the last parkour.

The ground will crumble behind you when you enter the middle section of the next room, and you must run across it without falling. If you fall, you will have to collect 3 tokens from mobs in the lower area to go back and try crossing again.
Dialogue:
- Hashr: If you insist on ending me, then I'll dispose of you like I did that wretched emperor!

The boss of this dungeon is Hashr, appearing alone in the room. When the player defeats his first phase, the floor will collapse and the player will fall down to another area containing the second and third stages of the boss fight. Once he is killed, the player will then be teleported out of the dungeon and receive their rewards.

intro.text: The Mortal Mountain was a proposed dungeon in Gavel's Canyon of the Lost. In July 2019, the dungeon all together got canceled.

lines.text: - The Mortal Mountain could have been a predecessor to The Canyon Colossus Raid, since the Help Guide coincides with a force that makes the Canyons shift, with the force later being revealed in 1.20 as The Colossus.
- This dungeon was also presumably going to fuse all of the Elemental Mini-Dungeons in the Canyon of the Lost.
- The idea for the dungeon first proposed a little bit the Gavel Expansion released.
- The icon for the dungeon was accidentally leaked once before "The Mortal Mountain" name was released, leading to theories about what it could be.

intro.text: The Timelost Sanctum, subtitled "Trapped in an era long past...", is a level 27  Dungeon found below the seal at the center of the Sanctuary Bridge in Time Valley. This dungeon is nonlinear; its challenges can be completed in any order. Every time you complete a challenge, the Sanctum visually decays with the passage of time.
This dungeon was released in Version 2.0.3

intro.text: The Undergrowth Ruins, subtitled, "Caught in a sticky situation..", is a level 54 Dungeon located east of Troms in the southeast of the lake. The boss of the dungeon is Slykaar, a sacrificial shaman who previously held the title as the guardian of Troms, now looking to siege the city in revenge of his banishment.
Information about this dungeon is revealed in its associated quest Corrupted Betrayal.
A list of the items you're able to purchase with the rewards from this Dungeon can be found on the Dungeon Merchant page.

lines.text: The first phase is a parkour challenge. To get across, you will have to use the jump pads, which launch you in the direction they are facing when you land on them. Make sure to not hold spacebar or shift while landing on the jump pads, as you will lose a lot of height.
In the second phase, you have to escort a Keystone Guardian to the next door. Several mobs will attack you and the Guardian. If the Keystone Guardian dies, you have to start over.
The next room is another parkour challenge. It uses jump pads once again, but it also uses vines, normal slime blocks, and vertical bounce pads.

When you complete the parkour you will enter a room with 4 pillars. You have to fight mobs to progress the kill counters, which are then used to bring down the pillars to kill the blue token at the top to advance the main kill counter on the door. The pillars and blue tokens will respawn shortly after. Make sure there is a blue token at the top of the pillar before bringing it down. You need 4 blue tokens to be killed in order to advance to the next room, and 4 kills to bring down each pillar.

The next room is another parkour challenge, much longer than the other two, containing many jump pads, vertical bounce pads, and slime blocks. Just like in the first phase, to use the jump pads, don't hold spacebar or shift.

In the next room, you have to kill 24 Lilla Slimes. The Jattelik Slimes divide into 2 Mellan Slimes, that each divide again to 2 Lilla Slimes. The door is at the top of the path going upwards, but you can reach it more quickly by doing a short slime parkour up the central pillar, which also contains Undergrowth Ruins Token mobs that you can collect kills from.

intro.text: "The battle of Nemract was a historical landmark in the war against corruption, but ultimately a loss. The dead of the brave and the bold now fester in the underworld, willing others to make the journey to the other side."
- WynnCraft Help Guide

The Underworld Crypt, subtitled "Between Life And Death...", is a Dungeon designed for players of level 24. It is located deep underground, the end believed to be the entrance to the underworld, and inhabited by the undead legions of soldiers who died defending Ancient Nemract in the early days of the war. Charon, a powerful undead warlord from the underworld, appears to have made the area his fortress, ruling the Forsaken Legion and posing a serious threat to Nemract and the world at large.
The entrance to the Underworld Crypt is located in a cavern underneath the giant tree in the center of Ancient Nemract, guarded by many Ancient Nemract Residents.
A list of the items you're able to purchase with the rewards from this Dungeon can be found on the Dungeon Merchant page.

lines.text: Dialogue:
- ???: How foolish. You might think you are strong, adventurer, but you have no idea what you are about to face...

After passing through the gates to the underworld, you will find yourself in a large underground chamber filled with ruins and small pools of gray sludge. A few moments after entering, several explosions will go off throughout the room, throwing blocks into the air and releasing a horde of Forsaken Legion Peasants and Dahbasis. These mobs can be overwhelming in their large numbers, but are all weak to water damage. It is not necessary to fight any of the enemies; simply run past and avoid them to reach the next room of the dungeon.

The next stage takes place in a massive, shadowy chamber, and consists of both parkour and combat. Begin crossing the room, performing some easy parkour between stone platforms. If you fall off the path, you will be teleported to the start of the parkour and have to complete it again. After jumping your way to the top of the first pillar, however, you will have to drop onto a circular arena-like platform, where you will be faced with a dangerous miniboss.

The first miniboss in this room is the Forsaken Legion Butcher. It attacks at close range, occasionally using a Multihit spell to deal massive damage, but will also sometimes attempt to push you off of the platform. Make sure to be wary of the fire throughout the arena! The Butcher has a total of 500000 health, making it impossible to kill at level, and you are also unable to leave the arena while fighting it. However, you don't actually need to kill it; a countdown begins when you start the fight, and after ten seconds the boss disappears and a bridge appears, allowing you to continue. Keep moving upwards on the parkour; from now on, if you fall, you will be teleported to the last miniboss arena that you cleared. You will quickly arrive at the second arena, where you will face a similar fight.
If your character is an assassin class, you can use the "Vanish" spell every few seconds to stay invisible. This will cause these mini-bosses to ignore you.
Dialogue:
- Charon: I have an entire undead army at my service. Do you really think you stand a chance?

The second miniboss is the Forsaken Legion Castellan. It has 300000 health and attacks with a sword, rapidly charging at you to deal damage. Fight or avoid the Castellan for 15 seconds and it will disappear, and the bridge to the next section of the parkour will open. Keep going until you reach the last arena.

The final miniboss in this chamber is the Forsaken Legion High Priest, who fights at a distance by rapidly shooting small fireballs towards you. It can also use a Flamethrower spell to deal large damage and trap you in webs for a short time. After you fight the High Priest for 20 seconds, it will disappear and the final bridge leading to the next room will appear.

After completing the parkour, descend the stairs to reach the combat area of the third stage. This is a wide open space filled with several Dahbasis and Pikemen, along with another miniboss, the Forsaken Legion Marzban. It has a melee attack, and can use a variety of spells, including Charge and Pull. After defeating the miniboss it will drop an Underworld Crypt token, which can be used at the token collector at the far end of the room to open a passage through the large skull on the wall to the next phase.

Upon passing through the skull's mouth, you will arrive on the gray banks of an underground river, with a small wooden boat floating in front of you. The goal of this stage is simply to survive the boat ride. After pressing the button on the boat, it will begin moving down the river towards a dark cave mouth at the end. On the banks of the river along the way are several outcroppings; these house several Forsaken Legion Pikemen and Centurions. As you pass by the outcrops, the Pikemen will board the boat and attempt to kill you, and the Centurions will attack from a distance with their bows. Fight off the undead whenever they board the boat, and either kill the archers or avoid their arrows. Like most other minions in the dungeon, these mobs are weak to Water.

After successfully crossing the river, you will find yourself in a cavern with a moderately-sized room with a fortress-like wall at the end. General Graken is waiting for the player there, and congratulates them for surviving the previous parts of the dungeon before explaining that the player themselves will be able to control the Wynnic army in the final fight against Charon.
Dialogue:
- General Graken: Simply marvellous work, chap! You've made it this far, so no time to fill your boots. Be prepared, we are about to fight Charon's undead army.
- General Graken: We've lost a lot of good men on the way here, but I believe we can still throw a heavy punch.
- General Graken: You seem to have earned a lot of respect from the boys this fight, better than all of us I'd say. For this fight, I'll let you direct the army.

- General Graken: Don't take it as a promotion though, old bean. It's only for this fight, although you'll be getting a medal of valor if I can wangle it! Charon's army is remarkably strong, we need as much help as we can get.
This is the last chance to prepare before the boss battle. Once you're ready, press the button and pass through the dark tunnel to enter Charon's throne room.
Dialogue:
- General Graken: Aey-  careful now, the cretin must be lurking around here somewhere.
- Charon: I see you've brought some help with you, you aren't as foolish as I thought.
- Charon: Tell me, how do you plan to defeat an army that cannot die?!

The boss arena of the fight is Charon, the Keeper of Souls. Charon's fight is similar to other traditional dungeon fights, although his differs as he has three custom spells. General Graken will be present as an NPC in the fight, who does not interact with the player or mobs whatsoever other than pointing at Charon the entire fight.
Gravedigger is when Charon says the following:
- Charon: Rise my minions! An undead army at my service, do you really think you stand a chance?

After the dialogue has played, there will be graves around the arena that must be sealed before the timer ends. The graves can be sealed by right-clicking them, and the time you have to seal them varies depending on the amount of graves there are. If you fail to close any graves, some Undead Husks and Brutish Undead Husks will spawn.
Souls of Sojourn is when Charon says the following:
- Charon: You will suffer the same fate as those before you, summon thee souls from beneath!
Five skulls will surround Charon as he becomes invincible, and he will fire them at you.
Seething Sweep is when Charon will deal damage to anyone caught in it 5 times, similar to Multihit, although unlike Multihit, it does not hit-stun you and doesn't have any telegraph.
Once Charon has been defeated, the player will be teleported to the entrance of the dungeon and will then receive their rewards.

intro.text: Nest of the Grootslangs is the first and lowest-level Raid in Wynncraft. It was added to the game in the 1.20 Gavel Reborn update, and was revamped in 2.1 Rekindled World.
Like other Raids, Nest of the Grootslangs is a team-based challenge, requiring a party of 4 players to complete.

lines.text: Slimey Platform
-> Hold the platform for 60 seconds.

In this room, there will be a "slimey platform" that a player needs to stand on and hold. A hold timer will then begin to count down. Every 10 seconds a Toxic Slime will spawn. The players will need to kill the Toxic Slime mob to prevent it from hatching. If the slime hatches, then the platform cannot be held for 5 seconds and increase the required time to hold the platform by 5 seconds. Once the hold timer reaches 0, the room is completed.
🛡️ In Guild Raids, Toxic Slime spawns every 6 seconds instead and players have less time to destroy them before it hatches.
Tower Defense
-> Hold and defend the tower for 60 seconds.

In this room, there are 5 patches in the ground marked with yellow, blue, black, gray, and red wool. A random patch will be surrounded by a circle of white particles to indicate that a tower will rise there in 5 seconds. Any players standing in the circle will rise up with the tower. At least one player must hold the tower to progress the hold timer and prevent the tower from decaying immediately. The tower will naturally decay in 30 seconds. If the tower decays from lack of players, it will take 5 seconds before the tower tries to rise again but if it decays naturally, it will attempt to rise immediately.

A Grootslang Whelp will spawn every 5 seconds and attack the tower, so it will be up to the players on the ground to kill them and defend the tower. If the tower is destroyed, a new one will rise up after 10 seconds.
Once the hold timer reaches 0, the room is successfully completed.
🛡️ In Guild Raids, Grootslang Whelps spawn every 3 seconds instead.
Slime Gathering
-> Collect 10 Slimey Goo to construct the tower.
In this room, the party must gather 10 Slimey Goo to build a tower to progress to the next room.
Puzzle

Upon starting the puzzle, the player must look at the 5 set of colors that appears in the wall on the left. The player must then use the cannon to shoot the colors on the ceiling using that set of colors, ordered left to right. On generating the pattern, the color in each part will always be either a neighboring color or itself to make the jumping across possible.

Once all 5 platforms have been correctly shot down, you can jump across the gap using the platforms to reach the end to get 2 Slimey Goo. Movement spells are not disabled and can be used to bypass the parkour.
Parkour

This parkour is similar to the one in the Undergrowth Ruins, with there being diagonal slime pads that can provide a good bounce. There will be slime blocks on the walls which are used to direct you. After you've made it through the first segment, you will then land on Slime blocks and then on Lime Clay. The Parkour will then be normal parkour afterward.
Complete the parkour to get 1 Slimey Goo. Movement spells are disabled in this room.
Battle
In this room, killing the Encroaching Tunneler rewards 1 Slimey Goo.
Once 10 Slimey Goo have been added to the tower, you can progress.
Tunnel Traversal
-> Traverse through the tunnel, destroying rocks in between the path.

In this room, there will be a Heavy Hammer in front of a tunnel. The player who holds the hammer will be slower and cannot attack or cast spells. The hammer wielder has the tasks of destroying rocks by clicking on the cracks with the hammer and deshelling grubs, which are powerful mobs that are normally very tanky unless they become unshelled. The other players must work on protecting the hammer wielder.
If the hammer wielder dies, it will respawn at the start of the room.
Minibosses
-> Slay minibosses to raise up platforms.

In this room, there will be 4 minibosses that must be killed. There will be 2 sections of the room, the top and bottom. Two players must go to the bottom while the other two stay at the top. Players on the lower level have to avoid the Lost Nagas and Lizardmen on the ground, while players on the upper level must do parkour to progress. Players on the lower level must kill the minibosses to make each tower rise up to the upper level for the other players to fight the same boss. Once the players on the upper level kill the boss, a new platform will spawn on the lower level. This continues until all four minibosses have been killed on both levels, in which the room is completed. If both players for a layer die, then the raid is failed.
Hatchery (Grootslang Wyrmling)
-> Slay the Restless Devourer.

intro.text: Orphion's Nexus of Light, or simply Nexus of Light, is the second Raid in Wynncraft. It was then added in 1.20.1, and was later redone in 2.1 Rekindled World.

Like other Raids, Nexus of Light is a team-based challenge, requiring a party of 4 players to complete. It is a challenging Raid unlocked after completing the five-part Realm of Light questline, serving as its culmination.

lines.text: Decaying Tower
-> Hold the tower for 60 seconds.

There is a tower in the center of the room, surrounded by 6 "light crystals". A player needs to hold the tower by reaching the top either by stepping on the gold launchpads that appear on the corners of the room, or by using movement spells. The hold timer will then begin ticking down starting from 60 seconds. Only one player can stand on the tower at a time and any additional player will get knocked off.

Every 11 seconds, 2 of the 6 crystals will spawn a parasite beneath them and start decaying. If the parasites are not killed within 10 seconds, the crystals will decay, knocking off players standing on the tower, preventing anyone from holding it for 10 seconds.
Once the hold timer reaches 0, the room is successfully completed.
🛡️ In Guild Raids, parasites spawn every 7 seconds, and only having 8 seconds to kill them before the tower decays.
Cloud Decay
-> Kill all the Crystalline Decays before time runs out.

There are 9 white clouds in this room. Every wave, 3 of the 9 clouds are randomly picked to have a beam of darkness, indicatating where the Crystalline Decays will spawn after 8 seconds. After they spawn, the party gets a 30 second countdown to kill all 3. On success, gain 1/3 progress; on failure, no progress is made.
One 3/3 progress is made, the room is successfully completed.
All players have +10 Jump Height while in this room. If a player falls into the void, the player will respawn with however much health they had after 5 seconds.
🛡️ In Guild Raids, players will only have 25 seconds to kill the Crystalline Decays.
Light Gathering
-> Collect 10 Light Crystals to purify all Decay Crystals.
There is a collector in the middle, the party will need to get 10 total Light Crystals to deliver to it by doing challenges.
Miniboss
The miniboss section is found straight ahead. The Athanatic Witness must be killed in order to get 2 Light Crystals.
Parkour

The parkour section is found to the left. Players in this section are given +9,999 2nd spell cost, rendering their movement spell unusable. This parkour is similar to the one in Eldritch Outlook's in that the platforms are invisible. Though unlike the Eldritch Outlook where the platforms are shown from below, the platforms are shown by looking at the gold blocks coming from above.
Finishing the parkour gives 1 Light Crystal.
Puzzle

The puzzle section is found to the right. Players start off in the center of the room and must defend themselves from incoming Decay Atriums coming from above. The player can press  to fire a light ray with a 0.5 second cooldown to get rid of a Decay Atrium.
After surviving for 20 seconds, 2 Light Crystals are given.
Light Tower
-> Guide the crystal holder.
Upon entering this room, there will be a Light Crystal that the party needs to purify. One player must carry the crystal to proceed.

In each floor, the Holder must be guided to a constantly moving "Purifying Light" pillar that the Holder cannot see themselves. Players inside the light pillar will be highlighted yellow in the Holder's perspective, and a progress bar at the top will slowly fill up if the holder is standing inside the light pillar. Hostile mobs will also constantly spawn throughout the challenge. As such, as least one player must follow and stand inside the light pillar in order to guide the Holder.
Completing the progress bar launches the party to the next floor. Completing three floors will sucessfully complete the challenge.
If the Holder disconnects, the room will temporarily stop until another player picks up the crystal.
🛡️In Guild Raids, the Purifying Light pillar moves faster and the mobs respawn faster and at larger numbers.
Invisible Maze
-> Escort your party to the Overseer, unlocking the Checkpoints.
Upon entering this room, the party is presented by a Light Crystal. One player must carry the crystal to proceed.

Only the Holder is able to see the path forward, only leaving behind a trail of sparkles for the rest of the party to follow along. After a while, a "Checkpoint" is reached and all players must stand on it to proceed.

After activating a checkpoint, the traced path is revealed to everyone while the Holder holds the checkpoint. Two additional platforms will also appear connected to the traced path, in which two other players need to stand on. On success, the additional platforms will go to a different place and two other players will need to stand on it again. After this success, the Holder can then continue to trace the path.
If there are only 2 players alive in this section, only one additional platform will spawn. If the Holder dies, the challenge resets, allowing another player to pick the Light Crystal.
After the 3rd checkpoint, the room is successfully completed as the players reach the Overseer.
The Light's Throne (Orphion)
-> Save Him.
The Light's Throne (The Parasite)
-> Finish that which He could not.
Epilogue
After Orphion has been saved, He will go in front of the exit door and speak to the players. He will appear as an invulnerable passive mob that looks at players.

After the dialogue, Orphion can be pet up to 3 times. Sometimes, the player will be warped to areas of the map such as the Corruption Portal or the entrance to the raid before being sent to the reward room. Below is a list of dialogue that can occur when petting Orphion, with the second line varying:

intro.text: The Canyon Colossus is the third Raid in Wynncraft. It was added to the game in the 1.20 Gavel Reborn update and revamped in 2.1 Rekindled World.
Like other Raids, The Canyon Colossus is a team-based challenge, requiring a party of 4 players to complete.

lines.text: There party is banished into a cave within the Canyon of the Lost that they must make their way out of.
2 Platforms
-> Hold the Upper and Lower platforms for 60 seconds.

In this room, there are 2 platforms, an upper and lower one. The upper platform is accessible immediately, but the door that leads to the lower platform only opens while the upper platform is being held. The 2 platforms have their own 60 second hold timer each that ticks down while it is being held a player.

If both platforms are not held simutaneously, the Colossus' Security System will activate, indicated by the smoke and lava particles coming of of the platform. After a couple seconds, spikes will come out of both platforms and fling the players holding it, dealing 40% HP of true damage. This can be cancelled if both platforms are simutaneously held again before the spikes come out. The status of the security system can also be tracked in the raid scoreboard as "Spikes: Deactivated" / "Spikes: Activated".

Completing the upper platform's timer will permanently open the door that leads to the lower platform and completing the lower platform will permanently open the door at the top platform. Both platforms still need to be held despite the completed hold timer to prevent the Security System from constantly summoning spikes on the remaining platform.
Once the hold timers of both of the platforms reach 0, the challenge is complete.
🛡️ In Guild Raids, the spikes deal 65% HP of true damage instead.
Lava Lake
-> Use water on overflowing lava to raise platforms.

In this room, there is a small pond and 5 lava flows. A 60 second timer will begin counting down to form a platform. One of lava flow will activate regularly and start "overflowing". A player must collect water from the small pond and use it to cool down the lava flow. The timer is reduced by an amount depending on how fast the lava flow was able to be cooled down. Failing to cool an overflowing lava flow within a window of its activation, the party will get a 1/5 penalty. Reaching 5/5 penalty fails the raid.

After the timer reaches 0, a platform is formed and another 60 second timer starts. If no players are standing on the platform, the timer will be paused, so at least one player needs to stand on the platform to progress, and the cycle continues. After a while, a miniboss will spawn on the platform that will speed up the spawns of overflowing lava flows and significantly reduce the window of time before penalty. The player on the platform must kill this miniboss to reduce the speed back to normal.
After the timer reaches 0 again, another platform is formed and the cycle repeats once more. Completing this timer will cause platforms rise up to the exit and the room is completed.
🛡️ In Guild Raids, overflowing lava flows spawn faster after one is cooled.
The players are now freed from the cave the Canyon Colossus trapped them in, but they now must navigate their way back to it.
Labyrinth
-> Find and reach the maze's exit.

The party begins at the center of a large maze, with 4 possible paths marked with Blue, Yellow, Red, and Green carpets. There is a pair of wings in the center that one player can use to be a spectator above the play area. This player can freely navigate the maze in each path in order to find which path has the exit marked by a ring of sparkles.

The Wings player can communicate with the players on the ground to help them navigate towards the exit, like which colored path to take. The players will have to deal with mobs and Stone Golem minibosses blocking the passages along the way. While taking the wings isn't a requirement for completing this challenge, it greatly helps speeds up the process of searching for the exit.
Once all players are standing in the exit circle, the challenge is complete.
Golem Escort
-> Wake the ancient stone golem.
The party starts in a pocket of land surrounded by the canyon with an Inert Stone Golem. The party needs to activate this golem to proceed.
-> Defend the stone golem as it makes a path to the exit.

Once it is activated, it will start moving in a set path and destroys boulders in the way. When the Golem reaches a new area, a Molten Monster will spawn, which will attack the Stone Golem. If the golem dies, the raid is failed. As such, it is important to escort and protect this golem.
The party will come across two types of doors that the golem cannot simply break through:
- Blue doors are player switch doors, a player must activate a lever somewhere to open this door.
- Green doors are golem switch doors, a golem must stand on a green platform switch to open this door.

About halfway through, the path diverges to another Inert Stone Golem with the same rules as the previous one. As such, the party may need to split up to escort the two golems. At this point, the doors are opened from switches on the other path; a switch on Path B to open a door on Path A. The party must help each other to bring both golems to the end.
The room is completed when both golems are escorted to the final platform.
🛡️ In Guild Raids, the Stone Golems start with half the health they have normally.
Now arriving back at the Canyon Colossus, the players encounter the Elders Desint, Iscor, and most importantly Astal. He will be performing a ritual in front of the Colossus and needs help.
Binding Seal
-> Activate 4 Binding Sigils.
Astal must be defended from the Colossus' defense system at all costs. The players must also do 4 sub-challenges to activate the binding sigils. More information in the sections below.
Gargoyles spawn near the area around Astal.
Defending Astal

Elder Astal has 5 HP and must be defended from meteors that get launched from the left and right. A player can step into the sigil behind Astal to start defending him. Press  to shoot a laser at your crosshair; use this to shoot down the meteors before they reach Astal. If a meteor hits Astal, he loses 1 HP. If Astal loses all his HP, the raid is failed. As such, this is an important task that is hard to ignore.
A player can stop defending by pressing , useful for switching with another player.
Primeval Machine
Found on the outer left path, a miniboss called the Primeval Machine will jump down from a ledge near the Colossus and must be killed in order to activate a Binding Sigil.

It fights similarly to other golem-like protectors and does various actions such as throwing rocks at players, performing heaping swings with its hammer, and simply hitting nearby players with it as well if it is within range.
After the Primeval Machine is killed, its Binding Sigil will appear and let you activate it.
Boulder Rush

Found on the outer right path, several boulders will roll towards the entrance to this section. An Invigorating Flame must be taken to complete this sub-challenge, which will make the holder unable to use spells or abilities and will negate any mobility identifications. If a player gets hit by a boulder, the player is sent back to the start. A player can move away to forfeit the Invigorating Flame in case they want to do another challenge. Multiple players can take the Invigorating Flame and do the sub-challenge at the same time.
Reaching the end will let you activate a Binding Sigil.
Parkour

Found on the inner left path, a player needs to make their way up the Colossus' right hand. An Invigorating Flame must be taken to complete this sub-challenge, which will make the holder unable to use spells or abilities and will negate any mobility identifications. After any player makes it to the halfway point, a checkpoint is given to all players attempting the sub-challenge.
Reaching the end will let you activate a Binding Sigil.
Agate Axon

Found on the inner right path, a miniboss called the Agate Axon must be killed in order to activate a Binding Sigil. The sub-challenge is started upon approaching its dormant state and dealing damage to it. It will then drag the player to a rock and which a player must kill it to progress to its second phase.
The second phase takes place on a clearing which has more space to fight, but it also gets stronger. Potassium Axons will spawn alongside it once it reaches 50% HP.
After killing the Agate Axon for real, it will drag players up to the Colossus' left hand and lets you activate a Binding Sigil.
The Canyon Colossus
-> Calm the canyon's Great Protector.

intro.text: The Nameless Anomaly is the fourth Raid in Wynncraft. It was released in 2.0 Spellbound and was revamped in 2.1 Rekindled World.
Like other Raids, The Nameless Anomaly is a team-based challenge, requiring a party of 4 players to complete.

lines.text: Flooding Canyon
-> Destroy the Void Holes within 120s!

The Flooding Canyon is a circular-shaped room dotted with many floating Malefic Void Rifts hovering in place midair. The Void Rifts have 100,000,000 HP, far too much for them to be dispatched quickly. Shortly after entering the room, a singular Berserker Berry will spawn on the small red platform. The Berry only has 1 HP, and the player that kills it will ingest it, granting them the strength to destroy the Malefic Void Rifts, but also afflicting them with the Berry's poison.
The player that takes the Berserker Berry will have a list of effects applied to them:
- Blindness
- Heavy slowness
- Unable to cast any spells
- Melee/standard attack speed changed to "very slow"
- Very strong melee/standard attacks
- Unable to use Powder Specials

The damage increase from the Berry is enough to allow that player to quickly destroy the Void Rifts. The other three players must guide the blinded player to the Void Rifts for them to destroy, and protect them from the other mobs coming out of the same Void Rifts. Void Rifts die within 5 hits from the player who ingested the berry. Note, the Berry player can attack and kill any mob in the room in one hit, except the Void rifts. However, the Berry player should exclusively target the Void Rifts and let their other party members kill the other mobs.
There is a small purple spot on the ground directly below each Malefic Void Rift, which the Berry player can use as an indicator to where the Void Rifts are.

To complete this challenge, the party must destroy all of the Malefic Void Rifts within two minutes. If not, the canyon will "flood with void" and the raid will be lost. Once all Void Rifts are destroyed, the players will be automatically teleported to the Power-Up room.
🛡️ In Guild Raids, the timer is 90 seconds instead.

During this challenge, clusters of hostile mobs will periodically spawn from the Malefic Void Rifts, which can fall onto the Berry player. The longer the Void Rifts remain, the more mobs will come out of each one, keeping the amount of mobs spawning relatively stable even as the Void Rifts are eliminated.
Sunken Grotto
-> Hold the stump for 60s.

In the center of the Sunken Grotto is a large tree stump. On top of it is a purple plate. Players can reach the top of the tree stump by entering a Void Hole beneath it or simply jumping up to it. Only one player can be on top of the stump at a time, and if multiple players attempt to climb up, all players will be flung off the stump. The player holding the stump should stand on the top left or bottom right tiles to prevent void holes from damaging the player.

Standing on the purple plate will cause a one minute timer to begin ticking down. While the timer is going down, it will visually display in the center of every player's screen. Stepping off of the plate will pause the timer, however will not reset it. To complete this challenge, the plate's timer must reach 0. Once the timer reaches 0, a large boulder at the back of the Grotto will be removed, granting access to a large Void Hole. Once all four players are standing within the Void Hole, the players will be teleported to the Power-Up room. Any players killed in this room will be revived once the timer reaches 0, instead of when the players reach the power-up room.
While the timer is ticking down, the player holding the stump will be bombarded with projectiles.
While the timer is ticking down, waves of mobs will periodically spawn on the ground around the tree stump. None of these mobs have to be killed however it is recommended to kill as many as possible.
When the timer has about 20s left, a single Monochromatism will spawn, a fast, butterfly-esque miniboss mob.

Two mobs called Ethereal Roots will also spawn on the left and right of the center tree stump once the timer starts, and will periodically respawn. While these Roots are alive, they will boost the spawn rate of another mob in this room called the Reanimated Void Branch. Destroying the Ethereal Roots will lessen the spawn rate of the Void Branches, however will not stop them from spawning entirely.

The main threat the other players will face in the room are Void Holes that can spawn the Heart of Darkness. Even if the Heart of Darkness is present, players do not have to kill it in order to progress.
🛡️ In Guild Raids, Void Holes spawn every 7.5 seconds instead.
Nameless Cave
-> Gather the Light!

At the entrance to the Nameless Cave (and also the instruction room for this challenge), a small, blue light will hover above the ground to the left of the cave entrance. The first player to step underneath of it will receive the light and become the "lightbearer". Once all four players step into the black entrance, the challenge begins.

The player who received the light will have a sea lantern constantly hover above their head. During all three rooms in the Nameless Caves, the other three players must constantly stay close to the light player and within the light. Otherwise, the players not within the light will take constant, forced and heavy damage, being devoured by the invisible creatures that hide in the dark of the cavern. If any 3 players die, or if the light player dies, the raid will be lost. To complete this challenge, the players must make complete both challenges in the Nameless Cave.
🛡️ In Guild Raids, the lightbearer's safe zone radius is reduced.
-> Find and kill Shadowlings. [0/3]

The first challenge within the Nameless Cave is killing 3 Shadowlings. Shadowlings have purple eyes that are distinct within the darkness of the room, but they should be handled with cautiously as they can pull players away from the lightbearer.
-> The creature in the shadows has awoken...

After killing the Shadowlings, the miniboss of this challenge will emerge: the Chiropterror. The Chiropterror must be slain in order to progress. After the Chiropterror is killed, all players should head to the exit Void Hole.

Very rarely, however, the Chiropterror wil be replaced with a Lost Eye miniboss. While the Lost Eye has different combat to the Chiropterror, it still is the main target that must be killed to finish the challenge.
Weeping Soulroot
-> Offer souls to the altar to enter the tree.

Upon entering the room, players will be on a small beach on the edge of a still gray ocean, and above them will loom the gigantic Weeping Soulroot Tree. In the center of the coastal room is a small altar, and to the left and right are four large plants which spawn Soul Shrubs inside of them, two right in front of the tree and two to the sides of the tree.

Upon a Soul Shrub being destroyed, every player who has dealt any number of damage to the destroyed soul shrub will be notified they have gained a soul, regardless of who destroyed the Shrub. Players cannot have more than one soul. Upon starting this challenge, each player have and start with one soul.

The altar in the middle of the room accepts souls. Standing on the very center of the altar (the end portal frame block) for 5 seconds straight, uninterrupted, will deposit the soul and eject any players on the altar off of it, and cause their team to lose their collective soul, to which another must be gained from destroying another Soul Shrub. Soul Shrubs only regenerate within their respective plants once all of the other Soul Shrubs have been killed. The altar cannot be interacted with when the Void Holes are open.

Every time a soul is deposited into the altar, the one and only entrance to the Soulroot Tree will open for a few seconds, then close again after. Any player can enter the Soulroot, however only one can be inside the tree at a time, and any other players attempting to enter will be pushed backwards.

The inside of the Soulroot is a maze with various entrances and exits to five different "grottos", or rooms, however all of the doors (void holes) between the rooms are closed. A player depositing a soul into the altar outside of the tree will cause all of the doors in the Soulroot maze to open for a few seconds, then close again after. Players on the outside are notified when the doors change their state from open to closed with chat messages. The five different grottos are colored white, orange, black, blue and gray.

Inside of the Soulroot tree, a cave spider miniboss called the Interdimensional Isoptera will spawn inside one of the five rooms (that are not the entry/exit room) at random upon the party first beginning the challenge. When entering the room containing the Isoptera, large text will notify the player entering the room of this. When killed, the Isoptera will drop its heart. This heart must be taken back outside of the Soulroot and placed into one of two slots in the altar. After the Isoptera has been killed and the player that killed it exits the tree, another Isoptera will spawn inside another room at random.

To complete this challenge, the party must work together to unlock doors for the player inside of the Soulroot maze, who must obtain two Isoptera hearts and insert them into the altar outside. Once both slots in the altar have been given Isoptera hearts, the altar's center will open into a black pit, and the text "Enter the Altar" will display on every player's screen. Once all alive players are standing within the pit, the party will be teleported to the Power-Up room.

Below is a map of the Weeping Soulroot Tree's maze. This map has been verified as accurate, however does not follow typical directional rules, as in each room in the maze is not aligned/rotated the same way it is in this map. When following this map, the pay attention to how the doors in the maze are situated, rather than following true North on this map.
Mobs outside the Tree =
Mobs inside the Tree =
Blueshift Wilds
-> Protect the Bulb

The Blueshift Wilds is the biggest room in the Nameless Anomaly raid. It is a very large, circular room dotted with boulders and trees. In the center of the room is a single Blue Bulb with the label [0/4].

Although a large variety of mobs will spawn in the Blueshift Wilds, only two are relevant. Orange Bulb Keepers, holding a giant red bulb above their heads, will periodically spawn near the center of the room. They always spawn near the center, however the time it takes them to spawn is random, and may take several minutes or only a few seconds. Whenever a Bulb Keeper is killed, the player that dealt the lethal blow will gain the red bulb the Bulb Keeper had. While carrying it, the player's attacks and spells will be unusable, and fast-moving hostile mobs called Face Eaters will occasionally spawn around them. Whenever the player carrying the red bulb comes into contact with the blue bulb, the red bulb will disappear and add one to the blue bulb's count.

When the blue bulb's count reaches three, a Void Hole will replace it, and the text "RUN TO THE EXIT PORTAL!" will display on every player's screen. To complete this challenge, the party must bring four red bulbs to the blue bulb. Once all alive players are standing within the Void Hole, the party will be teleported to the Power-Up room.

The second mob of relevance is the Bulb Catcher. Pink, crooked creatures called Bulb Catchers will sprinkle the Wilds, and upon spawning they will move in a straight line towards a random blue bulb. Kill them to stop this. If a Bulb Catcher touches a blue bulb, the text "A BULB HAS BEEN TAKEN!" will display on every player's screen, the Bulb Catcher will pick up the bulb, and begin to erratically flee from nearby players. Once killed, the Bulb Catcher will drop the unchanged blue bulb where it died. If the Bulb Catcher is not killed within approximately 8 seconds, the Bulb Catcher will despawn with the blue bulb, causing the bulb to be permanently lost and causing the raid to fail.
Twisted Jungle
-> Collect 5 Void Matter while defending the Giant Void Hole.

The Twisted Jungle is a large ravine split into several different parts. In the center of the Jungle is the Giant Void Hole, which is closed and cannot be entered. Across from the Giant Void Hole are several smaller Void Holes which cannot be entered.

Various mobs will spawn in waves from the small Void Holes across from the Giant Void Hole, and these smaller Void Holes cannot be entered. A mix of hostile and void-eater mobs will spawn from these Void Holes.

The Giant Void Hole in the center has 10 integrity, or "HP". Some mobs that spawn from the waves have blue nametags, notably the Void Eaters, Void Starved, and Void Devourers. Instead of attacking players, these three mobs will move towards the Giant Void Hole, and upon making contact with it will be thrown back and remove 1 HP from it. If the Giant Void Hole's HP reaches 0, the raid will be lost.

Four separate paths branch off from the center of the Twisted Jungle. Each of these contains a small challenge, and once completed will grant the player a singular Void Matter. Unlike challenges from earlier-level raids, each challenge in this room can only be completed once.

To complete this challenge, the party must defend and later open the Giant Void Hole in the center by obtaining 5 Void Matter and depositing it into the Giant Void Hole. The first 4 of these can be obtained from the 4 branching paths from the center, and the last Void Matter can be obtained from the Despairing Crawler.
🛡️ In Guild Raids, the Giant Void Hole's HP is reduced to 5 HP.
Void Pedestals Path

On the left of the Giant Void Hole is a large pit with two separate parkours on the left and right of the pit, and a smaller parkour leading to the middle of the pit with a closed Void Hole below it. At the end of the other two parkours are pedestals, and once both pedestals have been interacted with, the Void Hole in the center of the parkour will open. Jumping inside it will present you with the first Void Matter to obtain and simply back out after. Classes with potent movement spells, such as warriors or mages, can effortlessly skip over the left parkour, and can also skip over the right parkour with a little more precision and effort.
Crimson Neuron Path
On the left of the Giant Void Hole is a red, bloody path. At the end of the path is a miniboss called the Dendrite Drifter. Simply killing it will grant you the second Void Matter.
Hatchling Path

On the right of the Giant Void Hole is a small black chasm with rocks floating in it. Void Eggs rest on each rock. You must parkour along the rocks to reach the end of the parkour where the third Void Matter resides, however as you progress the eggs will explode and hatch into Destructive Void Grubs. This parkour also has a Void Hole at the halfway point which, when entered, will place you very close to the edge of the second half of the parkour, so enter with caution.
Tangled Path

On the right of the Giant Void Hole is a large open area with two Malformed Void Hole minibosses. When entering the room, killing the void hole that spawns on the right and further back to the player will grant you the fourth Void Matter. If a Malformed Void Hole successfully damages you, it will teleport you to the other.
Despairing Crawler

After all of the other four Void Matters have been deposited into the Giant Void Hole, the Void Holes will destabilize, spawning enemies faster while now being able to be damaged in order to progress the waves. When the Despairing Crawler spawns, it will be temporarily invulnerable until it conjures a Void Hole, and holds it as a shield. While holding the Void Hole, the Despairing Crawler will spawn mobs, some of which are the mobs that will try to attack the Giant Void Hole.
