When the Despairing Crawler is killed, the player that dealt the lethal blow will obtain the fifth and final Void Matter.
As soon as the fifth Void Matter is inserted into the Giant Void Hole, it will open. Once all alive players are standing within the Giant Void Hole, the party will be teleported to the Power-Up room.
Remains of Reality (The Nameless)
-> Survive.

intro.text: The Wartorn Palace is the fifth and current highest-level Raid in Wynncraft, located in the Aelumia Citadel. It was added to the game in the 2.2.0 Fruma Expansion.

Like other Raids, The Wartorn Palace is a team-based challenge, requiring a party of 4 players to complete. It is a challenging Raid unlocked after completing the 13-part Fruma Storyline Quests, serving as the culmination of the storyline.

lines.text: Regal Ballroom
-> Collect the Sonic Amplifier!
To begin the challenge, one player must go up the balcony to collect the "Sonic Amplifier", hereby referred to as the Wielder.

At any point during this challenge, if the Wielder falls off the balcony, disconnects, or somehow dies, the Sonic Amplifier respawns in the balcony, ready to be wielded again. If only one player is left alive, the raid is failed.
-> Collect the mobs together and kill them with the Sonic Amplifier!

A horde of mobs called Jagaubis starts spawning on the floor, highlighted in red to indicate their high damage resistance. Periodically, a miniboss called the Gendarme Caster will spawn, outlined in purple. When the Gendarme Caster dies, all Jagaubis will be pulled towards its death position for a second.

The Wielder must  the Sonic Amplifier to shoot the highlighted cracks in the glass ceiling, each giving 16% [1/6 hits] charge. If a shot is missed, 33% [2/6 hits] charge is lost. During this process, the rest of the party has to survive, trying to evade and corral the enemies as they wait for the Wielder to build charge.

Once the Wielder gains 100% [6/6 hits] charge, the Amplifier becomes fully 'charged', in which the Wielder can look down to see a yellow circular sigil on the floor that follows their crosshair. The Wielder can then  to lock its position, and 2 seconds later, a "blast of light" comes down from the ceiling. This beam strips off the high damage resistance of all Jagaubis caught in its area of effect, indicated by them losing their red highlight and gaining a white outline. The rest of the party can then finish off these weakened mobs to add progress to the challenge.

The Wielder has to adapt with the capabilities of the rest of the party in order to make the most of their "blast of light". A straightforward strategy is for the rest of the party to focus on killing the Gendarme Caster, triggering its death pull to group up the Jagaubis into one spot. In which, the Wielder would hold on to the charge before calling it at the Gendarme Caster the second before it dies. If executed properly, it hits all the Jagaubis just as they are pulled into the area.
The progress for this challenge is tracked in a yellow boss bar at the top "SLAY - Kill 0/25 Mobs to proceed". After the party kills 25 Jagaubis, the room is complete.
Grand Aisles
-> Fight through the palace rooms!

Before each door, the party is given a choice between two of the elements (). This determines the type of enemies to be encountered in the proceeding sub-room. After selecting one, the door will open and the chosen element is displayed as a hologram. Enemies aligned with that element will then spawn in the room and the party is required to kill all of them before proceeding to the next door, in which another choice is presented for the next sub-room. When only a few enemies remain in the room, they become highlighted.
It may be important to keep in mind your own and your party members' Elemental Defence and the damage they deal when making these choices.

After the third sub-room, the path splits as two keys are required from the left and right path respectively. Both paths consist of two sub-rooms; the path's key is automatically collected after clearing the last sub-room of the side. The party could split up into groups to do both paths simutanously.

Once both the keys are collected, the party can meet back up to proceed to the center path but a Gallehaut slams the door open before a choice is presented. The Gallehaut and its succeeding waves of enemies must be cleared before proceeding and making the final choice for the last room.
After all the waves in the last sub-room is cleared, the room is completed.
Buff Room 1
The first buff room takes place somewhere in the Palace with an imperial staircase. Upstairs, the Corruption starts spreading into the room from the door to the next challenge.
-> Choose a buff or go to the exit
For this raid's buffs, see §Raid Power Ups.
For repairing Crafted equipment, a Blacksmith is located to the right.
Statuary Hall
-> Slay the Knightmare by destroying its shields atop the statue.

The Statuary Hall takes place in a chamber of the Palace with a statue of Her Majesty. Corruption spikes grow out from the walls, and the Corruption rift itself is visible in this room through the glass in the dome above.

Knightmare acts as this room's miniboss. They start with 95% Damage Resistance given by the 5 Corrupt Shields around the statue. Using the Blistering Pustule that grows in front of the statue (or using movement spells), a player is able to go on the platform atop to deal with the shields, hereby referred as the Holder.

The Holder can press  to beam a puff of smoke capable of instantly destroying a Corrupt Shield. Unlike Light Gathering Puzzle and Defending Astal, this beam cannot be held to constantly fire nor has a set "fire rate". The Holder could mash  to fire as much as they want to deal with the shields.

However, the Holder also needs to pay attention to the floor of the platform; Deadly spikes rise up regularly, telegraphed by red glyphs. These spikes deal a notable amount of damage, so its best to mitigate it by avoiding the glyphs in the platform. If the Holder attempts to bypass the spikes on the platform by standing on a different elevated area, the Holder will get the message "" and begin to suffer constant unavoidable spikes directly underneath them until they step back into the platform or fall off in which it stops, getting the message: ""
Knightmare's damage resistance depends on how much shields are currently alive:
- 5/5 Shields Alive – 95% Boss Resistance
- 4/5 Shields Alive – 75% Boss Resistance
- 3/5 Shields Alive – 50% Boss Resistance
- 2/5 Shields Alive – 30% Boss Resistance
- 1/5 Shields Alive – 15% Boss Resistance
- 0/5 Shields Alive – 0%  Boss Resistance
The shields respawn periodically after a while, so the Holder must destroy them constantly to keep its resistance low.
After Knightmare is defeated, the room is complete.
🛡️ In Guild Raids, Knightmare has 6 Corrupt Shields and damage resistance from each one is frontloaded [99% > 89% > 80% > 60% > 35% > ??% > ??%].
Intruding Rifts
-> Defend the guards and close the rifts!
This room features two buildings with pools below and a garden on top. A Giant Rift has overtaken the space between the two, spreading corruption all around.

The 8 Gendarme Soldiers must be defended from any attacking enemies throughout this room. If a soldier dies, they will play a death animation and leave a puddle of blood, sending the message " ". If there are no soldiers left standing, the raid is failed.
The Giant Rift will regularly spawn enemies to attack the soldiers.
Lesser Rifts will open up periodically and require a player to do its given challenge in order to close it.
After 10 Lesser Rifts are closed, the room is complete. The Giant Rift closes and the party is teleported out.
Buff Room 2
The second buff room takes place in the Her Majesty's throne room, where the effects of Corruption are the most severe in the Palace.
-> Choose a buff or go to the exit
For this raid's buffs, see §Raid Power Ups.
For repairing Crafted equipment, a Scared Blacksmith is cowering away at the right corner of the room.
After the players stand in Her Majesty's throne, the ceiling collapses as the party is pulled into the Corruption Rift and enter the Realm of War.
The Spire's Shadow
-> Rip out the artifact to break the sigil.

The room is adorned with red spiraling sigils with a platform at the center, wedged is a spear called Bane of Binding, or simply the Artifact. To begin the challenge, a player must pull the Artifact out, hereby referred as the Wielder. After pulling out the Artifact, a non-damaging explosion happens that knocks the Wielder off the platform as the red sigils begin to slither away.
In rare cases where the Artifact was unable to enter the Wielder's inventory, it respawns on the floor at the start of the room, waiting to be picked up by any of the players to become the Wielder.
Note: The Wielder can still use their weapon to attack and cast spells freely at all times during this encounter. They just need to switch to and hold out the Artifact when it's needed to be used.
-> Expose and destroy the Anchors of Hate.

After sigils slither away, 9 patches of Hardened Crust appear in the room: 1 in the center (directly beneath the platform) and 8 surrounding it. The Wielder will also begin seeing white rings emanating from the Anchors of Hate hidden beneath these crusts.

Destroying a Hardened Crust exposes the Anchor of Hate beneath it. The Anchor must have a player nearby to "hold" it down to prevent it from sinking back into the ground, reforming its Hardened Crust. While an Anchor is being held, it will constantly erupt in flames in an attempt to get the holder off it. Hardened Crusts can occasionally grow corruption spikes, which prevent the crust from being damaged until destroyed.

The Wielder can activate the Artifact by pressing  while holding it. Once activated, a rectangular highlight appears directly in front of the Wielder, showing the area of effect to all players. This highlight follows where the Wielder's head is facing. Furthermore, the forward range can be adjusted by changing their pitch; looking up extends it forward, while looking down pulls it backward.

When the Wielder stops moving their head, the Artifact winds up briefly before launching the Wielder forward to the end of the projected range. This dash destroys every Anchor of Hate and obstacles (corruption spikes / platform) in its path. Every Anchor destroyed also visually destroys one of the chains covering the exit door.

Every time the Artifact is used, it discharges a  near the Wielder. The Carnifex tethers itself to the Wielder, the two constantly pulling on each other. The Artifact becomes unusable while its creation is alive, so the party needs to kill the Carnifex for the Artifact to recharge.
The rest of the party can assist by holding Anchors in place for the Wielder to line up and destroy multiple Anchors with a single use, minimizing the amount of Carnifex the party has to deal with.
If the Wielder dies or disconnects, the Artifact is dropped on the floor, in which another player can pick it up to become its new Wielder.
Once all 9 Anchors of Hate have been destroyed, the room is completed. The two braziers near the exit light up and the door is pulled up, allowing the party to proceed.
🛡️ In Guild Raids, the Anchors actively held by non-Wielder players cannot be destroyed by the Artifact's dash. Anchors also bury themselves 1 second faster when not actively held.
Buff Room 3

The third buff room takes place in the cavity directly underneath the Spire, with a corruption sigil connecting to the buff pedestals. A red crystal is visible on the ceiling, beaming out the red beacon seen radiating out of the Spire.
-> All players must choose a buff

Unlike other raids which offers you a 'Tier III buff' at this point, the party is instead given a §set of debuffs. All players in the party are forced to pick one to take for themselves. The raid timer ticks down until everyone has made their choice, after which the timer pauses again and the exit is opened.
For repairing Crafted equipment, a Blacksmith Devil is located on the floor opposite the "buff" chests, unresponsive yet functional.
The Spire's Crown (Anathema)
-> Put an end to War.
Epilogue
After Anathema has fallen, she will be lying down in front of the exit rift, slowly blinking as her central pupil follows the Player. They can choose to have a final conversation with her.
After the Player's conversation with Anathema concludes, her central pupil droops before the eye closes.
Interacting with Anathema again following a conversation indicates her death.
- …what remained of her spark has faded. She is gone.

intro.text: The Abyssal Shine is a Cave found in the Canyon of the Lost.

lines.text: The cave has several Shimmerstalks and Glowing Moths at the start. Eventually, a Tier 1  Loot Chest will be found halfway through the cave. At the end of the cave is a Tier 3  Loot Chest that can only be opened if the Abyssal Seal is killed.

intro.text: Ancestor Grotto is a  Cave found on the Coastal Trail.

lines.text: Ancestor Grotto only has one room filled with many Weak Zombies and Zombie Archers. Additionally, the Corrupted Salted, Corrupted Jumla, and Corrupted Grian mobs, which are references to the founders of Wynncraft, appear here. There is a Tier 1 Loot Chest inside of the tent. Following the path on the right will lead to a Tier 3 Loot Chest that unlocks after slaying 3-4 mobs.
- The old-timers mentioned by the description are the 3 founders of Wynncraft, Salted, Jumla, and Grian.

intro.text: Ancient Arthropods is a Cave found in the Frog Bog subregion of the Auburn Forest.

lines.text: The cave branches off into two separate paths at the start. Several Muck Mozzies and Mud Crawlers will attack the Player, the latter of which can poison them. On each path is a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 4 mobs to be killed. A path over the colossal amber-covered millipede connects the two paths. The two paths eventually unify at the end, leading to a miniboss arena with the Primordial Phasmid. Killing the phasmid results in the Tier 4  Loot Chest in the middle of the arena opening.

intro.text: The Angel Falls are a Cave in the Sky Islands.

lines.text: The cave instantly splits into 2 paths, both leading to separate challenges to different loot chests, meaning both paths have to be complete in order to get the reward chest if it's your first clear.
Left Path
The left path is a quick parkour. At the end of the parkour is a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 4 nearby mobs to be killed.
Right Path

The cave's right path is a small boss arena with the Angel of Agony, which has 4 phases. Several Youthful Angels spawn as minions throughout the fight. Once the Angel of Agony is defeated, they will drop the Angelic Blasting Gel, which is required to be used on the door to open it, revealing the path to a Tier 4  Loot Chest.

intro.text: The Aquaculture Aquifer is a Cave found in the Avos Territory. It is one of the caves required to unlock The Corkus Traversal lootrun.

lines.text: This cave has two entrances, one being the main entrance and the other being a secondary one found south of it. Both paths will converge near the start, leading to a prosperous farm underneath. The farm has a maze-like structure, with some dead ends being found at some points. At the end of the maze section, it will be fairly linear, revealing the famine hidden within the farm. At the end of the cave is an arena with a Plague Bot-1346 that must be killed to access the Tier 4  Loot Chest.

intro.text: Auburn Lumbermill is a  Cave found east of Espren in the Auburn Forest.

lines.text: After entering the Lumbermill and turning right, the first Tier 3  Loot Chest can be found at [-1824, 8, -1024]. Alternatively, the chest can be reached through an alternate entrance located west of the chest. A Mill Warden is found inside the house, who must be defeated to umlock the chest. Mill Wardens in the cave drop Lumbermill Keys, which are needed to unlock the final chest. The second Tier 3  Loot Chest is located at [-1827, 9, -981], behind a building. It is guarded by several Lumberjacks, a Timberlift and a Mill Warden. The Mill Warden must be defeated to unlock the chest. The last Tier 3  Loot Chest can be found underground at [-1856, 4, -912], the underground entrance being south of the second Tier 3  Loot Chest. It is also guarded by a Mill Warden and several Lumberjacks and Timberlifts. Killing the Mill Warden will unlock the chest. After defeating 3 Mill Wardens to get 3 Lumbermill Keys, going to [-1853, 6, -991] and putting the keys in will unlock an entrance to a Tier 4  Loot Chest. Killing a Lumbermill Mechanism inside will unlock the Tier 4  Loot Chest.

intro.text: The Avos Animation Totem is a level 98 Cave found in the Scraplands. It is one of the caves required to unlock The Corkus Traversal lootrun.

lines.text: Despite this cave being labeled as a normal cave, it functions more similarly to a Boss Cave. The only sections in this cave are the boss arena and the rewards room. The main boss of this cave is the eponymous being that resides within. Unlike most other mobs, the totem has a wide array of unique spells.
Category:Boss Caves

intro.text: The Azer Athenaeum is a Cave found in the Lower Molten Heights.

lines.text: The cave is mostly a straightforward path to the end. After doing some parkour, you will arrive in the final room which has a Tier 2  Loot Chest and a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires the miniboss of the cave, the Azer Taskmaster, to be killed.

intro.text: The Azurite Island is a Cave found in the Sky Islands. It is one of the caves that must be completed in order to unlock the Sky Islands Exploration Lootrun.

lines.text: The start of the cave is an open hollow with several Gem Aberrants and Crystalline Irregularities, along with their source of the Absurd Azurite. Below the crystal is a Tier 3 Loot Chest that requires it to be destroyed in order to open it. Continuing upwards will lead on to the next section of the cave.
| Gem Aberrant
| Melee
| Blindness Immune Knockback Immune Slowness Immune
| Azurite Island, Azurite Hollow
| Crystalline Irregularity
| Ranged (Flying)
| Azurite Island, Azurite Hollow
| Absurd Azurite
| Melee (Stationary)
| Explode Heal
| Azurite Island, Azurite Hollow

The main path from the spire will lead to a small house which has the madman who stole the crystal, the Bijou Bandit. Inside the house is also a Tier 4 Loot Chest that requires them to be killed. Inside the hideout will also be a Tier 2 Loot Chest.
| Bijou Bandit
| Burst Ranged
| Wave Charge
| Azurite Island, Bijou Hideout

intro.text: Bandit Groundbreaking is a Cave found in the Gylia Plains near the Kander Forest.

lines.text: The cave is mostly a straightforward path to the end. There is a quick section of parkour near the end. At the end of the cave is a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 6 nearby mobs to be killed to open it.

intro.text: The Basalt Basin is a Cave found in the Dernel Jungle.

lines.text: The cave starts off with an immediate access to a Tier 1  Loot Chest. Continuing on the path will be a Tier 2  Loot Chest found in lava. A hidden Tier 2  Loot Chest can be found on top of some mushrooms in the more green area. Continuing on will lead to a Tier 2  Loot Chest found after some brief parkour is done. There will be a Magmatic Flamebelcher in this section, but it should be ignored as it is unkillable. Lava geysers will also appear by the flamebelcher, but they are purely cinematic. Continuing on the path will be a Tier 1  Loot Chest leading to the end, which has a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 14 nearby mobs to be killed. Rarely, a Suspicious Spot mob will appear at the end.

intro.text: The Bird Sanctuary is a Cave found in the Dernel Jungle.

lines.text: The start of the cave has several Deranged and Possessed Parrots. A Tier 1  Loot Chest is found at the entrance as well. As you turn around, there will be a Tier 1  Loot Chest on the wall, as well as a Tier 2  Loot Chest being found in the center of the second section. By the entrance to the next room is a Tier 1  Loot Chest. Kill the Suspicious Soil to move on to the next room.

As you fall down into the next room, a Tier 2  Loot Chest is behind you. As you continue onward, a small boss arena will appear with a Tier 3  Loot Chest at the end which requires the Tropical Necromancer to be killed.

intro.text: The Blaze Springs are a Cave found in the Canyon of the Lost.

lines.text: The cave is mostly a straightforward path to the end. Halfway through the cave is a Tier 1  Loot Chest. As you continue through some quick parkour, the end of the cave will have a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 10 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: The Blazing Oasis is a  Cave found near the Abandoned Mines.

lines.text: This cave is a long, overgrown tunnel that leads through several chambers.
Mossy Chambers

The first chamber is filled with Giant Weevils (Lv. 12) and Bushwhackers (Lv. 15), while the path forward is guarded by a single Guzzler (Lv. 14). The following tunnel has a short split, and a Tier 2  Loot Chest can be found on the left side. Shortly afterwards is the second chamber, which has a Guzzler (Lv. 14) at the entrance and stronger Giant Weevils (Lv. 16) and Bushwhackers (Lv. 19) alongside the lower-level versions. The path to the next chamber has a Guzzler (Lv. 18) positioned in the way. The third chamber contains Hosts, as well as the previously encountered Giant Weevils (Lv. 12) and Giant Weevils (Lv. 16). There is also a Tier 2  Loot Chest hidden in the tall grass on the right side of the room. The entrance to the final chamber is guarded by another Guzzler (Lv. 18).
Fiery Chamber

This chamber shows evidence of corruption with fire and corrupted stone appearing. Blazing Hosts and the Hothead are corrupted mobs that appear here. A Tier 2  Loot Chest is hidden to the left side of the room in the vegetation. Next to the exit, there is a Tier 4  Loot Chest that unlocks after slaying 4-5 nearby mobs.

intro.text: The Blind Burrow is a Cave found in Void Valley. It is one of the caves that must be completed to unlock the Silent Expanse Expedition lootrun.

lines.text: The cave is mostly a straightforward path to the end. At the end of the cave is a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires 6 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: The Boar Burrow is a  Cave found on the north side of Mount Wynn.

lines.text: This cave is a long tunnel filled with Cave Boars, Undead Explorers, and Mud Brutes. There is a Tier 2  Loot Chest hidden behind a boulder right at the beginning of the cave. Further into the cave, there is a secret shortcut on the wall, between a small pond and a light blue tent. The short cut has a small parkour, but it has no mobs and leads directly to the end of the cave. Alternatively, following the main path will lead to a Tier 1  Loot Chest. The path will eventually reach a water stream that must be swam down to the end of the cave. Near the exit door of the cave is a Tier 4  Loot Chest, which unlocks after slaying 1 nearby Mud Brute.

intro.text: The Bovine Bedrock is a Tower found in the Gylia Plains.

lines.text: The tower is mostly a vertical climb to the top. Several Armless Bedrocks and Bedrock Bisons will attack you as you climb up. A small river has several Ossified Tourotos as well as a Tier 2  Loot Chest. As you parkour up to the top, there will be a Tier 1  Loot Chest on the way. At the very top of the tower is a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires the miniboss of the tower, the Cow King, to be killed to open it.
Category:Towers

intro.text: Breaking Ice is a Cave found in the Nesaak Tundra.

lines.text: The first room of this cave is a simple passage to the end of the first section, ending with a room with a prompt that says to place Large Rocks there. Large Rocks can be dropped from the Shivering Skeletons and Hailstorms inside the cave. 9 Large Rocks are required to progress.
The second room is a simple boss arena with a Tier 3  Loot Chest within that requires the miniboss of the cave to be killed: the Snow Storm.

intro.text: The Broodmother's Bestiary is a Tower found in the Canyon of the Lost.

lines.text: The tower has a linear, yet complex structure. Several harpies will attack you as you progress, and you will eventually arrive at the nest of the Harpy Broodmother. Once the broodmother is defeated, the Harpy Key will drop from her and reveal the path to a Tier 4  Loot Chest.
Category:Towers

intro.text: The Builder-Bot Central is a Cave found in the Corkus Plateaus. It is one of the caves that must be completed in order to unlock The Corkus Traversal lootrun.

lines.text: The first section of the cave is guarded with several B500-Mason Bots, before a section with several Boom Stones and T-1000 Tunnel Borgs. A spiral parkour will have Bricklayer-1000s along with a Tier 2  Loot Chest.

At the top of the parkour will be a small corridor with a Tier 3  Loot Chest and a Crazed Machinist that must be defeated to open the chest. Several Bricklayer-1000s and B500-Mason Bots will attack you as you progress. A hidden Tier 2  Loot Chest can be found on the way to the next section.

A parkour section will then appear with several Orinthopters attacking you as you move along. A Tier 2  Loot Chest is found on an out of the way structure at the beginning. Near the end of the parkour, a Tier 3  Loot Chest will be there that requires a nearby Orinthopter to be defeated.

The final section of the cave will have several Bricklayer-1000s, B500-Mason Bots, and 1900-Drill Bots being in the way to the end. The section ends at a boss arena with an Architect-430, which must be killed to open the exit to the cave as well as a Tier 4  Loot Chest.

intro.text: The Burning Bog is a Cave Complex found in the Gylia Plains.

lines.text: Shortly after the start of the cave, it will split into 2 paths. The left path will be a parkour, while the right path will be a battling section with a little bit of parkour. On the right path, several Stone Bogs will pelt at you from a distance, while the blue stone platform will spawn Cobble Bogs. At the end of the right path is an Inflamed Peat, which drops the Fiery Remains needed to get to the end. At the end of the first room there will be a Tier 3  Loot Chest, alongside the entrance to the second room and an exit.

The second room is a Lv. 85 area, with it being a miniboss arena requiring you to defeat both minibosses there, Brothers Incineration and Combustion. Both brothers drop Blazing Orbs, which need to be placed into the white circles near the door to open it. In the rewards room is a Tier 3  Loot Chest.
Category:Cave Complexes

intro.text: The Burning Delve is a Cave found in the Canyon of the Lost.

lines.text: The cave immediately has a split path. The left path has a much simpler path to the end, with 2 Tier 2  Loot Chests being found along the way. The right path will lead to a hard parkour that leads to a Tier 2  Loot Chest. The end of the cave has a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 8 nearby mobs to be killed. A Tier 2  Loot Chest can be found near the exit as well.

intro.text: Caged Creatures is a Cave found in Void Valley. It is one of the caves required to unlock the Silent Expanse Expedition lootrun.

lines.text: The first room of the cave has several Adult Lidins attack you as a Volatile Host hangs in the cage above. Walking under the cage will free the host, and when it is killed several Lidin Fledglings will attack you. Three Explosive Masses must be harvested from them in order to progress.

The room starts off as a simple passage to the end, with several Lidin Caretakers attacking you. At the ending room, three Volatile Hosts hang from cages above you, which are released by walking under them. All three Volatile Hosts must be killed to open the Tier 4  Loot Chest, and 10 Explosive Masses must be gathered from the Lidin Fledglings that are in their body to open the exit.

intro.text: The Captain's Quarters is a  Cave found in Pirate's Bay.

lines.text: This cave is a series of three rooms connected by tunnels. The first two rooms have a circular path, with one half of the path being raised up over a tunnel. Cadaverous Pirates and Mutineers spawn throughout the entire cave, while the Drunk Captain only appears at the end. There is a Tier 4  Loot Chest on top of a pile of treasure which unlocks after slaying the Drunk Captain.
Category:Cave

intro.text: The Carnadile Den is a Cave found in the Troms Jungle.

lines.text: At the entrance there will be a Tier 2  Loot Chest. Following this is a passage to the end with several Carnadiles attacking you on the way. At the end is a Carnagator who must be killed to open a Tier 3  Loot Chest.

intro.text: The Cave Springs is a  Cave found in the Nemract Swamp.

lines.text: This cave is a long tunnel filled with natural springs. Several small alcoves can be found along the way with Swamped Cadavers inside them. Biting Bugs appear throughout the cave. Deeper in the cave, Turtles, Mudslingers, and more Swamped Cadavers can be found around the larger springs. A large pit is found close to the end. This can be deadly due to high number of mobs that fall down and the limited options of escape. There is a Tier 4  Loot Chest at the end which unlocks after slaying 10-12 nearby mobs.

intro.text: The Cave of Doom is a Cave found in the Lower Molten Heights. It also serves as a Grind Spot.

lines.text: A Tier 1  Loot Chest can be found near the main grinding area. In the center of the cave is a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires 20 nearby mobs to be killed to open it.

intro.text: The Cave of the Seasons is a Cave found in the Realm of Light.

lines.text: Following the drop is a room without hostile mobs. The only thing to do is kill the Chlorophyll Parasites in order to open the door. You can also leave the Chlorophyll Munchers alone or kill them.
Once the four Chlorophyll Parasites are dead, the door to the Summer Room will open.

In the first part of the Summer Room, the player must go through a tunnel filled with Cherry Cruxes. A Tier 2  Loot Chest can be found near the start, and a Tier 3  Loot Chest is found halfway through this section, requiring 3 nearby mobs to be killed.
In the second part of Room 2, the player needs to kill 5 Sunflowers to unlock the door. The Sunflowers are passive mobs with no AI, but plenty of other mobs spawn that will attack you.
At the start of the Fall Room there is a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires 4 nearby Sunflowers to be defeated.

The Fall Room is mostly a parkour section. Several Flying Foxes and Thigh Threshers will attack you as you progress. At the end of the room there are two Tier 3  Loot Chests, one requires you to kill 3 nearby mobs to open it while the other requires you to finish the parkour. You can exit the cave through here, or you can continue to the level 95 area of the Winter Room.

The Winter Room is a boss arena with the Rink Master being the main enemy found here. The Rink Master must be killed in order to access the chamber with two Tier 4  Loot Chests. The Rink Master's second phase shouldn't be attacked, as its a survival phase instead of an attacking phase.
Category:Cave Complexes

intro.text: The Chiseler's Cavern is a Cave found in the Canyon of the Lost.

lines.text: The cave is mostly linear. At the start of the bridge to the ending section is a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires 10 nearby mobs to be killed. On a blue island in the lake below is a Tier 1  Loot Chest. If you are on your first run of this cave, the rewards chest will spawn in the stone structure near the end.

intro.text: The Corkus Quarry is a Cave found in the Corkus Plateaus. It is one of the caves that must be completed in order to unlock The Corkus Traversal lootrun.

lines.text: The quarry is a long hopper-shaped cave. The first layer has a dug out section with a LAZER Driller and a Tier 2  Loot Chest, along with a Tier 1  Loot Chest found at the opposite end of the entrance. The second layer has a Tier 2  Loot Chest found in the first dugout area, along with a Tier 1  Loot Chest found near a barricade. An alcove on the path to the stairs down will have a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 11 nearby mobs to be killed. At the bottom level of the cave, there will be a section with a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 6 nearby mobs to be killed. At the very end of the cave is a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires the LAZER Driller found at the end to be killed.

intro.text: The Corrupt Time Warp is a  Cave found in Time Valley. The crystal warps the player into the past and shows the decay of an Olmic temple as it approaches the present.

lines.text: The cave entrance is a short tunnel to doorway holding a mysterious purple crystal. There are no mobs and very few features except for Corruption spikes and some old stone ruins. Touching the purple crystal will warp the player to the next stage.

After warping, the cave is now a stone hallway in pristine condition and no mobs. Several dark gray statues line the walls on both sides of the corridor, and the torches have an unusual pink and blue color. At the end of the hall is a large, sealed door, as well as the same purple crystal from before to warp to the next stage.

This is the same hallway as the previous stage, but at a much later point in time. It has started to deteriorate and become overgrown with vines. The straight pathway through the hallway is now obstructed with rubble, and a new side path to the left has opened up instead. The statues from Stage 2 have become animated Ancient Sentinels, which also have noticeable overgrowth on them. Stolid Remnants, pieces of animated rubble, will also attack. Towards the end is a brief parkour that must be completed while an Ancient Watcher fires projectiles at the player. Touching the crystal warps the player to the next stage once again.

In the same hallway at an even later point in time, the Corruption has arrived and began to consume the temple. More Ancient Sentinels and Stolid Remnants defend the tunnel. The rubble that blocked the hall is gone, replaced with a large hole. This can be crossed using a parkour, while the path to the left holds a Tier 2 Loot Chest. A later section of the hallway is now blocked by corruption spikes, but another new path has opened on the right side. The new path is entirely parkour, with an Ancient Watcher and a Tier 1 Loot Chest on the platform in the center. At the end of the path there is a Tier 3 Loot Chest that unlocks after slaying 10-13 nearby mobs. There is one final parkour guarded by an Ancient Watcher to reach the crystal and warp to the next stage.

The final stage of the cave has the hallway completely overrun with Corruption. The path is once again blocked, this time with corruption spikes, so the path to the left is required to progress. The Ancient Sentinels have also become corrupted and more powerful, with both Sentinels and Stolid Remnants continuing to guard the halls after so much time has passed. Most of the parkour is similar to the previous stage and is still defended by Ancient Watchers. The sealed doorway at the end has finally been breached by a corrupted spike. A Tier 4 Loot Chest is found in front of the door, unlocking after slaying 3 nearby mobs. Inside the door is a Tier 2 Loot Chest in a pile of treasure, as well as a large purple crystal on the wall that has a similar appearance to the small crystal encountered up to this point. Going near this crystal will warp the player one final time back to the entrance of the cave in the present.

- Behind the cave entrance at -333, 68, -1276 is a secret cranny that has a skull along with a sign that reads "Re--mb-- o-- le---- f--ls w-- i--e-it th-- pl--e...". The missing letters can be readded to reveal the message: "Remember our legacy fools who inherit this place..."
- This message was left by the Olm.

intro.text: The Corruption Mines is a  Cave found in the Roots of Corruption.

lines.text: Entrance

The start of the cave leads to a small room with several Collapsing Miners. Immediately to the right is an alcove, from which two Stonecrushers emerge, and in the center of the room there is a Fiery Demolisher firing projectiles. On top of a scaffold to the right is a Tier 2  Loot Chest, which can be accessed by jumping between the wooden stakes on the ground. A large Corrupted Claimer blocks the doorway to the next room. This room is similar to the first and has the same mobs. Another Fiery Demolisher fires from a high vantage point near the entrance, and Collapsing Miners also appear in the room. There is a long wooden path that winds around the edge, with two more alcoves on the right, each one holding 2 Stonecrushers. The doorway to the next section is blocked by another Corrupted Claimer.
Muddy Tunnel

The tunnel continues through a muddy area with many slow-moving Mud Sloughers. Two hidden alcoves harbor a single Muckwrecker each, and the alcove towards the back on the left side has a Tier 1  Loot Chest as well. There is a hole at the end of the tunnel that drops down to the next and final section of the cave.
Boss Arena

This room is a small arena with the Infernowight miniboss. Additionally, many Collapsing Miners and 3 Fiery Demolishers, one on each side and another above the arena at the back, provide support by firing projectiles. Defeating the miniboss unlocks a Tier 4  Loot Chest, which is found near the exit door that is accessible by following a path on the right side of the arena.

intro.text: Crab Fighters is a  Cave found on the Coastal Trail near Katoa Ranch.

lines.text: This cave is a moderately-sized arena that is filled with Katoa Crabs and Katoa Crabs. Four Corrupted Crab Guards stand on podiums surrounding a larger, central podium holding the Corrupted Crab Master miniboss. Near the exit is a Tier 4  Loot Chest that unlocks after slaying 12-13 nearby mobs. Additionally, there is a Tier 2  Loot Chest high up on the eastern wall of the cave.

intro.text: The Cryovern Covert is a Cave found in the Freezing Heights.

lines.text: The cave starts with a path that leads to a downwards path. A Tier 2  Loot Chest is found partway through the path. Some parkour will eventually be reached. At the end of the parkour is a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires 3 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: Crypt Excavation is a  Cave found on the edge of the Nivla Woods near Elkurn.

lines.text: The entrance room of the cave has a Tier 1  Loot Chest alongside Zombie Miners and Skeleton Miners. At the end of the tunnel is a ladder that goes down to the next room, as well as some Abnormal Miners.

The second room of the cave is a maze with the appearance of a crypt. There is a Tier 2  Loot Chest hidden behind the ladder used to reach this area. Abnormal Miners appear in places in close proximity to the ladder, while Zombie Miners and Skeleton Miners are found everywhere in the crypt. Another Tier 2  Loot Chest can be found inside a tomb by taking the first left to reach [-10, 30, -1400]. The room at [-13, 46, -1446], adjacent to the largest chamber with fours tombs, has a Tier 4  Loot Chest. This chest unlocks after slaying 8-12 mobs. The Miner Chef also appears in this room. This cave does not have an exit portal; the only way out is through the entrance.

intro.text: The Crystal Caverns is a  Cave found in the Almuj Desert.

lines.text: The cave begins with a group of tunnels that are full of Death Worms and Desert Crawlers. Following the left-side leads to an alternate cave opening at [1181, 78, -2176], while following the right-side leads to a large room holding some ruins. This room additionally has Sand Golems (Melee) and Sand Golems (Ranged) alongside the previous mobs. The tunnel at the back of the room will lead to the second floor of the cave, or there is a straight drop directly below the crane.

The deeper floor of the cave is covered in purple crystals that have also infected any living beings found here. The initial chamber contains Crystallized Miners (Purple) and a stronger Crystallized Miner (Gold). Continuing through the cave will lead to several abandoned buildings which do not shows signs of age, suggesting that they were built closer to the present time. This area contains Crystallized Miners (Purple), Sand Golems (Melee), Sand Golems (Ranged), and Crystallized Scarabs. Additionally, the Hidden Bandit secret mob can be found in one of the structures at [1059, 12, -2101]. Somehow, the Bandit has avoided becoming infected, unlike the other mobs found around the crystals. At the very end of the cave there are Crystal Fanatics and the Crystal Fanatic Leader miniboss. Near the Fanatics is a Tier 4 Loot Chest that unlocks after slaying 9-10 nearby mobs. To reach the exit of the cave, follow the path that circles above the arena.

intro.text: The Crystalline Polynya is a  Cave found in the Ocean near the Ice Islands.

lines.text: The initial room of the cave has Crystal Hermits and a Tier 1  Loot Chest. After this, there is a split path. The left path contains Cryo-shell Crawlers and Crystal Seers. There is an additional blockade of four Crystal Seers before the final room of the cave. The right path has no mobs and is a brief parkour over a wooden bridge. Falling off the bridge will teleport you back to the start of the parkour. Both paths lead to the final chamber, which is filled with more Cryo-shell Crawlers. The Tier 4  Loot Chest unlocks after slaying 10-12 nearby mobs, and there is additional Tier 1  Loot Chest right in front of the exit door.

intro.text: The Cultists Passage is a Cave found in the Pre-Light Forest. It also serves as a passage to the Light Forest.

lines.text: At the very start there is a Tier 2  Loot Chest. Several Rapid Deadeyes and Swordsman Guards will attack you as you progress. Eventually, Raksdens Cultists will appear, and at the very end tucked away into a crevice on the left side of the cave is a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 15 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: The Cyclonic Spirit Trap is a Cave found in the Canyon of the Lost.

lines.text: The cave is a straightforward path to the end. You will run by several Spirits of the Lost before ending up at the end, which has a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires the Cyclonic Seal to be killed to open it.

intro.text: The Cyclopes's Shrine is a Cave found in the Canyon of the Lost.

lines.text: The cave has several Cyclopes found all over the cave except on the bridge, where trolls will spawn instead. At the end of the cave is a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 5 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: The Dead Man's Dugout is a  Cave found southwest of Half Moon Island in the Ocean.

lines.text: Cursed Pirates and Cliff Bats are mostly present in the dugout. The main area is where Captain Nomor Beard is present, in which defeating him is required to unlock the Tier 4  chest and complete the cave.

intro.text: The Demolition Derby is a Cave found in the Canyon of the Lost.

lines.text: The start of the cave quickly diverges into two paths, although they both also quickly converge right back into each other. At the end of the first section is a minecart which requires 4 Explosives to be put into it, which are dropped from Hobgoblin Demolitions. Once 4 Explosives have been placed into the minecart, the minecart will run off of the rails and explode the rubble underneath, revealing a small room with a Tier 4  Loot Chest inside that requires a nearby mob to be killed.

intro.text: The Derelict Mine is a  Cave found in the Maltic Plains.

lines.text: The entrance to the cave has a large sign that reads "DO NOT ENTER", along with a smaller sign with red text that also reads .

A brief stairway down will lead to a bridge, where a Zombie Archer attacks from the scaffolding in the chasm. Decaying Zombies are found throughout the entire tunnel, while Putrid Zombies are found towards the end of the cave. At the end, there is a Tier 3  Loot Chest which unlocks after slaying 3-4 nearby mobs.

intro.text: The Deserter's Camp is a Cave found in the Canyon of the Lost.

lines.text: The cave starts as a large plunge into water as you climb up through the cave. At the very base of the cave is a Tier 2  Loot Chest. At the top of the cave is a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires 17 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: The Detlas Salt Mine is a  Cave found in the Detlas Suburbs.

lines.text: The entrance to the cave has several Black Bats and a Tier 2  Loot Chest right in the middle of the tunnel.

Following the cave will lead to a horizontal corridor with three different paths: the left, middle-left, middle-right, and a dead-end all the way on the right. The left and middle-right paths can be used to reach the end of the cave.
Left Path

This path has no mobs and leads to a broken minecart puzzle that is currently impossible to complete. This puzzle used to consist of guiding a minecart through a rail, using items to hold down pressure plates to choose the path that the minecart takes. Jumping off the ledge at the end will lead to the end of the cave.
Middle-Left Path

This path will lead to a Tier 2  Loot Chest overlooking a chasm. Although the path appears to lead to a different area, it is blocked by an invisible barrier, and back-tracking is required to continue.
Middle-Right Path
The third path has a wooden bridge to cross the chasm and reach the end of the cave. There is a small teleport at the end of the bridge that will dismount players from horses.
End
The ending of the cave is a large open room with a wooden scaffolding wrapping around the wall from the middle-right path. There is a Tier 3  Loot Chest that unlocks after slaying 10-12 mobs.

Taking the exit door behind the Loot Chest will teleport the player to the dead-end room from the earlier crossroad. There are several Miner Zombies and a tent in this room. To exit the cave, simply follow the left wall out of the room.

intro.text: The Dragon Delta is a Cave found in the Lower Molten Heights.

lines.text: Bronchial
The first boss in the delta is the Bronchial. Several Animated Dragonbones and Suspicious Eggs will serve as minions in the fight. A Tier 3  Loot Chest is rewarded for killing it.
Dissolved Chevalier

The second boss in the delta is the Dissolved Chevalier, which constantly fires projectiles at an extremely fast rate at you. It has some Draconic Wizards and Animated Dragonbones to assist it. A Tier 3  Loot Chest is rewarded for killing it.
Grume

The third boss in the delta is the Grume. While it is slow, it also is a heavy hitter. No minions spawn during its fight, nor will they spawn in any others from here. A Tier 3  Loot Chest is rewarded for killing it.
Dissolved Pyromancer
The fourth boss in the delta is the Dissolved Pyromancer. It moves at a fast pace and has flamethrower. A Tier 4  Loot Chest is rewarded for killing it.
The Fragmented Creature
The final boss in the delta is the Fragmented Creature. It is a ranged mob that does a lot of damage per projectile. A Tier 4  Loot Chest is rewarded for killing it.

intro.text: The Dragonkin Nest is a Cave found in the Upper Molten Heights.

lines.text: There are five nests that each have a specific type of Dragonling. Several Dwarven Poachers are also here, as well as various Tier 1 and Tier 2 Loot Chests being dotted around the area. All 5 Dragonlings must be killed to get enough Newborn Scales to get into the center. They can also be obtained by killing the same dragonling repeadedly, but this is not advised because of thier long respawn timer.
