intro.text: The Drone's Retreat is a Cave found in the Canyon of the Lost near the Qira Hive.

lines.text: Several Hive Drones will attack you as you enter the cave. As a crossroads is reached, both paths will lead to different areas. The right path leads to an optional Tier 1  Loot Chest, while the left path continues to the end. At the end of the cave is a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires 15 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: The Dullahan Gardens is a Cave found in the Dark Forest in Castle Dullahan.

lines.text: The final room of this cave has a Tier 1  Loot Chest in a loot stash, alongside a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires 7 nearby mobs to be killed at the end of the cave.

intro.text: The Dust Bowl is a  Cave found in the Almuj Desert.

lines.text: The entrance drops into a small pond of water with Oasis Leeches nearby. There is also a Tier 1  Loot Chest beside the water. Following the path into the cave leads to an area with wooden support structures and crates, and it is filled with Desert Crawlers, Dry Zombies,  Spirited Dusts (Small),  Spirited Dusts (Big), and Greedy Miners. Towards the end of the room is a large hole with Sand Golems (Ranged) inside, followed by a short parkour that has both Sand Golems (Melee) and Sand Golems (Ranged) below. The end of the cave has a Tier 4  Loot Chest that unlocks after slaying 9-11 nearby mobs.

intro.text: Earth Eaters is a Cave found in the Pre-Light Forest.

lines.text: The cave starts with you going on a wooden path with Little Eaters underneath. At the end of the path is a Tier 1  Loot Chest. As you progress, you get to a brief parkour section, which then leads to the ending area, which has a Tier 2  Loot Chest against the wall and a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 10 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: Electrifying Outpost is a  Cave found in the central Auburn Forest.

lines.text: The very entrance of this cave is guarded by two Auburn Watchtower Arbalists, both of which must be killed to open a Tier 3  Loot Chest. An alternate entrance can be found at the southern part of the cave, where a rope leads into the lower level. Both entrances lead to a room with a rope in the center. Climbing up the rope leads to a higher level with a single arbalist. Jumping down the balcony onto the deck outside leads to another Tier 3  Loot Chest that also requires two arbalists to be killed. In that room is a rope that must be climbed. The rope leads to a roof, which is beneath another rooftop. Climbing another rope leads to the Thunder Captain's miniboss arena. The Tier 4  Loot Chest in the arena is unlocked upon killing the captain.

intro.text: The Elemental Hollow is a Cave found in the Dark Forest.

lines.text: As you progress through the cave, there will be a Tier 1  Loot Chest found on some wood platforms. Another Tier 1  Loot Chest is found on top of another wood platform, and by the waterfall to the next section is a Tier 2  Loot Chest. The section after has a hidden left path that leads to a Tier 2  Loot Chest. At the end of the cave is a Prismatic Geode miniboss alongside a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires 7 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: The Emerald Knives Hideout is a Cave found in between the Almuj Desert and Rymek Mesa.

lines.text: The cave starts off with a small section with Greedy Miners and Scarabs, along with a split path that leads to roughly the same area, being an opening with several aggressive Emerald Knives Bandits. Near the end there will be a bridge that will fall down, revealing the final section of the cave, the treasure room and a Tier 3  Loot Chest requiring 11 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: is a  Cave found Southeast of Aldwell in the Mistwoods.

lines.text: The central hole at the entrance stump leads to a large underground area inhabited by Entozoons. There are four Tier 3  Loot Chests in total; opened by killing various amounts of Entozoons.

Starting in a clockwise direction, directly in front of the exit is the first Tier 3  Loot Chest, unlocked by killing an Entozoon. Next, to the rightmost area of the cave is the second Tier 3  Loot Chest, unlocked by killing 2 Entozoons. Towards the right backside of the exit hole is the third Tier 3  Loot Chest, unlocked by killing 4 Entozoons. Lastly, to the immediate left behind the exit hole is the last Tier 3  Loot Chest, unlocked by killing 3 Entozoons.

intro.text: is a  Cave Complex found on the border between the Mistwoods and the Highlands.

lines.text: The entrance of the manor leads to a foyer with a pedestal. Three small basilisk statues must be collected and placed here to unlock the next section.
- One statue can be found at in the highest floor of the tower across the bridge, traversable via the adjoined tower connected to the left dining hall.
- One statue can be found on a high shelf at by taking the right main hallway and turning left into the fireplace room overlooking the dining hall.

- One statue can be found at by taking the right main hallway and climbing two flights of stairs to reach the master bedroom. Behind the wardrobe is a hidden pathway, enter the last room on the right to find an attic filled with statues. The basilisk statue is hiding between a bookshelf and a crate with its lid ajar. Alternatively, this statue can be reached by taking the west stairs on the highest floor of the tower directly connected to the dining hall.
Place all three basilisk statues on the pedestal at the entrance to unlock the basement.
A long flight of stairs leads to the final boss room, where Lord Estalis must be defeated to unlock a Tier 4 Loot Chest.

intro.text: The Eyeball Gauntlet is a cave found in the Eyeball Forest in the Silent Expanse. This cave can appear as a challenge in the Silent Expanse Expedition lootrun. Unlike other caves which tend to have a more linear structure, the main goal is to fill the altar before the rewards room with 6 Eyes, the eyes of which can be obtained from any eyeball. Most eyeballs give 1 Eye, but some can give 2.

lines.text: Inside the reward room are two Tier 3  Loot Chests and a Tier 4  Loot Chest. They are opened by filling up the altar with 6 eyes.

intro.text: The Fallen Passage is a level 32 Cave found in the Almuj Desert.

lines.text: The cave is mostly a simple passage to the end. Several Battle Beetles & Harvestmen will attack the player along the way. Near the end of the cave in a hollow ruins column is a Tier 3  Loot Chest which requires 10 nearby mobs to be killed in order to open it. Unlike other caves, the exit is found in the hole to the ground which leads to the Invaded Barracks.

intro.text: The Fallen Salient is a Cave found in the Dernel Jungle. It is the highest-level cave in Wynn.

lines.text: At the very start there is a Tier 1  Loot Chest, followed by another Tier 1  Loot Chest before entering the tunnel. At the end of the tunnel is a Tier 2  Loot Chest. After crossing the first set of wooden bridges, the path splits into two, with the right one leading to a Tier 2  Loot Chest and the left one continuing upwards across more wooden bridges with Corrupted Arbalests. After proceeding past the stone ruins, there is a Tier 2  Loot Chest in the tent and a  Tier 1  Loot Chest in the tent directly to the left, just before the next tunnel. After the second tunnel is a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires 7 nearby mobs to be killed. Before taking the exit, there is a Tier 2  Loot Chest in the stone tower along with a Suspicious Spot.

intro.text: Far From the Roots is a  Secret Discovery located on the Emerald Trail. This serves as an introduction to secret discoveries for new players; the Enzan's Brother  Quest leads here, and the discovery progresses simultaneously with the Corrupted Passageway  Cave.

lines.text: Kill the Corroded Key item mob located on the top of the nearby staircase to obtain a Corroded Key, then right click with it on the door. Continue down the corridor into the  Corrupted Passageway.
Clicking the door without the key will display the message:

intro.text: Fire & Water is a  Cave found on the Emerald Trail.

lines.text: This cave starts with a drop into a large room before diverging into separate water and fire themed paths. There is one Tier 2  Loot Chest at the top of a column of water, and another Tier 2  Loot Chest the end of a small parkour over lava.
Water Path
The water path is filled with Drenched Zombies. A stream of water in the middle of the tunnel acts as an obstacle while fighting the mobs.
Fire Path
The fire path has weaker Charred Zombies, but it also has lava and fire hazards. A Tier 1  Loot Chest can be found here, raised up on a small parkour.
Ending Section
The fire and water paths meet at the end of the cave, where there is a Tier 3  Loot Chest that unlocks after slaying 6-8 mobs.

intro.text: The Fire Swamp is a level 57 Cave found in the Olux Swamp.

lines.text: The lead-in to the cave is a tunnel to the actual cave below. Several Naga Fighters can be fought here. Patches of fire can also be seen, serving as an environmental hazard.

Within the cave are several Flame Geysers and Rats of Unusual Size, along with some more patches of fire and holes in the ground that deal around 10% of the player's max HP per every time it is landed in. Halfway through the cave is a Tier 3  Loot Chest which requires 7 nearby mobs to be killed. Further onward is a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires 10 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: The Flesh Mesh is a Cave found in the Kander Forest. It is a series of viscera pits scattered across the land.

lines.text: When you immediately drop down into the cave from the main entrance, a Taskmaster can be found alongside a Tier 2  Loot Chest. By sticking to the right path from this room there is a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 15 nearby mobs to be killed. Taking the second left on the path to the Tier 3 chest room from the main entrance room leads to a similar room with a Tier 2  Loot Chest.

intro.text: The Forgotten Excavation is a Boss Cave found in the Sky Islands. It is one of the caves that must be completed in order to unlock the Sky Islands Exploration Lootrun.

lines.text: The cave is mostly a quick straightforward path to the end. At the end of the path is the rampaging Excavated Golem. There is also a Tier 4  Loot Chest found in the same boss arena that requires the golem to be killed.
Category:Boss Caves

intro.text: The Fortress Catacombs are a Cave found in the Dark Forest.

lines.text: The start of the cave is a straight path until there is a fork in the road. Taking the right path will lead to an optional parkour that leads to a Tier 2  Loot Chest. The left path leads to a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 10 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: The Fungas Log is a  Cave found in the Nivla Woods.

lines.text: This cave is a tunnel through a decaying tree stump that is filled with Fungal Parasites (Brown) and Fungal Parasites (Red). A Tier 1  Loot Chest can be found just before the ending room of the tunnel, and Tier 2  and Tier 3  Loot Chests can be found in the final room before the exit. The Tier 3 Loot Chest unlocks after slaying 3-4 mobs.
Category:Cave

intro.text: The Gator Range is a Cave found in the Rymek Mesa.

lines.text: The range will have several small ponds with Mud Alligators in them. There are several dead ends in this cave, although the rails will lead you on the correct path. At the end of the cave is a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires 11 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: Geodesic is a Cave Complex found on Corkus Island.

lines.text: The start of the cave has a warning sign to not enter this cave. There are several Tier 1  and Tier 2  Loot Chests dotted across the cave. There are several geodes which have their own challenges.
In the geode found at -1369, 48, -3036 has a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 4 M-70 B Crystal Bots to be killed to open it.
In the geode found at -1434, 47, -3063 has a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires the Silicon Consumer to be killed to open it.
In the geode found at -1411, 67, -3093 has a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires the B-99 Unstable Bot to be killed to open it.
In the geode found at -1402, 60, -3032 has a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires an M-90 C Branch Bot to be killed to open it.
Category:Cave Complexes

intro.text: Gold Rush is a  Cave found in the Rymek Mesa. Access to the cave is blocked prior to helping Jankan in the Canyon Condor  Quest.

lines.text: The cave starts off with several Toxic Stone Dusts attacking you. You will then see some Dynamite and Unfortunate Miners before approaching a parkour section. After the parkour is completed, there will be some Gold Chunks needed for Canyon Condor alongside a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires a nearby mob to be killed to open it.

intro.text: The Gorgon Gorge is a level 80 Cave found in the Canyon of the Lost.

lines.text: The cave is a straightforward path to the end. There are some parkour segments found on the main path. The area near the end has a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 8 nearby mobs to be killed. Gorgon Dwellers are the only mobs that spawn in the cave.

intro.text: The Grook's Nest is a  Cave found in the Ragni Outskirts. This is the tutorial cave encountered in King's Recruit.

lines.text: This cave only has one room filled with 3 Angry Grooks. The Angry Grooks will fire projectiles at the player. At the center of the cave is a Tier 2 Loot Chest that can be opened by killing all 3 of the Angry Grooks.
| Angry Grook
| Grook's Nest
- Due to this cave being in the Ragni Outskirts, it is not included in the Content Book as it would prevent players that joined prior to the 2.1.1 update from 100% completion.
- During the HERO Beta when it was in the Content Book, it had the description "A group of angry Grooks have made their nest in this small cave."

intro.text: Guardians Cove is a Cave found in the Canyon of the Lost.

lines.text: The cave is mostly a straightforward path to the end. At the end of the cave is a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires 9 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: Half Moon Island is an enormous island-shaped  Cave found in the Ocean. It is located directly north of Almuj, or northeast of Nemract, and has a large amount of loot chests. It is also a good grinding spot for level 30+ players due to the high number of mobs that spawn on certain parts of the island.

lines.text: Entrance Beach

Traveling using the Seaskipper will take you directly to this beach. There is a short dock and several tents around a campsite, where Lunatic Devotes, Lunar Possessed, and Lunar Parasites are gathered. The final reward chest will also appear here once you have opened the 4 required Loot Chests at the other landmarks on the island. There are two paths found to the west; the left path leads to the Southern Tower, and the right path leads to the center of the island.
Central Island

The main part of the island has paths that lead to the 3 towers, each with a Loot Chest at the top. There are also many Tier 1  and Tier 2  Loot Chests scattered around the island and within ruined structures. More Lunatic Devotes, Lunar Possessed, and Lunar Parasites are found here, alongside Lunatic Interlopers and Lunatic Remnants. At the highest point in the middle of the island is the Lunar Effigy miniboss that uses the Heavy Push and Heavy Pull spells. There is a Tier 4  Loot Chest nearby that unlocks after defeating the Effigy.
South Tower

This tower is found at the southernmost end of the island. Inside is a stairway and ladder that lead up to a room with a Tier 1  Loot Chest and continuing up leads to the Lunar Effigy miniboss that uses the Meteor spell. Defeating the Effigy will unlock a nearby Tier 4  Loot Chest. The staircase can be followed down to an alcove with a Tier 1  Loot Chest, as well as a secret underground chamber with more Lunatic Devotes and a Tier 2  Loot Chest.
West Tower

This tower is found on a chain of smaller islands off of the main island's western shore. There are Lunatic Squids in the water surrounding these islands. On the first floor of the tower, there is a Tier 1  Loot Chest in a hole in the wall, and even further up the stairs is a Tier 2  Loot Chest in the wall. Climbing the staircase to the top leads to the Lunar Effigy miniboss that uses the Heavy Wave spell. A Tier 4  Loot Chest unlocks after slaying the Effigy.
Northeast Tower

On the northeast edge of the island, there is a tower with some parkour that uses invisible platforms indicated with particles. At the very top of the tower is a Tier 3  Loot Chest that unlocks after reaching the end of the parkour. The path leading down from the tower goes to a small beach where Lunatic Interlopers and Lunatic Remnants spawn.

intro.text: The Haze Cave is a Cave found in the Toxic Wastes. It is one of the caves required to unlock the Silent Expanse Expedition lootrun.

lines.text: The first room is a waiting section. Several Toxic Clouds will emerge from the crevices found in the walls. After you have survived for a while, a door will open, revealing a pad to bounce on to the next room.

The second room is a passage to the end. At the end of the passage is a large, open arena with several crevices in the walls. Toxic Clouds will emerge from them, and the miniboss of the cave will not spawn until a few seconds have gone up. The Toxic Creeper must be killed to unlock the Tier 4  Loot Chest at the end.

intro.text: Headless Hollow is a Cave found in Twain Lake.

lines.text: The cave has two chambers which each have a chest. The left chamber leads to nothing, while the right chamber has several mobs alongside a Tier 2  Loot Chest. Continuing straight from the entrance is a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires the Headless Horseman to be killed.

intro.text: The Hex Keep Gateway is a  Cave Complex found in the Detlas Suburbs.

lines.text: The first room is a large open area that has two Crystal Guardians atop of pedestals on either side. Both need to be killed in order to open the door.

Beyond the door is a Tier 2  Loot Chest and a parkour challenge with a single Hexed Soul in the middle. A Tier 3  Loot Chest is at the end, which unlocks after slaying a Hexed Soul. There are more Hexed Souls near the chest if the requirement had not been met. There is also an exit door to leave the cave at this point. An optional, more challenging parkour can be found in the middle, giving access to an extra Tier 2  Loot Chest, as well as a shortcut to the end of the third room through the floor.

This part of the cave features a long corridor with several Hexed Souls and Mistakes. At the end of the corridor is a grid of square platforms with a Tier 3  that unlocks after slaying 3-4 mobs. The second exit door is found behind this chest.

This room is a parkour on a grid of square platforms. Wooden barriers and Hex-Master Rooks serve to make it difficult to traverse. Falling off the platforms will cause an explosion that launches the player back up while also dealing 10% of the player's max health. At the end of the parkour maze is a Tier 4  Loot Chest that has no prerequisites to open.
Category:Cave
Category:Cave Complexes

intro.text: The Hill Hovel is a  Cave found in the Detlas Suburbs.

lines.text: There is a second entrance to the hovel at [220, 68, -1549]. The entrance floor of the hovel shows various living amenities and decorations, and it also houses a single Corrupted Charger. Towards the back of the hovel, a staircase can be found to reach the basement.

The basement is maze-like, with several Corrupted Slingers and Corrupted Chargers to fight. A Tier 1  Loot Chest can be found near the back. Going right from the stairs will lead to a Tier 3  Loot Chest which unlocks after slaying 5-6 mobs.

intro.text: The Holehold Orc Camp is a Cave found in the Llevigar Plains.

lines.text: At the very start of the cave there is a Tier 1  Loot Chest. It then winds down a path into the main part of the cave. An optional section will appear partway through, requiring you to do some parkour to reach the Tier 2  Loot Chest. Underneath the entrance to this section is also a hidden Tier 2  Loot Chest. At the end of the cave is a Tier 2  Loot Chest alongside some parkour, at the end of which is a Tier 3  Loot Chest requiring 7 nearby mobs to be killed. Hidden in the water below the parkour is another hidden Tier 2  Loot Chest.

intro.text: Ice Doors is a Cave found in the Nesaak Tundra.

lines.text: The cave starts off with a path leading to the first room. Inside will be a Tier 2  Loot Chest, several Icy Shards, and a Frozen Spirit. The Frozen Spirit will occasionally cast Push, but should not be killed, due to its high HP. Instead, a  Door Key will have a rare chance of dropping from an Icy Shard. When you get the key, you then use it on the doors, of which one will open at random.

Both doors' rooms start the same, being a simple passage to the miniboss, either the Corrupted Raider or Corrupt Icy Shard. Both minibosses will drop their token which is then needed to access the room containing the Tier 3  Loot Chest. Both minibosses must be defeated to complete the cave in the Content Book.

intro.text: The Jade Well is a Cave found in the Dernel Jungle.

lines.text: The cave's entrance is a drop down into a well. There will be a path leading to the end of the cave, with a more open area having a Tier 1  Loot Chest being tucked away into a corner of the area, while a Tier 2  Loot Chest is found on top of the massive jade spike. At the end of the cave is a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 11 nearby mobs to be killed.
Rarely, a Suspicious Spot mob can appear in the area with the Tier 1 and Tier 2 Loot Chests.

intro.text: The Jungle Fetish Camp is a Cave found in the Dernel Jungle. It is visited as one of the locations you go to in the quest Temple of the Legends to obtain the Aseado Leaf.

lines.text: Several Tribal Fetishes will attack you while the Fetish Shamans will reside in the tents, healing the other Fetishes. In the first tent is a Tier 1  Loot Chest. Getting to the middle section will show a split path, the right one leading to a Tier 2  Loot Chest. The left path leads directly to the last section, with a Tier 1  Loot Chest being out in the open and a Tier 3  Loot Chest being in the center that requires 11 nearby mobs to be killed. In the last section are also some Aseado Leaves, needed for the quest the Temple of the Legends. Unlike most other caves, there is no exit at the end. Rarely, Suspicious Spots can spawn at several locations in the cave.

intro.text: Jungle Horrors is a Cave found in the Troms Jungle.

lines.text: The cave is a passage to the end. The final section of the cave has several Bloodthirsty Fiends, a Tier 2  Loot Chest, and a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires 11 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: The Jungle Labyrinth is a Cave found in the Troms Jungle.

lines.text: The start of the cave is rife with Dead Miners. A Tier 1  Loot Chest can be found in the tent to the right. After the first fork in the road appears, going to the right into an alcove will reveal a Tier 2  Loot Chest. Going on the path to the left will lead to the end of the cave, with a Tier 4  Loot Chest being at the section that requires an Ancient Iboju Shaman to be killed to open it.

intro.text: The Junk Pit is a Cave found in the Scraplands. It is one of the caves required to be completed in order to unlock The Corkus Traversal lootrun.

lines.text: The pit is a large and dark maze-like structure. There are three Tier 3  Loot Chests hidden across the cave, one being on the eastern side of the cave, one being on the western side of the cave, and one near the end of the cave, and all require 8 mobs to be killed to open them. Below are the specific locations of each chest:

intro.text: The Kander Crypt is a Cave found in the Kander Forest.

lines.text: The first room of the cave has six coffins that can be pushed open. Some Corpse-Eating Mites will jump out of the coffin, though one grave will have a Stained Key that can be used to progress.

The next room's first section is a simple passage to the next room with coffins. Several Aggressive Ashes will attack you as you progress. In the next room, opening an iron coffin will reveal a Decayed Dragoon. To get to the ending room, jump on the wooden floor. Breaking it will unleash several Corpse-Eating Mites. In the room is a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 4 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: is a  Cave Complex found South of Hyloch, connected by highway to the city and Aelumia Citadel.

lines.text: Three Krisa Elders must be slain to obtain their dropped Osprey eyes, used to unlock the next section.
- A Krisa Elder can be found at in the large void pit immediately to the right of the main entrance hall. Killing this Elder unlocks a Tier 3 Loot Chest.
- A Krisa Elder can be found at in another void pit at the end of the central corridor from the main hall. Killing this Elder unlocks a Tier 3 Loot Chest.

- A Krisa Elder can be found at on the rooftop of the manor, surrounded by ospreys. From the main hall's entrance, this rooftop can be reached by taking the staircase at the end of the left hallway. Then, once on the second floor, enter the right room filled with pots and skeletons to find another staircase at the left turn. The top of this staircase leads to the rooftop. The next section's entrance is also located here. Killing this Elder unlocks a Tier 3 Loot Chest.

Once all three elders have been slain, bring the three eyes to the stone door to unlock Lady Krisa's study. From the staircase on the rooftop's manor, this door is located directly one floor down. Killing Lady Krisa unlocks the final Tier 4 Loot Chest.
(Note: Unlocking Lady Krisa's study door with the eyes starts a timer. If you don't enter before it expires, you'll be blocked from getting in.)

intro.text: The Lake Pit is a  Cave found in the Corrupted Plains.

lines.text: The entrance to the cave is a large pit in the center of a lake. There pit has a water stream at the bottom so you can safely drop down. Many Giant Termites and Chamber Lurkers can be found throughout the cave. Following the tunnel, there are frequent splits in the path that quickly rejoin, some of which lead through stone ruins. There are also some large root-like pillars that travel from the floor to the ceiling, although they do not seem to correspond with anything on the surface. Upon reaching the large granite chamber, heading up the left path leads to a Tier 2  Loot Chest. Tunnel Spiders replace the termites past this point. The cave continues for a little longer before reaching the end, where there is a Tier 4  Loot Chest that unlocks after slaying 10-12 nearby mobs.

intro.text: The Lamprophis Lair is a Cave found in the Sky Islands.

lines.text: The entrance of the cave quickly splits into two paths. The left path leads to a stone ruin with a Tier 2  Loot Chest, while the right path leads to the rest of the cave. Continuing straight to the end, the final room will be reached which contains a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 5 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: The Ledant Hill is a Cave found in the Pre-Light Forest. It can be involved in the quest All Roads to Peace if you choose to help Etemitoro.

lines.text: The hill is a complex maze that occasionally has some nest rooms with Ledant Grubs and Broodmothers. At the very end of the cave is a Ledant Queen alongside a Tier 4  Loot Chest that can only be opened if she is defeated.

intro.text: The Lily Pad Parkour is a Cave found in the Olux Swamp.

lines.text: The cave quickly splits into two paths, the left path will have larger platforms but will have Spitting Frog Spirits firing at you, while the right path will have smaller platforms but no mobs. After some more parkour, a Tier 4  Loot Chest will appear that requires 6 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: The Lion's Lair is a large  Cave in the Savannah, near Bremminglar.

lines.text: The final room of the cave; this is where the Pride Male Lion miniboss is fought. Several Lion Trainers, Wildcat Hunters, and Trained Lion Cubs are also found here. The Pride Male Lion has a lot of health, as well as heavy-hitting Multihit spells, which it combos with its Charge spells to catch the player off guard. The Tier 4  Loot Chest unlocks after defeating the miniboss. Two  Loot Chests are also found alongside it.

intro.text: The Loot Symposium is a Cave found in the Toxic Wastes. It is one of the caves required to unlock the Silent Expanse Expedition lootrun.

lines.text: The first room of the cave has some Toxamines in it, alongside what appears to be a Tier 1  Loot Chest. However, this loot chest is actually a Conaedi Guardian in disguise, and it will drop a Granitic Key when defeated, which is used to open the path to the second room.

The second room of the cave has what appears to be four Tier 1  Loot Chests, although like before, these are actually Conaedi Guardians in disguise. Two real Tier 3  Loot Chests are found within the cave, and both require two Conaedi Guardians to be killed, with each chest requiring a specific type. Four Granitic Keys must be given to open the exit.

intro.text: The Lovers' Cavern is a  Cave found in Ancient Nemract near Saint's Row.

lines.text: The entrance to the cave leads to a crypt where several Skeleton Brides and Zombie Fiances are found. Continuing down the tunnel leads to a small room with a parkour over some vines. Immobile Carnivorous Vines with high knockback can knock players that touch them to the ground below, where mobile Carnivorous Vines attack. At the end of the cave are several Concealed Earth Creatures and a Tier 4  Loot Chest that unlocks after slaying 3-4 of the aforementioned Creatures.

intro.text: The Lower Abandoned Mines is a  Cave found in the Abandoned Mines.

lines.text: The entrance of this cave utilizes a mechanical lift to access the lower section of the Abandoned Mines. The mines consist of a very large tunnel filled with Tunnel Spiders, Mine Crawlers, and Corrupted Cave Miners. Many supporting beams and blocked off-shoots line the cave. The tunnel winds around for a while before reaching the end, where there is a Tier 3  Loot Chest that unlocks after slaying 14-16 nearby mobs. The exit door of the cave is an ancient, ruined structure.

intro.text: The Lush Grotto is a  Cave found in the Ocean near Mage Island.

lines.text: This cave can be accessed by swimming through an underwater trench found near Mage Island. At the end of the trench is a mossy cave filled vegetation as well as many Shining Urchins and Lush Water Skaters. A Tier 1  Loot Chest is found right by the entrance. Additionally, heading to the beginning of the water stream on the left leads to a secret underwater alcove. Inside, there is a pufferfish and a Tier 2  Loot Chest. There is a short path to the end of the cave, where there is a Tier 4  Loot Chest that unlocks after slaying 6-7 mobs.

intro.text: Maddening Mud is a Cave found in the Olux Swamp.

lines.text: The cave is mostly a straightforward path to the end. Some wooden structures will collapse along the way as you do some parkour. At the end of the cave is a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires 5 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: The Mesquis Tower is a Tower found in the Kander Forest.

lines.text: The tower has several different floors with several Mesquises on each one. Below the stairs to the third floor, there is a Tier 1  Loot Chest. At the first outside level, continuing going straight will lead to a Tier 2  Loot Chest. Continuing through the parkour will lead to a hidden Tier 1  Loot Chest. At the very top of the cave is a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires 5 nearby mobs to be killed.
Category:Towers

intro.text: The Mossy Grotto is a  Cave found on the edge of Time Valley.

lines.text: This is an overgrown cave featuring an upper section and a lower section. A few Puffblooms guard the entrance.
Upper Section

This section has the most challenging parkour out of all of the caves prior. There are no mobs that spawn in this section. At the end of this section, there is a Tier 2  Loot Chest. Failing the parkour will drop the player into the lower section of the cave.
Lower Section

This section can be reached by jumping off from the upper section at any time. There is a wide river in the middle of the path so that the player can fall more safely. Many Puffblooms and Fallers are found throughout the section. Following the cave to the end will lead to more mobs, including Stumbling Fallers, and a Tier 3  Loot Chest, which unlocks after slaying 10-12 mobs.

intro.text: The Muddy Cavern is a  Cave found in the Nemract Swamp.

lines.text: The opening of the cave drops into a small mud puddle. Muddy Zombies appear throughout the entire cave. A single Continuing into the tunnel, a single Merlug can be found just past the ledge with the puddle on it, as well as a lone Mudslinger a little bit beyond that. At this point, there is a small, slightly hidden side tunnel to the right of the main path which has no mobs spawn in it. Both tunnels lead to the final room of the cave, an arena mostly surrounded with a moat of water. Rock Throwers and another Merlug appear here, alongside many Muddy Zombies. There is a Tier 4  Loot Chest just before the exit that unlocks after slaying 8-9 nearby mobs.
Category:Cave

intro.text: The Mycolite Mountain is a Cave found in the Sky Islands.

lines.text: In a side room from the entrance is a Tier 2  Loot Chest. In the room with the stone ruins, it will then become a parkour. At the end of the parkour is the path to the end of the cave, which has a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 5 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: The Mystifying Stump is a Cave Complex found in the Kander Forest.

lines.text: As you drop down into the cave, several Blacksoil Dwellers will attack you. After you get past them, a parkour segement is introduced. After the parkour is complete, there is some more battling before a more complex parkour appears. After arriving to the small ledge with a Putrifier on it, the path will split, with the left path leading to the first exit of the cave, while the right path leads to an optional Tier 2  Loot Chest. Near the first exit is a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 10 nearby mobs to be killed.

The first part of this section is some parkour, which then leads to a small arena to fight the main miniboss of the cave, the Plague Master. After the arena is some more quick parkour, leading to the final exit. Near this exit is a Tier 1  Loot Chest and a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires the Plague Master to be killed.
Category:Cave Complexes

intro.text: The Naga Dugout is a level 58 Cave found in the Olux Swamp.

lines.text: The cave is a small boss arena with several Naga Fighters within. The main boss of the cave is the Naga Commander, though unlike the others found in the swamp, this one has Ambush AI, which causes it to burrow underneath the ground in order to reach the player, which it will frequently do as it has very low walk speed. Once the commander is killed, the Tier 3  Loot Chest will open.

intro.text: The Natural Sanctuary is a Cave found in the Canyon of the Lost.

lines.text: The start of the cave has several Frog Men, Lurking Tadpoles, and Crocadilian Spearmen attacking the Player. A large open area will be reached soon after entering. A Tier 1  Loot Chest is found underneath the overhang, and a Tier 2  Loot Chest can be found directly east of the overhang on the upper level. On the large lily pad in the center of the room is a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 7 nearby mobs to be killed. A small opening in the ceiling of this area connects this cave with the nearby  Colossi Infection. After this area is a small tunnel leading to a miniboss arena. In the center of the arena is a Tier 3  Loot Chest requiring the Sanctuary Guardian miniboss to be killed. A hidden Tier 2  Loot Chest can be found in some vines at the upper-right corner of the arena towards the exit.

intro.text: Nest & Bones is a Cave found in the Lower Molten Heights.

lines.text: The entrance of the cave is found in the massive skeleton of the Ice Drake used to create the Freezing Heights. Once the parkour on the skeleton has been finished, a closed door will open when it is approached. The door can be found at [1461, 44, -5575]. Continuing into the cave will bring you to the end of it, which has a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 3 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: The Nymph Towers are a Tower found in the Light Forest.

lines.text: The eastern tower is mostly a climb with several Terra Nymphs attacking you along the way. At the very top of the tower is a Gust Nymph miniboss alongside a Tier 3 Loot Chest that requires you to kill it to open it.
| Terra Nymph

The western towers are an optional path you can take in this cave. The path to the top of the western towers is at the western-most tower. Several Terra Nymphs will attack you as you progress. Storm Nymphs will appear at the top of the towers, and at the end of the east tower of this set is a Tier 2 Loot Chest.

intro.text: Old Growth Rot is a  Cave found in the Nivla Woods.

lines.text: Several Resurrected Ragni Soldiers will appear around a tree with four corruption spikes around it. Every time five soldiers are killed, one of the spikes will be destroyed, indicated by the following message:
- One of the obsidian spikes have fallen.
Note: If the soldiers are killed too quickly, they may not register for the kill counter. It is recommended to avoid using area of effect spells when fighting the mobs.
When all four spikes have been destroyed, the following message will appear:
- An explosion can be heard from inside the tree!
Entering the newly formed opening at the base of the tree leads to a small room with two Tier 2  Loot Chests and a Tier 3  Loot Chest, the latter unlocking after slaying 20 mobs.

intro.text: The Orc Cove (also called the Secretcove Orc Camp) is a Cave found in the Llevigar Plains. It is visited in the quest  Blazing Retribution.

lines.text: The entrance to the cave is found beneath a lake. It is a simple passage to a quest area for Blazing Retribution.

intro.text: Overgrown Rubble is a Cave found in the Sky Islands.

lines.text: The cave's beginning is mostly a straight curvy path, but later on it will start to become harder to navigate due to the rubble. After the rubble is some quick parkour. Some more rubble will appear after the parkour, and some parkour after the rubble. Continuing through the path will be a small arena with the Cave Treguard in it, alongside a Tier 3  Loot Chest that can only be opened by killing it. Several Stone Cutter Moles are found in the same arena.

intro.text: The Ovine Spire is a Cave found in the Sky Islands. It is one of the caves that must be completed in order to unlock the Sky Islands Exploration Lootrun.

lines.text: The exterior of the cave is a straightforward path to the spire. Near the to the spire is a Tier 3 Loot Chest that requires a Dust Devil Ovis to be killed to open it. As you continue to the spire, there will be a Tier 1 Loot Chest on the way before some parkour has to be completed to reach the interior of the spire.

The interior of the tower will give you permanent jump boost. Several Nimbus Lambs will attack you as you climb up the tower with Wave. As you reach the purple platform, there will be a miniboss fight with the Heat Lightning Caprine and some Pastoris Canors. Once the Caprine has been killed, the Tier 4 Loot Chest will open, and the tower can be exited by jumping into the pool of water below.

intro.text: The Pigman Barbeque is a  Cave found on the Emerald Trail. This is the lowest level cave in the Content Book.

lines.text: This cave only has one room filled with Boars and Zombie Pigmen. There is also one Flame Grilling Swine near the entrance, and one Truffle Sniffer in the pit of mud. At the end of the room is a Tier 3 Loot Chest that unlocks after slaying 4-7 mobs.

intro.text: The Pirate Hold is a  Cave found in the Pirate's Bay.

lines.text: The entrance leads to a large room with an old shipwreck embedded in the wall. Many Cadaverous Pirates and Mutineers are found throughout the cave. A path to the side leads to the end, where the Drunk Captain and a Tier 3  can be found. The chest unlocks after slaying 8-12 nearby mobs.
Category:Cave

intro.text: The Pirate Lattice is a Cave found in the Relos Plateaus. It is one of the caves required to unlock The Corkus Traversal lootrun.

lines.text: The entrance to the cave is guarded by several Pirate Guards and Tamed Wolves. After a while, the latticework of the cave will be reached, serving as the main challenge. Several Pirate-Bots 9001 will appear on the latticework, and threaten to knock you off, causing you to be launched up into the air while taking some damage, while the far more dangerous Cyborg Picaroons will attack from a distance and sometimes cast wave. The projectiles can be avoided by hiding behind several brick walls.

After the first checkpoint, there will be a divergence in the cave. Taking the path to the right will lead to a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires a nearby mob to be killed in order to open it. Continuing straight will lead to a gold stash with a Tier 2  Loot Chest and a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 2 nearby mobs to open. At the second turn is the next checkpoint.
Past the second checkpoint, there will be another crossroads. Taking a left path will lead to a path with a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires a nearby mob to be killed to open it.

Continuing on the main path will lead to the final checkpoint, which leads to a path with a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 2 nearby mobs to be killed. Though this cave can be exited, it can also lead to another cave found nearby, the Pirate Sloop.

intro.text: The Pirate Sloop is a Cave found in Corkus Island, serving as an addon to the Pirate Lattice.

lines.text: The cave is very simple. The only mobs are the Pirate Lieutenant and Captain, alongside a Tier 4  Loot Chest that must be opened by killing the latter.

intro.text: The Plasmatic Gouge is a Cave found in the Canyon of the Lost.

lines.text: The cave has a linear path, with several Plasmatic Shamblers and Shellwalkers attacking you along the way. At the end of the cave is a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires the Plasmatic Seal to be killed to open it.

intro.text: The Quicksand Carvers' Den is a Cave found in the Almuj Desert.

lines.text: The first section of the den is a simple tunnel to the end. Several Quicksand Carvers Bandits will attack you. Near the end is a large open arena with several mobs that has a Tier 3  Loot Chest in the middle, requiring 13 nearby mobs to be killed.
Quicksand Crossers
Quicksand Crossers

intro.text: The Raging Survivor is a Cave found in the Ice Canyon.

lines.text: The cave immediately splits off into three branches at the start, although the left and center ones converge, the right one is a parkour with several Wild Snow Wolves. After you reach the end of the passage, the main miniboss of the cave will appear, the Raging Bandit. Killing the bandit will open a Tier 4  Loot Chest alongside dropping some TNT, which must be used to open the gate to the end.

intro.text: The Raging Tower is a  Tower found in the Detlas Suburbs. This is the main setting of the Taking the Tower  Quest.

This tower was formerly a structure used by the Wynnic army to defend against the Corruption, although in recent times it has fallen to it and has become a corrupted stronghold. At the top lies the commander of this force, the Fire Flak.

lines.text: Zombies surround the bottom of the tower. A ladder inside lead to the next floor, but several Smolders will shoot at the player while climbing. During Taking the Tower, Detlas Soldiers will fight off the Zombies at the ground level. Sometimes higher-level zombies can wander to the bottom of the tower as well.

The second floor of this tower is a brief parkour section with no enemies. Holes in the floor can send the player down as far back as the bottom floor. A Tier 2 Loot Chest is found before the ladder to the third floor..

The third floor of the tower holds a long staircase and a window that leads out of the tower. Zombies guard the bottom of this floor, and Slag Coats, which spawn Cinders on death, defend the staircase. The ladder at the end of the staircase leads to the top of the tower.

The final floor of the tower is a simple boss arena for the Fire Flak miniboss. The Fire Flak has four phases. Its first phase does not move and will occasionally cast flamethrower towards the player. Its second phase gains the ability to fire a large cloud of inaccurate particles towards the player. It also begins to chase the player when it is too far away. When the second phase is defeated, it will split into two Fire Flaks, which have the same HP and elemental stats as the previous phase, but they fire individual shots at the player and lose the Flamethrower ability. Each of the third phase Fire Flaks will split into two Fire Fletchettes, the final phase of the miniboss. The Fletchettes are the same as the previous phase, but they have 100 HP each. A ladder in the middle of the arena leads to a Tier 4 Loot Chest which unlocks after slaying 2 Fire Fletchettes. The beam behind the chest leads to the edge a tower, where the player can safely jump down to land in a pool of water.

- Prior to the 2.0.3 update, the lore of this tower was different, instead being the former tower of a soldier called Van, who would later be forcibly evicted by the corrupted in the tower, causing him to live as a vagrant.

- Prior to the 1.20 update, there was instead a secret found where the cave is now, a minor easter egg could be activated here. Five players would stand on stone pressure plates which would then cause a hole to appear, opening what seems to be a crypt. To exit the crypt, there is a room with a sign that says "A b*w wi** li*ht t*e w*y." (A bow will light the way.), which hinted towards an Archer being needed to exit the crypt.

intro.text: The Raiders' Hideout is a Cave found in the Ice Canyon.

lines.text: The start of the cave has a Tier 2  Loot Chest. Continuing the way to the top, there will be a split pathway, although neither path has any outstanding features. Once you reach the end of the cave, there will be a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires 17 nearby mobs to be killed to open it.

intro.text: The Raiders' Rockhill is a Cave found in the Gylia Plains.

lines.text: The cave is mostly a straightforward path to the end. At the end of the cave is a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 5 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: The Recluse Nest is a Cave found in the Light Forest.

lines.text: The cave starts with several Recluse Spiders attacking you as you enter the cave. A Tier 1  Loot Chest can also be found near the entrance. As you continue, there will be a brief parkour section with some Vile Cocoons. In the room after the parkour, there will be a Tier 2  Loot Chest. Continuing on will lead to a drop that leads to the final room which has a Tier 1  Loot Chest and a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 15 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: The Rocky Peril is a Cave found in the Canyon of the Lost.

lines.text: The cave's first section starts off as parkour. Eventually, a crossroads will be reached. The right path leads to nothing, while the right path leads further into the cave. After the parkour is finished, a few rooms will appear, the first one of which will have a Tier 2  Loot Chest on the left. The final room of the cave is a somewhat open arena with a Tier 4  Loot Chest by the exit of the cave that requires 10 nearby mobs to be killed in order to open it.

intro.text: The Root Slingers' Rut is a Cave found in the Gylia Plains near the Letvus Airbase.

lines.text: The cave is mostly a straightforward path to the end. There are several walls and Root Slingers that will impede your path. At the end of the cave is a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 6 nearby mobs to be killed to open it.

intro.text: The Roots of Infestation is a  Cave found in the Nivla Woods near Alekin Village.

lines.text: The entrance features a small pond encircled by a path. Several Spider-Infested Roots can be found along the path.
There is a small parkour section that leads to the end of the cave with more Spider-Infested Roots and a Tier 3  Loot Chest, which unlocks after slaying 8-12 mobs.

intro.text: The Rotten Altar is a Cave found in the Troms Jungle.

lines.text: The cave is a simple passage to the end. Halfway through the cave is a hidden Tier 2  Loot Chest. At the end of the cave is a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 17 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: The Runaway Fleris Cranny is a Cave found in the Canyon of the Lost.

lines.text: The cave immediately starts with a crossroads, although the only path to take is the left path, as the right one will simply lead outside the cave. As you continue on, 2 Tier 2  will appear in some of the stashes. At the end of the cave is a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires 13 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: The Scarred Ingress is a Cave found in the Sky Islands. It is one of the caves that must be completed in order to unlock the Sky Islands Exploration Lootrun.

lines.text: The cave is mostly a straightforward path to the end. Several Abiogens and Leyline Elementals will attack you as you descend. At the bottom of the cave is an open area with a hidden Tier 1  Loot Chest and a miniboss named the Primordial Earth, which must be killed to open a nearby Tier 4  Loot Chest. After the chest is opened, you then head down the path the Tier 1  Loot Chest is on to the other side of the cave.

intro.text: Scorched Earth is a Cave found in the Upper Molten Heights.

lines.text: The cave starts as a straightforward path to the end. The King of Scorchers will appear before some parkour appears. Halfway through the parkour is a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 7 nearby mobs to be killed to open it.

intro.text: The Secret Mine is a level 46 Cave found in the Llevigar Plains.

lines.text: At the start of the cave is a Tier 2  Loot Chest. The cave is mostly a simple passage to the end, though there are some bridges without any railings, which can cause the Spitter Critters to knock the player into the water. Mired Miners will also attack the player. At the end of the cave is a Tier 3  Loot Chest which requires 10 nearby mobs to be killed. A Tier 2  Loot Chest can also be found near it.

intro.text: The Seismic Bore Hole is a Cave found in the Canyon of the Lost.

lines.text: The cave is mostly a straightforward path to the end. Several Rock Bagworms hang from the ceiling while several Earth Borer Beetles will scurry on the ground. At the end of the cave is a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires the mysterious Seismic Seal to be killed.

intro.text: The Sewer Herps are a Cave found in the Olux Swamp.

lines.text: The first room has the player fight various mobs in waves, with there being 4 waves in total, having 3 mobs for the first 3 and a miniboss for the last wave. After the Subterranean Beast has been killed, the door opens to the next room.

The second room is a battle with the Subterranean Overlord. Falling off of the arena will kick you back to the entrance of the cave. After the Subterranean Overlord is defeated, you get access to a Tier 2  Loot Chest and a Tier 4  Loot Chest.

intro.text: The Shadow Altar is a Cave found in the Lower Molten Heights.

lines.text: The entrance of the cave is found through some tunnels which lead to parkour. Eventually an area will be reached with several Byrnic Imps, along with a priest that serves as a miniboss. Killing the Byrnic Imp Priest will drop a  Ritual Stone. Placing it inside the stone in the middle of the lava at the altar will open a 3-by-3 netherrack door to the left, revealing the path to the main boss of the cave, the Shadow Dwarf. Killing the Shadow Dwarf will open a hole in the middle of the arena to a Tier 4  Loot Chest along with the exit.
Category:Boss Caves

intro.text: The Shadow Spears Refuge is a Cave found in the Rymek Mesa.

lines.text: The refuge starts off as a simple corridor to the end with several buildings within. Make your way past the rubble and a crossroads will appear. The central room contains a Tier 2  Loot Chest and a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires 11 nearby mobs to be killed. Taking the path to the right will lead to a small overlook to one of the prior rooms with a Tier 2  Loot Chest.
Shadow Spear
Shadow Spear

intro.text: The Shineridge Orc Camp is a level 45 Camp found in the Llevigar Plains.

lines.text: The Shineridge Orc Camp is about the size of other larger Orc camps such as Loamsprout, Sablestone, and Cliffhearth. However, unlike most other Orc camps, almost all of the mobs in Shineridge are neutral except for Rai-Senmi.
There is an extra Tier 1  Loot Chest found at -1614, 47, -4646.

In the center of Shineridge is a large bonfire with two Tier 3  and one Tier 4  Loot Chests. The western Tier 3  Loot Chest requires 30 nearby mobs to be killed while the eastern Tier 3  Loot Chest requires 5 Shineridge Orc Barkers to be killed. The sole Tier 4 chest requires Shineridge Rai-Senmi to be killed, which is a challenging miniboss found in the largest tent in Shineridge.

intro.text: The Shock Shrine is a level 75 Cave found in Aldorei Valley.

lines.text: The cave is a straightforward path to the end. At the end of the cave is the Electrified Elf, a Tier 2  Loot Chest, and a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 9 nearby mobs to be killed in order to open it.

intro.text: The Shroom Sleeper Dugout is a Cave found in the Light Forest.

lines.text: The cave is mostly a straightforward path to the end. Near the end of the first section is a door that requires 2 Sleeper Spores to open it, which are obtained from brown Shroom Sleepers. After the door is opened, the drop down will reveal a small room with a Tier 2  Loot Chest. Continuing on will lead to the final room with a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires 5 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: Siltswimmer Den is a Cave found in the Frog Bog subregion of the Auburn Forest.

lines.text: The cave's entrance leads to a single room with a Tier 4  Loot Chest that requires 3 Siltswimmers to be killed.

intro.text: The Sink Hole is a level 55 Cave found in the Olux Swamp.

lines.text: Felimgember Frogs will be guarding the entrance of the cave. Nearby is a Tier 1  Loot Chest and a Tier 2  Loot Chest. The cave's structure is a maze, with several Felimgember Frogs and Sinking Slimes. At the left end of the maze is a room with a Tier 3  Loot Chest requiring the miniboss of that part of the cave to be killed, the Coal Spider. On the opposite end is the exit of the cave alongside a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires the miniboss of the cave, the Under Dweller to be killed.

intro.text: Skien's Prison Block is a Cave found in Skiens Island. It is involved in the quest Reincarnation.

lines.text: The prison block has several cells within. Some cells can be opened by pressing buttons, and they can easily be exited by also pressing a button by the door. One cell has blood leading towards it, and it must be opened by using a key dropped by the warden. Inside the warden's room is a Tier 1  Loot Chest. Going back to the door the blood leads to, you must drop the key into the hopper. Inside the cell is one of Bob's loyal companions, Mooington, who must be killed to open a Tier 3  Loot Chest. To exit the cell, press the wooden button to open the door.

intro.text: The Sky Shroom is a Boss Cave found in the Sky Islands.

lines.text: The Skyshroom itself is found near the edge of the island with several Skyshroom Enthusiasts being found near it, the latter of which become Riled Skyshroom Enthusiasts after being killed. Once the Skyshroom is killed, a parkour will appear which leads to the reward room, containing 2 Tier 2  Loot Chests and a Tier 4  Loot Chest.
Category:Boss Caves

intro.text: The Sol Hive is a Cave found in the Llevigar Plains.

lines.text: The start of the cave has several Sol Hornets attacking you as you move on. At the end is an open area with a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 10 nearby mobs to be killed.

intro.text: The Spider Mother Grove is a  Cave found in the Nivla Woods.

lines.text: This cave is entered by jumping through the webs in the middle of a tall stone nest. There is a small web-infested room with many Spider Eggs, which release Forest Spiders after a short time. The next room is a small arena with more Spider Eggs and the Spider Mother miniboss. In the middle of the arena is a Tier 3 Loot Chest that unlocks after slaying the Spider Mother. There is also an exit at the end that is blocked with the same restriction.
During the Infested Plants Quest, there is an additional room past the exit door that contains the saccharum plant.
| Spider Egg

| Spider Mother Grove
- Although the cave itself was used in Infested Plants, it did not become a Cave in the Content Book until Version 2.1.1.

intro.text: The Spiteful Crossing is a Cave found in the Eyeball Forest. It is one of the caves required to unlock the Silent Expanse Expedition lootrun.

lines.text: The first room is an invisible maze, the path of which can be found by looking at the ground. Several Jealous Spitefuls will attack you as you traverse the maze.

The second room is a simple path to the end which has a Tier 4  Loot Chest at the end that requires 3 nearby mobs to be killed. The Spiteful Flatter is also at the end of the room, serving as the miniboss of the cave.

intro.text: The Spore Spiral is a  Cave found on the Black Road.

lines.text: The cave is a circular, fungus-infested tunnel with large amounts of Spore Launchers and Fungal Knights throughout. There are multiple raised areas with more mobs that are accessible using different paths. At the end there are Sentient Polypores and a Tier 3  Loot Chest. The chest unlocks after slaying 1 Sentient Polypore.

intro.text: The Statue Opening is a Cave found in the Eyeball Forest. It is one of the caves required to unlock the Silent Expanse Expedition lootrun.

lines.text: The cave only has one section, a large open arena with passive Mystical Statues inhabiting it. However, the Mystical Statues will turn into hostile creatures when killed. A Tier 3  Loot Chest is found in the center which requires 6 Statue Keys to be given to it to unlock it.

intro.text: Steamworks is a Cave found in the Relos Plateaus. It is one of the caves that must be done to unlock The Corkus Traversal lootrun.

lines.text: The first room of Steamworks is a parkour section. While the first section of this room is over a small stream, the second part is on a white structure. At the top is a spike that must be right-clicked to make it puncture the floor and the way to the second room.

The second room of this cave starts off with a quick way down to the final section, although a Tier 3  Loot Chest will be skipped. By 2 Deepwater Steambots is a Tier 2  Loot Chest. Continue through the pipe by going straight. There will be a battling section followed by a thin path on a small stream which then leads into a parkour section, although if you can climb the rope in the center of the room, you can avoid going through the parkour at all. When the parkour is finished a section will then appear which has the tier 3 chest mentioned priorly, requiring 6 mobs to be killed to open it. After that section is a boss arena with the Fission Guardian, who must be killed to open the Tier 4  Loot Chest at the end.

intro.text: The Submerged Coal Mine is a Cave found in the Ice Canyon.

lines.text: The cave starts off with you shattering the sheet of ice above the cave by jumping on it. Afterwards it is a simple passage to the end. At the end is a miniboss arena with a Tier 4  Loot Chest that must be opened by killing the Corrupted Foreman.

intro.text: The Subterranean Mire is a Cave found in the Dernel Jungle.

lines.text: The cave starts off with a quick path to a brief parkour section. A Tier 1  Loot Chest can be found to the right of the parkour. Another Tier 1  Loot Chest can be found on the path to the end. At the end of the cave is a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 19 nearby mobs to be killed. Hidden in an alcove in the near-left corner of the room is a Tier 2  Loot Chest, which can sometimes have a Suspicious Spot spawn there.

intro.text: The Sundial Sanctum is a level 34-45 Cave Complex found in the Almuj Desert.

lines.text: The Sundial Sanctum has 13 different sections, a central hub room and 12 rooms which each have a miniboss inside of them, along with a Tier 3  Loot Chest for each of them except the one in Room XII, being a Tier 4  Loot Chest.
The hub room has all of the miniboss rooms as well as an exit located on a rope.
I: Cora the Servant (Lv. 34)
Cora the Servant is the miniboss of Room I, and needs to be killed in order to open a Tier 3  Loot Chest.
II: Dune Crawler (Lv. 35)
The Dune Crawler is the miniboss of Room II, and needs to be killed in order to open a Tier 3  Loot Chest.
III: Rhoda & Rena (Lv. 36)
Rhoda & Rena are the minibosses of Room III, and both of them need to be killed in order to open a Tier 3  Loot Chest.
IV: Huntsman (Lv. 37)
The Huntsman is the miniboss of Room IV, and needs to be killed in order to open a Tier 3  Loot Chest. Spiderlings also spawn as minions throughout its fight.
V: The Monolyth (Lv. 38)
The Monolyth is the miniboss of Room V, and needs to be killed in order to open a Tier 3  Loot Chest.
VI: Philo (Lv. 39)
Philo is the miniboss of Room VI, and needs to be killed in order to open a Tier 3  Loot Chest.
VII: Bazaar Bandit (Lv. 40)
The Bazaar Bandit is the miniboss of Room VII, and needs to be killed in order to open a Tier 3  Loot Chest.
VIII: Ozias (Lv. 41)
Ozias is the miniboss of Room VIII, and needs to be killed in order to open a Tier 3  Loot Chest. Time Frozen Effigies will be on the corners of the arena.
IX: The Unseeing (Lv. 42)
The Unseeing is the miniboss of Room IX, and needs to be killed in order to open a Tier 3  Loot Chest.
X: Mirages (Lv. 43)
Four Mirages are the minibosses of Room X, but only one needs to be killed in order to open a Tier 3  Loot Chest.
XI: Hippos & Xenophon (Lv. 44)
Hippos & Xenophon are the minibosses of Room XI, and both of them need to be killed in order to open a Tier 3  Loot Chest.
XII: Superintendent of the Sundial (Lv. 45)

The Superintendent of the Sundial is the boss of Room XII and the Sundial Sanctum as a whole. Its arena is larger compared to the other minibosses, and it must be killed in order to open a Tier 4  Loot Chest.

intro.text: The Sunken Ship is a  Cave found off of Nemract's docks following the Underwater Route. This cave is mostly underwater, so it is recommended to bring the Breathing Helmet from the Underwater  Quest.

lines.text: The entrance is a dive into an underwater tunnel. Passive Shoreline Squids and a hostile Tiderider Squid will be encountered shortly after entering. Near the squids, there is a Tier 2  Loot Chest at the bottom nested in iron blocks. The underwater section ends near some wooden wreckage. Proceeding upward will lead to the end of the cave; however, entering the wall of wreckage will lead to another Tier 2  Loot Chest. The underwater tunnel opens into an air-filled chamber filled with treasure, Wriggling Lampreys, and a Tier 4  Loot Chest that unlocks after slaying 6-7 nearby mobs.
Category:Cave

intro.text: The Swamp Hill is a Cave found in the Olux Swamp.

lines.text: The cave is a straightforward path to the end. At the end, there is a Tier 3  Loot Chest that can be opened by killing 3 nearby mobs.

intro.text: The Temple Entrance is a Cave found in the Dernel Jungle.

lines.text: The cave starts off with a path. The first left path will have a Tier 2  Loot Chest by an altar, while the right path leads to a dead end. Continuing on, there will be an open area which has a Tier 1  Loot Chest tucked away in the near-left corner. Continuing on will lead to a lush area of the cave. The straight path will have a Tier 1  Loot Chest at the top of it. The right path will have a hidden Tier 2  Loot Chest, and the end will have a Tier 3  Loot Chest that requires 10 nearby mobs to be killed.
Rarely, Suspicious Spots can spawn in this cave.

intro.text: The Termite Mounds are several structures that make up a single  Cave Complex in the Savannah. This unique cave has three separate entrances that each have their own loot.

lines.text: All three mounds lead to this large central room on its east side. There are normally no mobs upon entering the room, but there may be some Termites dropped by Winged Termites if you entered the southern mound. The room forms a ring, so if your goal is to exit the cave quickly, follow the ring counterclockwise until you reach the Splutter Snake and red boulders that mark an exit door. Alternatively, continue moving counterclockwise to reach a tunnel filled with Termites and a Tier 2  Loot Chest. There is also a large pit with a single Winged Termite over the entrance; this leads deeper into the cave. The bottom of the pit has a puddle of water to soften your fall, but you will also find many more Termites. Heading forward will lead to a short parkour defended by a Winged Termite and a Splutter Snake. Near the end of the cave is the Corpse of Guile miniboss. This mob uses Weakness, Slowness, and Multihit spells, which can be difficult to avoid in the cramped space. Defeating the miniboss releases a few more Termites and unlocks a Tier 4  Loot Chest. Both exits of the cave teleport to the entrance of the southern mound.
Category:Cave Complexes

intro.text: The Alcazar is a  Cave located in Time Valley.

lines.text: The entrance is a cavern path with Ruin Swoopers and a few short ladders to climb up. To the left, there is a vantage point on top of a ruined structure, while the staircase to the next room is straight ahead.

At the top of the staircase is a hallway with Idle Attendants inside. The hall leads to a dining room with many Famished Specters seated around a dinner table. Keep moving to reach the doorway found on the right, or else the Specters can become overwhelming. This door leads to a snowy chamber with a pip in the middle and an opening to the sky. More Idle Attendants are found here, as well as a Groundskeeper in the back. The pipe in the middle has an opening opposite of entrance to the room, which can be dropped into to the next section of the cave.

Falling down leads you to a decayed, moldy dungeon filled with Eternally Sentenced, which turn into Hateful Skulls upon death. There are also some Idle Attendants and Ruin Swoopers. To progress, press the button on the wall, highlighted with bright blocks. This opens the door to go further into the cave, but it will also open the cell doors and release the mobs inside. There is a Tier 1  Loot Chest inside the cell to the right of the This button. Heading forward will lead to a second button that opens all of the nearby doors. There is another Tier 1  Loot Chest in the cell directly opposite the button.
The next section is a long spiral staircase back up out of the dungeon. There are 4 alcoves in the wall, each one holding a Groundskeeper that will try to attack as you head upward.

The spiral staircase leads to an overgrown chamber where the main miniboss of the dungeon, the Grasslands Paladin, resides. The Paladin starts in an immobile ranged phase, where it will cast the Pull and Weakness spells. However, it has a very short aggro range, so you will be safe  hiding back in the tunnel or on the other side of the room. Killing the Paladin will progress to the next phase, where it begins moving and switches to melee attacks. It also begins casting the Charge, Pull, and Multihit spells. There is a ladder behind the miniboss that leads to a Tier 1  Loot Chest, a Tier 2  Loot Chest, and a Tier 4 , the latter only unlocking after slaying the Grasslands Paladin. Heading right leads to a small drop, where the exit can be found in a very narrow walkway on the right. There is also a hidden Tier 1  Loot Chest on top of the collapsed dirt straight ahead. The exit of the cave drops into a pond of water at the bottom of a tower outside.

intro.text: is a Cave found in Aelumia Citadel.

lines.text: The cave starts on the second floor of the central tower in the military sector. Heading straight and turning left on the bridge leads to a junction. At the end of each path is a Tier 3  Loot Chest guarded by a Gendarme Knight which must be slain. On the left path, the knight can be found inside of a hole. On the other, they are found inside of a tower.

Backtracking back to the tower entrance, heading up one floor and turning left towards the capital's inner ring leads to the last Tier 3  Loot Chest in another hole, unlocked by killing its respective Gendarme Knight.

intro.text: The Donjon is a Cave found in the Sky Islands. It is one of the caves that must be completed in order to unlock the Sky Islands Exploration.

lines.text: The castle is blocked by a gate that requires Red, Lime, and Cyan Keys to open it.
The Red Key can be found in the path that is marked by a red banner.
The Lime Key can be found on top of the statue of the white dragon. The path to the top of the statue is marked by carpets.
The Cyan Key can be found by the pond right by the gate.

The start of the castle has a Tier 1 Loot Chest at the start of it. Eventually a room with several Exploding Seed Pods will appear, and a Tier 2 Loot Chest will be hidden under a staircase. In the next room will be a crossroads in the castle alongside a Tier 3 Loot Chest that requires 15 nearby Castle Vampyrs to be killed. Going right at the crossroads will lead to a room with a Tier 1 Loot Chest within, while the straight path leads to parkour necessary to progress. After this, the outside of the castle will be reached.
